name: Abies Canadensis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It is one of the remarkbale remedies in the treatment of chronic gastric affections and uterine

disorders.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Indigestion. Liver disorder. Uterine disorder.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS
sections.content: It acts on stomach and uterus, heart, lungs. It produces catarrhal condition of stomach.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Great debility with strong desire to lie down and rest most of the time.

2) Gnawing, hungry, faint feeling at the epigastrium.

3) Great appetite, even tendency to eat far beyond the capacity for digestion.

4) Craving for meat, pickles, radishes, turnips, coarse food etc. is peculiar.

5) Chilliness is very characteristic especially when associated with peculiar cravings and prostration.

6) A remedy for uterine displacement with sore feeling at fundus of uterus relieved by pressure.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Stomach

Gastric symptoms are the most prominent Symptoms to guide us in our selection of Abies Can. There is canine hunger which gnaws in the stomach causing, a sort of fainting feeling at the epigastrium. The patient does not know how much he eats and very often there is excessive loading of the stomach which causes distention of stomach & abdomen with severe palpitation of heart.

Female genital Organs

Uterine prolapsus with sore feeling at fundus of uterus, relieved by pressure. Prostration; wants to lie down all the time. She thinks womb is soft & feeble.

name: Abies Nigra
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: A powerful and long acting remedy, in various kinds of diseases, whenever the characteristic stomach symptoms are present.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Constipation. Dyspepsia,

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content: The most specific action of this remedy is on stomach and also on heart and lungs.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Sensation as if a hard-boiled egg had lodged in the cardiac end of stomach.

2) Pain in stomach always comes after eating.

3) Wakeful and restless at night, with hunger.

4) Dyspeptic troubles of the aged after abuse of tea or tobacco.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastrointestinal Symptoms

It is a grand remedy in dyspepsia especially of the aged, habituated to excess of tea and tobacco. They are generally low spirited and dull and have wakeful nights. The most characteristic symptom of Abies N. is the sensation as if a hard boiled egg had lodged in the cardiac end of stomach. The patient may describe this as a feeling as though he had swallowed some indigestible substance which had stuck in his stomach. Severe pain in stomach is felt after eating. Total loss of appetite in morning, but great craving for food at noon & night. Dyspepsia with functional heart symptoms.

Chest

There is painful sensation, as if something were lodged in the chest and had to be coughed up. Chest cannot be fully expanded. Sharp, cutting pain in heart ; heart's action heavy & slow, tachycardia. Dyspnoea worse lying down. Water brash succeeds cough, worse coughing.

Relation : Compare, China, Bryo, Puls, in Lump in Stomach; also Thuja, Sabina, Nux Vor, Kali Carb

name: Abrotanum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Abrotanum is a very useful medicine derived from the vegetable kingdom. The mother tincture is prepared from fresh leaves of the plant, which abundantly grows in Southern Europe. This is a remedy often required in cases of Marasmus in children and for Rheumatism caused by checked diarrhoea or other secretions. Abrotanum is one of the drugs having prominent alternating actions.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Chilblains, Gout, Haemorrhoids, Hectic Fever, Hydrocele, Indigestion, Lientery, Marasmus, Pleurisy, Rheumatism, Umbilicus, Oozing

from, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The chief centres of action of Abrotanum are gastro-intestinal tract, nerves, mind, fibrous tissue and serous membrane.

PATHOGENESIS

Its action on gastro-intestinal system causes disturbed digestion, defective assimilation, impaired nutrition, lientery distension of abdomen resulting in progressive emaciation and marasmus. While its action on fibrous tissue produces rheumatic and gouty manifestation, its affection on serous membrane sets in pleurisy, hydrocele etc.

CONSTITUTION

Make up of the body : The patients, usualy a child, is emaciated especially more marked in Lower Extremities old looking face; face pale and wrinkled; the skin is flabby and hangs loose in folds; head is weak and the child cannot hold it up.

Temperature : Cruel and inhuman temperament. Relation with heat and cold : Chilly patients.

Miasm : Psora is in the background of all the troubles, Diathesis : Tubercular diathesis,

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Great progressive wasting, specially more in the Lower Extremities.

2. Ravenous appetite; eats well, loses flesh while living well (lod; Nat.mur; Sanie; Tub).

3. Lientery, i.e. stool contains undigested food particles; alternate diarrhoea and constipation (Ant.c; Nux v; Sulph; Verat.alb; Ant. t; Podo; Chelid).

4. Rheumatic conditions with heart irritation, epistaxis, bloody urine, anxiety and trembling. Rheumatism without swelling, but Gout with swelling and inflammation, Rheumatism alternates with haemorrhoids and dysentery (Kali bich).

5. Hydrocele in children; oozing of blood and moisture from navel of new born (Calc. phos.), (of urine Hyos).

6. Angioma of the face.

7. Mind : The patient is very cruel; always wants to do something cruel; irritable and ill natured, violent and inhuman, cross and despondent; with incapacity to think.

8. Aliments from : Suddenly checked diarrhoea or other secretions, malnutrition, defective digestion and absorption.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Marasmus

Causation: Impaired nutrition, defective digestion and imperfect assimilation and absorption.

Character: Progressive marasmus of children, with marked emaciation of Lower Extremities. Ascending type of emaciation. The child is very weak and is unable to hold up head; great weakness and disturbed digestion.

Concomitants : There is ravenous appetite; the child eats well, still progressive emaciation is well marked and continues to lose flesh. Along with this, there is great weakness and prostration and a kind of hectic fever.

Such children usually pass lienteric stool; suffer from alternate obstinate constipation and diarrhoea. The baby is chilly, mentally irritable and ill-natured.

In marasmus

Abrotanum can be compared with Aethusa-eyn, lodum Natrum mur, Silicea, Calcarea phos, Tuberculinum and Sulphur which are as follows :

1. Aethusa cyn : It is generally indicated in acute attacks of the baby caused by heat of summer, during dentition and due to intolerance of milk. The baby cannot bear milk in any form; it is vomited out in large curds as soon as taken, Indigestion of teething children; diarrhoea and vomiting especially in hot summer weather; followed by great weakness, prostration and sleepiness complete absence of thirst; child is unable to hold up head; incapacity to think with well marked linea-nasalis.

2. lodum : lodum is the hottest baby. Baby has scrofulous and tubercular diathesis, cachectic condition, profound debility and emaciaiton of the whole body, but with hypertropy and induration of all the glands. The baby has great, Ravenous hunger, eats freely and well, yet

name: Acalypha Indica
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: There is controversy about the first prover of this medicine. Dr. N.M. Chowdhury says that, “This remedy was first proved by Dr. P.C. Mazumder of Calcutta” where as Dr. S.C. Ghosh in his “Drugs of Hindoosthan” says that “Dr. C.F. Tonnere, a french homoeopath made a proving of Acalypha Indica and called attention to this plant as a valuable remedy”. Dr. Mahendra Lai Sirkar has also conducted the proving of this medicine through his disciple Babu Joy Kissen Ghoshal. Acalypha Indica is an infallible remedy for haemorrhages especially haemoptysis in our Materia Medica.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Bronchiectasis. Cough. Diarrhoea. Flatulence. Haemoptysis. Incipient phthisis.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Respiratory symptoms : Acalypha Indica is employed in the beginning of phthisis associated with hard, dry and severe cough followed by bloody expectoration. Expectoration of pure bright red blood comes on in morning and dark clotted blood in the evening. Cough most violent at night. There is dullness of chest on percussion and severe pain in chest with progressive emaciation, night sweat & evening rise of temperature. It is indicated in incipient phthisis with hard, racking cough, bloody expectoration, arterial haemorrhage but no febrile disturbance.

Gastrointestinal symptoms : This medicine also has marked action on the alimentary canal characterised by burning in intestines, sensation of weight in stomach, flatulence and spluttering diarrhoea with forcible expulsion of noisy flatus. (Calc. Phos.) Rectal haemorrhage worse in the morning.

N.B. Author has releived hundreds of cases of haemoptysis when there is active, bright red bleeding from the respiratory passages (From bladder : Erigeron, haemorrhage from piles-Mill.)

name: Acetic Acid
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Although debility and prostration run through all the acids, these are more marked in Acetic Acid, Mur. Ac., Phos Ac. and Sulph. Ac. For cachectic condition or anaemia or pallor or excessive wasting and dropsical condition, Acetic Acid leads the other acids of our Materia Medica. Guernsey says, “Vinegar must be remembered as an antidote to all anaesthetic vapors— chloroform, ether etc. as well as fumes of charcoal.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anaemia. Croup. Diabetes. Diarrhoea. Dropsy. Fevers. Phthisis. Haemorrhage. Vomiting. Stomach- Cancer of. Marasmus. Corns. Warts.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS
sections.content:
It produces a sort of anaemia with debility, loss of flesh, cough, dropsical swelling & haemorrhage. CONSTITUTIOIN

Physical Make up : Adopted to pale, lean persons with lax, flabby muscles. Face is pale & waxy.

Heat cold relation : Sensitive to cold (Kent) Temperament : Irritable, borrows trouble.

Diathesis :Haemorrhagic. _

Miasm :All three miasms.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Great burning thirst, insatiable even for large quantities but no thirst in fever.

2) Great prostration—after injuries, anaesthetics and surgical shock and with other complaints.

3) Haemorrhage from every mucous outlet : nose, throat, lungs, stomach, bowels and uterus.

4) Profound anaemia with waxy pallor of the face,

5) Great emaciation especially of the face, hands, & thighs (Nash)

10

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastrointestinal Symptoms

Acetic Acid is indicated in various kinds of gastrointestinal diseases; it covers even advanced stage of peptic ulcer, malignancy of stomach, intestinal tuberculosis etc. The symptoms are : sour belching and vomiting after every kind of food, burning waterbrash and profuse salivation with fermentation in stomach. There is violent burning pain in stomach and chest followed by coldness of skin and cold sweat on forehead. Cold drinks disagree but patient has intense burning thirst.

Diarrhoea

Chronic diarrhoea of emaciated children. Diarrhoea in dropsy, typhus, phthisis, exhausting, copious, frequent watery stools worse in the morning. Diarrhoea with great thirst & night sweats.

Urinary Symptoms :

Copious pale urine is the characteristic of Acetic acid in Diabetes Mellitus if associated with intense burning thirst and dry hot skin and debility.

Dropsy : It is one of the prominent medicines for dropsy associated with diabetes and gastrointestinal diseases. With dropsical condition, there is profound anaemia with waxy pallor of the face, Dropsy with great thirst and debility, emaciation, sour belching, waterbrash and diarrhoea. Patient cannot sleep lying on back but rests better Iving on belly.

Fever : Especially indicated in hectic fever with drenching night sweat & prostration. Skin dry and hot. There is red spot on left cheek. No thirst in fever is characteristic. There may be profuse salivation and stomach disorder with fever. Patient feels better by lving on belly.

Relations : It antidotes anaesthetic vapors. (Amyl.); fumes of charcoal and gas; Opium and Stramoniurm.

Cider Vinegar antidotes Carbolic acid. Follows well : after cinchona, in haemorrhage; after Digitalis, in dropsy.

name: Aconitum Napellus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: There are several remedies derived, proved and established from Aconite family, the most important of which is Aconitum Napellus. Aconite is one of the deadliest and most rapidly acting poison; yet, through Hahnemann’s discoveries, it has been transformed into one of the best of the nurseries. sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. “Tension” is the key-note of Aconite (Key-note of Belladonna is congestion). Due to irritation of the mind and affection of circulation, tension always prevails in Aconite patients.

2. Aconite is indicated in the first stage of any acute case which starts suddenly and violently like a storm.

3. It is one of the Trios of restlessness (others being Arsenic and Rhus tox.). The patient is very much restless. Cannot remain in one place. He is full of energy, vigor and strength; as such, moves frequently from place to place. (Aconite patient moves quite frequently because physically he is very strong and he can move about, but in Arsenic the patient is too weak to move although he wants.)

4. There is great fear and anxiety of mind : intense nervousness. The very face of Aconite expresses FEAR and this remedy is curative of ailments from fright, mental or physical. The patient tosses about in agony; life is rendered miserable by fear.

5. Fear and fright are the most characteristic manifestations of Aconite—fear of death even predicts the time of death. (In Arsenic patients too, there is fear of death. He feels that the disease is fatal and he is surely going to die. But the difference is that Arsenic patient does not predict the time of death and he feels that the. disease in incurable and fatal. Therefore, there is no use of taking any medicine; hence no doctor is to be called, The Aconite patient thinks that unless proper medicine is taken, he is going to die and, therefore, wants the doctor to be called immediately.)

6. Dry and hot skin with rare sweat (Nash). (Where there is sweat it is only on the parts rested upon—Boericke).

7. According to Nash, Aconite is one of the greatest pain remedies. His Trios of pain remedies are Aconite, Chamomilla and Coffea. Aconite screams with pain, pains

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Exposure to dry cold air, exposure to draught of cold air, while in perspiration, bad effects of checked perspiration, fear, fright, shock, heat of sun, excitement, etc.

Location ; Intense pain is felt in the frontal region or semi-laterally.

Sensation : Headache as if nailed up; drives him crazy; fullness and heaviness in forehead, as if the skull would be forced out through the forehead. Burning headache as if the brain were agitated by boiling water. Sensation of fulness and throbbing in the head,

Modalities

¢ Aggravation: Towards the evening and at night, when going to bed. Pains are worse in a warm room and when lying on affected side,

* Ameliorafion : In the open air. Concomitants: Fear of death, anxiety, worry, mental uneasiness and restlessness.

Cough

Causation : Cough may be caused due to exposure to dry cold air, dry North or West wind, or exposure to draught of cold air; checked perspiration, etc. The cough may.come along with fever or cough itself may start violently.

Character of cough : It is sudden and violent. It may be croupy in nature. Cough is dry, hoarse, suffocating, loud, rough, croaking, hard, ringing and whistling.

Modalities

¢ Aggravation : On expiration, towards evening and at night. ¢ Amelioration: In the open air.

Dysentery

Causation : Fear, fright, shock, heat of sun. or® excitement. Mode of onset : Sudden and violent.

Character of stool ; There is sudden agonising pain in the abdomen. Severe tenesmus and gripping colicky pain. Frequent stool, stool contains undigested food particles, mucus and bright red blood; frequent desire to defaecate.

Modalities : Attack severe and more towards evening and at night.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Some confusions may arise in the minds of the students due to different names applied to this remedy and, therefore, appearing in different parts of Materia Medica. It was Hughes who preferred it to be called by its Linnaean-name Actaea. Others who supported him rank from Hering, Clarke, Allen, Genius Kent and Guernsey, whereas it was Nash, Boericke, Roger and Stanels, in opposition who named it as Cimicifuga. Hughe’s Pharmacodynamic reveals its nick-name. “The Homoeopathic milk for the Allopathic Babes” for his Object was, evidently to reconcile Homoeopathy or at least. make it acceptable to the members of the orthodox school of medicine.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abortion tendency to, Breast affections, Chest affections, Disorders of Pregnancy, Puerperal mania, Headache, Heart affection, Labour, Menstrual disorders, Rheumatism, Vomiting of pregnancy, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Acts especially upon the entire nervous system and female generative organs. As far as the nervous system is concerned, it acts especially on the cerebro-spinal nerves and especially on the motor nerves as well as upon the uterus, ovaries and joints.

Te

PATHOGENESIS

It disturbs the nerve centres and produces irritation. It also increases arterial tension, eee

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: There is no particular look of the patient.

ved eee .-' 5

Temperament: Hysterical temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm; Psora is in the background. Diathesis: Rheumatic and gouty diathesis.

1. All the symptoms are WORSE DURING MENSES: more profuse the flow, greater the sufferings.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: From cold, damp wet weather. The headache is also of rheumatic origin,

Sensation: Sore, bruised feeling all over the head; bruised sensation in the occiput; sore, bruised feeling on the top of head, as if top of the head would fly off.

Character: Shooting and throbbing pains in the head from reflex symptoms of uterus. Brain feels too large with waving sensation or opening and shutting sensation in the head, Pains as if pressing outward, Pressing type of headache with soreness in the back of neck.

With headache, the eye balls are very sore; feels pain if he turns head to any direction with ciliary neuralgia, aching or sharp, darting, shooting pain in the globes extending” to the temples, vertex and

occiput.

Modalities

* Aggravation: From going upstairs; during menses; weather changes; cold damp weather.

* Amelioration: By lying down.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This is a rheumatic & gouty remedy and it has special affinity for smaller joints. It is especially suited to old people.

CLINICAL :

Rheumatism.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Rheumatism

This remedy has special affinity for smaller joints, particularly the wrist. The joints start aching and swelling after a slight excercise. Affected joints are swollen and in affected limb great weakness is felt as if paralysed. There is extreme tenderness to touch, weakness & tingling. The right arm and right wrist are specially affected.

Pains are of a violent, tearing, drawing character & are worse by touch or movement. Pains of this kind running from decayed tooth to temples.

Modality : Aggravation— at night, motion and change of weather, fatigue.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Hale writes of Aesculus, “A veritable polychrest having a wide range of action, but like some other polychrests it has a central point of action from which radiates a series of reflex symptoms.

This central point of action is the liver and portal system and nine out of every ten of its symptoms are due to this action.” It is one of our great haemorhoidal remedies.

CLINICAL :

Backache. Constipation. Coryza. Haemorrhoids. Liver-affection of Uterine—affection of. SPHERES OF ACTION :

It appears to have a marked influence on the venous especially portal system, liver and lumbo-sacral articulation.

Mucous membrances of mouth, throat, rectum also come under the domain of this remedy.

Pathogenesis : It produces many symptoms of disordered liver resulting engorged haemorhoidal veins. Due to congestion of veins sense of fullness, dryness, heat & pain are produced.

Constitution : It is suitable to persons having haemorrhoidal tendencies and who suffer with gastric, bilioiis or catarrhal troubles. It is an antipsoric medicine. GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Severe dull backache in lumbo-sacral articulation; more or less constant, affecting sacrum & hips is the greatest concomitant symptom.

2) Sensation of fullness in various parts such as heart, lungs, stomach, anus, brain, pelvis etc.

3) Piles-purple, painful, burning, blind, rarely bleeding.

4) Stool followed by fullness of rectum and intense pain in anus for hours (Aloe., Ign., Mur. Ac., Nit.ac. Sulph., Ratan., Paeonia.)

5) Frequent inclination to swallow, with burning, pricking stinging and dry constricted fauces (Apis., Bell.)

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Nose

Mucous membrance is dry, swollen. Inspired air feels cold & nasal passages are sensitive to cold air. Sneezing, followed by severe coryza with thin watery burning discharge and sensation of rawness.

Modality : Aggravation ; Cold air, after washing.

Throat

A medicine for follicular pharyngitis where dry-ness, roughness, rawness & sensitiveness to inspired air are characteristic symptoms. There is also violent burning like fire on swallowing. Frequent inclination to swallow, with burning, pricking, stinging and dry constricted fauces. Patient hawks ropy mucus of sweetish taste.

Backache

Location-Aesculus Hip. has special affinity for lumbo-sacral articulation. Severe dull backache in lumbosacral articulation which is more or less constant. There is sensation of heaviness and lameness in back.

Modality: | Aggravation—Motion, walking, stooping Concomitant :Backache associated with constipation, piles, prolapsus uteri, leucorrhoea.

Rectal Symptoms :

Constipation

Stool is large dry, hard & difficult to pass. Stool followed by fullness of rectum and intense pain in anus for hours. There is dryness and heat of rectum. Constipation with severe lumbosacral backache.

Haemorrhoids

Haemorrhoids blind, painful burning & purplish, rarely bleeding. Rectum sore with fulness, burning

and itching. Dryness & heat of rectum, with sensation as if rectum is full of small sticks. Knife- like pains shoot up the rectum,

Relations

Similar: To Aloe., Coll., Ign., Mur.ac., Nux., Sulph., in haemorrhoids.

After collinsonia has improved piles, Aesc. often cures. Useful after Nux and Sulph. have improved, but failed to cure piles.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: AEthusa Cynapium is one of the best remedies for the vomiting in children especially during dentition and in hot summer weather due to intolerance of milk. It is a thirst remedy and is most important for Cholera infantum and also for Epilepsy in babies.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Brain fag, Cholera infantum, Convulsion, Cough, Delirium, Dyspepsia, Epilepsy, Headache, Hiccough, Idiocy, Infantile paralysis, Intolerance of milk, Disorders of stomach, Vomiting, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Agaricus muscarius is a gift of vegetable kingdom. It is very much suited to nervous affections of old people, drunkards who often become delirious and get epileptiform fit. Agaricus finds a respectable place in the Materia Medica as an excellent remedy for neruous

affections.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Bad effects of alcohol Chilblains, Chorea, Delirium, Debauch, Epilepsy, Enteric Fever, Gangrene, Headache, Itching, Lumbago, Prolapse, Rheumatism, Skin affections, Sexual excess, Suppressed eruption, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It energetically acts upon nerves, mind, brain,

circulation, skin and mucous membrane.

PATHOGENESIS

It irritates nerves and brain producing various delirious conditions, epileptiform fit and exaggeration of nervous functions other reflex symptoms.

Constitution :

. is best adapted to old people with weak indolent circulation, light hair, lax skin and muscles,

Temperament: Nervous temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm: Psora and Syphilis are in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Delirium with constant raving. 2. Involuntary movements while awake; spasmodic motion and chorea. 3. Uncertainty in walking; stumbles over everything on the way. 4. Twitching and trembling run through the whole remedy.

ig

29

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache may be caused by defective circulation, alcohol or sexual excess.

Character of headache: Headache of those readily become delirious in fever or with pain; of persons subject to chorea; twitching or grimaces; from spinal affection.

Modality; Aggravation from exposure to cold air, before a thunderstorm, after coition or alcoholism.

Concomitants: Delirium; twitching and jerking; especially while awake.

Convulsion and delirium

Causation: Of drunkards, bad effects of sexual excess, debauch or suppressed eruption.

Character of delirium; With constant raving. The patient tries to. get out of bed and escape, generally in typhoid. Twitching and trembling and jerking of the whole body with chorea. Involuntary | movements while awake, ceases during sleep; chorea of single muscle to the dancing of the whole body. | There may be spinal irritation due to sexual excess. Nervous prostration after sexual debauch. Every motion and turn of the body causes pain in the spine. There is uncertainty in, walking; stumbles over everything on the way. Feels pains as if beaten. A peculiarity of the delirium is tendency to make verses and prophecy and incoherent talks; it gives the nearest approach to paralysis; exalted notions of grandeur and power, followed by depression, confusion and imbecility.

Concomitants: There may be headache along with or consequent upon this attack, The whole body is very painful and sensitive to touch. Extreme sensitiveness to cold air.

Skin

Causation: Exposure to cold; snow-bite.

Sensarion: Chilblains with itching, redness and burning. Frostbite and all cosequences thereof. Sensation as if ice touched or ice cold needles were piercing the skin or as from hot needles.

Burning, itching and redness of various parts; ears, nose, face, hands and feet. The affected parts are red, hot and swollen.

Feels pain all over the body. Spine is very sensitive to touch. Pain is sore, aching, especially in lumbar and sacral region, during exertion, in daytime and while sitting. Single vertebra is very sensitive to touch. Extremely sensitive to cold air,

Modality: Aggravation when standing and in cold air.

name: Agnus Castus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Agnus Castus was used in early days by both men & women to suppress the sexual desire and hence homoeopathically it becomes a medicine for sexual weakness with no desire & power, It belongs to the same category as Selenium, Staphysagria and Acid Phos, although properly speaking it typifies a condition more desperate than that presented by any one of those remedies.

CLINICAL :

Agalactia, Impotency. Leucorrhoea. Sterility. Gonorrhoea—secondary. Sprains.

Spheres of Action & Pathogenesis : Agnus produces its chief effect on sexual organs of both the sexes. It lowers sexual vitality, with corresponding mental depression and loss of nervous energy.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS : Factors ABA

1) Prematurely old age-from abuse of the sexual powers.

2) Complete impotence with relaxation, flaccidity, coldness of genitalia. No sexual power or desire.

3) Impotency after repeated attacks of gonorrhoea.

4) Deficient secretion or suppression of milk in nursing women (Asaf., Lac.Can., Lac.Defl.)

5) Leucorrhoea transparent but Draining linen yellow; passes imperceptibly from the Very relaxed parts.

6) Mind : Absent minded. Unable to recollect things. He has to read a sentence twice before he can comprehend, He becomes melancholic apathetic, distracted from abuse of sexual powers. Illusions of smells, herrings, musk. There is great sadness with a fixed idea of approaching death. This fear is not of immediate death as with Aconite, but the patient thinks it is sure to come after a while, and there is no use in doing anything. Nervous debility in unmarried persons. Tachycardia caused by tobacco in neurotic young men.

7) Ailments from—Sexual excesses. Repeated attacks of gonorrhoea or gleet. Sprains or Overlifting.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Male sexual Organs :

It has more marked action on male sexual organs than female sexual organs. Aqnus should be thought of when the sexual life is entirely annihilated due to abuses & excesses of former years and due to repeated attacks of gonorrhoea in the past. The patient becomes a complete impotent with relaxation, coldness, flaccidity of the genitalia. There is no sexual power and desire, even voluptuous fancies excite no erection. It is also medicine for secondary gonorrhoea. Gleety discharge with absence of sexual desire & erections. Testes cold, swollen, hard & painful.

Female sexual Organs :

Breast symptoms : Agalactia—There is deficient secretion or suppression of milk in nursing women (Asaf., Lac. Can., Lac. Defl.) This condition is often associated with great sadness & an idea of

approaching death. Leucorrhoea : There is transparent, imperceptible discharge from the very relaxed parts which

stains the linen yellow.

Sterility : This remedy is very good for sterility if a woman had indulged extensively in secretvice. She has no sexual desire, aversion to coition, sexual thrill is absent with suppression of menses.

In sterility Agnus Castus can be compared with Borax, Lycopodium, Nat. Carb, Platina and Sepia. Borax : In Borax hot, acrid leucorrhoea causes death of sperms thereby preventing pregnancy. Lycopodium :Coition is prevented by dryness of vagina (Nat Mur., Lyssin).

Nat Carb :There is discharge of mucus from vagina after an embrace causing sterility.

Platina : Here coition is prevented by extreme sensitiveness of the vagina (Thuja).

Sepia :In Sepia also, there is aversion to opposite sex, to coition, even young newly married Sepia lady has no desire for intercourse. Vagina painful especially on coition

name: Allium Cepa
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The mother tincture of Allium cepa is prepared from the fresh red bulbs which abundantly grow in India. Ordinarily it has no therapeutic value, but when it is potentised, it serves as an excellent remedy for any catarrhal inflammation. It is more or less an acute drug.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Catarrah, Cold, Coryza, Cough, Diarrhoea, Influenza, Injury, Laryngitis, Nasal polypus, Throat affections, Whooping cough etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its main seats of action are conjunctiva, mucous membrane of nose, respiratory tract, intestine, nerves and veins.

PATHOGENESIS

It causes irritation of conjunctiva and mucous membrane of nose, respiratory and gastro-intestinal tracts, producing acute catarrhal inflammation and profuse discharge. It also causes neuralgia and inflammation of veins.

CONSTITUTION

Since it is mainly an acute drug, consideration: .of . constitution is not important. The patient is, however, very hot with psoric miasm in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Allium cepa is a left sided medicine. Symptoms go from left to-right.

2. In common cold or cough or headache, which is aggravated in a warm room, better in open air and worse again on-returning to a warm room, Allium cepa must be thought of.

3. Profuse watery and acrid nasal discharge with profuse bland lachrymation (rev. of Euphrasia where nasal discharge is bland and lachrymation is acrid).

4. Desire for raw onion is an indication for the remedy (Cub.). 5. Aggravation in warm room and in the evening; relieved in cold room and open air.

6. Violent laryngitis, cough seems to TEAR AND SPLIT THE LARYNX.

34

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

There is catarrhal dull headache with coryza, which aggravates in warm room, better in open air and worse again on returning to a warm room.

Eyes -

The eyes are burning, biting, smarting as from smoke, must rub them for relief, watery and suffused; capillaries are injected, congested and EXCESSIVE LACHRYMATION WHICH IS PROFUSE-BUT

BLAND.

Nose

The discharge from nose is also profuse and watery but ACRID. Excoriates the part touched by the nasal discharge. The nasal discharge drops from tip of the nose.

There may also be nasal polypus found in the patient (Sanguinaria, Psorinum, Mar.v., Sang. Nit.).

Coryza

There is spring coryza after exposure to damp northwestern wind; discharges burn and corrode the nose and upper lip. catarrhal laryngitis, with severe cough which compels the patient to grasp the /arynx: seems as if the cough would tear the larynx.

Modalities: The above symptoms of headache, eyes, nose and coryza are aggravated in the evening, in a warm room and are relieved in the open air and in a cold room.

Colic

Alliurn cepa patient may also suffer from colic usually caused from cold; by getting feet wet; from overeating; cucumbers; salads; haemorrhoidal; of children; is aggravated by sitting and relieved by moving about.

Injury

If in neuralgia the pain is like a long thread on face, hand, neck or chest or if there is traumatic chronic neuritis of neuralgia after amputation with burning and stinging pain Allium cepa is the remedy.

Phiebitis

Furthermore, if phlebitis, puerperal or after forceps delivery, develops or panaritia with red streaks up the arm with pain driving the patient to despair, in child-bed Allium cepa is to be thought of as an effective remedy.

For the sore and raw spots on feet especially heel, ‘from friction particularly when the feet are rubbed sore” Allium cepa is very much efficacious.

The discharge from nose is also profuse and watery but ACRID. Excoriates the part touched by the nasal discharge. The nasal discharge drops from tip of the nose.

There may also be nasal polypus found in the patient (Sanguinaria, Psorinum, Mar.v., Sang. Nit.).

Coryza

There is spring coryza after exposure to damp northwestern wind; discharges burn and corrode the nose and upper lip. catarrhal laryngitis, with severe cough which compels the patient to grasp the /arynx: seems as if the cough would tear the larynx.

Modalities: The above symptoms of headache, eyes, nose and coryza are aggravated in the evening, in a warm room and are relieved in the open air and in a cold room.

Colic

Alliurn cepa patient may also suffer from colic usually caused from cold; by getting feet wet; from overeating; cucumbers; salads; haemorrhoidal; of children; is aggravated by sitting and relieved by moving about.

Injury

If in neuralgia the pain is like a long thread on face, hand, neck or chest or if there is traumatic chronic neuritis of neuralgia after amputation with burning and stinging pain Allium cepa is the remedy.

Phiebitis

Furthermore, if phlebitis, puerperal or after forceps delivery, develops or panaritia with red streaks up the arm with pain driving the patient to despair, in child-bed Allium cepa is to be thought of as an effective remedy.

For the sore and raw spots on feet especially heel, ‘from friction particularly when the feet are rubbed sore” Allium cepa is very much efficacious.

name: Aloe Socotrina
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Aloe socotrina is an excellent remedy like Nux vomica in re-establishing physiological equilibrium after much drugging where disease and drug symptoms are mixed to form a common pool. For this wonderful medicine, Dr. N.M. Choudhury has masterly remarked that “To write a Materia Medica without Aloe is to write a novel without a hero.”

Its importance and usefulness become evident as soon as we launch in our business of curing the sick.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal disorders, Anal affection, Colic, Constipation, cough, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Haemorrhoids, Skin affections, ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts especially upon the nervous system, portal system, blood and skin. It has got special action upon the liver and intestine.

PATHOGENESIS

When acting on mucous membrane of gastrointestinal tract, it produces diarrhoea, dysentery and haemorrhage from the haemorrhoidal vessels. It affects the intestine especially rectum producing loss of control of sphincter ani. It also causes congestion of various parts, especially abdomen, pelvic organs and head.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Especially suited to old people, women of relaxed, phlegmatic habit. Indolent weary persons leading sedentary life, averse to either physical and mental labour.

Temperament: Bilious temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Hot patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1. Profuse jelly like of mucus from all mucous membranes, especially of intestine and throat (Kali bi., Podo., Helleborus).

name: Alumina
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: As a result of a fast civilization, people are much habituated to using metals and their compounds for various purposes. One of them is the use of metals in cooking utensils— Aluminium being the major component. Prolonged use of these utensils brings a state of chronic aluminium poisoning. This state is now- a-days often met with for which potentised Aluminium is the remedy. Hering has remarked “apparently as usual, crude poison is antidoted by its potencies—200, etc.”

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anus affection, Constipation of infants, Cough, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Eczema, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Locomotor Ataxia, Menstrual disorders, Nervous affection, Skin affection etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Alumina directly affects the motor nervous system; most specific action is on mucous membrane, specially of intestine and vagina. Skin remains the main seat of action.

PATHOGENESIS

When acting on the motor nervous system, it produces a state of paralysis—paralytic condition. By its action on mucous membrane, like Bryonia, it produces a condition of] extreme dryness, lack of secretion, with more or less irritation. Skin under the action 0

this drug also becomes dry. CONSTITUTION

Physical makeup: Alumina patient is spare, dry, thin, having dark complexion, persons of sedentary habits who suffer from chronic ailments; to constitutions which suffer from diminished animal heat.

Temperament: Hypochondriac.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

Diathesis: Scrofulous diathesis.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastrointestinal symptoms

Stomach : Abnormal craving for starch, charcoal, cloves, coffee or tea-grounds, acid and undigestible things. (Calc. carb., Nitric acid, Cicuta, Cina, Psorinum). There is no desire to eat; potatoes disagree, aversion to meat. Chronic eructation for years, up and down, worse in the evening.

Diarrhoea : Inactivity of the rectum and paralytic condition of the intestine is well-marked. Consequently, there is great straining. Even soft stool requires great straining (Anac., Platina, Nit. acid.). There is diarrhoea when the patient urinates, The patient has to strain at stool in order to urinate. Diarrhoea after eating potatoes.

name: Ambra Grisea
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
About its origin Dr. H.C.Allen says. “Of doubtful origin, for years on the borderland as to its true classification, but probably a nosode or morbid product found in the belly of the spermwhale, It has many characteristics of intestinal or biliary concretions and has been considered to be of hepatic origin, probably a fatty excretion from its gall bladder” Dr. N.M. Chowdhury says, “Ambergris is a fatlike substance found in the intestines and among the excreta of the spermwhale.” The Oil of Amber i.e.

Oleum Succium should not be confounded with Ambergris.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Constipation. Convulsions. Cough. Dyspepsia. Hysteria. Menstrual disorder. Leucorrhoea. Neuroses. Nymphomania. Ranula.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It affects predominantly nervous system especially pneumogastric, spinal nerves and solar plexus. It also acts on gastrointestinal and respiratory tracts and female genital organs.

PATHOGENESIS |

Acting on nervous system it produces faintness, jerking, twitching and other nervous hysterical manifestations. It affects female genital organs manifesting as leucor-rhoes. menstrual disorder and pruritus valvae etc,

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up : It is suited to old people and children especially young girls whe are excitable, nervous and weak. Lean, thin emaciated nervous persons and thin scrawny women (Sec. Cor.)

Temperament—Nervous bilious temperament.

Heat cold relation—Patients are aggravated from warm and better from cold i general.

Miasm—Psora and syphilis are in the background.

44

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Great bashfulness is very characteristic of Ambra Grisea.

2) The presence of others is unbearable during stool, when urinating even can’t do any thing in pressence of others.

3) After business embarrassments, unable to sleep, must get up (Act., Sep.)

4) Sensation of coldness in abdomen (Cal.)

5) Discharge of blood between periods, at every little accident—a long walk, after every hard stool etc.

6) Leucorrhoea : Thick, bluish-white mucus especially or only at night (Caust, Merc., Nit Ac.)

7) Cough in spasmodic paroxysms, with eructation and hoarseness. Ranula with foetid breath.

8) One sided complaints.

9) Mind : The red strand of this remedy is found in its bash fulness, embarassment and nervousness. The patient is excitable, nervous and hysterical. He is intensely shy blushes easily. He can’t do any thing in presence of others. The presence of others even the nurse, is unbearable during stool, when urinating. There is great sadness, patient sits for days weeping. Music is intolerable, causes weeping. Dread of people and desires to be alone. Restless, excited, despair and very loquacious. Time passes too slowly. Fears of becoming insane. The presence of other people and music aggravate the symptoms. Ambra is a good remedy for sleeplessness due to nervousness and business embarrassment.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastrointestinal Symptoms

Stomach ; Eructations with violent convulsive cough. Distension of stomach after midnight. Heart burn from drinking milk, Thirstlessness.

Abdomen : Flatulence, distended abdomen after midnight. Sensation of coldness in abdomen.

Constipation : There is frequent ineffectual desire for stool which makes the patient anxious. The presence of others even the nurse is unbearable during stool. Inveterate constipation in old people.

Modality: Aggravation—After eating, warm drink especially warm milk after midnight, in the morning.

Respiratory Symptoms : Cough : Violent nervous cough in spasmodic paroxsysms with eructations and hoarseness.

Hollow, spasmodic barking cough coming from deep in chest. Whooping cough without .crowing inspiration, morning with, evening without expectoration.

Modality : Agg.—Talking, reading aloud, in presence of people, Music.

name: Ammonium Carbonicum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Ammon. carb. is a very effective remedy potentised from the pure salt-carbonate of ammonium. Hahnemann s masterly knowledge in Chemistry revealed to him the curat.ve power o this powerful irritant, smelling salt.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Bronchitis, Cough, Epistaxis, Emphysema, Haemorrhage, Headache, Heart affection, Leucorrhoea, Menstrual disorders. Nose affection, Skin affection, Tonsillitis, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on blood, cardio-vascular system, respiratory and gastro-intestinal tract, female genital organs, nerves and bones. PATHOGENESIS

Ammon. Carb. causes degeneration of blood and haemolysis, diminishes tendencey to coagulation and oxygen carrying capacity affects the blood vessels resulting in haemorrhage, irritates mucous membrane of respiratory and gastro-intestinal tract, setting in catarrhal condition; snuffles of nose, cholera like symptoms, initiate profuse menstruation; by its affection of nerves, it produces increased activity of blood vessels

and heart. CONSTITUTION It is specially suited to women and children.

Make-up of the body: Stout, fleshy and delicate women who lead sedentary life, with a “smelling-bottle” always in the hand.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

Diathesis: Haemorrhagic diathesis,

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It is a RIGHT-SIDED remedy.

2. Haemorrhagic tendency; blood becomes fluid, haemolysis and degeneration of R.B.C. take place, and consequently blood has diminished tendency to coagulate and

a7

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

‘Causation: Exposure to cold, wet stormy weather.

Location: Headache is felt more in the forehead.

Sensation: Sensation of fulness as if the forehead would burst.

Modalities

* Aggravation: From cold, cold washing and during menses. * Amelioration: By pressure and lying on painful side.

Nose

Nose-bleed WHEN WASHING THE FACE AND HANDS in the moming, after earing; bleeding from left nostril.

Blood rushes to tip of nose when stooping.

Ozaena; when blowing, bloody mucous from nose comes out frequently.

Stooping of nose, mostly at night, must breath through the mouth.

Long-lasting coryza; “snuffles” of infants (Hepar, Nux vom., Sambucus, Lyco, Lachesis).

In diphtheria, the nose is stopped and the child cannot get sleep because it cannot breathe. The patiaent gets relief from these troubles in dry weather.

name: Amylenum Nitrosum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Climacteric headache. Location : Hemicrania especially left side is affected. Sensation . There is sensation as if blood would start through skin, with heat & redness and sensation as if something were rushing up into the head, with throbbing. There is intense surging of blood to face and head.

Modality: Aggravation : In warm room, mental & physical exertion. Amelioration : Open air, cold water, cold air.

Concomitant: Affected side often looks paler than the other side. Easy flushing and blushing of the face.

Heart

Amyl Nitrite is one of the grand remedies for Angina pectoris in our Materia Medica. There is praecordial anxiety, cardiac oppression, stitching pains and a feeling of constric-tion in the cardiac region. At the least excitement the face looks flushed and pulsation is felt over the entire body. The heart's action becomes intensified and almost tumultuous. Intense throbbing of the carotids is also noticed. Patient craves fresh air. There is sensation of swelling of the front of chest and a bursting out feeling in ears. Profound and repeated yawning.

Relations

Similar: to., Bell., Cac., Coca., Fer., Glon., Lach,

N.B.: Acts promptly by inhalation ; resuscitates persons sinking under anaesthetics.

Crude drug chiefly palliative ; must be repeated as patient becomes accustomed to it ; is curative in the stronger higher potencies.

The cure more frequently depends upon the strength of the potency than many who have not put it to the Curative test imagine.

name: Anacardium Orientale
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Anacardium is a unique discovery which is prepared form the husk of marking nut. It has been proved to be an excellent remedy and very much akin to its botanical relatives, the different species of Rhus, particularly in the sphere of skin affection and its symptoms, such as vesicular eruptions with intense burning and itching. It is best known for its peculiar and extreme mental

symptoms.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Alcoholism, Abdominal affections, Brain fag, Constipation, Cough, Debility, Dyspesia, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Heart affection, Loss of memory and mental weakness, Nervous aliments, Skin affection, Warts, Writer's cramp ete. Dr. Tyler has summarised Anacardium thus: Anacardium, marking nut plugged sensation, eye to gut, Anacardium, here’s your guide, Plug within, tight band outside.

Mentally two wills oppose, Which to obey he never knows.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on mind and nerves, stomach, rectum and skin. Acts directly upon the sensorium, depressing the cerebral centres and the organs of special senses.

PATHOGENESIS

It is mostly used in cases of neurosyphilis producing brain fag. It also acts on nerves producing a condition known as neivous dyspepsia. CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Pale face with blue ring around the eyes.

Temperament: Highly irritable, slight causes make him excessively angry.

Relation with heat and cold: \t is neither chilly not hot.

Miasm: Psora and syphilis are in the background.

54 a

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. All gone Sensation in stomach, comes on only’when stomach is empty and is relieved by eating and during the process of digestion (Chel. Jodum, Petroleum, Sepia).

2, Plug-like sensation in the inner parts such as anus, oesophagus, etc.

3, Constrictive sensation of a hoop or band around the parts e.g. head, knee, etc. (Sulphur, Carbolic acid).

4. Great desire for Stool, but with the effort the desire passes off without evacuation.

5. Symptoms prone to go from right to left (Lyco.).

6. Mind : Anacardium patients manifest very peculiar and striking mental symptoms which are as follows:-

There is SUDDEN LOSS OF MEMORY, the patient is very much disturbed about his forgetfulness. The patient is so forgetful that he even forgets his own name and the names of well known places and most intimate friends.

There is irresistible desire to curse.and swear (Lil. tig., Lac, can., Nit. ac.).

Sensation of a hoop or band around the parts. Feels he has two wills; one commanding him to do what the other forbids and he does not know what to do. In one ear a devil prompts him to do murder, in the other an angel counsels him to do acts of benevolence.

In Anacardium patient, there is very strange temper. He laughs at serious matter and becomes serious over laughable matter (Bar. Carb., Platina).

When walking, he feels as if some one is following him. Great illusion, delusion and hallucinations.

Suspicious—doubts, everything around him. Takes bad side of everything and becomes violent. Cowardice.

Very cruel, malicious and wicked; inflicts bodily injury upon himself.

Absent minded and hypochondriacal. Lack of confidence in himself and others. Anxiety and feeling of impending misfortune.

7. Ailments from : Bad effects of mental excitement, excessive utilisation of brain for purposeless thoughts, consequences of fright and mortifications, sedentary habits.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causasion : Nervous headache of sedentary persons from anxiety, fear or fright. Location: In forehead.temples, vertex and occiput. Sensation; Of a plug in the inner part. Character of Pain: Pressing pain as if from a plug in the inner part.

name: Anthracinum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Anthracinum was introduced intoHomoeopathic practice by “Lux” long before the experiment of “Pasteur”. Though it is not a polychrest medicine having limited sphere of action still it has got very important and respected place in Homoeopathy because it has got power to make surgeon's knife useless and relieves the most serious cases of Carbuncle, Gangrene, Felons, Blood boils etc.

CLINICAL: Acne. Boil. Carbuncle. Insect stings. Gangrene.

Malignant pustules. Felons. Septic fever. Splenic fever. Dissecting wounds. Anthrax poisoning by foul breath, Foul gas ete.

SPHERES OF ACTION : Anthracinum has its centre of action over the connective tissues. It covers all the inflammatory conditions of connective tissue in which there exists some purulent focus. It also acts on skin. GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Atrocious burning pains as if hot coals were applied to parts. (Ars.)

2) Discharges are ichorus, putrid and offensive from mouth, nose, throat, nostrils, vagina, rectum, ulcer, carbuncle etc. Horribly offensive (Ars., Pyr.).

3) Haemorrhages are black, thick, tar like, rapidly decomposing, from any orifice.

4) Tendency towards malignancy and rapid formation of gangrenous condition.

5) Fever, rapid loss of strength, great prostration, sinking pulse, delirium and fainting.

6) Affected parts turn black and blue.

7) Red lines from the area of infection marking the course of lymphatics.

8) Rapid spread of infiltration and oedema of cellular tissue. Excessive thirst with inability to swallow. COMPARISONS :

We may compare Anthracinum with Arsenic Album, Tarentula Cubensis & Secale Cornutum in relation with the above mentioned complaints.

57

It is the Arseniate of Antimony and has been advocated greatly in emphysema. Hearer is the chief authority for this drug.

Cough. Catarrhal Pneumonia. Emphysema.

Pleurisy : after effects of.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:

Antim Ars. has been found very useful in emphysema (Sienega, Amm. Garb) with excessive dyspnoea and cough cough with much mucus secretion and is aggravated by eating and lying down. name: Antimonium Crudum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Here is yet another effective remedy from the Mineral kingdom—Antimonium crudum. The crude drug substance is a compound formed by Antimony and Sulphur. When it is potentised, it becomes a very good polychrest remedy. Antim. crud. corresponds in a sense to the race of SWINE, as ARESENIC does to HORSE and PULSATILLA to SHEEP.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Catarrh, Constipation, Corns, Diarrhoea, ’ Feet sore and horny, Fever, Lung affection, Piles, Stomach disorders, Skin affection, Thirst, Tongue coated, Voice low, Warts, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main action of Antim Crud. is on mucous membrane, especially, of stomach and intestine; then corners skin and mind.

PATHOGENESIS

It causes disorganisation and vital depression of mucbus membrane of stomach and intestine, interferes with digestion creating a catarrhal condition in the whole of intestinal canal, resulting in alternate diarrhoea and constipation and above all peculiar tongue; it produces on skin a disturbed and depressed state of vitality and its action on brain results in various mental symptoms.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: Suited to children and young people, who are inclined to grow fat—extremes of life, having tendency to thick unhealthy skin.

Old people with morning diarrhoea (Phosphorus).

Relation with heat and cold: Antim crud., patient is easily affected by extremes of heat and cold and as such it is difficult to conclude whether he is hot or chilly.

Miasm: Psora and sycosis are in the background. Diathesis: Rheumatic and Gouty diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content: 1. A THICK MILKY WHITE COATING ON TONGUE is the red strand of the remedy: 2. Patients who are in extremes of life and who are inclined to grow fat.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: From river bathing, Cold Bathing, taking cold, alcohol, deranged digestion, acids, fat, fruits suppressed eruption.

Sensation: Congestive and throbbing headache. Location: Over the entire head, especially at vertex. Modality: Headache is relieved in the open air, during rest and after a warm bath.

Concomitants: Weakness of limbs, aversion to food from disordered stomach; vertigo with nausea and occasiona! vorniting, congestion of blood to head resulting in nose-bleed

Mouth

Cracks and fissures at the corners of mouth, Canker sores in the mouth, A THICK MILKY WHITE COATING ON THE TONGUE is the red strand of remedy.

Throat

Large quantities of mucous is hawked out from the posterior nares, Soreness in the throat, with a sensation of plug in throat, constantly trying to swallow.

name: Antimonium Tartaricum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It is due to the emetic influence of the tartarised antimony that this medicine got its name “Tartar Emetic.” Emetic is a substance which when taken can make a person vomit. Vomiting is under the control of nerve centre present at the base of the brain in Medulla Oblongata. This medicine acts not only on those nerve centres, but also on the pneumogastric nerve to produce pneumonia and bronchitis.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Alcoholism, Aphthae, Asphyxia neonatorum, Asthma, Bronchitis, Catarrh, Chicken-pox, Cholera, Cough, Fever, Impetigo, Lung affection, Pneumonia, Rheumatism, Tongue coated, Vomiting, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Antim. tart, acts on respiratory organs, salivary glands, mucous membranes, brain, nerve and skin.

PATHOGENESIS Its action on the pneumogastric nerve causes depression of respiration and circulation and other symptoms, resembling pneumonia, bronchitis, asthma, etc.

Nausea and vomiting are the manifestations of its influence on the Medulla Oblongata. While on the mucous membrane, it establishes catarrhal inflammation and increased secretion; on the skin it causes pustular eruption, resembling smallpox. The drug also promotes rapid waste of tissues.

CONSTITUTION

Antim. tart. has got hydrogenoid constitution of Grauvogl, torpid, phlegmatic persons. Child at birth is pale. Diasm : Psora and Sycosis are in the background,

Diathesis: Scrofulous diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content: 1. Usually suited (or diseases originating from exposure to damp basements or cellars, and after vaccination.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal symptoms

Overeating, yawning and drowsiness. Vomiting in any position except when lying on right side. The vomitus is green, watery and frothy. Due to violent straining, there is tendency to vomit.

Tongue

Tongue is covered with thick, white pasty coat; red streaks; very red, dry in the middle. On the tongue there are smal] pustules which are very painful. In most complaints this remedy is; thirstless.

There is perspiration on forehead; with coldness of surface, usually the hands and feet are as cold as ice; thirstless or may drink little often.

Asiatic cholera

There is incessant diarrhoea and vomiting until the patient faints. The patient has inordinate craving for apple (Aloe). Very much sleepy after vomiting. Nausea Is better and relieved after vomiting. Vomiting in any position except when lying on right side.

Diarrhoea and constipation alternate.

name: Apis Mellifica
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Apis is a very useful anti-psoric medicine prepared from the poison of Honey Bee. Bee sting

gives burning, stinging pain, soreness, red rose hue and puffiness of the part which is sensitive to touch. Person becomes irritable, restless and cries or even weeps till the pain subsides.

So, also when Apis is proved on healthy

human being, the same pathogenetic symptoms are found.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Apoplexy, Asthma, Bright’s disease, Carbuncle; Constipation, Cancerous affections, Diarrhoea, Dropsy, Eye troubles, Gdrigrene, Hydrocephalus, Intermittent fever, Kidney affections, Meningitis, Menstrual troubles, Rheumatism, Skin affection, Tumours, Urinary troubles, etc,

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Apis acts on cellular tissues, glands, skin, brain, urinary system, heart, pleurae and serous membrane. PATHOGENESIS

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Apocynum is reputed to be a very good remedy for dropsy, hydrocephalus and ascites and as such it occupies a place as

important as that of Apis.

CLINICAL:

Ascites. Amenorrhoea. Cough. Dropsies. Heart affection. Hydrocephalous. Metrorrhagia. Urinary affection. Vomiting.

SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS :

It acts on urinary organs digestive tract and uterus. Acting on urinary organs, induces diuresis and removes the dropsical effusions It depresses the heart, kidneys and intestines relaxing sphincters. It also

produces intense gastric disturbance.

1) Excretions diminished, especially urine and sweat.

name: Argentum Metallicum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Argentum metallicum is prepared from the precipitated Silver. It is mainly a left- sided remedy. Almost all the heavy metals have been proved to be excellent remedies after the process of potentisation and so does the Silver too. Hahnemann.was shrewd enough to understand the curative value of this metal and enunciated the process for the benefit of all generations of mankind.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Brain-fag, Diabetes, Exosfosis, Heart affections, Laryngitis, Loss of voice, Male genital organs, Prolapse of uterus, Rheumatism, Throat affections, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main centres of action of this remedy are mucous membrane of throat and respiratory tract; affects all cartilages, and hence all joints and bones; cartilages of ear, nose, euslachian tube, male and female genital organs, etc.

PATHOGENESIS

It causes irritation of mucous membrane of throat and respiratory tract, producing hoarseness and loss of voice and cough; it also produces sexual weakness in male and prolapse with pain and haemorrhge in female. As it affects the cartilages, bones and joints it produces bruised pain, tenderness and weakness.

CONSTITUTION Make-up of the body: Usually the patient is tall and thin, with constitutional effects of onanism and abuse of mercury.

Temperament: Irritable temperament. Miasm: Syphilis is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Hoarseness of professional singers and public speakers with total loss of voice.

2. Laughing excites cough (Drosera, Phosphorus, Stannum), and produces profuse mucus in larynx.

3. Great weakness of the chest (Stannum).

74

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Throat and respiratory tract

There is exhausting and fluent coryza with sneezing. Hoarseness of professional singers and public speakers with total loss of voice.

Throat and larynx feel sore or raw on swallowing or on coughing. Laughing causes cough (Drosera, Phosphorus, Stannum) and produces profuse mucus in larynx, cough with easy expectoration of gelatinous viscid mucus, looking like boiled starch.

While reading the patient has to hem and.hawk to clear the throat and expectorate the mucus. Great weakness in the chest (Stannum); worse when lying on left side. Raw spot over the bifurcation of trachea; worse when using voice, talking or singing.

Modalities

* Aggravation: When riding in a carriage; when touching or pressing upon, when talking, singing or reading aloud.

Male Genital Organs

Causation: Due to sexual excess, onanism and abuse of mercury.

Character: There is seminal emission after onanism, almost every night, without erection. The penis is atrophied.

There is crushed pain in the testicles.

Female Genital Organs

Prolapse : There is prolapse of uterus with pain in the left ovary and back. The pain extends forwards and downwards. During climacteric age; along with prolapse, there will also be haemorrhage. Unine : The colour of urine is like whey in diabetes mellitus. General Modalities : Aggravation: Riding in a carriage (Cocculus), when touched or pressed upon; talking, singing, reading aloud.

Relations

Follows well after Alumina. Similar to: Stannum in cough excited by laughing. Antidoted by: Puls and Mercurius.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Argentum nitricum is one of the “Monumental treasures”, and in its PATHOGENESISis, we find a wonderful remedy having tremendous influence over the human economy, particularly in the affections of the brain, nerves and _ gastro-intestinal tract, producing multiple physiological and pathological changes. This great anti-sycotic remedy is mainly indicated in those persons in whom intellectual features predominate.

It has been extensively used by the Allopaths for the cauterisation of ulcers which do not yield to medicinal treatment.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acidity, Addison’s disease, Anaemia, Dyspepsia, Diarrhoea, Emaciation, Eructation, Eye affections, Flatulence, Gastric, ulcer, Gonorrhoea, Headache, Heart-burn, Locomotor ataxia, Neuralgia, Ophthalmia neonatorum, Paraplegia, Paralysis, Ricket, Spinal ‘irritation, Throat affection. Ulcerated tongue, Warts, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on brain, spinal cord, nerves, blood, mucous membranes such as of eyes, throat, stomach, urethra, etc. periosteum, bones, kidney, liver, gastrointestinal tract also are susceptible to the action of this great remedy.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces hyperaesthetic and anaesthetic condition of the nerves, i.e. neuro-sycosis. Kidney liver and other glands show degeneration. It also causes disturbed digestion, diarrhoea, etc. The blood becomes fluid and darker. Haemoglobin is diminshed, setting in defective oxidation and anaemia. Mucous membranes are inflamed.

CONSTITUTION Adapted to hysterical nervous person with vivid imagination, having carbo- nitrogenoid or hydrogenoid constitution.

Physical make-up: Cachectic, scrawny, withered, dried up, old looking young persons, having history of unusual or long continued mental exertion.

Temperament: Bilious temperament. Very irritable and becomes angry easily.

76

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Emaciation progressing every year which is most marked in the lower extremities.

2. Defective co-ordination of muscles (Gels.) with trembling in the affected parts.

8. Great apprehension, especially when getting ready for church, opera, examination, public meeting or any other, engagement and at that time DIARRHOEA SETS IN (GELS.). It is a good remedy for examination funk.

4. Sensation of a splinter in throat, uterus and other parts of the body (Hepar sulph., Nitric acid). 5. Chilly when uncovered, yet feels smothered if warapped up, craves fresh air (Puls.). 6. Desire for sugar, sweets (Lyco., Cina, Sulpur), for salt (Carbo veg., Nat. mur., Phos.). 7. Great longing for fresh air. - 8. Belching accompanies most gastric ailments. 9. Urine passes unconsiously day and night (Causticum). 10. Impotence, erection fails when action is attempted. 11. Chronic laryngitis of singers. The high notes cause cough. 12. Great weakness of lower extremities with trembling. Cannot walk with eyes closed (Alumina). 13. Coition is painful in both sexes, followed by bleeding from vagina (Nitric acid). 14. Post-diptheritic paralysis (Gels.). 15. Aeute or chronic diseases from unusual or long continued mental exertion.

16. Metrorrhagia in young widows; in sterility; with nervous erethism at chage of life (Lach.). 17. Arg. nit. is an excellent remedy for epilepsy caused by fright or occcurring at

menstrual period. Pupils dilate days and hours before, attack. After attack the patient becomes restless with trembling.

18. Mind : There is GREAT APPREHENSION when getting ready to go to church or opera, examination or any other important engagement and at that time diarrhoea sets in.

u~ There is frequent loss of memory; makes frequent faults in speech because he cannot find the right words.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache of literary men, habitual or gastric in origin and from dancing. Also caused by prolonged mental exertion.

Location: In the frontal eminence or temple. Sensation: OF EXPANSION of the head and face. Character of pain. Pressing, screwing pain in he frontal eminence or temples.

Modalities: Aggravation from mental exertion, during menstruation, bright light and relieved by sitting in a dark room tight ban daging, open air, cold application and complete mental rest.

EYES

Causation: Gonorrhoea, catarrhal condition, fine needle work and eye strain.

Character: Argentum nitricum has got many eye troubles such as Ophthalmia neonatorum in young infants who contacted gonorrhoea during the passage through the birth canal of the infected mother there is profuse purulent discharge, cornea is opaque, ulcerated lids are sore, thick and swollen which agglutinate in the morning.

Granular conjunctivitis; scarlet red, like raw beef, eye strains from needle works.

Dilated pupil, with dimness of vision and intense photo-phobia. The inner canthi, are swollen and congested. Paretic condition of the ciliary muscles; defective accommodation.

Modalities

* Aggravation: Worse in a warm room, sitting by the side of fire and bright light. ¢ Amelioration: From cold application and in a dark room.

name: Arnica Montana
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Arnica grows all over the world in the mountain region. Before proving. Arnica plant was used in any injury from fall with astonishing results. So it can be said to be the traumatic par excellence. Trauma in all its varieties and effects, recent or remote, is met by Arnica, more than by any other single drug.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Apoplexy, Boils, Brain affection, Bronchitis, Bruises, Carbuncle, Chest affections, Diabetes, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Ecchymosis. Eye affections, Fever, Haematemesis, Haematuria, Headache, Heart affection, Injury, Labour, Meningitis, Paralysis, Rheumatism, Rheumatic fever, Sprain, Suppuration, Typhoid, Urinary affection, Skin affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The Chief action of Arnica is on blood and blood vessels particularly on capillaries. It is generally believed to possess the. power of absorbing blood. PATHOGENESIS

By its action upon the blood, it produces anaemia, tendency to haemorrhage, capillary stasis, ecchymosis and defective nutrition. Arnica causes reabsorption of extravasated blood, prevents septic condition and recovery of the parts. On the muscular, serous and cellular tissues and tendons, it produces condition similar to those resulting from blunt injuries.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Sanguine, plethoric persons, lively expression and very red face, who are disposed to cerebral congestion.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Temperament: Nervous temperament Miasm: Psora is in the background.

81

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. SORE, LAME, BRUISED FEELING ALL THROUGH THE BODY AS IF BEATEN, 2. The patient is very much oversensitive to pain. 3. EVERYTHING ON WHICH THE PATIENT LIES SEEMS too hard. 4, Heat of upper part of the body and coldness of lower part. 5. Tendency to small painful boils one after another. 6. Stupor with involuntary discharge of faeces and urine. 7. The patient bleeds easily; blood vessels seem to be relaxed and, therefore, extravasation is easy.

8. Arnica is specially suited to cases where injury, however, remote, seems to have caused the present troubles. Master Hahnemann feels that this remedy is most suited to chronic cases.

9. Arnica causes and cures haemorrhage of any kind; haemorrhage into the tissues of internal organs or the skin.

10. Concussion and contusions, result of shock or injury without laceration of soft parts; prevents suppuration and septic condition and promotes absorption.

11. Local application of Arnica produces extraordinary growth of hair and checks falling of hair. :

12. Mind : The patient remains unconscious; when spoken to, answers correctly, and completely, but immediately unconsciousness and delirium return (Phos. acid.; falls asleep in the midst of answer—Baptisia). The patient is in a stuporous condition with involuntary discharge of stool and urine, specially typhoid. Indifferent to everything. Complete inability to perform continuous active work. He is morosed, quiet, wants to be alone, with depression of spirit and absence of mind. Low muttering delirium or complete stupor in malarial or typhoid fever. Fears of being struck or even touched by those coming near him. Sudden fear of death rousing him up at night, with cardiac distress.

13. Ailments from. Bad effects of mechanical injuries even if received years ago, falls, blow, concussion, contusion, hard work, spirituous liquor, charcoal vapour, fright and anger,

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eye

For conjunctival and retinal haemorrhage with extravasation and intra ocular haemorrhage from injuries or cough. Arnica is an infallible remedy.

Gastrointestinal symptoms

Stomach : Longing for vinegar. Distaste for milk and meat, Pain in stomach during eating. Belching and eructation are very much foul, putrid, like rotten eggs. Putrid smell from mouth.

Eye affections, Fever, Haematemesis, Haematuria, Headache, Heart affection, Injury, Labour, Meningitis, Paralysis, Rheumatism, Rheumatic fever, Sprain, Suppuration, Typhoid, Urinary affection, Skin affection, etc.
SPHERES OF ACTION: The Chief action of Arnica is on blood and blood vessels particularly on capillaries. It is generally believed to possess the. power of absorbing blood. PATHOGENESIS

By its action upon the blood, it produces anaemia, tendency to haemorrhage, capillary stasis, ecchymosis and defective nutrition. Arnica causes reabsorption of extravasated blood, prevents septic condition and recovery of the parts. On the muscular, serous and cellular tissues and tendons, it produces condition similar to those resulting from blunt injuries.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Sanguine, plethoric persons, lively expression and very red face, who are disposed to cerebral congestion.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Temperament: Nervous temperament Miasm: Psora is in the background.

81
GUIDING SYMPTOMS: 1. SORE, LAME, BRUISED FEELING ALL THROUGH THE BODY AS IF BEATEN, 2. The patient is very much oversensitive to pain. 3. EVERYTHING ON WHICH THE PATIENT LIES SEEMS too hard. 4, Heat of upper part of the body and coldness of lower part. 5. Tendency to small painful boils one after another. 6. Stupor with involuntary discharge of faeces and urine. 7. The patient bleeds easily; blood vessels seem to be relaxed and, therefore, extravasation is easy.

8. Arnica is specially suited to cases where injury, however, remote, seems to have caused the present troubles. Master Hahnemann feels that this remedy is most suited to chronic cases.

9. Arnica causes and cures haemorrhage of any kind; haemorrhage into the tissues of internal organs or the skin.

10. Concussion and contusions, result of shock or injury without laceration of soft parts; prevents suppuration and septic condition and promotes absorption.

11. Local application of Arnica produces extraordinary growth of hair and checks falling of hair. :

12. Mind : The patient remains unconscious; when spoken to, answers correctly, and completely, but immediately unconsciousness and delirium return (Phos. acid.; falls asleep in the midst of answer—Baptisia). The patient is in a stuporous condition with involuntary discharge of stool and urine, specially typhoid. Indifferent to everything. Complete inability to perform continuous active work. He is morosed, quiet, wants to be alone, with depression of spirit and absence of mind. Low muttering delirium or complete stupor in malarial or typhoid fever. Fears of being struck or even touched by those coming near him. Sudden fear of death rousing him up at night, with cardiac distress.

13. Ailments from. Bad effects of mechanical injuries even if received years ago, falls, blow, concussion, contusion, hard work, spirituous liquor, charcoal vapour, fright and anger,
PARTICULARS: Eye

For conjunctival and retinal haemorrhage with extravasation and intra ocular haemorrhage from injuries or cough. Arnica is an infallible remedy.

Gastrointestinal symptoms

Stomach : Longing for vinegar. Distaste for milk and meat, Pain in stomach during eating. Belching and eructation are very much foul, putrid, like rotten eggs. Putrid smell from mouth.
