name: Arsenicum Album
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: ARSENIC patient can be compared to a RACE HORSE as PULSATILLA to a SHEEP and ANTIM CRUD to a SWINE. Arsenic is a deadly poison. The fatal dose is 2-4 grains, Arsenic was used as a medicine from ancient times. Hughes says that Arsenic was used in China long ago and in India for cutaneous affection, neuralgia, chorea and_ cholera. Physiological dose will produce vomiting, purging and great prostration due to excessive secretion from gastro-intestinal tract. It produces feeble pulse. In short, it gives the full picture of a cholera patient or you may imagine a dying man with burning sensation, continuously sipping warm drinks and wants to be carried from one place to another, with a cadaverous odour from his body. Kent even says that from the very odour itself you may recognise an Arsenic patient as soon as you enter his room.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Alcoholism, Anaemia, Asthma, Abdominal disorders, Cancerous affections, Carbuncle, Cholera, Cough, Delirium, Diarrhoea, Dropsy, Duodenal ulcer, Fever, Gangrene, Gastric ulcer, Gout, Headache, Heart affection, Haemorrhoids, Kidney affection, Locomotor ataxia, Lung affection, Measles, Menstrual disorders, Pleurisy, Pneumonia, Rheumatism, Rickets, Skin affection, Throat affection, Vomiting, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Main seats of action of Arsenic are mind, nerves, mucous membrane, joints, periosteum, liver, spleen, lymphatics, blood, lungs, skin, stomach and alimentray canal. Arsenic acts more promptly on vegetarians than on non-vegetarians (rev.—Nux vy; All sat).

Arsenic is a poison and causes constant and violent irritation to all tissues such as:— 1. Acting on gastro-intestinal tract, it produces a picture like Cholera Asiatica.

2. It attacks blood, causing mente changes i.e. exanthemata, ecchymosis, petechial haemorrhage, etc.

3. It attacks veins, varices which burn like fire, especially at night.

es

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Arsenic patient has GREAT FEAR OF DEATH. Thinks that he is incurable, the

disease is fatal and it is useless to take medicines.

2. Mentally restless, but physically too weak and exhausted to move about. It is one

of the trio of restlessness (others being Aconite for mental restlessness and Rhus tox. for Physical restlessness). Just like a horse an Arsenic patient is always restless.

. Burning pain relieved by heat except in head. This is very much peculiar and

characteristic of Arsenic. Kent says that the patient wants to keep his body in a hot room but head in refrigerator.

. Great prostration is persistently present, sinking of strength out of proportion to

a degree of illness.

. Gastric derangements such as diarrhoea, vomiting, etc., are due to food poisoning

from spoiled eggs, fish or meat, decayed food, alcohol, ice cream, etc.

. Complaints return periodically (usually annually), So it is a useful drug in

intermittent fever.

. All discharges are acrid, scanty, putrid, dark and offensive with cadaverous odour

(rotten egg—Sulphur; rotten cheese—Hepar Sulph; sour milk—Calc. carb.; like fumes of sulphur Phosphorus).

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

etc.

Causation: Exposure to cold, taking ice cream, decayed food, loss of vital fluid, abuse of alcohol,

Location: According to Kent, Arsenic has periodical headache in all parts of head: even forehead is

congested.

Character of pain: Headache with throbbing and burning. Occipital headache is so severe as to

make the patient dazed, feels as if the skull would burst. Sensation as if there is vibration and looseness in brain. Head is hot. Headache every two weeks.

name: Arsenicum Iodatum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This medicine was originally used by H. Nankivell, on analogical grounds, in case of Phthisis. It has had a short, independent proving, and symptoms observed on patients have increased the pathogenesis. In Ars. lod. the conditions resemble more closely those of Arsenic than those of lodum.

CLINICAL :

Angina Pectoris, Breast-tumour of. Bronchitis. | Cancer-Catarrh. Consumption. Debility. Diarrhoea. Epithelioma. Eczema, Hay fever. Heart-affection of. Laryngitis. Liver-affection of. Otorrhoea. Pneumonia. Psoriasis. Syphilisis.

SYPHERES OF ACTION :

Especially it acts upon mucous membr-ances of respiratory tract, digestive tract, and also acts upon heart, glands and skin. CONSTITUTION :

No particular look or physical make up is present is Ars-Iod.

Relation with heat & cold : Sensitive to heat & cold. Miasm : Psora & Syphilis in the background. Diathesis : Tubercular diathesis.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Discharges are irritating, Corrosive, profuse & greenish yellow.

2) Chronic nasal Catarrh : Thin, watery excoriating dis-charge from anterior & posterior nares.

3) Enlarged scrofulous glands.

4) Recurrent fever with drenching night sweats, profound prostration, emaciation with rapid feeble pulse.

5) Marked exfoliation of skin in large scales, leaving a raw exuding surface beneath.

6) Epithelioma of the lip.

7) Cancer of breast after ulceration has set in.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Respiratory symptoms

Nose : It is a very useful remedy for chronic nasal catarrh, hay fever, etc. There is irritation and tingling in nose with constant desire for sneezing. Discharge is thin, watery, irritating excoriating from anterior and posterior nares. In chronic nasal Catarrah, the nose is swollen, membrane is sore and excoriated with profuse, thick yellow discharge. Modality : Nasal symptoms are aggravated by sneezing. Throat: Especially indicated in diptheria, tonsillitis, and chronic follicular pharyngitis. There is

marked burning in Pharynx with dryness. Difficult swallowing, foetid breath, enlarged swollen glands are the other indications in throat complaints.

Chest: Dry hacking cough with little expectoration. Cough is also loose, croupy, suffocating & spasmodic, Expectoration is copious greenish—yellow and purulent. Asthma from 11 p.m. until 2 a.m. It is indicated in tuberculosis when there is hoarse, racking cough with profuse, purulent expectoration. Debility, emaciation, tendency to diarrhoea and fever with night sweats are present.

Modalities : Aggravation from motion, talking, in warm room.

Skin : It has many types of eruptions on the skin, such as, boils, pustules, rash and scales, moist eruptions, eczema, itching eruptions, herpes and psoriasis. Skin is dry, scaly and itching. There is marked exfoliation of skin in large scales, leaving a raw exuding surface beneath. Acne hard, shotty, indurated base with pustule at apex. Eczeme of the beard, watery, oozing itching & worse by washing.

Relations

Compare : Tuberculinum, Antim-lod. Antidote : Bry. Complementary: Phos.

N.B.: Ars. lod. should not be given in empty stomach.

name: Arum Triphyllum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Arum Triphyllum is the most important of the Arums. It is one of the sovereign remedies for an acute cold. It should not be given in low potency or repeated often as bad effects often follow.

CLINICAL:

Aphonia. Coryza. Diphtheria, Headache. Mouth sore, scarlatina. Typhoid. Clergyman’s sore throat. Glandular swellings. Tongue cracked,

SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS :

It prominently affects left side. It has marked action on mucous menbranes of mouth, throat, larynx. It also acts on kidneys, brain, blood and skin. It is an irritant poison causing excitability & irritability of mind and body. It causes inflammation of the mucous surfaces and destruction of the tissue. Discharges are acrid causing painful, sore, rawness & burning of parts.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Constant picking at the nose until it bleeds, boring with the finger into the side of the nose.

2) Pick lips until they bleed, corners of mouth cracked & bleeding.

3) Acrid, ichorous discharges, excoriating mucous surfaces.

4) Painfully sore, raw and burning of parts.

5) Nose feels stopped, inspite of the watery discharge.

6) Aphonia complete, after exposure to northwest winds (Aco., Hep.) and from singing (Arg. Nit., Caust.)

7) Fluent Coryza with nostrils raw.

8) Children refuse food & drink on account of soreness of mouth & throat.

9) Tongue and buccal cavity raw and bleeding with profuse acrid salivation.

10) Ailments from—Exposure to northwest wind, getting cold, overuse of voice.

11) Mind—Children excessively cross & stubborn. They are nervous, restless and irritable. Persistently boring into nose or picking at lips, fingers at one spot until it is sore or bleeds.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Mouth : Mouth painfully raw, sore and inflamed. Corners of mouth cracked and bleeding. There is profuse acrid secretion of saliva corroding the mucous menbranes of mouth. Patients pick and bore into raw bleeding surface though very painful. He screams with pain but keeps up the boring, This is key note symptom in diphtheria, scarlatina & typhoid. Tongue cracked and bleeding. Children refuse food and drink on account of soreness of mouth and throat.

Nose : Arum Triphyllum is one of the important remedies in acute- cold when the discharge is acrid and fluent. Stuffy nose inspite of the watery discharge, patient must breathe through the mouth. Sneezing worse at night. Constant picking at the nose until it bleeds. Boring with the finger into the side of the nose is another characteristic of this remedy.

Throat : Throat is raw, sore, painful on clearing or coughing. Patient cannot swallow. It is medicine for cleargyman’s sore throat or sore throat on one who speaks a great deal, orators, singers, actors. Voice is hoarse, uncertain, uncontrollable, chang'rg continually. Complete aphonia after exposure to north west

winds and from singing. Modality: Aggravation : Talking, speaking, or singing.

General Modalities : Aggravation : Overuse of voice, talking, singing, northwest wind, heat, lying down, at night.

Relations

Useful after—Hep, & Nit. Acid in hoarse, croupy cough. After—Caust. & Hep. in morming hoarseness & deafness and in scarlatina.

subsections.content: Useful after—Hep, & Nit. Acid in hoarse, croupy cough. After—Caust. & Hep. in morming hoarseness & deafness and in scarlatina.

name: Umbelliferae
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
In common language it is called the Devil’s Dung, a name very apporpriate because of the very offensive smell. It was introduced in our Materia Medica by Franz in 1822 and Hahnemann himself contributed to the proving. Its influence is most marked on the nervous system producing hysteria, chorea & neuralgia. It is suited to nervous, hysterical & syphilitic people.

Asthma. Bone-diseases of. Chorea. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Hysteria. Iritis, Lactatton-

diseases of. Neuralgia. Ozaena. Syphilis. Ulcers.

1) Hysteria from suppression of habitual discharge such as sudden checking of long standing expectoration or of chronic diarrhoea or menses or skin affections.lt has globus hystericus i.e. patient feels as if a ball ascends from stomach to oesophagus. This is attended with excessive distension of abdomen and sensation as if the peristaltic motions were reversed with eructations

smelling like garlic even regurgitation of food.

2) Asafoetida affects left side generally : Left side of abdomen, left side of neck & nape,

left arm & left leg. (Lach., Lil. Tig., Thuja).

3) All discharges are horribly offensive and ichorous.

4) Intolerance of all dressings ; sensitivness to contact is a leading characteristic in

periosteal inflammations, ulcers & caries of bones.

5) An empty gone feeling in the stomach at 11 A.M. (Sulph., Zinc) with a strange pulsation in the pit of the stomach.

6) Deficient milk with oversensitiveness after confinement (Lac Defl.)

7) Modalities.

Aggravation—After eating, drinking, at night, rest, warm, left side.

Amelioration—By pressure, in open air.

Aggravation—After eating, drinking, at night, rest, warm, left side.

Amelioration—By pressure, in open air.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This medicine is prepared from star fish belonging to the natural order of Radiata so it shows its pathogenetic relationship to Sepia & Murex which are prepared from cuttle fish and

purple fish respectively. CLINICAL :

Acne. Apoplexy. Cancer, Constipation, Convulsions. Epilepsy. Headache. Diarrhoea. Uterus-affection of.

SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS:

It mainly acts on circulation, nerves, female sexual organs & rectum. This remedy produces disturbances of the circulation with pulsations and congestion in head, womb & chest., Acting on female sexual organs It produces great excitement.

CONSTITUTION :

Make up of the body : It is suited to flabby lymphatic constitution with red face.

Temperament : Iritable temperament.

Diathesis : Sycotic Diathesis.

Miasm : Sycotic & psoric miasms are in the background.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Easily excited by any emotion, especially by contradictions (Ana. Con.)

2) Sanguinous congestion of the brain.

3) Heat of the head, as if surrounded by hot air.

4) Apoplexy, face red, pulse hard, full, frequent.

5) Gait unsteady, muscles refuse to obey the will (Alum., Gels.)

6) Epilepsy, twitching over the whole body four or five days before the attack.

7) Constipation : Obstinate, ineffectual desire with hard round ball like stool.

8) Diarrhoea : Watery, brown, gushing out in a violent jet (Grot. T.,) Orat, Gam. Jatr., Thuja)

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The most precious thing which any creature likes and loves in the world, is its ‘own life’. Anything and everything could be sacrificed for its ultimate protection. But here is an element which possesses the inherent power to destroy the very desire to survive. Gold is a very rare valuable metal, no doubt. Still it hasn’t got any direct utility as such in its natural form. It was Hahnemann who found out the high therapeutic “value of gold after it undergoes the process of potentisation.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Alcoholism, Asthma, Gonorrhoea, Genital organs, Glandular affection, Haemorrhoids, Heart affection, Locomotor ataxia, Mental affection, Paralysis, Syphilis, Throat affection, Urinary discorders, Uterine troubles, Vertigo, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Aurum met. affects mind, nerves, bones, cardiovascular system, genito-urimary organs and glands.

PATHOGENESIS

Its actions on the mind and brain mainfest a strong tendency to profound melancholy and inclination to constantly dwelling on suicide. It affects bones and glands tending to destruction of tissues, while its action on heart results in degeneration of the tissue and their reflex symptoms. It degenerates even blood and causes haemorrhage.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body, Aurm met. is suited to sanguine, ruddy people, with black hair and eyes, old people who are tired of life due to their missdeeds, having no desire to live and low spirited, lifeless pining boys. Constitution broken down by bad effects of mercury and syphilis.

Temperament: Melancholic and irritable temperament.

Relation with heat and cold; Very chilly patient.

Miasm: Syphilis is in the background.

Diathesis: Scrofulous diathesis.

100

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Suited to old people who are tired of life, in whom syphilis is implanted on a scrofulous constitution.

2. PROFOUND MELANCHOLY AND CONSTANTLY DWELLING ON SUICIDE.

3. Hurried and worried; uneasy and restless

4, Aggravation from sunet to sunrise (Merc. Syphi.).

5. Oversensitive to pain, smell, taste, hearing, touch etc.

6. Mind : Aurum met. patient shows peculiar characteristic, rare and uncommon mental symptoms as follows: All mental affections are consequent upon and incidental to bad effects of mercury and syphilis. He feels as if he has committed many unpardonable crimes and sins of enormous magnitude when young and on realisation of the paramount seriousness thereof, he becomes sad, repentant and despondent with despair of salvation and eager for redemption of sins. Therefore, he is sad and has complete disgust for life; very gloomy and taciturn. In order to get rid of these worries, he is constantly DWELLING UPON SUICIDE as the only way of solution. Consequently PROFOUND MELANCHOLY, prevails upon him throughout. He feels that life is a constant burden for him; feels hateful and quarrelsome and want to put a permanent end to it by COMMITTING SUICIDE. Aurum met, is the topmost medicine for depressive insanity. Self condemnation is inborn in a Aurum met, patient. He is very restless and anxious about the future. Has great desire for mental and physical activity, still connot do things fast enough. He is low-spirited, lifeless with weak memories. He is very much hurried and worried; uneasy and restless; irritable and peevish; least contradiction excites anger in him. He feels that he is an unwanted element in society and has no right to live; even God cannot pardon his unlimited amount of sins and crimes, etc.

7. Ailments from : Bad effects of mercury, syphilis, alcohol, fear, fright, anger, contradiction, mortification, vexation, dread, reserved displeasure and disappointed love.

PARTICULARS :

Headache

Causation: Headache from least mental exertion, fear, fright, anger or contradiction. Headache from constipation.

Character of headache: Intense congestive headache with heat. Tearing pain through the brain to forehead. Boring and tearing in skull bones.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Baptisia tinctoria is a Short acting and left- sided rernedy and can undoubtedly be claimed as a near about specific remedy for typhoid fever in any stage—says Dr. P.C. Paul of Calcutta. More than 60% of early cases of typhoid point towards Baptisia. Dr, Burnett says of it, “The king of all remedies for typhoid. No remedy can supplant it in the first stage”. Referring to this remedy Dr. Farrington says: “Typifies a fever which is decided typhoidly in tendency”. It can also be used as preventive against typhoid. In its low potency, it produces antibodies against typhoid bacilli. Dr. Bell says, “Extended clinical observation has proved its value when dysentery assumes the typhoid type”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Dilirium, Enteric fever, Headache, Hectic fever, Throat affection, Tonsillitis, Uleerated tongue, Urinary affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Baptisia acts on blood, mind, nerves, mucous membrane of digestive tract; left side of the body. PATHOGENESIS

Baptisia disorganises and decomposes the blood and thereby tends to putrescence, specially in low fevers as in typhoid, paratyphoid and dysentery, etc. The principal use of Baptisia is exact typhoid state. In low potency it is capable of producing antibodies against the typhoid bacilli and thus it can undoubtedly be said to be a specific remedy for typhoid fever. It can also be used as a preventive medicine against typhoid.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Face of Baptisia patient look as if flushed, dusky and dark red. He is stupid and has besotted expression and looks like a drunkard with prefect indifference. Ulcerated mouth with OFFENSIVE SMELL and OFFENSIVE breath.

Temperament: Lymphatic temperament.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora is in the background.

104

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. All the discharges of the body such as stool, urine, sweat and ulcers are VERY

OFFENSIVE. Even breath is very offensive.

. In whatever position the patient lies, THE PARTS RESTED UPON FEEL SORE

AND BRUISED.

. Patient is unable to sleep as he thinks that his head and body are scattered around

the bed; he is three persons and is unable to keep them covered. So he tosses about to get the pieces together.

. Patient falls asleep even before he can answer a question or in the midst of his

answer.

. Perfect indifference and incapability of thinking anything; stupid, inability of fixing

his mind on work, aversion to mental labour.

6. He can swallow liquid only; least solid food gags; his throat is sore but painless.

10.

. Look of the face is flushed, dusky and dark red with stupidness. Face and eyes are

suffused so as to give it a besotted appearance and expression is like that of a drunkard,

. Ulceration in the mouth with offensive smell and dry tongue with a streak down the

centre.

. A typical “TYPHOID STATE” is present in all diseases, such as typhoid, dysentery,

diphtheria, etc.

Mind : Confused mind and perfect indifference. The patient is absolutely incapable of thinking anything with utter inability to fix his mind on any work. Does not want to do any mental work. °

The patient falls asleep either before completing the answer to a question, or sometimes when he is in the middle of an answer. The patient tosses about and says

that he feels his head and/or body is scatterd around the bed; he is three pieces or persons and is unable to keep them covered; so he tries to get those pieces together.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Typhoid Fever :

Dr. Burnett says, “Baptisia is the king of all remedies for typhoid. No remedy can supplant it in

the first stage.” It is claimed that Baptisia will, cut the disease short if given as soon as typhoid is suspected. It can be said to be almost the specific remedy for typhoid fever in any stage.

The symptoms which call for Baptisia in typhoid are as follows:-

(a) Temperature: Ranging from 103°F to 106°F. There Is great nervousness, chilliness and aching pain especially in head, back and limbs. SORE AND BRUISED FEELING OF THE PARTS RESTED UPON, IN WHATEVER POSITION HE LIES, is well-marked.

(b) Pulse: There is marked bradycardia, Pulse \s full and soft.

name: Baryta Carbonica
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Baryta carb. is fully proved and constitutional remedy. It is deep-seated, long lasting medicine and it especially suits to those who are at the extremes of life, i.e. infants and

old people.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Aneurysm, Apoplexy, Alimentary affection, Brain affection, Dwarfism, Foot-sweat, Glandular swelling, Haemorrhoids, Heart affection, High B.P., Memory defective, Quinsy, Tonsillitis, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on nutrition, glands, throat, prostrate, heart, blood vessels and nerves.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces degenerative changes in infancy, acting upon the glandular system, causing inflammation and hypertrophy. In old age it is capable of acting on muscular coat of heart and blood vessels producing arteriosclerosis. Blood vessels get thickened and haemorrhage occurs. Due to this there is high rise of blood pressure especially in old men.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: Baryta carb. patients are dwarfish in appearance; mentally deficient and physically weak and short. Children present a picture of typical cretinism, having short stature, swollen abdomen, puffy face, enlarged glands, thick lips and idiotic appearance. Old people, weak and fatty but childish in behaviour.

Temperament: Melancholic temperament.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora is in the background.

Diathesis: Tubercular and scrofulous diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Dwarfishness, both mental and physical, runs through the whole of Baryta carb.

2. Those who are liable to take cold easily, and every cold settles in the throat, resulting in sore throat, tonsillitis, quinsy and other glandular affections need the

help of this great remedy.

108

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : The buccal cavity smells foul. Dryness of mouth early in the moming. Vesicles inside the cheek and the mouth. Saliva runs out of mouth in sleep. Intolerable stench from mouth unnoticed by the patient himself.

Teeth : After eating, teeth feels too weak to chew any more. TOOTHACHE IN DECAYED teeth, before menses or from cold. TOOTHACHE WORSE when thinking about it, disappears when the MIND IS diverted.

Throat

* Causation: Tonsillitis, caused by Supperssion of foot-sweat, cold drinks and cold air. * Character of throat affection: Every cold settles in the throat. Tonsils inflamed with engorged veins; enlarged glands of the neck. Smarting in the throat when swallowing. Throat is sore to touch.

Tonsils enlarged and prone to suppurate, especially on right side. Along with tonsillitis, palate and uvula are also swollen.

* Modalities: Aggravation on swallowing solids and when thinking about his troubles. * Concomitans; Sensation of plug in throat. Tonsillitis leading to quinsy.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Belladonna was known to the medical profession as early as 1500 A.D., but its full therapeutic value was not realised until it was potentised and proved by Hahnemann. The word “Belladonna” is a combination of two Latin words “Bella” and “Donna” which means “Beautiful Lady”. The Venetian ladies, of olden days used this plant as a cosmetic to brighten their eyes and flush the cheeks due to the property of its alkaloids, Atropin and Belladonnin. It was Hahnemann’s deep insight which could find out the immense curative value of these alkaloids and transformed them into a marvellous medicine through the process of potentisation.

Belladonna is one of Hahnernann’s Polychrests which has its Paramount utility in ACUTE AND VIOLENT CONDITIONS. It is one of those medicines without which we

might indeed to close our shops. Belladonna is one of CLARKE’S A.B.C. NURSERIES, others being Aconite and

Chamomilla. WHILE BELLADONNA CAUSES TURMOIL IN BRAIN, ACONITE and CHAMOMILLA CAUSE TURMOIL IN CIRCULATION AND TEMPERAMENT

RESPECTIVELY.

CLINICAL -

Abscess, Apoplexy, Boils, Brain affection, Carbuncle, Convulsion, Cough, Delirium, Dysentery, Epilepsy, Fever, Glandular affection, Headache, Heart trouble, Lung affection, Measles, Meningitis, Menstrual troubles, Mumps, Skin affection, Pleurisy, Disorders of pregnancy, Rheumatism, Uterine affection, Vertigo, Whooping cough, Abdominal affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its chief centre of action is cerebrum from where it radiates its influence upon the entire organism. Brain and its membranes, cardio-vascular system, heart, lungs, mucous membrane of eyes, mouth, throat, skin, glandular structures are also not spared.

Its action on brain and its membranes and various organs produces a state of CONGESTION everywhere in the body leading to inflammation, delirium, illusion, delusion and hallucination and mania. General hyperaesthesia of both sensory and motor

113

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. 2.

Belladonna is predominantly a right sided remedy.

Acute “SUDDEN and VIOLENT” onset is very characteristic of this drug. This aspect of the symptom is invariably present in every disease requiring Belladonna.

. “Congestion” is the key note of Belladonna. (Tension is the keynote of Aconite). As

a result of its action on the brain a state of active congestion is produced, resulting in furious excitement, irritability, convulsion, delirium and pain. Consequently, there is FLUSHED FACE, THROBBING CAROTIDS, HARD AND BOUNDING PULSE, rush of blood to head with wild delirium. Congestion causes redness of the face and eyes, rush of blood to head and face, throbbing of brain and carotids.

. “Redness” of Belladonna is very characteristic. Arising from congestion there is

great redness of the inflamed part in particular and in general, all over. The skin is very red and shiny. Smooth redness of the surface occurs over the whole body.

. “Heat” is yet another peculiarity. Due to the congestion there is great heat,

especially at the congested and inflamed part. The heat is so severe that the affected part imparts a burning sensation to the examining hand and the physician is reflexly compelled to withdraw his hand.

. “Burning” sensation is another characteristic of Belladonna. There is intense

burning anywhere and everywhere, both internal and external such as in skin, brain, mouth, throat, tonsils, stomach, liver, etc.

. Sensitiveness to touch of affected part is very well marked in this great remedy.

Cannot bear to be touched anywhere.

. Great dryness runs through the whole of this drug. This dryness is often associated

with heat, redness, burning and throbbing. -

. Along with the above sings of inflammation, swelling or oedema are also found. The

affected part is swollen, shiny, very red, hot and sensitive to touch.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Exposure to cold or to heat of sun; from hair cut; congestion and suppression of catarrhal flow.

Mode of Onset; Sudden and violent.

Location: Right side, supra-ciliary region and forehead.

Sensation: Sensation as if the brain were pushed through the forehead. Sensation of stabbing as by a knife from one temple to the other.

Character of pain: There is intense periodical nervous and CONGESTIVE HEADACHE, accompanied by tensive pressure on the vertex and on forehead, Rush of blood to the head with pulsation of cerebral arteries and THROBBING IN THE BRAIN. Jerking headache as if a weight were in the occiput; pain in the head and eye-balls, feels as if the eyes would be pushed out from the sockets.

Modalities

* Aggravation: From slight motion, jar, noise, light, touch, lying down, least exertion or leaning forwards, bending downwards or lying down; anything that takes the patient out of the prependicular

* Ameliorafion: By tight bandage and during menses.

* Concomitants: RED FACE, THROBBING OF CAROTIDS; often with pain in the eye balls, boring head into the pillow. REDNESS OF EYES with buming and great intolerance of light. Double vision, dim vision, objects’ appear upside down.

Vertigo

Vertigo is caused by stooping or rising after stooping or change of position. Vertigo with falling to the left side or backwards; as if objects tum in a circle or sway to and fro.

Sensitive to least contact. Scalp is very sensitive to touch with much throbbing and heat. Vanishing of sight and turning over in bed.

Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Mouth is very dry with or without thirst. Tongue and palate are dark red and dry: tremor and stammering speech. Submaxillary glands are swollen, Putrid taste in the mouth.

Throat : There is great dryness, of the throat and fauces, with REDNESS AND BURNING; Worse on the right side. Throat feels very much constricted with consequent difficulty in deglutition. Tonsillitis, worse on the right side. Uvula is red, swollen, very painful and burning, Constant urging and desire to swallow, Cervical glands are suddenly inflamed.

Stomach and Abdomen : There is great nausea and vomiting after eating and drinking. Vomiting of undigested food with much bile and/or blood; crampy and spasmodic pain in the stomach and epigastric region. Burning sensation in the stomach, pain in the stomach, which is aggravated by motion. Region of liver is very sensitive, painful and It Is very worse when lying in the right side. COLIC FROM GALL STONE is also found.

Abdomen is very painful and distended and it is very sensitive to touch. Constriction, pain and heat around umbilicus. Violent cutting pain in abdomen. Tenderness of the abdomen; aggravated by least jar,

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Acne, Boils. Indigestion. Masturbation, Over work. Pregnancy-complaints of. Railway spine. Rheuma-tism. Stasis. Traumatism. Varicosis.

1) Bellis Per is the first remedy in injuries to the deeper tissues, after major surgical work.

2) “Stasis & fag’—is the keynote of the remedy. “Exudation, stasis, swellings of all kinds, varicose veins, engorgement of breast and uterus, cerebral stasis etc. all come within the range of this remedy,

3) Traumatism—Of the pelvic organs with sore, bruised feeling in the pelvic region. Autotraumatism such as ill effects or fag from masturbation. It is an

excellent remedy for sprains and bruises. It is also indicated in condition like Railway spine i.e. Traumatic neurosis.

4) Complaints such as dyspepsia, amenorrhoea, skin affec-tions, rheumatism, effects of cold or iced drinks, when heated. DRUGS OF INJURY

1) Concealed injury—Arnica Mont.

2) Lacerated injury—Calendula.

3) Sprained injury—Rhus tox.

4) Bone injury—Symphytum.

5) Nerve injury—Hypericum.

6) Gland injury—Conium Mac.

7) Punctured injury—Ledum.

8) Capillary injury—Hamamelis.

9) Incised injury—Staphysagria.

10) Rubbing injury—Allium Cepa.

11) Burn injury—Cantharis.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This remedy occupies a very important place, though of limited scope, in our homoeopathic materia madica. The main action of the remedy is upon urinary system. It is one of the members of Nash’s trio of offensive urine, others being Nit. Acid & Sepia.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma. Bladder affection of. Cough. Diarrhoea. Enuresis. Ganglion. Gonorrhoea. Gout. Rheumatism. Prostate enlargement.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS
sections.content:
It acts especially upon the kidneys, urinary bladder, joints, and also on respiratory and digestive tracts. It produces and cures symptoms of a uric acid diathesis, with urine highly coloured and very offensive and gouty symptoms.

CONSTITUTION Physical make up—lIt is suited to gouty or the uraemic or the lithaemic constitution. Heat cold relation—Chilly patient. Miasm—All the three miasms are in the background. Diathesis—Rheumatic, gouty diathesis & uric acid diath-esis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Urine dark brown and the urinous odour highly intensified.

2) Nocturnal enuresis in delicate children with strong characteristic odour of urine-

3) Rheumatic and gouty complaints with gonorrhoeal or syphilitic base.

4) Asthmatic cough with expectoration of green mucus and extreme weariness.

5) Diarrhoea of children—Stool white, very offensive, exhausting, liquid,-stools running “right through the diaper”.

6) Gouty concretions, affects all the joints especially the knee, cracking on motion.

7) Pains tearing, stitching in large joints of big toe, redness and swelling of joints, gov! agg. at night.

8) Ganglion of wrist and bunion of great toe with urinary complaints.

120

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Urinary complaints

It has got marked action on urinary system. It is to be thought of in nocturnal enuresis of delicate children, enlargement of prostate in old men, catarrh of blad-der after suppressed gonorrhoea and even in any morbid condition, when urine is strong smelling.

Character of Urine—Urine is dark, brown and scanty with urinous odour highly intensified. There is excess of uric acid in urine.

Rheumatism & gout Causation—Suppressed gonorrhoea & syphillis. Location—All joints are affected ‘but especially knee symptoms may go from left to right.

Character of pain—Pains tearing, stitching in large joints especially of big toe. Pains suddenly change their locality. There is gouty concretions. Nodositis in joints, due to depos-ition of uric acid, cracking sound in joints. (Coc., Graph., Nit. acid)

Modality—Agg.—Open air, uncovering at night, motion. Ame.—By heat. Concomitant—Very strong smelling offensive urine and generally dark. Rheumatism alternating between the extremeties & heart.

General Modalities Aggravation—Motion, open air, uncovering at night, lying on right side.

Relations

Similar to—Cop., Nitr., Fer., Thuja especially in enuresis after Nitr. has failed. Berb Vulg., Lith C. in arthritic complaints. Think of Benz Acid when Colch. fails in gout and after abuse of Cop. in

Suppression of gonorrhoea. Incompatible—Wine which aggravates urinary, gouty and rheumatic affections. In Enuresis Benz. ac. can be compared with the following drugs: (1) In wormy children : Cina (2) After first sleep : Caust, Kreos,, Sep. (3) After Catheterisatiori : Mag. Phos. (4) In old people : Secale Cor. (5) When the best selected remedy fails, with a history of sycosis : Medo. (6) Obstinate cases with a family history of eczema : Psor.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Berberis belongs to vegetable kingdom, the natural order of Berberidaceae, to which order also belongs Caulophllum and Podophyllum. It occupies a very important place, though of limited scope, in our Homoeopathic Materia Medica. The main influence of the remedy is upon urinary system.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Biliary colic, Bladder and urinary affection, Gall-Stone colic, Renal colic, Rheumatism, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts especially upon the kidney, urinary bladder, liver and gall bladder. It is a left sided drug. PATHOGENESIS

Its action on urinary organs, results in irritation and subsequent inflammation and formation of renal stone; it produces gall-stone colic. It also has marked action on the liver promoting the flow of bile or when there is stasis of bile, producing gall-stone. Therefore, it is an excellent medicine for jaundice and gall-stone.

sepemeerccih CONSTITUTION Physical make-up: Berberis vulgaris is especially suited to those people who are pale. having earthy complexion with sunken cheeks, having blue rings me eyes. GUIDING SYMPTOMS NS 1. Left side is principally affected, left kidney and left urefer, 2. Bruised pain with numbness, stiffness in kidney region and in small a back. 3. Soreness of the kidney, bubbling sensation, worse from jar and motion. 4. Backache, worse when sitting or lying, especially when lying on bed in morning. 5. Sensation of numbness, stiffness and lameness with painful pressure in lumbar and renal region. 6. Wandering, radiating pains from one part to another, especially along the course of | left kidney and ureter. |

122 |

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gall-stone colic : It has got marked action on the liver and produces various kinds of manifestations.

* Character of pain: There is short, sudden, stabbing, puncturing type of pain in the liver region. The pain is shooting, tearing, burning, stitching and tingling, wandering from one side to another.

* Modality: Pain is aggravated from little jar and motion,

* Concomitants; Gall stone colic is often associated with jaundice. Stool white, bileless, clay coloured. = —

Urinary Symptoms :

Urine : Constant urging to urinate; sensation as if some urine remained after urinating, with burning pain in the bladder. The bladder becomes very irritable and urine very slow to flow.

Character of urine: Greenish, bloody with mucus and jelly like sediment. It may be dark, turbid. with copious sedimentation. :

Renal-colic :

¢ Causation: Due to stone in kidney.

* Location: Left sided, starting from left kidney to ureter, then to urinary bladder and coming down to urethra.

© Sensation: (1) Numbness in the kidney region. (2) Bubbling sensation in the kidney region. (3) Stiffness in the kidnty region. (4) Lameness and painful pressure in kidney region (5) Burning and soreness \n the kidney region.

* Character of pain; Stitching cutting pains from left kidney following the course of ureter, bladder and then to urethra. Pain run up to the kidney, burning, stitching in several successive waves In the region of kidney.

In acute condition, the pain is more severe. There may be haematuria with soreness in urethra. The character of urine may be bloody, greenish with thick slimy mucus and jelly-like sediment.

In thronic condition the urine may be dark, turbid with copious sedimentation. Urine is very slow to flow with constant urging.

INTRODUCTION: Berberis belongs to vegetable kingdom, the natural order of Berberidaceae, to which order also belongs Caulophllum and Podophyllum. It occupies a very important place, though of limited scope, in our Homoeopathic Materia Medica. The main influence of the remedy is upon urinary system.
CLINICAL: Biliary colic, Bladder and urinary affection, Gall-Stone colic, Renal colic, Rheumatism, etc.
SPHERES OF ACTION: It acts especially upon the kidney, urinary bladder, liver and gall bladder. It is a left sided drug. PATHOGENESIS

Its action on urinary organs, results in irritation and subsequent inflammation and formation of renal stone; it produces gall-stone colic. It also has marked action on the liver promoting the flow of bile or when there is stasis of bile, producing gall-stone. Therefore, it is an excellent medicine for jaundice and gall-stone.

sepemeerccih CONSTITUTION Physical make-up: Berberis vulgaris is especially suited to those people who are pale. having earthy complexion with sunken cheeks, having blue rings me eyes. GUIDING SYMPTOMS NS 1. Left side is principally affected, left kidney and left urefer, 2. Bruised pain with numbness, stiffness in kidney region and in small a back. 3. Soreness of the kidney, bubbling sensation, worse from jar and motion. 4. Backache, worse when sitting or lying, especially when lying on bed in morning. 5. Sensation of numbness, stiffness and lameness with painful pressure in lumbar and renal region. 6. Wandering, radiating pains from one part to another, especially along the course of | left kidney and ureter. |

122 |
PARTICULARS: Gall-stone colic : It has got marked action on the liver and produces various kinds of manifestations.

* Character of pain: There is short, sudden, stabbing, puncturing type of pain in the liver region. The pain is shooting, tearing, burning, stitching and tingling, wandering from one side to another.

* Modality: Pain is aggravated from little jar and motion,

* Concomitants; Gall stone colic is often associated with jaundice. Stool white, bileless, clay coloured. = —

Urinary Symptoms :

Urine : Constant urging to urinate; sensation as if some urine remained after urinating, with burning pain in the bladder. The bladder becomes very irritable and urine very slow to flow.

Character of urine: Greenish, bloody with mucus and jelly like sediment. It may be dark, turbid. with copious sedimentation. :

Renal-colic :

¢ Causation: Due to stone in kidney.

* Location: Left sided, starting from left kidney to ureter, then to urinary bladder and coming down to urethra.

© Sensation: (1) Numbness in the kidney region. (2) Bubbling sensation in the kidney region. (3) Stiffness in the kidnty region. (4) Lameness and painful pressure in kidney region (5) Burning and soreness \n the kidney region.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Just like many other metals, Bismuth too has been found to be an excellent remedy which exerts its general influence in the stomach region. It has been observed by Hahnemann that the hydrated oxide of Bismuth could be easily potentised to develop its curative power

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal, operation and Vomiting, Cholera, Cough Delirium, Diarrhoea, Gangrene, Headache, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Bismuth predominantly acts upon the gastrointestinal tract, mind and nervous system.

PATHOGENESIS

* Bismuth exerts its influence on the stomach and stomach region. It causes a PURE gastralgia, but not associated with catarrh, like that of Nux vom. There is ejection of water immediately after it is taken, but food is retained a little longer.

CONSTITUTION Bismuth is mostly an acute drug, as such consideration of constitution does not have much bearing on its selection.

Miasm: Psora and Syphilis are in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Bismuth patient CANNOT BEAR SOLITUDE THE ALWAYS WANTS AND DESIRES COMPANY (Stram., Kali carb., Lil., Lyco.).

2. He has MUCH ANGUISH and, therefore, moves about frequently—he sits, walks, lies, never long in one place.

3. Vomifing of water as soon as it reaches the stomach but solid food is retained for days together.

4. There is post-operative vomiting, especially of liquid, particulary after laparotomy, with GREAT ANGUISH OF MIND AND RESTLESSNESS.

125

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Vomiting

Vomiting of water in large quantity as soon as it reaches the stomach, but solid food is retained for

a long time until large accumulation takes place in the stomach, which also is vomited out later on in decomposed form which is very offensive.

There is convulsive gagging and inexpressible pain in the stomach due to accumulation of solid portion of food.

Such pain may also appear after laparotomy. Concomitants: Headache returns every winter, alternating or attended with gastralgia.

Stomach

Due to accumulation of large amount of solid food particles and stool, there is great pressure as from a load in one spot. There is great pain which is crampy and spasmodic in nature, with irritation, cardialgia and pyrosis.

Stool

Since food gets accumulated in the stomach .for several days, stool becomes very much profuse. offensive and cadaverous smelling.

Cholera

Bismuth is one of the best remedies for cholera infantum and cholera morbus, usually occurring is summer.

¢ Causation: Cholera is usually Caused in summer and In cholera epidemic time. * Onset: The onset is sudden and Its course Is rapid.

* Character: There is profuse vomiting and purging. Water is vomited out the moment it reaches stomach but solid food is retained a bit longer. In Bismuth cholera, vomiting predominates over purging:

name: Blatta Orientalis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It accidentaly relieved asthma in a patient who took tea in which these insects were boiled down. It is very useful in acute attacks of asthma especially when given in low potencies. CLINIGAL

Bronchial asthma. Bronchitis.

SPHERE OF ACTION It has special action on bronchiotracheal tree.

Borax is one of the invaluable medicines, with very distinctive symptomps and selective tissue action. It is not easy to forget this wonderful drug, only when its peculiar characteristics are mastered. In old days Borax was used with bland vehicles for treatment of sore nipples and children’s sore mouth. But Homoeopathy offered it as a medicine of great value, telling when it may or may not be used, Kent also acknowledges the fact that Borax was one of the main constituents amongst the domestic remedies used for all sorts of local conditions as a soothing substance and for

healing purpose.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) It acts best on stout and corpulent patients.

2) In acute case of asthma, especially when associated with bronchitis, threatened suffocation due to rattling of mucus, oppression of breathing, restlessness, profuse perspiration & aggravation from lying down are some of the indications.

3) Useful incases of bronchitis and phtihsis where there is much dyspnoea.

4) Indicated after Arsenic when it is insufficient ; Especially useful in acute cases when Arsenic has given temporary relief. (Thuja Oc. is chronic of Arsenic in Br. Asthma.)

5) It is also suited to cases which aggravate in rainy weather.

1. Dread of downward motion in nearly all complaints, e.g. while going downstairs or rapidly down hill. . Excessive nervousness, easily frightened by slightest noise. . Aphthae: mouth of the child feels hot to mother’s nipple. Child screams before urination (Lyco.). . Leucorrhoea copious, albuminous and UNNATURALLY HOT. . Symptoms are aggravated in warm weather and after menstruation.

. Mind : Great anxiety. Patient is anxious about trifles. He starts at every noise, on hearing unexpected news, from excitement, this anxiety and nervousness are aggravated from DOWNWARD MOTION, even riding down hill or walking downstairs.

The patient is excessively nervous. Easily frightened by the slightest noise or an unusual sharp sound, and cough, sneeze, cry, lighting of a match, etc.

It was hysterical manifestation also. Changes from one work to another. It has restlessness, nervousness, anxiety, and excitable state which run through the entire drug.

a Ao ® wo Ww

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Aphthae, Diarrhoea, Ear discharge, Eye affection, Headache, Menstrual disorders, Leucorrhoea, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It mainly acts on gastro-intestinal system, especially mouth, stomach and rectum female genital organs, especially vagina and vulva. Skin and blood are not spared when the drug is used in physiological doses.

On the mouth and other mucus membranes, it produces a state of inflammation— ulceration with too much heat and copious secretions. From the uterus and vagina there

is discharge of HOT ACRID LEUCORRHORA. This heat and acridity are the keynotes and characteristic pathological effects of the drug whenever it is needed. CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Borax is especially suited to women and children with pale earthy face, red nose of young women, lax skin and muscles, tangled and frowsy hair.

Relation with heat and cold: Hot patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

122

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Head

Plica polonica (matted hair because of filth and from a parasite). Hair becomes frowsy, tangled, splits, sticks together at the tips. If these bunches are cut off, they form again; very difficult to be combed.

Eyes

Lashes turn inwards; eyelids are inflammed; eye lashes loaded with dry, gummy exudation, agglutinated in the morning, turn inward and inflame the eyes.

Mouth

Aphthae in the mouth, on tongue and inside the cheeks, buccal mucus membrane much reddened. easily bleeding during eating or when touched prevents child from nursing, with hot mouth, cracked arid bleeding tongue with salivation. Aphthous sore mouth; worse from touch and taking salty or sour food,

Menses

Useful in membranous dysmenorrhoea when there is violent, labour like pain before and during the flow, as if the uterus would expel itself through the vagina. Menstruation has the following characteristics :

* Time: Too early.

* Quantity: Too profuse. * Character of blood: Very MUCH HOT: the flow starts meagrely, but the same violent pain keeps on until the expulsion of the membrane. .

* Concomitants: Pain in the head and stomach with buzzing sound -in the ears.

name: Bovista
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This drug with a limited sphere of curative action is obtained from a globular fungus. It is eaten in Italy before it is ripe, and when ripe, it becomes filled with a blackish dust that breaks its husk with a slight noise. Corresponding to this doctrine of signature, bloatedness, puffy condition of the body surface, signs of enlargement, flatulence, distention and noisy passage of flatus are the leading features of Bovista PATHOGENESIS is.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Coccyx itching, Diarrhoea, Skin affection, Headache, Heart affection, Menstrual disordets, Leucorrhoea, Rheumatism, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
With a limited sphere of action on the female uro-genital systems, abdomen, blood and skin, the drug has earned unlimited name and fame.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces moist vesicular eruptions with formation of thick crusts. It relaxes the entire capillary system leading to haemorrhage from various outlets. Loose stool and vomiting are the effects when it produces inflammation of gastro-intestinal tract. On the

skin it causes warts and corns.

CONSTITUTION Physical make-up: Adapted to old maids who suffer from tettery type of eruptions. Temperament: Nervous temperament.

Miasm: Sycosis is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Discharges from all mucous membrane are very tough, stringy and tenacious (Kali bi., Hydrastis), 2. Intolerance of tigh lothing around the waist (Lach.). 3. Usually deep impression on finger from using blunt instruments, scissors, knife, etc. 4. Sweat in axilla smells like onion. 5. Awkwardness: inclined to drop things from hand (Apis, mel., Natrum mur.).

132

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Menses

In menorrhagia and metrorrhagia. Bovista is infallible. Time: Too early or occasional show every few days between periods. Character of blood: Dark and clotted.

Pain

Painful bearing down sensation. There is occasional show of menstrual blood every few days between periods with intolerance of tight clothing around the waist.

Modality: Aggravation of flow only at night, not in the day time. (Mag. carb., Kreos., Ver. alb.— rev, of Cactus, Caust., Lil.).

Concomitant: Diarrhoea before and during menses.

Leucorrhoea

It has pronounced leucorrhoea. Time: Leucorrhoea ten days after menses (Borax, Conium).

Character: Very much acrid; thick, stringy, tenacious; the discharge may be like white of an egg or yellowish, green with soreness of vulva.

Skin

Unhealthy skin. The eruptions may be either dry or moist, with thick crust formed by very thick,

tough, stringy and tenacious discharges from the eruptions.

Urticaria on excitement: Urticaria covers nearly the whole body from exertion. There is intense itching at the tip of coceyx, scratches until it bleeds, still there is no relief. Usually there is deep impression on fingers, from using blunt instruments, scissors, knife, etc.

Extremities

There is great weakness of all joints, clumsiness, weariness of hand and feet, drops things from hand, objects fall from powerless hands. The patient drops cups and various other objects and breaks them constantly in spite of great carefulness and firm determination not to do so, This is due to weariness and weakness of joints.

Relations

Bovista antidotes tar application; suffocation from gas.

In chronic urticaria when Rhus tox. seems indicated but falls to cure. Antidoted by: Camphor.

Antidotes to; Effects of tar applied locally.

Followed well by: Gale., Rhus tox., Sepia.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It is a deep acting, constitutional, poly-chrest

medicine. It’s chief action is on the respiratory organs especially larynx & trachea etc.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Respiratory Symptoms

Coryza : Coryza with corrosive soreness of nose. There is pressure at the root of nose with stoppage of right nostril. Fan like motion of alae-nasi (Ant tart, Lyco, phos) Sneezing from inhaling dust.

Hoarseness with dry cough & rawness in throat. Hoarseness coming on, from becoming overheated.

Diptheria : In diptheria the formation of diptheric membrane starts in bronchi, trachea or larynx and extending upwards. Chest pain runs upwards. There is membranous and dipth-eritic croup with much rattling during cough but no choking.

Cough : During whooping cough there is croupy symptoms with hoarseness. Patient gasps for breath. Cough, spasmodic with rattling of mucus. Every inspiration provokes cough. Cold sensation in larynx is characteristic.

Asthma : It is a very good medicine for sailors’ asthma. Sailors suffer from asthma “on shore” or when they come on land & better at sea.

Dyspnoea : With inability to inspire deep cough. There is sensation as if breathing through a sponge or the air passages are full of smoke or vapour of sulphur.

Sexual Symptoms : Male : Swelling & induration of testicles with pains worse slight jar. Female ; Menses : Too early ; too profuse with membranous shreds. Low spirited before menses.

Breast: Tumour in breasts with stitching pains, worse left. Stitch-pains from breasts to axillae: Sharp shooting pain in left breast, worse pressure.

General Modalities :

Aggravation : From evening, until midnight. when sitting in warm room, warm, damp weather.,

Amelioration : From any motion, exercise, at sea.

Relations : Compare : in croup & croupy affections, chlor. Hep., lod, Spong. Bromium had cured croup after failure of lod., Phos., Spong., Hep.,

Hard goitre was cured after lod. failed.

N.B. : “The Chief distinction between Brom. and lod. Is, the former cures the blue-eyed and the latter the black-eyed patients"—Hering.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Bryonia is one of the remedies in Homoeopathy, which is especially useful in acute diseases. It was one of the Hahnemiann’s earliest provings—one of those “without which” as Dudgeon says, “We might indeed shut up our shops”. Hence, Bryonia finds its pride of place in every handbook of Homoeopathy and into every domestic medicine chest.

Alcoholism, Asthma, Bilious attack, Brain affection, Constipation, Dropsy, Dyspepsia, Enteric fever, Headache, Heart affection. Measles, Meningitis, Rheumatism, Vicarious, Menstruation, Breast affection, Cough, Epistaxis, Gastric disorders, Pleurisy, Pneumonia, Respiratory affection, Thirst, Tongue, Toothache, Vertigo, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Serous membrane, mucous membrane, liver, fibrous tissue, respiratory system and brain are its main seats of acion. It is a right sided remedy.

PATHOGENESIS

It acts as an irritant and sets up a condition of sub-acute inflammation of synovial membranes, resulting in exudation and effusion in muscle fibres and joints, thus presenting a picture of typical rheumatic arthritic symptoms. Inflammation, dryness and lack of secretion, except in case of serous effusion, are the keynote actions of Bryonia. Jn all the mucous membranes of the body, there is great dryness and lack of secretion. It affects blood in its quantity, quality as well as circulation, increasing the flow and power of the heart’s action.

CONSTITUTION Make-up of the body: Tall, slender persons having dark hair, dark complexion, and firm muscular fibres. Temperament: Irritable temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Patients are hot; aggravated by warmth in general. Miasm: Psora is in the background. Diathesis: Rheumatic and gouty diathesis,

136

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1, All complaints are worse from motion : This “worse from motion” in Bryonia is such a constant symptom with all sufferings and in all parts of the body, as to have become a GENERAL, ALONG WITH AMELIORATION BY ABSOLUTE REST AND PRESSURE,

2. It is a very persistent remedy. All complaints develop slowly and have an insidious beginning (Gels).

8. Bryonia causes dryness of all the mucus membranes e.g. lips, mouth, nose, respiratory tract, alimentary tract and thereby produces some of the most characteristic symptoms, e.g. DRY, HARD AND KNOTTY STOOL; DRY SPASMODIC COUGH, STITCHING PAIN, ETC.

4. Great thirst for large quantity of cold water at long intervals; great appetite, eats voraciously,

5. Stitching pain runs through the whole of Bryonia which is relieved by absolute rest and pressure and by lying on painful side.

6. Bryonia is gourmand (Nux, an epicure).

7. Dropsical effusion into the serous and synovial memberane, resulting in pleurisy, rheumatic arthritis etc.

8. Desire: Desires for things, which when offered are immediately refused (China, Cham., Kreosote, Staph.); oysters, sweets, coffee, cold acid drinks and sour drink.

Aversion: To milk, rich food, fatty and greasy food.

9. Most complaints aggravate in summer and by heat; symptoms aggravate after a meal.

10. There is intolerance of vegetable food.

11. Vicarious menstruation; nose bleed when menses should appear (phos.); blood spitting or haemoptysis.

12. Breasts are heavy, of a stony hardness, pale but hard, hot and painful; MUST SUPPORT THEM WITH HAND TO prevent least motion.

13. Mind : The patient is very morose and ill humoured; exceedingly irritable and inclined to be angry. There are great anxiety and mental depression, Delirium, talks about daily business; worse at night; desires to escape from bed and wants to go home, although the patient is at home. Constant motion of the left arm and leg. Desires for things which are refused when offered. Weakness of mind, as if he would faint.

14. Ailments from Anger, chagrin, mortification; complaints after taking cold or getting hot in summer; when the days are hot and nights are cold; cold food and drink; from suppression of discharges and skin eruptions.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Due to draught of cold air; from constipation, from ironing.

Character of pain: Bursting type, as if brain is going to burst, with stitching and sticking pain. Feels that the contents of cranium would be pushed out.

Modalities: Aggravation FROM MOTION, in the morning, when first opening the eyes and relieved by PRESSURE and lying on painfuf side.

Concomitants: Dry white coating of tongue and thirst for large quantity of cold water at long intervals.

Gastro-intestinal symptoms

Mouth : As there is great dryness of the mucous membrane of the whole alimentary canal, the lips are dry, parched and cracked. Dryness of the mouth is well-marked, with great thirst for large quantity of cold water at long intervals.

Stomach : There is pressrue in the stomach, as if a stone is lying at the pit of stomach. Dyspepsia with soreness in stomach is often met with. There is nausea and faintness when rising up. Vomiting of bile immediately after eating, pain in the abdomen, aggravated after food, not relieved by pressure.

N.B. Most of the pains of Bryonia are relieved by pressure except gastric pain.

Constipation

* Causation: As Bryonia causes dryness of mucous membrane of colon, it produces a very bad * Sensation.: No inclination or desire for stool, ¢ Character of stool: Stool is DRY, HARD KNOTTY, AS IF BURNT.

e Concomitants: Headache due to constipation, with dry tonaye; and thirst for large quantity of cold water at long intervals.

Diarrhoea

* Causation: After taking cold food and drinks (Puls., Arsenic, Argentum nit.), when the days are hot and nights are cold, during the spell of hot weather.

* Time: Morning diarrhoea, as soon as the patient gets up from the bed and puts the feet on the floor (Nat. sulph.).

¢ Character of stool: Dirty, watery stool, containing undigested food particles; very much acrid * Modalities:

Aggravation: From SLIGHTEST MOTION,

Amelioration: By COMPLETE REST. * Concomitants: With dry tounge and great thrist for large quantity of cold water at long intervals

Respiratory symptoms

Nose : Vicarious menstruation, nose bleeds at the time of menses. If the menstrual flow is checked suddenly from cold, nose-bleed will appear, Dryness of nose with frequent sneezing and loss of smell.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This remedy is prepared from the poison expressed by cutaneous glands of the toad. The chief laurels of Bufo have been won in the

treatment of epilepsy.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Chorea. Epilepsy. Impotency. Lymphangitis. Panaritium. Breast-affection of. Skin-affection of. SPHERE OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS

It acts on nervous system, skin, male and female genital system. It causes a desire for intoxicating drink and produces impotency. Bufo causes low grades of inflammatory action, foetid exhalations, and discharges.

CONSTITUTION It is specially suited to feeble minded children who are prematurely senile. The

patient has great sensitive-ness to cold. It is a deep acting antipsoric remedy.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Convulsive seizures or epileptic fits occur during sleep at night, (Cuprum Met, Lach.) also during coition and at the time of menses.

2) The epiletic aura start from the sexual organs or from solar plexus.

3) Desire for solitude in order to practice masturbation.

4) Panaritium where the pain runs in streaks/all the way up the arm. /

5) Lymphangitis of septic origin.

6) Mentals — In Bufo lack of development is found like Baryta Carb patients. They always behave like children, feeble minded children. A state of confusion, loss of memory & imbecility present in marked degree. The patient is sad, restless,

impatient and he is anxious about health. Desires for solitude in order to practice masturbation. There is also sensation of heart swimming in water.

7) Ailments from — Self abuse, masturbation, injury.

441

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
It is a very important remedy in epilepsy, which is more or less connected with sexual derangement.

Epilepsy

Causation — Masturbation habit or self abuse. Aura begins in sexual organs or from solar plexus. The attacks usually occur during sleep at night, during coition, and at the time of menses. The patient

may or may not be awakened by the attack but when he does awake he will have violent headache, Convulsion usually followed by profound sleep.

Modality — Aggravation — At night. During sleep. In warm room,

Skin : It is a valuable remedy when the whole, lymphatic course is affected after an injury. In panaritium where the pain runs in streaks all the way up the arms. Every slight injury suppurates. There may be itching and burning of skin.

There may also be loss of sensation in patches of skin. Blisters on palms & soles may appear.

Sexual Symptoms :

Male : Bad effects of onanism resulting in impotency, involuntary or too quick emissions. There is disposition to hold organs. In these patients aura begins in sexual organs and they suffer from spasms

Female

Menses—Too early & copious clots and bloody discharge at other times. Epileptic attacks during excitement and at time of menses.

Breast : Induration in breast. It is a great palliative medicine in cancer of mammae & especially useful when the milk is mixed with blood.

General Modalities : Aggravation—In warm room, on awakening, during sleep at night, during menses. Amelioration—From bathing or cold air, from putting feet in hot water.

Relations

Antidotes and antidoted by—Lach., Senega. Complementary—Salamandra.

8) Falls asleep during evening fever and wakes when stops.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Calcarea ars. is prepared by mixing Calcarea and Arsenic, So in Calcarea ars. we get few symptoms of Calcarea carb. and few symptoms of Arsenicum album, e.g. the person is chilly, fatty, ailments occur during climacteric period, mental depression, weak heart Palpitation on ascending, etc., are the symptoms of Calcarea; whereas mental anxiety, chill, great weakness, etc. are the symptoms of Arsenic. Dr. Hering proved this drug on his own body.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Cholera, Constipation, Fever, Heart affection, Headache, Kidney and Liver affections, Nephritis, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on mind, heart, liver, spleen and kidney.

PATHOGENESIS Calearea arsenica, acting on heart, causes palpitation; on kidney it produces inflammation, resulting in acute and chronic nephritis.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: The patient is fair, fatty and flabby and looks like a calcarea patient.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Slightest emotion causes palpitation of heart (Lith.c.) 2. Rush of blood to the head and chest (Glonoine). 3. Kidney region is very sensitive to pressure. 4. Enlarged spleen and liver of the children. 5. Epilepsy from valvular diseases of the heart.

6. Mind : Anger, anxiety, great mental depression, desires company, confusion, delusion and illusion.

——

149

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Weekly headache, violent rush of blood to head with vertigo. Pain in head, better by lying on painful side.

Heart

Calcarea ars. is a great heart remedy.

The slightest emotion causes palpitation of the heart.

Constriction and pain in region of heart, suffocative feeling. Oppression arid throbbing with pain in back extending to arms.

Rush of blood to head and left chest.

Epilepsy with valvular diseases of the heart. Aura felt in the region of heart.

Heart beat is missing at every fourth beat.

All these heart complaints are mostly found in fleshy and chilly women, approaching menopause. Palpitation worse on exertion, emotion and on ascending.

Great craving for alcohol is present.

Kidney

Nephritis; Kidney region is very sensitive to pressure. Albuminuria, urine passes every hour. General Modality :

Aggravation: From slightest exertion and EMOTION.

Relations

Antidoted by; Carbo veg., Glon. and puls. Compatible: Con., Glon., Ruls., and Op.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This great Hahnemannian antipsoric is a wonderful constitutional remedy par excellence. Dr. Mrs. Tyler remarks about

Calcarea that—

“With the chalky complexion goes —

Fatness without fitness,

Sweating without heat.

Bones without strength,

Tissues of plus quantity and minus

quality, Mere flabby, bulky with weakness and Weariness.” “Some remedies are difficult to spot; the difficulty is to MISS Calcarea, when typical”

says Tyler. It is one of the greatest monuments of Hahnemann’s genius and is a great polychrest remedy, and ranks with sulphur and Lycopodium at the head of anti-psorics.

This is one of the twelve tissue remedies introduced by schussler. Homeopathic proving was done by Dr. J.B. Bell on himself & others in 1874. It is a great polychrest & has got a powerful hold on the human economy. Cale fluor is long and deep acting constitutional remedy for hard stony glands, varicose & enlarged veins & malnutrition of bones ete. It is found in the surface of bones, in the enamel of teeth, in elastic fibres & in the cells of epidermis.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Abdominal disorders, Acidity, Anaemia, Bone affection, Breast affection, Cough, Dentition, Diabetes, Diarrhoea, Dropsy, Dyspepsia, Eye troubles, Epilepsy, Fever, Glandular affection, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Lung affection, Menstrual disorders, Miscarriage, Pregnancy disorders, Respiratory troubles, Rheumatism, Ricket, Skin affection, Uterine affection, Vertigo, Worm troubles, etc.

Adenoids, Aneurism, Affections of Bone, of Glands, Cataract, Catarrrh, Constipation, Corneal Opacities, Exostosis, Fissure, Fistula, Fib-radenoma of breasts, ganglion, Gum- boils, Lun-bago, Rheumatism, Sprains, Syphilis, Tonsillitis, Varicose Veins.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seats of action of Calcarea carb. are bones, glands, blood, skin, mind and female genital organs.

Calcarea carb. produces impairment in nutrition of various organs, particularly BONES; alteration in composition of blood, with chief action on skin and bones, manifesting inereased local or general perspiration, swelling of glands, softening and bending bones, abscesses in deep muscles, polypi and exostoses.

151

It acts on bones, enamel of teeth, skin, connective tissues & vessels. Also acts on lymph nodes, glands & fibrous tissues etc.

It causes relaxation & dilatation of elastic fibres of any portion of the vessels, of connective tissues or of the lymphatic system leading to haemorrhoidal tumors, varicose veins, vascular tumors, indurated glands, uterine displacements, weakening of abdominal walls & hard, knotty tumor on the surface of the bones.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : There is Sour taste in mouth with great thirst in the afternoon. Toothache only while eating. The toothache is aggravated by both heat and cold and in the evening. Putrid and offensive smell from the mouth.

Stomach : The pit of stomach is swollen like an inverted saucer and is very painful to pressure. There is great craving for undigestible things such as chalk, coal, pencil, salt, etc. (Alumina, Cina, Cicuta, Nitric acid, Psorinum). The patient has great longing for eggs, especially either during sicknmess or convalescence, but has aversion to meat, fat and milk which disagree. Acidity of the digestive tract is very prominent. There is frequent sour eructation, sour vorniting and stool. When the patient is tired and

overworked, there is complete loss of appetite, with pain in the epigastrium, which is very painful and tender to touch. Aggravation by eating and by pressure.

Abdomen : The abdomen is pot-bellied and is very sensitive to slightest pressure. Liver region is very painful, aggravated by stooping. Inguinal and mesenteric glands are swollen and painful. Increased deposition of fat in abdomen, with consequent distension and hardness.

Stool : Calcarea carb. patient is habitually constipated and the patient feels better in every way when constipated. However, there may also be occasional diarrhoea especially in children during dentition period. The character of stool is white and sour smelling.

Head & Scalp :

Hard excreM@enses on the scalp. Cephal : haematoma. Ulcers of the scalp with callous, hard edges, Cracking noise in head. Blood tumours of newborn infants on a rough bonybase.

Respiratory organs

Nose : Nasal symptoms are caused by exposure to cold. ¢ Character: There is frequent sneezng without cold, Dry coryza with much sneezing.

¢ Modality: aggravated by exposure to cold. ¢ Concomitant; The above symptoms may be associated with or followed by violent headache.

Throat

* Causation: Exposure fo cold.

Eyes

Dimness of vision on overstraining the eyes. Conjunctivitis. Styes. Enlarged meibomian glands. Tumours on the eyelids, Flickering & sparks before the eyes. Subcutaneous palpebral cysts.

Ears

Calcareous deposits on the tympani; Sclerosis of ossicles & petrous portion of temporal bone, with

deafness. Chronic Suppuration of middle ear. Copious, offensive, thick, greenish, lumpy, Yellow nasal

i . Osseous growths. Adenoid growths in postnasal space & pharynx, hypertrophy of Luchka’s tonsils.

Face

Hard swelling on the cheek with pain or toothache. Hard swelling on jaw bone. Carries of malar bone with oozing of dark, offensive bloody fluid, swelling of bone on outer surface.

Mouth

Gum-boil with hard swelling on the jaw, stony hard swelling on the jaw bone. Ulceratians of mouth & throat manifesting congenital hereditary syphilis.

Tongue

Cracked appearance of the tongue with or without pain. Indurations of tongue, hardening after inflammation.

Teeth

Delayed dentition in children. Enamel of teeth rough & deficient. Unnatural looseness of the teath with or without pain. Teeth become loose in their sockets.

Throat

Follicular sore throat, plugs of mucus are continually forming in the crypts of the tonsils. Pain & burning in throat better by warm drinks & worse from cold drinks. Hypertrophy of Luschka’s tonsil. Uvulé relaxed causing irritation, tickling & cough.

deafness. Chronic Suppuration of middle ear. Copious, offensive, thick, greenish, lumpy, Yellow nasal

i . Osseous growths. Adenoid growths in postnasal space & pharynx, hypertrophy of Luchka’s tonsils.

Face

Hard swelling on the cheek with pain or toothache. Hard swelling on jaw bone. Carries of malar bone with oozing of dark, offensive bloody fluid, swelling of bone on outer surface.

Mouth

Gum-boil with hard swelling on the jaw, stony hard swelling on the jaw bone. Ulceratians of mouth & throat manifesting congenital hereditary syphilis.

Tongue

Cracked appearance of the tongue with or without pain. Indurations of tongue, hardening after inflammation.

Teeth

Delayed dentition in children. Enamel of teeth rough & deficient. Unnatural looseness of the teath with or without pain. Teeth become loose in their sockets.

Throat

Follicular sore throat, plugs of mucus are continually forming in the crypts of the tonsils. Pain & burning in throat better by warm drinks & worse from cold drinks. Hypertrophy of Luschka’s tonsil. Uvulé relaxed causing irritation, tickling & cough.

,
GUIDING SYMPTOMS: 1) This remedy acts favourably on hard, stony glands & varicose veins.

2) One of the powerful remedies for tumor in the female breast specially when it is hard & knotty.

3) In osseous growths & in suppuration of bones, it acts favourably after Silicea & Calc. Phos. have failed.

4) This has got marked action on the lower jaw producing necrosis & suppuration. Complications of Wisdom teeth.

5) Periosteal swelling due to congenital hereditary syphilis.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This remedy belongs to Schuessler’s Twelve Tissue Remedies. But since its introduction into the Homoeopathic system, we remain indebted to Dr. Constantine Hering for a thorough proving of this remedy. Being a tissue remedy, it is somewhat similar to Calcarea carb. and Phosphorus. The phosphorus element in this preparation seems-to change the temperament as it acts best in spare subjects instead of fat, while it retains its wonderful power over tardy bones.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal disorders. Anaemia, Ankle’s weakness, Back weakness, Bone affection, Brain- ) Fe fag, Bright’s disease, Chorea, Cretinism, Debility, | Dentition, Diabetes, Epilepsy, Fistula, Gonorrhoea, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Menstrual troubles, Rheumatism, Rickets, Respiratory affection, Skin affection, ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Main action of this drug is on those tissues of body which have more calcium an¢ phosphorus contents, such as bones, teeth, etc. Glands, digestive system, female genital organs also come within the domain of its action.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces a state of malnutrition because of defective assimilation in regard we calcium and phosphorys, leading to improper bone formation, ossification and bending “ long bones, spinal curvature, delayed dentition, resulting in rickets, etc.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Adapted to persons who are pale, of dark complexion, dark hai and eyes; thin spare subjects instead of fat, emaciated body, sunken flabby abdomen, sof bones bent disproportionately, enlarged head and long weak emaciated neck, unable

support head. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background. Diathesis: Scrofulous and gouty diathesis.

160

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1

. Defective bone development : Tendency of bones to curve, especially long bones, like tibia, fibula, ulna and radius. Non-union and malunion of bones.

. Fontanelles remain open too long, especially posterior fontanelles (Anterior fontanelles—Cale. carb.).

. Emaciated body with sunken flabby abdomen (Distended abdomen—Silicea).

4. Weakness and relaxation—child is slow in learning to walk, on account of weak

ankles, inability to stand. . Craving for salted and smoked meat, ham, bacon, etc. . Dyspepsia where pain is relieved by passing wind and temporary relief by eating.

. Complaints aggravate while thinking of them. (Baryta carb,, Gels.,Medo.,

. Fistual in ano alternates with chest complaints (Berb. vul., and Silicea). . It is the most important remedy for chronic hydrocephalus and it may be given “as

10. At every attempt to eat there is colicky pain in abdomen.

wet.

* Aggravation: On change of weather and after eating. * Amelioration: During rest.

Colicky pain in abdomen at every attempt to eat. Abdomen is sunken and flabby. During colic,
