name: Calendula Officinalis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Calendula is our favourite marigold. The mother tincture is prepared from its leaves and flowers, together with blooms and buds. IT IS A GREAT HOMOEOPATHIC ANTISEPTIC. It restores vitality of an injured part. Unlike Arnica, it has no irritating property and consequently not capable of producing erysipelas. It is, therefore, suitable to all cases of injuries where the skin is broken. It prevents suppuration and brings about healing promptly. It can also be used externally with wonderful results. Calendula is a great healing agent in our Materia Medica and it ranks first in our Homoeopathic surgical and first aid box for sueh

conditions.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Burns, Carbuncles, Chillblains, Eye inflammation, Glandular affection, Injuries, Suppuration, Ulcers, Wounds, ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on muscles, tendons, nerves, scalp, skin, ete.

PATHOGENESIS

Its action on the muscles, tendons, nerves, etc. produces a condition similar to lacerated injuries with solution of continuity of skin with suppuration.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Calendula is almost specific for clean cut, surgical cuts or lacerated wounds or suppurating wounds, It prevents suppuration, promotes healthy granulation of tissues and rapid healing by first intention.

2.Pain is excessive and out of all proportion to injury due to probable nerve involvement.

3. Constitutional tendency to erysipelas. 4, It can be used in the case of cancer as an intercurrent remedy. 5. It is an excellent haemostatic in tooth extraction (Bov., Ham., Phos).

6. Ailments from : Loss of blood and post surgical injury. 164

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Injury

Causation: Clean cut injury, amputation, surgical operation, lacerated wounds, during labour, extraction of teeth, fracture of bones, etc.

Character of injury: Calendula it used in all cases of loss of soft parts, when union cannot be effected by means of adhesive plaster. Rupture of muscles or tendons, laceration and perineal tear during labour; wounds penetrating articulations with loss of synovial fluids.

External wounds with or without loss of substance; torn and jagged looking wounds; post surgical operation; to promote healthy granulation and prevent excessive suppuration and disfiguring scars.

Exhausted from loss of blood (China, Ham.) and excessive pain. Traumatic and idiopathic neuroma; neuritis from lacerated wounds (Hypericum), after amputation (Cepa, Calc. phos.). Bleeding from extraction of teeth (Am., Bov., Ham. and Phos).

For old neglected, offensive injuries, threatening to a gangrenous condition, Calendula is ideally suited.

Ulcers

Irritable, inflamed, sloughing and excessive secretion of pus; painful as if beaten (Arn.), ulcers of varicose vein. Calendula has remarkable power to produce local exudation and helps acrid discharge and

makes ulcers healthy and clean. It has good reputation for external application in any cut or open wound surface or in any. ulcer. Calendula mother tincture, lotion or liniment can be applied externally.

General Modalities : Worse in damp cloudy weather.

Relations

Antidoted by: Amica. Calendula is complementary to: Hepar sulph. Follows well: Ars. alb. Followed well by: Arn. and Hepar.

N.B. : Hot calendula lotions are generally preferable to a cold one. Hot calendula fermentations are better than poultices in the case of abscesses.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Camphor is another medicine that .should be in every house for emergency use, but “Keep it in the bathroom.” Dr. Tyler very sophistically remarks in her Drug picture. She adds “don’t let Camphor come near any of your medicines, for it antidotes most, if not all of them. It is one of the repidly acting and short lasting medicines) hence requires very frequent repetition.” Master Hahnemann who introduced this drug, tells us that though powerful, it is more transient than any other drug. Therefore, it needs very frequent repetition till reaction is ensured. In cholera the medicine is to be repeated every five minutes till warmth is restored.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Cholera Asatica, Convulsion, Epilepsy, Suppressed eruption, Erysipelas, Gonorrhoea, Hyperpyrexia, Measles and _ its Complications and sequelae, Rheumatism, Strangury, Urinary affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Acts especially on the digestive tract, cerebro-spinal nerves and urinary organs i.e. kidney. PATHOGENESIS

It does not create much dehydration, either by stool or by vomiting or by sweat. It also causes delirium, stupor with epileptiform convulsion. Collapsed condition is due

circulatory failure. CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: There is no particular make up of the body as such, But it i8 especially suited to those persons who are exceedingly sensitive to cold air, person® physically and mentally very weak.

Temperament: Irritable temperament, Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient; very much sensitive to cold air. Miasm: Psora is in the background,

166

)

|

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Cholera

It typifies the collapse stage of Asiatic Cholera, says Dr. N.M. Chowdhury.

* Stage: In the first stage of Cholera morbus and Aslatic Cholera, * Onset: Sudden attack of vomiting and diarrhoea. * Quantity; There is not much discharge from the bowels, not much vomiting, sweat and urine,

but suddenly the patient CoLLAPSES..

Great coldness of surface, body cold to touch yet cannot bear to be covered. Throws off

all the coverings. With collapse, there is great prostration and rapld sinking of strength.

name: Cannabis Indica
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Cannabis Indica is said to be botanically identical with Cannabis Sativa, “the difference in soil and climate being responsible for the difference in their properties”. Indeed, many writers “lump” them together, as if there is no differences,— but it is Cannabis Indica which provides such an extra ordinary wealth of mental symptoms and which is so astonishingly curative wherever these provide the indications. Our writers seem to have given up can. Indica in despair, probably because of the redundancy of its mental aberrations.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Catalepsy. Chordee. Clairvoyance. Delirium tremens. Delusions. Epilepsy. Gonorrhoea. Headache. Mania. Menorrhagia. Paralysis. Pros-tatitis. Satyriasis. Stammering. Urinary diseases. GUIDING SYMPTOMS : MIND :

1) Very forgetful—forgets his last words and ideas; begins a sentence, forgets what he intends to speak, inability to recall any thought or event on account of other thoughts crowding his brain (Anac., Lac. C.)

2) Constantly theorizing.

3) Laughs immoderately at every trifling word spoken to him.

4) Full of fun and mischief, then perhaps moaning and crying.

5) Great apprehension of approaching death.

6) Delirium tremens, excessive loquacity, exaggeration of time and distance.

7) Time seems too long (Arg. N.) a few seconds seem ages.

8) Distance seems immense, a few rods seem miles.

9) Sensation as if the calvarium was opening and shutting (Act.)

10) Sensation of swelling in the perineum or near the anus, as if sitting on a ball (with great quantities of ropy mucus in urine-Cinch)

11) Limbs and parts seem enlarged.

12) Wonderful imaginations and hallucinations.

be

169

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Head

Sensation as if top of head were opening & shutting and as if calvarium were being lifted. There is involuntary shaking of head. Uraemic headache & when associated with flatulency. Un-usual excitment with loquacity usually precedes the attack of migrain,

Face

Expression : drowsy & stupid. Mouth and lips dry Lips glued together. Saliva thick, frothy & sticky. Grinding of teeth during sleep.

Stomach

Sensation of extreme tension in abdominal vessels as if bursting. Appetite increased. Pain at cardiac oriPco oetter by pressure. Pyloric spasm.

Urinary Symptoms :

Stitches and burning in urethra. Dull pain in region of right kidney. Dribbling urine, patient must strain. He has to wait some time before the urine flows. (Nat. Mur.) Urine loaded with slimy mucus.

Sexual Symptoms : Male : Backache after sexual intercourse. Oozing of white glairy mucus from glans. Satyriasis Chordee. Prolonged thrill.

Female : Menses Profuse, dark, painful, without clots. Backache during menses. Uterine colic, with great nervous agitation & sleeplessness, Dysmenorrhoea with sexual desire.

Extremities : Pain across shoulders and spine. Must stoop; can not walk erect. Thrillirs through arms and hands and from knees down. Entire paralysis of the lower extremities.

Pains in soles, calves, ankles and knees ; very exhausted after a short walk.

Sleep : Obstinate and intractable forms of Insomnia. Catalepsy. Nightmare, Dreams of dead bodie> Very sleepy but unable to sleep.

General Modallties :

Aggravation : Morning, from coffee, liquor, and tobacco, lying on right side. Amelioration :Fro™ fresh air, cold water, rest.

Relations

Compare : Bell, Hyos. Stram.

6) Delirium tremens, excessive loquacity, exaggeration of time and distance.

7) Time seems too long (Arg. N.) a few seconds seem ages.

8) Distance seems immense, a few rods seem miles.

9) Sensation as if the calvarium was opening and shutting (Act.)

10) Sensation of swelling in the perineum or near the anus, as if sitting on a ball (with great quantities of ropy mucus in urine-Cinch)

11) Limbs and parts seem enlarged.

12) Wonderful imaginations and hallucinations.

be

169
PARTICULARS: Head

Sensation as if top of head were opening & shutting and as if calvarium were being lifted. There is involuntary shaking of head. Uraemic headache & when associated with flatulency. Un-usual excitment with loquacity usually precedes the attack of migrain,

Face

Expression : drowsy & stupid. Mouth and lips dry Lips glued together. Saliva thick, frothy & sticky. Grinding of teeth during sleep.

Stomach

Sensation of extreme tension in abdominal vessels as if bursting. Appetite increased. Pain at cardiac oriPco oetter by pressure. Pyloric spasm.

Urinary Symptoms :

Stitches and burning in urethra. Dull pain in region of right kidney. Dribbling urine, patient must strain. He has to wait some time before the urine flows. (Nat. Mur.) Urine loaded with slimy mucus.

Sexual Symptoms : Male : Backache after sexual intercourse. Oozing of white glairy mucus from glans. Satyriasis Chordee. Prolonged thrill.

Female : Menses Profuse, dark, painful, without clots. Backache during menses. Uterine colic, with great nervous agitation & sleeplessness, Dysmenorrhoea with sexual desire.

Extremities : Pain across shoulders and spine. Must stoop; can not walk erect. Thrillirs through arms and hands and from knees down. Entire paralysis of the lower extremities.

Pains in soles, calves, ankles and knees ; very exhausted after a short walk.

Sleep : Obstinate and intractable forms of Insomnia. Catalepsy. Nightmare, Dreams of dead bodie> Very sleepy but unable to sleep.

General Modallties :

Aggravation : Morning, from coffee, liquor, and tobacco, lying on right side. Amelioration :Fro™ fresh air, cold water, rest.

Relations

Compare : Bell, Hyos. Stram.

name: Cannabis Sativa
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This European and American Hemp is said to be botanically identical with Cannabis Indica, Both of them belong to the same natural order. The difference in soil, and climate is responsible for the difference in their properties. Cannabis saliva was first introduced accidentally in the field of Homoeopathic therapeutics by Dr. O. Shaughsessy who also described the effects of the Indian hemp, Cannabis Indica.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Constipation, Gonorrhoea, Respiratory affection, Urinary affections ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts chiefly upon the urinary organs, especially the mucous lining of the urethra, sexual and respiratory organs.

It causes excessive irritation followed by inflammation of the mucous membrane of urethral passage producing mucus-like discharge, the whole condition closely simulating

Gonorrhoea.

CONSTITUTION

There is no particular constitution of the patient as such. However, there is sycotic and syphilitic background for the troubles.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Acute inflammatory first stage of gonorrhoea.

2. Urethra is very sensitive to touch and pressure. Cannot walk with legs close together. They hurt the urethra.

3. There is tearing pain along the urethra in zigzag direction.

4. Pain extends from external orifice of the urethra backwards, burning and bitting. Pain while urinating.

5. Obstinate constipation causing retention of urine, with constriction of anus.

6. Dyspnoea or asthma where the patient can breathe better only by standing up.

7. Choking in swallowing; things “go down the wrong way.”

eee

171

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Urinary Symptoms :

Cannabis sativa is adapted to urinary troubles, arising from or brought on by gonorrhoea, the cardinal symptoms of which are as follows:

Stage: In acute and inflammatory stage of gonorrhoea especially in the first stage; in urethritis,

Urethra is very much sensitive to touch and pressure. Cannot walk with legs close together. Keeps the legs wide apart because touch hurts the urethra.

Sensation: “Burning” sensation in urethra during and after urination.

Character of pain: Stiching and tearing pain along the urethra in a zigzag direction. Pain extending from orifice of urethra to backwards; burning and bitting while urinating. There is frequent, violent and constant urging to urinate.

During urination: Most painful and diffucult urination. There is stitching pain in urethra while the urine flows. Violent pain at the close of urination.

After urination: Pressing out feeling at the orfice of the urethra after urination.

Character of Urine: Urine is mixed with blood; scalds when passing; there is thick, yellowish gonorrhoea! discharge from the urethra.

Modality: Aggravation from touch.

Respiratory symptoms

Suited especially in bronchitis and asthma. Sensation: There is sensation of weight on the chest.

Character of cough: Rattling cough with wheezing and dyspnoea where the patient can breathe better only by standing up. Must have windows open.

Character of Sputa; Cough with green viscid expectoration, salty sputa with blood spifting. Character of pain; During coughing there is Stiching pain in the chest.

Modalities

* Amelioration: By standing up. For threatened abortion complicated with gonorrhoea, this drug is an excellent remedy. There may also be sexual over excitement in either sex.

General Modalities : Aggravation: From lying down and going upstairs. Amelioration: By standing up.

Relations

Antidotes: Camphor and Merc. Similar to: Cantharis and Cup. met.

name: Cantharides
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This medicine is prepared from the Spanish Fly by reducing into a course powder and saturating it later with alcohol to prepare the mother tincture. It was first introduced into the parlance of Homoeopathy by our Master Hahnemann. To stress its importance, Dr. Tyler remarks “ANOTHER VEHEMENT DRUG OF STORM AND STRESS” tempered by Hahnemann. Cantharides in its crude form is a powerful irritant and is hardly ever used internally. After Homoeopathic proving, the same irritant drug is used for an irritant disorder on the basis of Homoepathic Law “Similia Similibus Curantur”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Bladder affection, Burns, Dysentery, Diarrhoea, Gonorrhoea, Kidney troubles, Neuralgia, Pleurisy, Pregnancy troubles, Haematuria. Skin affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts especially on urinary organs, urinary bladder, urethra, ureters, skin, respiratory system and gastro-intestinal canal.

PATHOGENESIS

It especially affects the urinary and sexual organs and prevents their function by setting up violent inflammation. It also causes inflammation of the whole gastro intestinal canal, especially of lower bowels, Inflammation produced by Cantharides on lower bowels, kidneys, ovaries, meninges, pleura or pericardium is usually ASSOCIATED WITH BLADDER IRRITATION.

1. “Burning” in every part of the body; both internal and external, run through the whole remedy.

2. Constant and intolerable uriging to urinate before, during and after urination is the key-note of Cantharides.

3. Burning and cutting pain in urethra during micturition, 4. Oversensitiveness of all parts. 5. There is haemorrhage from nose, mouth, intestine, genital and urinary organs.

ee

173

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Dysentery

Cantharides is a good medicine for dysentery. Before stool There is great urging for stool with violent colicky pain in the abdomen. During stool. There is severe burning and cutting pain in the anus. After stool: After stool colic is alleviated, but the tenesmus continues with great shuddering.

Character of Stool: White mucus like scraping of intestine, bloody mucus with streaks of blood or frank blood.

Concomitants: Dysentery is associated with dysuria.

Urinary Symptoms :

in whatever diseases or urinary complaints, such as urethritis, cystitis or renal colic, gonorrhoea, etc.. it matters little, if the following symptoms are present, Cantharides can be thought of'’as an effective remedy.

Constant urging to urinate before, during and after micturition.

Only a few drops of urine pass at a time,

There is VIOLENT TENESMUS.

Burning during urination is always present.

Oversenstiveness of parts is well marked.

Haematuria

Blood passes with urine. Aggravation after drinking coffee or cold water,

Character of pain; There \s violent pain WITH FREQUENT URGING TO URINATE. Cutting, lancinating and stabbing pain as from knives, in neck of bladder. Pain shoots off in different directions:

There is burning and cutting pain in urethra during micturition with VIOLENT TENESMUS: — Violent lancinating pains through the kidneys and back. Over sensitiveness of the parts. There is sever? pain on urinating so that the patient screams on passing every drop.

name: Capsicum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Master Hahnemann says—this Spanish pepper as it is called, was introduced as a spice to season the sauces and to work as an appetiser. But in the rational therapeutic sphere, it has gained enough deserving name and fame by its characteristic, though limited sphere of action. Dr. Tyler remarks in regard to this remedy “these remedies of limited, but curious and unique action, are most useful where they fit, one may need them seldom, But yet nothing on earth will take their place where symptoms demand them”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Abdominal disorders, Brain affection, Cough, Delirium, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Ear affection, Headache, Haemorrhoids, Home sickness, Fevers, Lung affection, Pregnancy troubles, Rheumatism, Sciatica, Throat affection, Urinary troubles, Whooping cough Tonsillitis, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Capsicum affects principally mucous membranes e.g. of mouth tongue, abdomen. bowels, rectum, etc. Chest, lungs and skin may also be affected in rare instances. It als affects the bones, particularly bones of the ear.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces inflammation of mucous membrane with mucus discharge from bowel throat, etc. It also causes well marked chill, fever and neuralgia with threatening dee? seated abscesses.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Especially suited to fatty persons with light hair, blue eyes, stov' and plethoric who easily get exhausted, indolent, dread of any kind of exercise, person inclined to be jovial, yet angry at trifles, Children dread open air. A Capsicum child # fatty, dirty, clumsy, and is always chilly.

Temperament: Nervous temperament.

176

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Burning and smarting sensation in the throat and other parts, not relieved by heat whereas aggravated from cold water (Clarke).

9. Constriction in faces, throat, nares, chest, bladder, urethra and rectum. 3. Pain in distanat parts on coughing e.g. bladder, knees, legs, ears, etc.

4. The burning, spasmodic constriction and all other pains are worse between the acts of degulutition (Ign.).

5. Every stool is followed by thirst and every drink is fallowed by shuddering.

6. Burning is aggravated by application of cold water and slightest draught of cold air, but not relieved by heat.

7, Home-sickness with red cheeks and sleepiness (Ign. and Phosphoric acid); much hot feeling in faces.

8. Mind : Mentally there are many striking features in Capsicum, Home-sickness is well-marked which runs through the remedy with sleeplessness and red cheeks. There is persistent thought of suicide. He does not want to kill himself; he resists the thoughts which persist and he is tormented by these sad thoughts. The patient is very taciturn, peevish and obstinate; great clumsiness and awkwardness, excessive peevishness, wants to be left alone at home.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Sensation: Headache as if the head would fly to pieces, feels as if head were large. Character of headache: Bursting and throbbing type of headache. Headache as if the brain would

be pressed thorugh the forehead. Patient holds the head with hands.

Modalities

e Aggravation: Moving the head, when walking or coughing and stepping. ¢ Amelioration; Lying down with head high.

Ear

It has got peculiar action on the bones of the internal ear and MASTOID PROCESS. Location: Inflammation of mastoid, In mastoid abscess with swelling and behind the ears.

Character of pain: BURNING AND STINGING PAIN in the ears; aching and pressing pain with cough as if an abscess would burst.

Necrosis of the petrous portion of temporal bone and caries of the bones of ear, especially the mastoid process are successfully treated by capsicum.

name: Carbo Animalis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It is one of the carbons and seems to be especially adapted to scrofulous and venous constitutions, old people and after debilitating disease with feeble circula-tion and lowered vitality.

Aneurism. Breast,—cancer of. Bubo. Cancer. Constipation. Cough. Eructations. Glandular indurations. Haemorrhoids, Headache. Leucorhoea. Pleurisy. Sprain, Uterus-cancer of.

SPHERES OF ACTION AND PATHOGENESIS

It acts on glands, blood vessels, respiratoy, gastrointestinal & genito urinary systems. Skin & extremities.

CONSTITUTION

Make up of the body. It is suited to old persons greatly debilitated especially when there is venous plethora and blueness of skin.

Heat cold Relation—Chilly patient.

Miasm—It covers all the three miasms psoric, Sycotic & syphilitic.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Diseases of elderly persons with marked venous plethora, blue cheeks, blue lips and great debility.

2) Aversion to open, dry, cold air.

3) Circulation feeble, Stagnated and vital heat sinks to a minimum.

4) After appearance of menses so weak, she can hardly speak. (Alum. Coc.).

5) Menstruation, leucorrhoea, diarrhoea are all exhausting. (Ars.-are all offensive Pgor.).

6) Glands : indurated, swollen, painful; in neck, axillae, groin, Mammae ; pains lancinating, cutting, burning (Con.)

7) Easily strained from lifting, even small weights ; straining and overlifting easily produce great debility ; ankles turn when walking.

8) Joints weak : easily sprained by slight exertion (Led.)

9) Hearing confused ; cannot tell from what direction a sound comes.

180

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Head

Headache as if a tornado in head ; as if head had been blown to pieces ; has to sit up at night and hold it together. Rush of blood with confusion. Sensation as if something lay above eyes so that she could not look up.

Stomach

Weak empty feeling in the stomach is not relieved by eating. Burning & griping pain in stomach. Eating tires patient. Flatulence. Repugnance to fat food. Weak digestion. Pyrosis.

Complaints from eating spoiled fish and decayed vegetables.

Respiratory Symptoms : Pleurisy assuming a typhoid character. A stitching pain remains in chest after recovery from pleurisy. Ulc-eration of lung with feeling of coldness of chest.

Cough with discharge of greenish pus.

Female

Menses : Too early, frequent and long lasting. Flow only in the moming. After appearance of menses so weak she can hardly speak. Burning in Vagina and labia.

Pregnancy : Nausea of pregnancy ; worse at night. Breast : Painful indurations in breast especially right. Darting in breast. Cancer of uterus with burning pain down thighs.

Skin : Glands indurated, swollen, painful ; in neck, axillae, groin, mammae ; pains lancinating, cutting & burning.

Spongy uterus, copper coloured eruption. Acne rosacea. Warts on hands and face of old people with bluish colour of extremities. Chilblains, worse in evening, in bed and from cold. Benign suppurations change into ichorous or malignant conditions.

Extremities : Ankles turn easily, Straining and overlifting produce great debility. Joints weak; easily sprained by slight exertion. Easily strained from lifting even small weights, Pain in coccyx ; burns when touched.

General Modalities : Aggravation ; After shaving (after Brom.) ; Slightest touch ; after midnight.

Relations

Complementary: Gale. phos. Similar to, Bad., Brom., Carbo V., Phos., Sep., Sulph.

It acts on glands, blood vessels, respiratoy, gastrointestinal & genito urinary systems. Skin & extremities.

Make up of the body. It is suited to old persons greatly debilitated especially when there is venous plethora and blueness of skin.

Heat cold Relation—Chilly patient.

name: Carbo Vegetabilis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Carbon is an important constituent of each and every cell in the human body. It maintains the vitality and integrity of all the organs and tissues. Carbo veg. is indicated mainly in the 1st and 2nd childhood and when the resistance of the body is low and is incapable of coping up with the external environment.

Carbo veg. is rather an “inert” substance which is made medicinally useful and a powerful agent of great helping value by fine trituration. Its true latent power of helping is developed when it is sufficiently potentized.

It is a chronic, deep and long acting anti-psoric medicine which enters deeply into life. It mainly affects the VENOUS SIDE OF THE ECONOMY producing symptoms of IMPERFECT OXIDATION, BLUENESS, ECCHYMOSIS AND PASSIAVE HAEMORRHAGE resulting from deficient capillary circulation. It is mainly indicated in the last stage of exhaustive diseases which result in disintegration and improper oxidation of the tissue with ‘air hunger’.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acidity, Acne, Angina pectoris. Aphonia, Asthma, Bronchitis, Carbuncle, Cancerous affection, Cholera, Constipation, Cough, Debility, Diarrhoea, Dentition, Dysentery, Dyspepsia, Disorders of Pregnancy, Emphysema, Eructation, Epistaxis, Fevers, Flatulence, Gangrene, Haemorrhage, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Heart affections, Lung affection, Measles and Mumps, Orchitis, Otorrhoea, Stomach disorders, Skin affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Carbo veg. acts very particularly upon the sanguinous and nervous system and all the vegetative process of the body. Affects vascular system, particularly the venous side: blood and capillary, mucous membrane, gastro-intestinal tract and lung.

PATHOGENESIS

It causes sluggishness, turbidity and swelling of the parts. Everything about the economy is sluggish, turbid distended and swollen. The head feels full and the limbs feel dull and puffy. The veins are relaxed and paralysed. It also produces vaso-motor paralysis.

182

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Exhausted vitality from loss of vital fluid.

2. The surface of the body is COLD TO TOUCH, especially from knee to feet. The pulse is intermittent, thready and imperceptible.

3. Weak Digestion, SIMPLE FOOD DISAGREES causing excessive flatulence; abdomen is full to bursting point especially on the upper part; aggravation from least food and relief from eructation and on passing flatus. It is one of Nash’s Trio of tympanitic and flatulent drugs (others being Lyco. and China).

4. In the last stage of any disease with copious cold sweat, cold breath, cold tongue, voice lost, this remedy may save a life.

5. WANTS TO BE FANNED RAPIDLY AND FROM A CLOSE DISTANCE in nearly every complaint.

6. Wants clothing loose around the abdomen (Lach. and Bovista).

7. The patient craves things which makes him sick. Old toppers crave whisky or brandy.

8. Hoarseness aggravated in the evening (Aconite, Phos. and Rumex).

9. Sysmptoms of imperfect oxidation, resulting from deficient capillary circulation, causing blueness of skin and coldness of extremities.

10. Constant sour and rancid eructation.

11. Mind : Slowness of thought and weakness of memory, dislikes darkness and fears ghosts.

12. Ailments from ; Loss of vital fluid, mercury, salt, salted meat or fish and from abuse of quinine, especially suppressed chill and fever; bad effects of long ago injury, persons who have never fully recovered from the bad effects of some previous illness.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Stomach

Simplest food disagrees due to weak digestion with excessive accumulation of gas in the stomach and intestine particularly in the epigastric region with frequent eructation and passing of flatus.

Causation: Alcohol, wine, spoiled meat, fish, fat, salt and salted meat. Sensation: As if the abdomen will burst open due to accumulation of excessive gas.

Location: Especially in the upper part of the abdomen (stomach and transverse colon). (Lower abdomen-lyco, whole abdomen-china).

Modalities

* Aggravation: By lying down, after eating and drinking, rich food, butter, milk, coffee, etc. ¢ Amelioration: From eructation and passing flatus. Concomitants: Diarrhoea and cadaverous smelling stool with burning in the rectum. It is suited to painful diarrhoea of old people.

Character of stool: Frequent, involuntary, cadaverous smelling stool followed by burning in rectum. Soft stool voided with difficulty.

Cholera

Carbo veg. is very useful in the COLLAPSE STAGE of cholera.

Causation: Caused by great drain of the vitality due to profuseness of its discharges. Character of stool: There is frequent, involuntary cadaverous smelling stool, followel by burning.

Look of the face: Hippocratic face eyes are sunken, cheeks are sunken with earthy complexion.

Look of the skin: There is deficient capillary circulation causing blueness of skin and cokiness of extremities, vital power nearly exhausted.

Sweats: There is COLD SWEAT ON the forehead with coldness of entire body.

Relation with fan: There is GREAT DESIRE TO BE CONSTANTLY FANNED RAPIDLY AND FROM A CLOSE DISTANCE.

If Carbo veg. is given in last stage with copious cold sweat, cold breath, cold tongue, voice lost, this remedy may save a LIFE.

Respiratory Symptoms : Causation: Low vitality and neglected pneumonia (China, Plumbum and Lyco.).

Character of Cough: Cough with tingling and itching in larynx causing spasmodic cough with gagging and vomiting. Hoarseness worse- in the evening; aphonia more in the morning with rawness, soreness and burning, wheezing and rattling of mucus in the chest

Modality: Worse in the evening, open air, after eating and talking Relieved by CONSTANT FANNING FROM A CLOSE DISTANCE.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Carbolic acid is a great antiseptic and powerful irritant. In its crude form, it is capable of poisoning. This property had led Hahnemann to potentise this drug for the cure of various ailments. The potencies of Carbolic acid are made with alcohol, an exception to the rule for preparation of acids.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal affection, Burns, Carbuncles, Cholera, Constipation, Diabetes, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Dyspepsia, Flatulence, Fever, Gangrene, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Skin affection, Small-pox, Uraemia, Urinary affection, Ulcers, Vomiting, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on nervous system, skin, al] mucous membranes, especially of mouth, throat, gastro-intestinal tract and urinary organs.

It acts primarily on nervous system and produces deadly paralysis of respiratory centres and various consequent reflex symptoms. It causes much debility and weakness. It also produces inflammation of the skin resulting in ulceration and malignant manifestations of all mucous membranes and gastro-intestinal tract, in addition to

vomiting, dysentery, etc.

CONSTITUTION .

Physical make-up: There is no particular constitution for this drug. Persons of any and every constitution are susceptible tcvthis remedy. The patient is however, VERY CHILLY, having SYPHILITIC AND PSORIC BACKGROUND and is of irritable

temperament.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. As in the case of all acids, DEBILITY AND WEAKNESS ARE very common symptoms; hence in Carbolic acid too, these symptoms are persistently present throughout. 2. Pains come suddenly, last for a short time and disappear suddenly, (Bell, Mag: phos.). Pains are burning, pricking and stitching,

name: Carcinosin
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Carcinosin is one of the principal nosodes of cancer and is one of Dr. Burnett’s different cancer preparations. Dr. D. M. Foubister is the chief authority for its homoeopathic uses. We are greatly indebted to Dr. Foubister for our knowledge of Carcinosin. One learns more about this medicine from his famous “The Carcinosin Drug Picture”. He had been its chief exponent and had conducted extensive provings to give Car-cinosin a stable position in our Materia Medica. He proved it himself in the 200th potency. It is most commonly indicated and deep acting, constitutional polychrest medicine. It can be said that Carcinosin is a drug of many combinations, of great contradiction and of alterations of symptoms (like Lac. Can.)

CONSTITUTION : Appearance : Brownish—Brownish “cafe an tail” complexion

having blue sclerotics and numerous moles. There may be both fair and dark complexion, bulky and emaciated body, having multiple warts or some birth marks anywhere in the

body.

Thermal Interpretation :The patient may be chilly or hot or is affected by both

extremes of heat and cold. Temperament: Suited to every temperament.

Miasms :Psora, sycosis, syphilis, all three miasms are in the background.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) When apparently well indicated remedies even nosodes like psorinum, Medorrhinum, Syphilinum & Tuber-culinum fail to cure a case or produce a temporary amelioration of all the symptoms Carcinosin acts as a complementary drug.

2) When two or more remedies are partially indicated with-out complete coverage by and single one, Carcinosin should be considered.

3) Family history of cancer—Diabetes Mellitus, Tuber-culosis, Pernicious anaemia, syphilis or any other degenerative condition is traced—there may be or may not be such history, if symptoms agree ‘Carcinosin’ should be thought of.

4) Personal history of recurrent attacks of bronchitis, pneumonia, whooping cough in childhood, even ten-dency to suffer repeatedly from measles, chicken pox, diptheria,

name: Carduus Marianus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Carduus M. is pre-eminently a liver remedy. It stands next to Chelidonium in our materia medica so far liver complaints are concerned, It is, useful in various kinds of complaints which are secondary to liver affections.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Bronchitis. Dropsy. Epistaxis. Fever.Gail stones. Haemorrhoids. Influenza, Jaundice. Liver—affection of. Metrorrhagia, Neuralgia. Rheumatism. Varicose Veins. Spleen—affection of. Hemoptysis. Cholecystitis.

Cholelithiasis. Hepatitis. PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTION It has at least three special centres of action through the nervous system.

1) Liver—It acts upon the liver and portal system giving rise to jaundice and bilious disturbances.

2) Bowels—Here it acts as a laxative producing a catarrhal discharge.

3) Kidneys—It produces diuresis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Dragging pain in right hypochondrium when lying on left side (Arn., Mag. M., Nat. S.)

2) The liver enlargement in the transverse direction (that of Cheli, more vertical.)

3) Sadness, depressed and hypochondriacal with vertigo and dull heavy pain in forehead.

4) Constipation : Stools hard, difficult, knotty, alternates with diarrhoea. Clay coloured bileless or bright yellow.

5) Want of appetite with nausea, retching, vomiting of green acid fluid.

6) Complaints from abuse of alcoholic beverages.

7) Complaints such as dropsy, haemoptysis, spleen affec-tions, influenza etc. when associated with liver derange-ment.

8) Modalities : Agg.—Lying on “left side, beer, eating, motion, pressure, from stooping.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Caulophyllum is known to the common people as Blue Cohosh or Squaw root. Though the proving was done for a short period with a limited known therapeutic sphere, the drug has attained a position of being one more of what we term as the “LADY'S REMEDY”

Abortion threatened, Amenorrhoea, Bearing down pains, Dysmenorrhoea, Disorders of Pregnancy, Haemorrhage, Gonorrhoea, Labour, Leucorrhoea, Menstrual disorders, Rheumatism, Uterine affections, etc.

SPHERE OF ACTION

It acts especially upon the female genital organs- uterus and cervix. Joints, especially small joints and stomach are also the seats of action in few cases. PATHOGENESIS

Caulophllym has mainly pathogenetic changes on uterus and cervix. Its most prominent value seems to lie in its power of causing INTERMITTENT CONTRACTION OF GRAVID UTERUS Joints, especially small ones are inflamed. Rheumatic and gouty inflammation occur causing pain, soreness and Swelling.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is generally suited to women during pregnancy, parturition and lactation, having MOTH SPOTS ON THE FACE AND FOREHEAD AND DROOPING OF EYE LIDS.

Temperament: Nervous temperament. Diathesis: Rheumatic and gouty.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. “Weakness, exhaustion, Want of tone” are the keynotes of this remedy.

2. Pains are intemittent, paroxysmal, spasmodic and erratic, changing place every few minutes.

192

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Labour pain

Causation: Delayed labour due to spasmodic rigid os.

Character of pain: Needle-like pricking pain in cervix. False labour pain, short, irregular, spasmodic pain, erratic pains, changing places every few minutes. Pains are intermittent, paroxysmal and spasmodic.

During labour: Useless pain in the beginning of labour, with no progress of labour pain.

After panis: After long exhausting labour, there is spasmodic pain across lower abdomen extending to groins.

After labour: Haemorrhage after hasty labour, passive type of haemorrhage, BLOOD OOZES OUT WITH WANT OF TONICITY.

There is passive type of lochia which is protracted, oozing out for days from relaxed vessels.

When the above mentioned symptoms are present, if Caulophyllum is given, it will correct deranged Vitality and produce efficient pains.

During last 2 or 3 weeks of pregnancy, if a dose of 30th potency is given daily, it will make, labour easy.

Haemorrhage

Suited to Haemorrhage in case of habitual abortion.

Causation: From uterine debility.

Character of blood: Passive type of haemorrhage; blood oozes out with want of tonicity.

Pain: There is severe, spasmodic, paroxysmal pain in the abdomen which flies in all directions.

Caulophyllum is one of our best remedies to arrest the abortive process.

Leucorrhoea

Usually found in Jittle girls,

Character; Very much acrid and exhausting leucorrhoea. This |s due to congestion of uterus and is associated with bearing down pain with moth spots on forehead and ptosis of the upper eye lids.

Rheumatism

It is an important remedy in reheumatism, but it has a special affinity for small joints.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This drug is one of Hahnemann’s flashes of genius; and outcome of the labours of Hahnemann, the Chemist, Physician and the true Healer of rational art. It is a unique remedy and is one of those “without which we cannot do our practice”. Hering’s Guiding Symptoms say “Whatever diversity of opinion may exist theoretically, Causticum remains stamped by our best practitioners as a polychrest of the highest order”. Nash too says “If Hahnemann had never given to the Homoeopathic school any remedy but Causticum the world would still owe him everlasting obligation”. Causticum is an indispensable polychrest remedy.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Bladder affections, Bronchitis, Burns, Chorea, Constipation, Convulsion, Cough, Ear affection, Epilepsy, Eye affection, Facial Paralysis, Fistula, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Heart affection, Fevers, Laryngitis, Leucorrhoea, Locomotor ataxia, Menstrual disorders, Nervous affection, Paralysis, Pregnancy disorders, Neuralgia, Rheumatism, Throat affection, Ulcers, Urinary disorders, Warts, Whooping cough, Abdominal affections,

Respiratory affections, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The principal organs affected by this great drug, are medulla oblongata and vagus nerve; larynx, trachea : urinary bladder and mucous membrane; FLEXOR TENDONS

and skin. It is a right sided remedy.

PATHOGENESIS

The general physiological action of this drug is paralysis, slow pulse, low temperature and general paralytic, weakness. PARALYSIS, especially of vocal cord, Paralysis of the urinary bladder leading to retention of urine or inconigence of urine. Contraction of muscles and tendons is a striking characteristic phenomenon of Causticum. On mucous membranes of different hollow organs, Casusticum produces an Irritant action with increased secretions.

195

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache is caused by exposure of cold, toss of sleep, night watching, and effects of

sorrow, grief, fear, fright, joy etc.

Leukaemia. Spleen affection of, Leucorrhoea. Ceanothus is a spleen remedy par excellence and suited to anaemic patients where liver and spleen are at fault. It is good antidote to malaria. Drs. Burnett, Hale and P.C. Majumder proved its efficacy in a number of cases of malaria and in other diseases where spleen is affected. Its indications are pain, inflammation, enlargement of spleen with fullness in the left hypochonodrium, cchilliness and __ shivering principally down’back and dyspnoea and palpitation on exertion. Constant urging to urinate. Urine is green, frothy contains bile, sugar. There may be diarrhoea with bearing down in abdomen & rectum.

N.B. : In Ch. cases of Malaria, Kalazar specially when spleen is enlarged, it is beneficial when given in low potency.

name: Cedron
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Ciliary neuralgia. Headache. Hysteria. Intermittent fever. Neuralgia. Neuritis. Toothache.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) The great characteristic of Cedron is a clock like periodicity in the recurrence of the symptoms.

2) Neuralgia—Especially right side of face, head is affected. There is severe pain in eyeball with radiating pains around eye shooting into nose. Periodic supra orbital neuralgia with scalding lachrymation.

3) Intermittent fever : Cedron is valuable in intermittent fever especially when there is a clockwise recurrency in successive attacks of fever and chill.

Chill : Before chill, there is a great mental excitement and exaltation of vital energy.

During Chill : General coldness renewed by every movement as in Nux and Cinchona.

Heat stage : Red face in heat stage. Thirst for warm drink is marked.

Sweat stage : The dry heat state is soon followed by a state of profuse perspiration.

4) Complaints after coition such as epilepsy. Chorea.

Relations

In heart disease complicated with haemorrhoids consult collinsonia when Cac. Dig. and other remedies fail. Has cured colic after col. & Nux had failed.

Compare 

Aesc. Aloe, Nux. Sulph.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Chamomilla is an annual wind plant growing wild in cultivated fields amongst wheat and paddy. But finally it serves the purpose of an excellent remedy for all ailments BROUGHT ON OR AGGRAVATED BY ANGER. Just as the weed grows in a paddy field causing untold miseries, anger and pain to the farmers and grows at the cost of a useful product so also the patient displays similar manifestations and . develops uncivilised habits. But when the whole —— plant is crushed, mother tincture is prepared and subsequent potencies are succussed, it becomes a wonderful remedy capable of annihilating many diseases, especially of children, when given on the basis of symptom. similarity. It is an “ANGER AND PAIN REMEDY” which causes TURMOIL IN TEMPERAMENT.

name: Chelidonium Majus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
The mother tincture is prepared from extracted Juice of Celandine, a perennial plant growing in Germany, France and other adjacent counties. Chelidonium remains just the right remedy in any and every case where LIVER IS AT FAULT EITHER FUNCUTIONALLY OR ORGANICALLY. It is another medicine which establishes the doctrine of signature i.e. the yellow colouration of its juice corresponds to the yellowishness of skin, conjunctiva, etc. in jaundice.

The author has used this medicine with great success in physiological doses in thousands of cases of liver disorders resulting in Jaundice, Indigestion, Flatulence, Constipation, Cholecystitis, Cholelithiasis, etc. In complaints resulting from taking adulterated foodstuff.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Chest affection. Constipation, Cough, Dyspepsia, Gall-stone, Gonorrhoea, Haemoptysis, Jaundice, Liver affection, Neuralgia, Rheumatism, Kidney affection. Whooping-cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seat of action of the remedy centres on the hepato-biliary system—tliver. gall bladder, bile duct etc. Skin and stomach are also reflexly affected. In few cases, lungs are not spared with the affection of bronchi and mucous membrane. Spleen, and kidney are also not beyond the reach of this medicine. IT IS A RIGHT SIDED DRUG.

PATHOGENESIS

On liver, it produces congestion, inflammation and sometimes degeneration. As 3 result of this there is enlargement of the organ with final consequential shrinkage and cirrhosis. Right lung, when affected, producees symptoms of pneumonia with jaundiced skin and mucous membrane.

CONSTITUTION

It is adapted to persons of light complexion, blonde, thin and irritable, haviné hepatic, gastric and abdominal complaints at any stage, sex and temperament.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Affects RIGHT SIDE MORE e.g. right eye, right lung, right hypochondrium- and abdomen, right hip and leg.

od

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Mouth

Bitter taste in mouth.

Tongue

Coated thickly yellow, with red edges, showing imprint of teeth (Podo., Merc sol., Rhus tox.).

Abdomen

Great distension of abdomen with gas. PAIN through stomach to back and right shoulder blade.

Gastralgia, bitter taste in mouth with nausea and vomiting. Eating relieves temporarily. WANTS HOT FOOD AND DRINKS.

Constipation

Stool hard, round like a ball, like sheep's dung (Plumbum, Opium). Bright yellow, clay coloured stool, with burning and itching in anus. There is alternate diarrhoea and constipation.

Causation: Change of weather.

Time: At night (Pulsitilla, China—Diarrhoea during day, Petroleum).

Character of stool: Involuntary, bright, yellowish, brown or white, slimy.

Concomitants; There is alternate diarrhoea and constipation.

Liver

Chelidonium is indicated in hepatic diseases, such as jaundice, when there is CONSTANT PAIN UNDER THE LOWER and INNER ANGLE OF RIGHT SCAPULA. Yellow grey colour of the whole skin. Wilted skin of the palms and hands. Face, forehead, nose and cheeks are remarkably yellow. There is sluggish liver with great fermentation and accumulation of gas In the abdomen. There is nausea and

vomiting with bitter taste in mouth. The tongue |s large and flabby, yellow, showing imprint of teeth. The patient wants very hot food and drink.

Modalities: There is aggravation from motion and touch. Amelioration from pressure. In hepatic affection it differs from BRYONIA and LYCO, Both Bryonia and Chelidonium have sharp,

stitching pain under the right shoulder blade; both have bitter taste in mouth, and yellow tongue. But Bryonia differs in its stool which is HARD, DRY AND BROWN, while the stool of Chelidonium is

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The symptoms of general weariness and prostration produced by the drug have been utilised in prescribing it homoeopathically as a general tonic, often with very marked beneficial and prompt effect. In diphtheria specially prolonged cases, malaria, neuralgia etc. it has been found curative. It is also useful in asthmatic attacks which recur periodically, with great prostration.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Asthma, Diarrhoea, Gastralgia. Hectic fever. Neuralgia. Rheumatism.

1) Neuralgia : The periodicity is itensified (Cedron, Kali Bich.) An irritable mood precedes the headache, which is aggravated by mental and bodily exercise.

2) Gastralgia : Pressure in solar, plexus with tender spine just at back of it. Alteration of hyperacidity and decrease of acid, nausea and vomiting a.re followed

by sleep.

3) Diarrhoea : Egg produces diarrhoea.

4) Gastralgia from coarse food of ill-baked bread. Indiges-tion from unripe fruits. Colic from incarcerated flatus (Raphanus).

5) Chronic rheumatism of joints without swelling.

6) Intermittent fever : With great prostration & periodicity. Chill stage predominates with little thirst and continuous almost convulsive yawning.

name: Cicuta Virosa
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Cicuta virosa can be nick-named as ‘CONVULSION’. It is very valuable remedy for violent convulsion from any cause with loss of consciousness. This drug has been derived from vegetable kingdom. The whole plant is very poisonous and is fatal to animals. The mother tincture is prepared from fresh root of the plant. When the poisonous property is transformed into dynamic power after potentisation, it serves as an excellent remedy for various nervous disorders manifested in the form of epilepsy, chorea, spasm, hysteria, convulsion, etc.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Convulsion, Epilepsy, Hysteria, Meningitis, Numbness, Paralysis, Skin affection, Tetanus, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The cheif centres of action of this drug are cerebro-spinal nervous system, especially medula oblongata, gastro-intestinal tract and skin.

It causes irritation of the cerebro-spinal nervous system producing local and generalised spasm and paralysis, tetanus, epileptic, and epileptiform convulsions, trismus and tonic and clonic spasm in general.

CONSTITUTION There is no particular constitution or look of the patient as such.

Temperament: Nervous temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. According to Clarke, the two grand key-note symptoms of Cicuta virosa are:

(a) Twitching and spasmodic jerks. (b) Bending of the head backwards or opisthotonos.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Convulsion

Cicuta virosa is especially suited to women who are subject to epileptic or choreic convulsion or spasm of children during dentition period or from worms.

During convulsion, the attack is VIOLENT. There is very FRIGHTFUL DISTORTION of face, limbs or of the whole body. The patient loses consciousness. Opisthotonos is a general feature (Natrum sulph.. Veratrurh vir.). The epileptic attack is renewed from SLIGHTEST TOUCH, NOISE OR JAR AND MOTION.

Epilepsy is associated with swelling of stomach as from violent spasm of diaphragm. The patient screams. The face may be red or bluish. Consciousness is lost, jaws are locked with distortion of limbs and face, BEYOND RECOGNITON. The attack is frequently at night; recurring first at short intervals and then at long intervals.

Guernsey says, “think of this remedy for convulsion which are excessively violent— whether epileptic, cataleptic clonic or tonic eclampsia.”

According to Nash, .it it another remedy characterised by Its . excessively VIOLENT convulsions, The body is drawn into all sorts of odd shapes and violent contortions, but one of the most invariable symptoms is bending of head, neck and spine backwards (opisthotonos). It is on this account that it was tried for cerebro-spinal meningitis. Nash also thinks that it is as near a specific for this disease as there can be.

Kent says, that this remedy is of most extreme interest because of its convulsive tendency. It puts the whole nervous system into such a state of increased irritability that pressure on a part causes convulsion.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Cina, well known as the “WORM REMEDY”, especially for children.is one of' the monumental treasures discovered by Hahnemann. Although Homoeopathy does not believe in specificity, here is a drug which is very near to the specific remedy for worm affection in children. With the inclusion of this remedy in our Materia Medica we have an infallible and permanent solution for ailments brought on by worm.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Ascaris lumbricoid, Abdomen, Anaemia, Anus irritation, Chorea, Colic, Convulsion, Cough, Dentitional troubles, Diarrhoea, Enuresis, Fever, Twitching, Urine milky, Worm irritation, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Cina acts on mind, gastro-intestinal tract, urinary bladder and nerves.

PATHOGENESIS

Due to its action on gastro-intestinal tract, it causes irritation and inflammation, producing various reflex symptoms like convulsion, cough, etc.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Especially suited to persons or children with dark hair and complexion, pale face, sickly body, whitish or bluisih appearance around the mouth, with dark ring around the eyes. One cheek red and the other pale.

Temperament: Irritable temperament. Relation with heat and cold: May be any. Miasm: Latent Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
Worm troubles : Especially due to Ascaris lumbricoid.

1. Cina is pre-eminently a WORM remedy as it causes all the symptoms which characterise helminthiasis, mental, bodily and nervous, such as grinding of teeth, constant digging and boring of nose, screaming during sleep, indigestion, nausea and or vomiting, nocturnal enuresis, pain in abdomen and mental irritability extending even to convulsions.

212

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Headache alternating with pain in abdomen. Worse by study or meditation and relieved by stooping. Nose. Constant boring and digging at the nose, always pick up the nose. Itching and rubbing of nose, due to worm trouble.

Gastro-intestinal symptoms

Tongue : Cina patient generally has clean tongue, with white papillae raised on red edges.

Stomach : Canine hunger. Hungry soon after a full meal. There is great desire for sweets and different, indigestible things. There may also be spasmodic cramping pain in the stomach.

All gastro-intestinal symptoms are aggravated from taking sweets. With the above-mentioned symptoms, there may be diarrhoea and vomiting with clean tongue.

In diarrhoea, the colour of the stool is white, thin and watery with-undigested food particles in it.

Concomitant symptoms are: Boring of nose, grinding of teeth, irritability of mind, with nocturnal enuresis.

Abdomen : Distended and hard from worm troubles. Cina patient wants to lie on abdomen to get relief. There may be crampy spasmodic pain in'abdomen with gnawing sensation.

Urine : Patient, usually a child, passes turbid urine which turns MILKY and semi-solid after sometime. White and turbid urine, passing involuntarily. In children, usually suffering fronji worms there may be nocturnal enuresis.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
When we think about Cinchona, we are unknowingly taken to 1790 in the study room of Hahnemann because it was Cinchona bark which revealed to him the unique system of treatment, “Homoeopathy”. After passing the M.D., the then highest examination in Allopathy and practising it for about 10 years, Hahnemann became completely disappointed and disgusted with the crude, inhuman, torturing, troublesome and harmful system of allopathic treatment. He was master of many languages. Therefore, he decided to earn his livelihood by the most innocent, yet useful profession of translating various books into different languages. While doing so, he came across the fact that Cinchona bark has the power of producing malaria-like symptoms in healthy human beings, and this led him to conclude that if it has got the power to produce malaria-like symptoms in the healthy human beings, theri it is also capable of curing the natural disease manifesting symptoms similar to that of malaria in people naturally sick. With this idea in view, he himself took a little quantity of the juice expressed from the Cinchona bark and he was soon sick with symptoms similar to malaria. He tried the experiment on his family members and friends with the same results. This was the beginning of the historic invention of “HOMOEOPATHY”. THUS CINCHONA TO HAHNEMANN WAS, WHAT FALLING APPLE WAS TO Newton.

Following this pleasant experience and new idea, Hahnemann proved and established many remedies on the basis of “SIMILIA SIMILIBUS CURANTUR”. He also treated with great success many diseases t with the remedies he proved arid established, of which the first and foremost was Cinchona.

Clematis, like other Ranunculi, is a direct irritant of the skin producing inflammation and vesication. It was used by Stoerck before Hahnemann’s time in cancerous and other foul ulcers, inveterate skin eruptions, syphilis and rheumatism.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Anaemia, Abdominal disorders, Bilious attack, Catarrhal affection, Constipation, Diarrhoea, Dropsy, Dyspepsia, Deafness, Gall-stone colic, Haemorrhage, Headache, Intermittent fever, Jaundice, Labour, Liver complaints, Pain, Menstrual troubles, Rheumatism, Respiratory troubles, Spleen affection, Vertigo, etc.

Eye affection, Gonorrhoea, Headache. Glandular affection. Rheumatism. Stricture of urethra. Skin affection. Toothache.

SPHERE OF ACTION

It acts on skin, glands, genito-urinary

organs, especially testicles, and mucous membrane.

PATHOGENESIS

It is a direct irritant of the skin producing inflammation and vesication. It inflames and infiltrates tis-sues and so causes swelling and induration of glands. CONSTITUTION

It acts best on light-haired people; torpid, cachectic conditions.

All the three miasms—Psoric, sycotic and syphylitic are in the back ground. Chiefly Sycotic.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
China predominantly acts on blood, cardiovascular system, gastro-intestinal tract, liver, spleen, respiratory organs, nervous system, brain and mind.

215

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Great tendency to PERIODICITY is well-marked throughout the remedy.

2. Profound debility from exhausting discharges and loss of vital fluids and haemorrhage, etc. Great debility, trembling, “ aversion to exercise and very sensitive to touch to pain, to draught of air.

3. Excessiue irritability and sensitiveness of the whole nervous system is one of the prominent features of China.

. Dropsy, either generalised or localised, from anaemia, loss of vital, fluid or haemorrhage is one of the criteria for China.

. Pains are aggravated by slightest touch, but are RELIEVED BY HARD PRESSURE. . Shaking chill all over the body is well-marked.

. Debilitating sweat with noctural diarrhoeas is a peculiar characteristic of China.

. Disposition to haemorrhage from every orifice of the body.

. Painless nocturnal diarrhoea is found only in China.

10. Malaria cachexia, chronic fever with liver and spleen complaints.

11. After climacteric, there is PROFUSE HAEMORRHAGE, acute diseases often result in dropsy, with ringing and buzzing sound in ears.

12. Desire for sour things, sour fruit, dainties, wine, cold things, coffee and highly seasoned food. Aversion to bread, meat, fatty things, warm food and exercise.

rn

Conta uw

1) Painful swelling and induration of the glands.

2) Gonorrhoeal orchitis, the testicle is painful indurated and hard as a stone with pain along the spermatic cord, especially right side.

3) Toothache relieved by holding cold water in the mouth.

4) Interrupted flow of urine with burning sensation during micturition.

5) Aggravation of all skin symptoms by the heat of bed and-, from washing.

6) Nearly all symptoms aggravate at night.

7) Aggravation during increasing moon, amelioration dur-ing waning moon.

8) Ailments from : Suppressed gonorrhoea.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache caused as a result of HAEMORRHAGE, SEXUAL EXCESS OR LOSS OF VITAL FLUID and sleeplessness or suppressed coryza.

Location: Headache from occiput over the whole head.

Sensation: Sensation as if the skull would burst. Sensation as if the brain were balancing to and from and is striking against skull, causing great pain.

Character of pain: Confusion and dullness of the head as if intoxicated. Intense throbbing of head and carotids. Head is inclined to draw backwards.

Modality: Headache is worse in open air, on stepping and better in warm room. Headache becomes

worse by slight touch, contact and mental Exertion, but relieved by hard pressure. Headache is aggravated on sitting or by lying down; must stand or walk.

Concomitants: Vertigo on waking at night. Nausea and vomiting of sour food, bile and mucus.

Gastro intestinal tract

Mouth : Toothache while the baby sucks the breast. Throbbing toothache, aggravated by slightest touch, but REELIEVED BY PRESSING THE TEETH FIRMLY AGAINST EACH OTHER and by hot application. Tongue coated white or yellow; tongue dirty; dryness of mouth with profuse saliva day and night; every thing tastes sour or bitter.

Stomach and abdomen : There is no desire for eating or drinking, although there is appetite.

Vomiting of undigested food, of sour mttcus, bile or blood. TYMPANITIC ABDOMEN, with excessive

flatulence and belching which gives no relief and consequently great distension of entire abdomen and borborygmus.

Sensation as if the abdomen is full of gas; to get relief from which the patient tries to belch, but on eructation, there is no tangible relief.

Each food particle seems vo have turned into gas (lod., Kali carb.).

Worse from eating fruits, fish, wine, etc. Abdomen feels sore and tender; Aggravation by slight touch, and RELIEVED BY HARD PRESSURE AND DOUBLING UP. There is canine hunger without any special desire to eat Haematemesis with great loss of blood. Gastraigia with acidity, bloating and sour

Headache

Boring pain in temples with confusion and heaviness of the head which aggravates while bending head backward and amelioration in open air.

Toothache

Toothache from tobacco. Teeth feel too long (Mezerium.) Worse at night and better by holding cold water in the mouth and drawing cold air in. (rev. of Staphy.)

Urinary symptoms

The remedy is very useful for urinary troubles. There is frequent, scanty dribbling urination with

burning and sense of constriction in urethra. Patient has to wait a long time before he can Urinate. The flow is slow or interrupted. Pain worse at night.

INTRODUCTION: When we think about Cinchona, we are unknowingly taken to 1790 in the study room of Hahnemann because it was Cinchona bark which revealed to him the unique system of treatment, “Homoeopathy”. After passing the M.D., the then highest examination in Allopathy and practising it for about 10 years, Hahnemann became completely disappointed and disgusted with the crude, inhuman, torturing, troublesome and harmful system of allopathic treatment. He was master of many languages. Therefore, he decided to earn his livelihood by the most innocent, yet useful profession of translating various books into different languages. While doing so, he came across the fact that Cinchona bark has the power of producing malaria-like symptoms in healthy human beings, and this led him to conclude that if it has got the power to produce malaria-like symptoms in the healthy human beings, theri it is also capable of curing the natural disease manifesting symptoms similar to that of malaria in people naturally sick. With this idea in view, he himself took a little quantity of the juice expressed from the Cinchona bark and he was soon sick with symptoms similar to malaria. He tried the experiment on his family members and friends with the same results. This was the beginning of the historic invention of “HOMOEOPATHY”. THUS CINCHONA TO HAHNEMANN WAS, WHAT FALLING APPLE WAS TO Newton.

Following this pleasant experience and new idea, Hahnemann proved and established many remedies on the basis of “SIMILIA SIMILIBUS CURANTUR”. He also treated with great success many diseases t with the remedies he proved arid established, of which the first and foremost was Cinchona.

name: Coca
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Coca is used by the natives of South America as we use coffee, tea and tobacco. So it is like tea and coffee in arresting tissue changes and enabling those who take it to undergo unusual fatigues. It contains an alkaloid called cocaine,

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Angina Pectoris. Asthma. Cough. Debility. Dyspnoea. Carries of teeth. Insomnia. Mountain sickness. Nervous exhaustion.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) The mountaineers’ remedy—Useful in complaints incidental to mountain climbing such as palpitation, dyspnoea, anxiety & insomnia.

2) Suited to persons wearing out under the physical and mental strain of a busy life, and who suffer from exhausted nerves & brain (Fl.Acid., Kali Phos., Nux Vom.)

3) Shortness of breath in old people and in those who use tobacco and whisky in excess.

4) Want of breath in those engaged in athletic sports.

5) Longing for alcoholic liquors and tobacco for the accustomed stimulants.

6) Violent palpitation : From incarcerated flatus (Arg.N., Nux V.) from over exertion. from heart strain (Arn., Bor., Caust.)

7) Sleepy but can find no rest anywhere.

8) Mind : Coca patients are extremely bashful & timid. They are always ill at ease in society. Melancholic from nervous exhaustion. They are sad, irritable & delights in solitude and obscurity. They lose all sense of right and wrong.

9) Ailments : Bad effects : From mountain climbing or ballooning (Ars.) Bad effects of stimulants, alcohol, tobacco.

General Modalities :

Aggravation : From Ascending, in high attitudes. Amelioration—From wine, from riding in open air.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: For this poisonous’ vegetable plant Hahnemann says, “This vegetable substance, used hitherto only for destroying some noxious agents and for stupefying fishes so that they may be caught by hand, was first employed by myself as a medicine”. It is the picrotoxin alkaloid content of Cocculus which possesses the toxic effect when given in crude, form and serves the therapeutic purpose when administered in dynamic doses.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Brain affection, Cholera, Colic, Convulsion, Fevers, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Memory weak, Menstrual troubles, Mental excitement, Paralysis, Rheumatism, Sea-sickness, Sleep affection, from loss of sleep, Somnolence, Vertigo Vomiting etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It chiefly affects the cerebro-spinal system, voluntary muscular system and sensorium. PATHOGENESIS

Acting on the cerebro-spinal system, it produces great debility. It causes paralytic weakness of the spine and especially of its motor nerves resulting in weakness of the legs. Knees give out when walking. Soles of feet feel as if asleep. Convulsions, both clonic and tonic are a special characteristic of its action. It produces vomiting of cerebral origin rather than gastric.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Especially suited for women and children with light hair and eyes, who suffer severely Curing menstruation and pregnancy, unmarried and childless women. Also adopted to book-worms, sensitive romantic girls with irregular menstruation, onanist and persons debilitated by sexual excesses,

Temperament: Mind and sluggish temperament, nervous persons. Relation with heat and cold: As a whole there is aggravation from sun. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

The patient has very severe sick headache. Causation: Headache is caused due to loss of sleep, mental excitement, grief, anxiety or

vexation.

Time: At each menstrual period.

Location: Headache starts at the nape of neck and occiput extending to spine.

Sensation: Sense of emptiness in head: opening and shutting sensation, especially in occiput. Character of pain ; As if tightly bound by a cord, There is pressing throbbing type of pain. Modalities : Aggravation by lying on back and from carriage riding.

name: Coffea Cruda
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The effects of Coffea cruda have to be considered separately from those of Coffea tosta, since the roasting converts much of the Caffeine into Coffeone or Methylamine, which gives to Coffee its aroma. But the effects are scarcely distinguishable, and I have not attempted to keep them strictly apart. Coffea Cruda is one of the Nash’s trio of pain remedies, others being Aconite Nap & Chamomilla.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Abdominal colic. Crural _Neuralgia. Headache. Hyperaesthesia. Hysteria. Heart-affection of Joy-ill effects of. Migrain.

Neuralgia. Sciatica. Sleeplessness. Toothache.

PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTION It has seven special centres of action through the cerebrospinal nervous system.

1) Cerebrum : Here it stimulates the mentality and produces obstinate Insomnia.

2) Cord, posterior columns : It paralyzes the sensory nerve filaments.

3) Circulation : It stimulates the vasomotor nerves and increases blood pressure.

4) Kidneys : Here it increases the arterial blood pressure, produces diuresis and diminishes the urea.

5) Sexual organs : Producing great excitement of these organs which is followed by

paresis.

6) Digestive organs : It first stimulates the digestive organs and then prostrates

them.

7) Vagi: It very powerfully stimulates the respiratory centre.

CONSTITUTION Physical make up : It is suited to tall, lean, stooping persons with dark complexion. Temperament: Sanguine choleric temperament. Relation with heat » cold—Chilly patient.

Miasm : Psora.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Oversensitiveness of all the senses ; sight, hearing, smell, taste, touch etc. become more acute.

2) Unusual activity of mind and body.

3) Pain : Great sensitiveness to pain, seem almost insupportable, driving patient to despair, tossing about in anguish (In Aconite, Chamomilla and Nux Vomica there is also irritability of high degree, But the difference is that Aconite is fearful and anxious, dreads things ; Chamo. is spiteful & uncivil, Nux Vomica is sullen,

keeps the eyes shut, does not wish to speak or have anything to do with anyone ; and Coffea on the other hand is wakeful, on the constant move.)

4) Sleeplessness with physical excitement through mental exaltation.

5) Hasty eating & drinking (Bell., Hep.)

6) Headache from over — mental exertion, thinking & talking, worse in open air.

7) Toothache relieved by holding ice water in the mouth but returns when water becomes warm (Bis., Bry., Puls.; Cham.)

8) Mind : Mental symptoms of coffea are very peculiar & characteristic. Coffea is characterised by extreme sensitiveness, nervous agitation and restlessness. Great and unusual activity of the mind and body is an important point with Coffea cruda. The mind is full of ideas & is active with plans & fancies. There is oversensitiveness of all the senses such as sight, hearing, taste, touch, smell etc. and are equally acute. Due to all this mental exaltation patient becomes sleepless ; there is wide awake condition with impossibility to close the eyes. He feels pains intensely, it seems almost insupportable and drives him to despair. He, tosses about in agony. He is a great subject to ailments arising from sudden emotion and pleasurable surprise. He weBps from delight. Weeping alternates with laughing. He is hasty especially in eating and drinking.

9) Ailments from : Effects of sudden emotion, especially pleasurable ones, fear or fright, wine, overfatigue and long journeys, overmental exertion, thinking, talking.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Overmental exertion, talking, thinking, effects of sudden emotion especially pleasurable Ones,

Location : One sided headache.

Sensation : There is sensation as from a nail driven into the brain ; as if brain were torn or dashed to Pieces ; as if head was too small, as if head would burst and fly to pieces if she moved.

Modality ; Agg.—Mental exertion, thinking, open air. Ame.—By warmth.

name: Colchicum Autumnale
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It is a plant found in Europe. The fresh bulb is taken for preparation of mother tincture. It has received the name Colchicum autumnale because it blooms during autumn and usually the symptoms are also aggravated during autumn. So it is a useful remedy for the autumnal dysentery. It is also an indispensable remedy for gout and rheumatism. Dr. Hughes says that this medicine has a diuretic action and it increases elimination of uric acid of by the kidneys. Gout is a metabolic disease pertaining to defects in purine metabolism. It explains its usefulness in cases of gout. The Allopathic school has used and abused this drug for any gouty

condition, says Tyler.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Cholera, Cough, Colic, Cramp, Diarrhoea, Dropsy, Dysentery, Gout, Castro-intestinal disorders, Fever, Nausea, Rheumatism, Smell-intolerance of Vomiting, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Colchicum acts on disgestive tract, heart, pericardium, kidneys and joints.

This agent irritates the digestive organs and produces nausea, vomiting and loss of appetite, colic, diarrhoea and painful cramps. It also produces inflammation of intestine, leading to sloughing which ultimately passes out of scrapping of intestine in stool with blood and mucous. It also produces inflammation of joints with sensitiveness to touch.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up; Robust persons of vigorous constitution and diseases of old people. Leucophlegmatic constitutions.

Temperament: Irritable and melancnolic temperament. Relation with heat and cold; Chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora is in the background.

Diathesis: Rheumatic and Gouty diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:

name: Collinsonia Canadensis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Collinsonia Can. is an important haemor- rhoidal remedy of our materia medica. Most of the symptoms of collin. are due to portal congestion ajid pelvic congestion. Due to its congestive action it produces severe constipation, piles, dysmenorrhoea, headache and even heart symptoms etc.

1) Congestion especially of portal & pelvic region resulting in dysmenorrhoea and haemorrhoids.

2) Chronic, painful, bleeding piles with sensation as if sticks, sand or gravel had lodged in rectum. Vascular engorgement of rectum. Most obstinate constipation with protruding piles. There is congestion of pelvic viscera with piles in later

months of pregnancy, haemorrhoidal dysentery with tenesmus.

3) Constipation : It is very admirable remedy for constipation and usually presents in association with the haemorrhoids, headache and flatulence. In Collinsonia constipation is generally due to congestive inertia of lower bowel. (Sulph. Sepia). Stool is sluggish and hard with pain and great flatulence. Dr. Nash has permanently cured a case of obstinate constipation with Collinsonia in a patient who averaged only two stools a week for years and had taken any amount of cathartics without

any lasting relief.

4) Heart complaints associated with piles. Palpitation in patients subject to piles and indigestion. Heart’s action persistently rapid but weak. In Collinsonia after relief of

heart complaints old piles reappear or suppressed menses return.

5) Pruritus in pregnancy with haemorrhoids, unable to lie down. The genitals are

swollen and inflammed.

General Modalities :

Agg. : The slightest mental emotion or excitement aggravate the symptoms (Arg Nit.),

from cold. Ame. : By heat.
