Throbbing pain in stomach. PROFUSE BLEEDING DARK BLOOD, SORENESS IN THE

ABDOMEN, haemorrhage from intestine during typhoid or in dysentery, profuse bleeding, dark blood. Anus feels raw and sore. Haemorrhage does not cause any mental anxiety.

Modality: Aaggravation from motion and little exertion.

Haematuria

Dark blood with increased desire to urinate.

Varicosity of veins

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Helleborus is yet another of our Master’s immortal monuments derived from the vegetable kingdom—Chirstmas Rose, belonging to the natural order of Ranunculaceae. This is called Christmas Rose because the flowers bloom in mid-winter. The mother tincture is prepared from the dried root. In its crude form and in physiological dose, it is poisonous but when it is potentised, the poisonous effect is transformed into a wonderful dynamic power capable of curing brain, urinary and abdonimal symptoms.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Apoplexy, Brain affection, Cholera, Concussion, Convuilsion, Diarrhoea, Drospy, Headache, Hydrocephalus, Meningitis, Tetanus, Typhoid, Urinary affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seats of action of Helleborus are brain, nervous system, meninges, kidney, serous membrane, urinry organs and gastro-intestinal tract.

Acting on brain and meninges it produces dropsical effusion leading to hydrocephalus and meningitis and many other reflex symptoms. It acts on kidney resulting in scanty and high coloured albuminous urine; it irritates the digestive tract causing inflammation of stomach and intestine thereby producing jelly-like mucus and diarrhoea. It also causes cerebral and general paralysis and through pneumogastric nerve, respiration is retarded and there may be cardiac paralysis.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is more suited to weak and delicate persons, especially children who are prone to brain troubles with serous effusion.

Temperament: Irritable temperament. Relation with heat and cold; Chilly patient. Miasm : Psora is in the background.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This plant is also called the “Blazing Star’,’. Medicine is prepared from the fresh root gathered before flowering. Just like Murex, this remedy is chiefly a woman’s remedy and is regarded as a great uterine tonic.

Albuminuris. Anaemia. Breast affection. Diabetes. Menstrual anomalies. Urinary complaints. Uterine disorder.

SPHERE OF ACTION It has specific action over the female sexual organs including kidney, mind, muscles.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Generally called for women worn out with hard work mental or physical or

weakened by luxury and indolence and who complain of tired feeling in the back and limbs.

2) A consciousness of a womb. Feels it moves when she moves, it is so sore and tender.

3) Feels complaints more when thinking about them, always better when occupied. (Calc. Phos. Medo. Oxalic Acid)

4) Sensation of heaviness and soreness in pelvis.

5) Mind : Profound melancholy and great lowness of spirit. Irritable and fault finding nature. She can not endure least contradiction or receive least suggestion. Restfess,

wants to move around as she feels better when mind and body are employed. These mentals are always associated with uterine disorder.

6) For the bad effects of abortion and miscarriage.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Menses

Time : Too early.

Quantity ; Too profuse.

Character of flow: Passive, dark, clotted and offensive.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Hepar sulph. is a medicine possessing a place of importance no less than Nux vomica, even in the smallest homoeopathic domestic case. Hahnemann’s Hepar sulphuris areum is prepared by a mixture of equal parts of finely powdered shells and pure flowers of sulphur, kept for ten minutes at a uniform heat. From this the potencies are prepared. Hepar has gained a fame to be a member of one of the celebrated “Boenninghausen’s Group Powders” others being Aconite and Spongia, all in 200th

potency.

‘Kini Asthma, Boils, Breast affection, Bronchitis, Burns, Carbuncles, Chilblain, Chlorosis, Cold, Consumption, Cough, Diarrhoea, Ear affection, Eczema, Erysipelas, Eye affection, Glandular swellings, Headache, Hoarseness, Jaundice, Laryngitis, Leucorrhoea, Liver affections, Throat and Lung affections, Marasmus, Menstrual disorders, Pneumonia, Rheumatism, Skin affection, Suppuration, Urinary affection, Urticaria, Whooping cough, etc.

N.B. : The author highlights how the letter “H” is appropriate in describing the Hepar patient, as an aid to memory, as follows:

Hepar patient is hypersensitive mentally and physically, to touch, to pain and to cold air. He is hyper impulsive and heavily sweating, hasty in speech and drinking. He has hoarseness in the morning. Hépar hastens suppuration and cure and is ameliorated by

heat, hot fomentation and covering.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Hepar sulph. acts especially upon lymphatic, glandular system, skin, respiratory organ, mucous membrane. Of course, the nerves are not left behind from getting affected by this drug. It is a powerful remedy affecting both mind and body. This is a first class irritant (or temper, nerves and tissues. Hepar is hyper in all its actions.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces enlargement of lymphatic glands, suppuration, ulcers, eczmatous eruptions, unhealthy skin and a condition of non-healing moist eruption on the folds of skin. It acts on nerves and causes GREAT IRRITABILITY, OVERSENSITIVENESS

310

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Chilly patient, highly sensitive to cold air. Imagines he can feel the air if a door is opened in the next room. Must be wrapped up to the face even in hot weather (Psor.). Cannot bear to be uncovered (Nux—Cannot bear to be covered—Camphor, Secale cor.).

2. The patient is very much OVERSENSITIVE BOTH PHYSICALLY AND MENTALLY. Very sensitive to touch. According to Nash, its strongest characteristic is HYPERSENSITIVENESS to touch, pain and cold air.

3. Sweats profusely day and night without any relief, which is sour and offensive. Easily sweats on every mental or physical exertion.

4. Sensation of a splinter, fish bone or plug in throat (Arg. nitricum, Nit. acid, Anacardium).

Diseases where the system has been injured by abuse of mercury. . All the discharges are very much sour e.g. vomiting, stool, sweat, etc. . The slightest injury causes suppuration (Graphites, Silicea, Mercurius).

. The skin is very sensitive to touch. Cannot bear even clothes to touch the affected parts (Lachesis).

9. In diseases where suppuration seems inevitable, Hepar may open the abscess and hasten the cure if applied in low potencies.

10. Aggravation: From COLD IN GENERAL, cold air, cold food, uncovering the part.

Amelioration: From WARMTH IN GENERAL; covering from head to foot, from warm food and drink; IN DAMP WET WEATHER.

11. The patient has great CRAVING for sour things, vinegar, wine, acids and strong tasting foods. AVERSION to fatty food; dislike for all kinds of nourishment.

12. Mind : Mentally the patient is very much OVERSENSITIVE AND IRRITABLE. The slightest thing irritates him. Very much impulsive: Mother may have impulse to throw the child into fire. Impulse to do violence and to destroy.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Exposure to cold and suppressed eruption. Location; One side of the head and right ternple.

Character: Headache when shaking the head or riding. Boring pain every morning. Constant pressive pain on one side as from a plug or nail. Sealp is very sore and sensitive to touch.

Modalities: Aggravation from cold and amelioration from warmth, covering and in DAMP WET WEATHER.

Concomitants: Vertigo with headache. Boils on the head and neck. Humid eruptions, feel very sore and of foetid odour; itching and burning and sore on scratching.

Gastro-intestinal Symptoms

Mouth : There is offensive odour from mcvith. Gums and mouth are painfuil to touch; gums bleed easily. Ulcers in gums and mouth. Toothache after drinking cold things or opening the mouth. Toothache better in a warm room, from biting teeth together.

Throat : Pressive and constructive sensation in throat. Stitches in the throat which extend to ear. Smarting soreness in throat, worse on swallowing. Sensation as if a fish bone or a splinter were sticking in the throat. Also sensation of a plug or internal swelling in throat when swallowing.

Stomach : Putrid, bitter, sour, metallic taste arising from stomach. Eructation after eating. Stomach is painful on walking as if it were hanging loose. Frequent, but momentary attack of nausea, followed by vomiting of bile every morning. Feeling of distension in pit of stomach. There is heaviness and pressure in stomach after a slight meal. Stiching pain in the region of liver when walking, coughing, breathing or touching it. Colic with dry cough.

Stool : Stool is clay-coloured and soft; sour srneffing and white, containing undigested food particles. Although stool is not hard, it is expelled with great difficulty. Usually diarrhoeic stool with tenesmus.

Urine : Urine is dark and hot; burning, corroding the prepuce. Bladder is weak; flow impeded. Urine

is voided slowly without force, drops vertically. Flow intermittent; cannot empty the bladder thoroughly. The patient has to wait for a long time before he can pass urine (Nat. mur, Staph, Mur, acid).

Respiratory Symptoms :

Cough

* Causation; From cold air and when any part of the body Is uncovered.

¢ Sensation : With cough there 's Splinter like sensation in throat as if a fish bone or plug is sticking in the throat. The throat !s very much sensitive to touch.

* Character of cough: Dry cough, deep, rough, barking, DRY, CROUPY COUGH WITH CHOKING, gagging and with great soreness of chest.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on mucous membrane, especially of respiratory tract, gastro-intestinal tract, glands, liver and skin. PATHOGENESIS

Acting on mucous membrane, it relaxes them and produces a THICK, YELLOWISH, ROPY, AND STRINGY, VISCID SECRETION, particularly in the catarrhal conditions, which may be anywhere from the body. It produces a malignant or CACHECTIC DYSCRASIA and also alters the course and severity of small-pox.

Make-up of the body: Hydrastis is specially suited to old, easily TIRED PEOPLE, cachectic persons with great debility and scrofulous constitution, which has been broken down by alcoholism. The skin has a jaundiced look, mottled and puckered, with yellowish white colour of the face.

Angina Pecforis, Bronchitis, Brain affections, Chorea, Coma vigil, Cough, Delirum, Diarrhoea, Enteric fever, Epilepsy, Haemorrhage, Headache, Mania, Meningitis, Neuralgia, Paralysis, Pneumonia, Urinary disorders etc.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Skin

A great variety of skin affections such as acne, eczema, pemphigus, lupus, leprosy, coprer coloured eruption, papular eruption etc. have been cured with it. Great thickening of epidermoid layer and exfoliation of scales js the characteristic of this remedy which have let to its use in scrotal tumors as well as elephantiasis. It has considerable reputation in leprosy and lupus when there is no ulceratic= (Ulcerative stage : Calotropis). There is intolerable itching, especially of soles and profuse sweating.

Female Genital symptoms :

Hydrocot is of great use in fungus growths & granular ulceration on the upper lip & neck of == uterus. There is heat within vagina. Insupportable itching of the vagina is a characteristic indicaticr Profuse leucorrhoea.

Character: Pressing and stupefying pain in the forehead. Brain feels as if were loose. The patient shakes the head to and fro or rolls head from side to side.

Modality: Aggravation at night, by mental affections, during menses and when lying down. Concomitants: Confusion and vertigo as from intoxication, hiccough and dimness of vision.

Urine

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Hyoscyamus, one of the TRIO OF DELIRIOM, is also a gift of vegetable kingdom. Like Belladonna and Stramonium, Hyoscyamus too iS poisonous in crude from. The fresh root of the plant is used to prepare mother tincture when it possesses maximum medical powers. Poisoning, provings and _ experience of Hyoscyamus show its very definite range of action as well as different striking resemblances to its natural relation with Belladonna and Stramonium from which it can easily be distinguished.

Hyoscyamus is said to be especially poisonous to fowls, hence the name, but for other animals, it acts like a purgative. Old school uses Hyoscyamus as a “Cerebral depressant” in acute mania, delirium tremens, febrile delirium and insomnia. It is mostly used by them in asylum practice.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Hyoscyamus acts upon the nervous system, sensorium, muscular system, mucous membrane and skin.

PATHOGENESIS

It irritates nerve centres, producing increased cerebral activity, but non- inflammatory in type, delirium, hysteria and delirium tremens. It also irritates mucous membranes and skin. Its pathogenetic action besides producing epilepsy, melancholia and mania also covers coma vigil. Non-inflammatory increase of cerebral activity may also be noticed in a few cases. It produces a sensation of fulness and heat of the head With a flushed face without pronounced hyperaemia.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Like other members of the TRIO, Hyoscyamus too is more or less an acute drug and as such, consideration of constitution is not of much importance. However, these patients are usually light-haired with pale or bluish face.

319 P

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. “Increased cerebral activity”, but of a non-inflammatory type can be noticeg throughout this drug. Hyoscyamus has many points in common with Belladonna and Stramonium. Each one has got an individuality of its own. Hyoscyamus doeg not produce the intense cerebral congestion and inflammation of Belladonna, nor the intense maniacal delirium and sensorial excitement of Stramonium. In delirium too, Hyoscyamus occupies a place midway between Belladonna and Stramonium, [t lacks.the constant cerebral congestion of the former and the fierce rage and maniacal delirium of the latter.

2. One peculiar symptom pre-eminently found in Hyoscyamus is “DESIRE TO UNCOVER”. The patient throws off the bed-clothes not because they are too warm, but because he will not remain covered. Wants to expose his body fully.

3. Another striking feature of Hyoscyamus is that the patient HAS NO WANTS AND MAKES NO COMPLAINTS. The patient ceases to complain of his symptoms; he is hot, does not desire to drink; does not know whether to take this or that, does not recognise those around him, he abuses them, makes irrelevant answers, wishes to run away, cries aloud or whines, but without being able to say why he is doing so.

4. Hyoscyamus is famous for its delirium. In delirium it has its own peculiar features. The non-inflammatory type of increased cerebral activity, ridiculous gestures and display of a comical alienation of mind, and the horrible lascivious mania and the desire to remain uncovered are symptoms peculiar to Hyoscyamus alone.

5. The choreic symptoms of Hyoscyamus are well defined. Every muscle of the body twitches, from the eyes to the toes. There is a constant state of erethysm. Not a single part of the whole body, or a solitary muscle is in a quiet state for a moment. Convulsive motions, spasm, both tonic and clonic, without consciousness, but with ! restlessness are all characteristic of this drug.

6. Fear, suspicion and jealousy prevail always in a Hyoscyamus patient. (Lach.. Puls., Rhus tox. Nux vom., Stram.). Fear of being alone; of being poisoned, of being bitten, being sold. Suspects to eat or drink or to take what is offered; suspicious of some plot, of every body.

7. Intense sleeplessness of irritable, excitable persons, from embarrassment, often imaginary.

8. Mind : Hyoscyamus is a great remedy for distinct and characteristic mental symptprns which are as follows:

Diseases with increased mental activity, but of a noninflammatory type: Such as hysteria, delirium tremens or delirium.

The patient is very restless. Would not stay in bed. He jumps out of bed and tries to escape. Makes irrelevant answers and thinks that he is in the wrong place; behaves

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Injury

Hypericum is an excellent remedy for injuries involving NERVES, the symptoms of which are as

follows

Causation: Injuries are caused by mechanical affections of spinal cord, bad effects of spinal concussion, pains after a fall on coccyx.

Punctured, incised or lacerated wounds, whidh are very sore and painful. Injuries from nails, needles, rat-bites, with severe pain as from splinters.

Injuries of parts which are RICH IN SENTIENT NERVES, such, as fingers, toes, matrices of nails, palms and soles, having intolerable pain, indicating that nerve are severely involved.

Nervous depression following wounds or surgical operation. It also removes bad effects of shock, fright or mesmerism.

Hypericum is capable of modifying and sometimes arresting ulceration and sloughing (Calendula); crushed and smashed finger tips or tetanus after traumatic injuries.

Hypericum also can preserve the integrity of a torn and lacerated member when it is almost entirely separated from the body.

Convulsion and spasm after injury, blow or concussion, especially of head.

Excessive pain and.soreness of the affected parts. Violent pain and inability to walk or stoop. Feeling of weakness and trembling of all the limbs and numbness and cramping feeling.

Spine is very sensitive to touch after a fall; slight touch of arms or neck causes severe pain and the patient screams and cries with pajn.

Headache

There is severe headache after a fall upon coccyx. During headache, there is sensation as if being lifted up high into the air and consequently there is a great anxiety of falling from the height.

Vertigo

Vertigo with sensation as if the head suddenly became elongated; especially at night with urging to urinate.

For bunions and corns (Antim crud., Ran. bulb.), with severe excruciating pain, showing involvement of nerves, Hypericum is a gret remedy.

General Modalities : Aggravation: In cold dampness; in fog, in a closed room, least exposure, touch. Amelioration: Bending head backwards,

Relations

Compare: Arnica, Calendula, Ruta, Staph. In wounds where formerly Aconite and Arnica were given alternately, Hypericum cures. Antidoted by: Arsenic. Antidotes: Sulphur.

name: Ignatia Amara
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Ignatia is famous as “a REMEDY OF GREAT CONTRADICTIONS”. It is A WOMEN’S REMEDY, and is the “feminine” of “masculine”, Nux-vomica. The deep insight of Hahnemann penetrated into the curative value of this very useful drug. All the leading physicians, from time to time, were undoubtedly unanimous about its very contradictory nature as verified in the daily practices but for every true practitioner this is an indispensable remedy. The full implication of the numerous contradictory symptoms of the drug on one hand and those of the actual disease on the other, for which this remedy is aptly used with sure success, can hardly be understood by any person without exercising his prudence. Still the utility of the remedy has been well recognised by one and all, in their own way through daily practice.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal disorders, Anxiety, Appetite, Chorea, Convulsion, Constipation, Croup, Debility, Genital organs, Epilepsy, Flatulence, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Heart affection, Hysteria, Intermittent fever, Locomotor ataxia, Menstrual disorders, Melancholia, Numbness, Paralysis, Sleep, Throat and respiratory troubles, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Ignatia’s domain of action is predominantly on entire nervous system, especially medulla oblongata, spinal cord and consequently the whole nervous system. PATHOGENESIS

It acts especially on medulla oblongata and spinal nervous system, producing convulsion, spasm, chorea, hysteria and dyspnoea; intense acuteness of nerves resulting in HYPERAESTHESIA, EMOTIONAL DISTURBANCES, INCOORDINATION AND

VARIOUS CONTRADICTORY SYMPTOMS.

CONSTITUTION Make-up of the body: Dark looking lady, with dark hair and dark complexion.

Temperament: Nervous temperament, VERY SENSITIVE, easily excited, quick in Perception and rapid in execution.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1, It is a remedy of great contradiction, such as, (a) Roaring in ears relieved by music, (b) Sore throat relieved by swallowing solid, (c) Liquid is more painful than solid to swallow, (d) Cough is aggravated by more coughing, (e) Cough more on standing, less or nil on walking, (f) Empty feeling in the stomach not relieved by eating, (g) Piles relieved when walking, (h) Piles protrude when the stool is soft, but not during hard stool, (i) Prolapse of anus with soft stool, (j) Spasmodic laughter from grief instead of weeping, (k) Sexual desire with impotency. (l) Thirst during chill and heat without thirst. Red face during chill, pale during heat, (m) Relieved by external heat and aggravated hoovering, (n) Mental conditions suddenly change from joy to sorrow and vice versa.

2. Long involuntary sighing.

3. Hypersensitiveness to all external impressions, such as pain, touch, odour, noise, etc.

4. Pain, on a small spot that can be covered with the tip of a finger (Kali. bich,).

5. All symptoms are caused and aggravated by tobacco. There is utter inability to TOLERATE TOBACCO IN ANY FORM.

6. There is sweat on face or on the tip of the nose on a small spot only while eating.

7. Desire for cold food, acid things, onion, fruit, bread, butter, great variety of undigestible things and wants to be alone. Aversion to work, meat, milk, warm food, open air and mental exertion.

8. Mind : Ignatia patient develops peculiar mental conditions which are as follows:

Mental symptoms are caused by ill effects of bad news, fright, anger, grief, vexation, disappointed love, suppressed sexual desire, reserved displeasure and a feeling of shame and mortification.

There is RAPIDLY CHANGING mental condition from laughing to weeping; from joy to sorrow, one moment excessively happy, the next moment in rage, etc.

The patient broods in solitude over imaginary troubles; full of suppressed grief. Involuntary sighing (Lachesis, Cale. phos.).

Desires, tobe alone; MOODY.

Taciturn, sad, melancholic and indifferent,

There is weakness of memory.

Unreasonable; howls and cries; slightest fault finding or contradictions excite anger; very short-tempered patient.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: From TOBACCO, anger, grief, sorrow, bad news and suppressed mental sufferings.

Character of pain: There is congestive and throbbing headache. Heavy headache as if a nail was driven through the side, relieved by lying on it. Throbbing pain at occiput with every beat of heart.

Modalities: Headache is worse on stooping, jar and motion by SMOKING OR SMOKING TOBACCO worse when pressing for stool relieved by lying on painful side and by profuse urination (Gels , Silicea, Sanguinaria, Ver. alb.).-

Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : While talking or chewing bites inside of cheek. Stitching pain in the palate, extending to ear. Toothache from drinking coffee or from tobacco smoking, sour test in mouth.

Stomach : Empty feeling in the pit of stomach, not relieved by eating. Sinking in stomach relieved by taking deep breath. There is sweat on face or on the tip of the nose on a small spot only while eating, Cramps in stomach. All-gone sensation in the stomach, with much flatulence and hiccough; worse from touch, contact, jar and motion, flatulent colic; desire for stool felt in the epigastrum. (Ver. alb.). Sour €ructation.

Constipation : Obstinate constipation in habitual coffee drinkers from carriage riding; desire for stool felt in the upper abdomen. Excessive urge and desire for stool; but there is great pain in rectum which compels the patient to refrain from going to closet. There may be prolapse of anus from moderate Straining, lifting or stooping. PROLAPSE OF ANUS IS MORE WHEN THE STOOL IS LOOSE.

Haemorrhoids : Piles protrude with every soft stool, not with hard stool; have to be replaced, better by walking. Sharp stitching pain in the anus which shoots up to rectum. Pain remains for hours after stool Pain in small circumscribed spot. (Kali. bich.).

name: Iodum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It is a drug proved and recorded in chronic diseases by Hahnemann, who speaks of it as a heroic medicine, even when employed in the highest potency. Iodine, belongs to a family of Halogens, others being Chlorine, Bromine and Fluorine. If at all a student wants to remember lodum in rhymes, the following few lines may be helpful.

“Ravenous Iodine howls for her dinner,

Eats much sand eats often, but only grows thinner, Her phenomenal meals she’s ever repeating, Because all her Symptoms are better by eating, She is fidgety, fearful, unable to rest;

While, she eats, while she walks, in the cold, she feels best Air her glands (save the mammae) congested appear,

With corrosive, destructive to clothes leucorrhoea.”

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Appetite disordered, Atrophy, Brain affection, Constipation, Consumption, Cough, Debility, Diarrhoea, Diptheria, Goitre, Glandular affection, Headache, Heart affection, Jaundice, Laryngitis, Leucorrhoea, Liver affection, Menstrual disorders, Pneumonia, Rheumatism, Rickets, Throat and lung affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
lodum especially acts on all the glandular system, lymph glands, thyroid, liver. spleen, breasts, ovaries, testes, salivary glands, etc. Mucus membrane of eyes, nose. respiratory tract and even blood vessels are not spared from its action.

PATHOGENESIS

When acting on the glandular system, it leads to HYPERTROPHY, ENLARGEMENT AND INDURATION, EXCEPTING THE BREASTS WHICH DWINDLE AND ATROPHY. The hypertrophy of glands is at the expense of muscles, generalised emaciation. Mucus membrane produces a state of catarrhal inflammation. Blood vessels get Constricted, vaso-constriction, capillary congestion followed by oedema, ecchymosis haemorrhage and nutritive disturbances.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Ravenous hunger; feels relieved while eating and after eating. 2. Losing flesh while eating well (Abrot., Nat. mur., Tuber.).

3. All glands of the body are HYPERTROPHIED AND ENLARGED EXCEPT THE MAMMARY GLAND.

4, All the symptoms are WORSE FROM WARMTH in general and better from cold in general e.g. cold air.

5. Profound debility and loss of breath on going upstairs.

6. Discharges are acrid and corrosive ..g. foot-sweat, leucorrhoea, etc.

7. Pulsation all over the body e.g. stomach, back, even arms and fingers. 8. Sensation of constriction and squeezing, especially in heart.

9. Intense restlessness with apprehension.

10. Mind : The lodum patient is very much weak in mind; forgetfrul, cannot remember a little thing. He forgets what he was about to say or to do. The forgetfulness is extensive. There is great anxiety, especially when quiet, with depression. The patient must keep himself busy. Though mentally exhausted, he is compelled to keep busy and continue the work.

Again there is Sudden impulse to do some violence; he wants to do something hurriedly; he has impulse to kill. In this it is very closely related to Aresenic, Hepa and Natrum Sulph.—all these have got impulse to murder without any cause but the difference is in sensitiveness to heat. While lodum is very warm blooded, others are always chilly.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal Symptoms

Stomach : Throbbing pain at the pit of stomach, Empty eructation day and night as if every particle of food were turned into air (Kali carb.).

Indigestion from over-eating with much flatulence, sour eructation and belching.

name: Ipecacuanha
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Ipecacuanha is an interesting drug standing on the ceasefire line between the absolutely opposite ways of therapeutics. Old school usually studies, experiments with and uses drug for their physiological actions and lays down maximum non-lethal doses for adults and children, while Homoeopathy uses them for their exactly opposite effect and in dynamic dose for vital stimulation. Ipecac is interesting as being one of the drugs that Allopathy uses to cure Homoeopathically. It is used in both ways, in fact to PROVOKE AND TO CURE VOMITING. According to Hahnemann Ipecac is a short acting medicine.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anaemia, Asthma, Bone affection, Chorea, Convulsion, Constipation, Colic, Cough, Diarrhoea, Deafness, Dysentery, Eye affection, Fever, Gall-stone colic, Gastric ulcer, Haematemesis, Haemorrhage, Menstrual disorders, Nausea and vomiting, Pregnancy disorders, Stomach disorders, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The chief action is on the ramification of the pneumogastric nerve, on medulla oblongata, on mucous membrane of respiratory and gastro-intestinal tract and arterial vascular system.

When acting on pneumogastric nerve, it produces spasmodic irritation in chest and stomach, the former gives rise to ASTHMA and latter to NAUSEA AND VOMITING. When acting on mucus membrane, it produces a catarrhal condition, pulmonary congestion, even hepatisation, nausea and vomiting.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is especially suited to stout persons of lax fibre; fair people; women and children; emphysematous persons; persons who have a history of epistaxis and other forms of blood loss.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Temperament: Irritable temperament.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
i

Most of its acute complaints commence with NAUSEA and VOMITING or all complaints requiring Ipecac are attended more or less with nausea.

. Nausea constant, continuous and persistent with or without vomiting. Nausea not relieved by vomiting.

. Thirstlessness runs through the whole drug (Nux-mos., Puls., Aethusa, Gels., Apis), Clean tongue (Cina) with much saliva, but no thirst.

4, Bright red haemorrhage from natural orifices like nostrils, mouth and especially

from uterus.

5. Oppressed breathing especially with respiratory and/or gastric complaints. Anxiety

about the stomach is very much prominent.

6. Cold sweat on forehead (Carbo veg., Ver. alb.). 7. Wheezing and rattling of chest without expectoration especially in respiratory

troubles of earlyistage (late stage rattling, Antim tart.).

8. Desire for sweets and dainties. Aversion to all food. 9. Mind : The person is irritable and short tempered. Full of desire for many things

10.

about which he knows nothing, in other words, desire for a number of things without knowing exactly what it is and what it is for.

The person is very much oversensitive, cannot endure east noise. Children cry, how] and scream continuously without any cause.

Ailments from : Undigestible food, raisins, cakes, anger, reserved displeasure. injuries, suppressed eruption, quinine.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Clean tongue with no thirst. Copious secretion of saliva; constantly obliged to swallow saliva, Often indicated in salivation during

pregnancy.

Stomach : Should be thought of in ALL DISEASES WHICH COMMENCE OR ARE ATTENDED

WITH continuous and persistent nausea and even vomiting but without any relief to the patient such as, in gastritis, cholera, abdominal pain, dysentery, bronchitis, pneumonia, asthma and intermittent fever etc. In such symptoms Ipecac tops the list.

Modality: Nausea not relieved by vomiting; vomiting of white glairy mucus in Jarge quantities or of

green jelly like mucus.

When acting on pneumogastric nerve, it produces spasmodic irritation in chest and stomach, the former gives rise to ASTHMA and latter to NAUSEA AND VOMITING. When acting on mucus membrane, it produces a catarrhal condition, pulmonary congestion, even hepatisation, nausea and vomiting.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is especially suited to stout persons of lax fibre; fair people; women and children; emphysematous persons; persons who have a history of epistaxis and other forms of blood loss.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Temperament: Irritable temperament.
GUIDING SYMPTOMS: i

Most of its acute complaints commence with NAUSEA and VOMITING or all complaints requiring Ipecac are attended more or less with nausea.

. Nausea constant, continuous and persistent with or without vomiting. Nausea not relieved by vomiting.

. Thirstlessness runs through the whole drug (Nux-mos., Puls., Aethusa, Gels., Apis), Clean tongue (Cina) with much saliva, but no thirst.

4, Bright red haemorrhage from natural orifices like nostrils, mouth and especially

from uterus.

5. Oppressed breathing especially with respiratory and/or gastric complaints. Anxiety

about the stomach is very much prominent.

6. Cold sweat on forehead (Carbo veg., Ver. alb.). 7. Wheezing and rattling of chest without expectoration especially in respiratory

troubles of earlyistage (late stage rattling, Antim tart.).

8. Desire for sweets and dainties. Aversion to all food. 9. Mind : The person is irritable and short tempered. Full of desire for many things

10.

about which he knows nothing, in other words, desire for a number of things without knowing exactly what it is and what it is for.

The person is very much oversensitive, cannot endure east noise. Children cry, how] and scream continuously without any cause.

Ailments from : Undigestible food, raisins, cakes, anger, reserved displeasure. injuries, suppressed eruption, quinine.
PARTICULARS: Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Clean tongue with no thirst. Copious secretion of saliva; constantly obliged to swallow saliva, Often indicated in salivation during

pregnancy.

Stomach : Should be thought of in ALL DISEASES WHICH COMMENCE OR ARE ATTENDED

WITH continuous and persistent nausea and even vomiting but without any relief to the patient such as, in gastritis, cholera, abdominal pain, dysentery, bronchitis, pneumonia, asthma and intermittent fever etc. In such symptoms Ipecac tops the list.

Modality: Nausea not relieved by vomiting; vomiting of white glairy mucus in Jarge quantities or of

green jelly like mucus.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Potassium bichromate—readily available from mineral kingdom has attained a position in the Homoeopathic Materia Medica because of some very marked and characteristic features, all its own. The effect of the drug on the entire human economy shows profound reaction and produces some keynote characteristics which are of utmost value to the prescriber, rendering the drug one of the most important members of the Homoeopathic Materia Medica.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal and stomach disorders, Anaemia, Asthma, Bronchitis, Bone affection, Catarrh, Cough, Constipation, Diphtheria, Dyspepsia, Exostosis, Eye affection, Fever, Gout, Headache, Lung affection, Neuralgia, Nose affection, Pain, Peptic ulcer, Rheumatism, Skin troubles, Throat and Ulcers, Vomiting, Warts, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts mainly on the mucous membrane, skin, glands, kidney, fibrous tissue and periosteum. PATHOGENESIS

It is an irritant of mucous membrane causing erosion, ulceration and SECRETING TOUGH AND STRINGY DISCHARGES a hallmark of the remedy. Mucous membranes especially acted upon, are those of the respiratory and alimentary tracts. Kidneys, when affected, show congestion and inflammation. Urine becomes albuminous, Skin, just like mucous membrane, ulcerates discharging the characteristic discharge with papules and pustules. Periosteum is congested and inflamed. Nasal septum may be totally destroyed.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up : Fatty persons having light hair, fine complexion and suffering from catarrhal affections. Babies are fat, chubby and Short necked (Long neck, Nat. mur,), disposed to croup and croupy affections,

Relation with heat and cold ; Chilly patient. Miasm. It covers all the three miasms, but especially syphilis is in the background.

337

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : From suppressed catarrh. Before headache, there is blurred vision or preceded by bnlindness (Gels., Nat. mur.) Character of headache: Shifting pain from one place to another; pain comes-suddenly

and goes suddenly, Pain in small spot that can be covered with the tip of a finger.

Modalities: Aggravation from light and noise; amelioration by lying down. Concomitant: Sight returns as headache increases,

Gastro-intestinal Symptoms

Gastric complaints generally peptic ulcers i.e. gastric and duodenal ulcer. Causation: Bad effects of beer, alcohol. Sensation: Weight in the pit of stomach, with loss of appetite and great flaulence.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Potassium Bromide occurs as a colourless or white odourless or white cubical crystals or granules. It is odourless and has a pungent saline taste. It abates all forms of nervousness, fidgetiness or even spasms and creates a tendency to mental calm and indifference.

The greater part of the pathogenesis of this drug is made of symptoms observed in Allopathic overdosing though it has been proved.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acne. Aphasia, Asthma, Cholera infantum. Cough-colic. Diabetis. Epilepsy, Gout. Impotence. Locomotor ataxy. Nightmare. Paralysis, Paralysis agitans. Psoriasis. Self- abuse. Sensibility. Sleeplessness. Somnambulism. Stammering. Speech -affections of. Urine-incontinence of.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
This remedy acts profoundly on mind, cerebro-spinal nervous system, skin and sexual organs. PATHOGENESIS

The prolonged administration of the Bromide of Potassium, produces a peculiar state of the system and is known as Bromism. Kali Brom. affects the mind and nerves producing failure of mental power, general numbness, and anaesthesia of mucous membrane esp. of eyes, throat and skin, weakens the heart and lowers temperature.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up : Kali Brom. is more particu-larly adapted to persons inclined to obesity ; to children ; to nervous women,

Termperament: Patient is depressed, melancholic and weepy.

Relation with heat and cold: There is no stamping heat-cold relation, Patient is neither hot nor chilly.

Miasm : Psora & Syphilis are in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Loss of memory : forgets how to talk; absentminded ; has to be told the word before he can speak it (Anac.).

sections.content:
Head

Brain fag. There is heaviness, numbness feeling in head, violent headache particularly in occiput with flushed face, throbbing of carotids and temporals, and feeling of fullness of head.

Gastrointestinal Symptoms

Throat: Anaesthesia of fauces, pharynx and Larynx. Dys-phagia, esp. of liquids (Ign. Hyos.) Uvula and fauces congested. Stomach : Vomiting with intense thirst, after each meal

Persistent hiccough. Abdomen : Internal coldness of abdomen. Retraction of abdomen.

name: Kali Carbonicum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Postassium carbonate, from which this i sy

treasure has been prepared, is a drug about which Farrington says, Kali carb. is indicated in t a great variety of diseases, but is a drug much neglected in everyday practice, perhaps because, except in a few of its uses, as in Asthma and Pneumonia, it does not appeal strongly enough to the imagination and, therefore, is not—so to speak “on the spot,” Kent says about the Kali carb. patient, “The Kali carb. patient is a hard one to study and the remedy itself is a hard one to study.” It is a right sided medicine.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Aneamia, Asthma, Backache, Biliousness, Catarrh, Cough, Cold, Consumption, Ear and Eye affections, Gastralgia, Haemorrhage, Headache, Haemorrhoids, Hysteria, Kidney affection, Liver affection, Menstrual discrders, Preganancy disorders, Stomach and abdominal disorders, Sciatica, Throat and lung affections, Urinary troubles, Uterine affection, Vertigo, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Kali carb. acts specifically on the respiratory mucus membrane, digestive tract, and upon the ovaro-uterine system, heart, liver, kidney, etc.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces a condition of excessive irritation giving rise to a state bordering on inflammation, yet hardly reaching that point, The serous and mucous membrane become extremely dry, as a result of which there is SHARP STITCHING PAIN, enfeebles the heart, lowers the temperature, causes anaemia, promotes tissue waste, increases the amount of urine and its solid constituents especially uric acid and urea.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: The patient is dark skinned and haired, but of lax fibres with inclination to obesity. Especially helpful in diseases of old people who are fleshy with dropsical condition. Puffiness of upper eyelids and paretic tendencies.

Relation with heat and cold: The patient is always chilly.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. The patient is very much OVERSENSITIVE TO TOUCH; starts when touched ever so lightly, especially on THE feet.

2. Pains are stitching, darting, Worse during rest and lying on affected side (rev.

Bryonia).

8. Bag-like swelling between the upper eye-lids and eyebrows.

4. Early morning aggravation. is very characteristic particularly between 2 to 4 a.m. (Asthma and cough).

5. Backache accompanies all the complaints. It is of a constant nature; with a sensation as if the back and legs would give out any time.

6. Great debility, So much so that she drops herself into a chair or throws herself on the bed completely exhausted.

7. Sitting up, leaning forward or rocking constantly, relieves the chest affections, especially asthma.

8. Lastly, to conclude, quoted below is what Farrington states. “Sweat, backache and weakness as a combination are not found under any other remedy.

9. Mind : There is great aversion to being alone (Bismuth, Arsenic, Lycopodium. Stramonium—desires to be alone, Gels. Ignatia, Nat.mur., Nux vomica, Sepia). Alternating mood with irritability. Obstinate. Hypersensitive to pain. Anxiety arising from chest. Despondent and afraid of imaginary things.

10. Ailments from : Exposure to cold, over-strain, sexual excess, icecream and iced- water.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache from exposure to cold, riding in cold wind and sexual excess. Location: Usually in both the temples and occipital region. Sensation: Sensation of loose feeling in the head.

Character of headache: Stitching pain in temples and-oeciput, congested and heavy. Attack on one side at a time.

Modalities: Aggravation by riding in a carriage, sexual excess and lying on painful side. Relieved by warm application and by moving. Concomitants: Yawning during headache; nausea; great dryness of hair; hair falls out.

Eye

There is stitching pain in the eyes; lids stick together in the morning. BAG-LIKE SWEELING OF UPPER EYELIDS. Swelling of glabella. Weak sight from excessive sexual indulgence.

name: Kali Muriaticum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This is one of the organic tissue salts introduced by Schussler. This remedy has been proved by Central Council For Research in Homoeopathy, Govt. of India, but the symptomatology has not yet been included in any Materia Medica, Kali Mur. unites with albumen, forming fibrin, which is found in every tissue of the body except the bones. In other words this Salt is found in blood corpuscles muscles, nerve and brain cells as well as in the intercellular fluids. In its physiological character it is closely related to sodium chloride, many of the properties of which it shares.

Apthae, Bubo. Chilblains. Constipation. Cystitis, Dropsy. Dysentery. Ear-affections of. Eczema. Eyes affection of, Haemorrhoids. Hodgkin’s disease, Jaundice. Cracking of Joints. Leucorrhoea. Mumps. Rheumatism. Bad effects of vaccination, Warts. Diphtheria, Croup. Eustachian catarrh.

OF ACTION Kali Mur. acts on blood corpuscles, muscles, nerve & brain cells.

Kali Mur acts well in the second stage of inflammations of mucous membrane & serous membranes when the exudation is of a fibrinous character usually white in colour. It is also of great use in catarrhal affection & glandular swellings.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eyes : Discharge of white mucus from the eyes, or yellow, greenish matter and yellow purulent scabs. Superficial flat ulcer of the eye. Trachoma. Corneal opacities.

Ears : Chronic catarrhal conditions of the middle ear. Snapping and noises in the ear. Deafness from swelling of external ear, throat troubles. Great effusion about the auricle. Glands about the ear swollen. Threatended mastoid.

Nose : Catarrh. Phlegm white thick ; Vault of pharynx covered with adherent crusts. Nosebleed. Stuffy cold.

Mouth ; Aphthae thrush, white ulcers in mouth. Swollen glands about jaw & neck. Coating of tongue grayish white, dry or slimy.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This is one of the organic tissue salts introduced by Dr. Schussler. This medicine has been proved by several authorities from time to time but proving by provers’ union of Chicago under the direction of H. C. Allen is notable one. One of the greatest nerve remedies.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anaemia, Asthma, Brainfag, Cancrum Oris, Carbuncle, Chilblains, Dysentery, Enuresis, Gangrene, Hypo-chondriasis. Hysteria, Insomnia, Melancholia, Neurasthenia, Paralysis, Puerperal mania, Whitlow.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main action of this drug is on animal fluids & tissues, notably of the brain, nerves, muscles and blood-cells.

PATHOGENESIS

Kaliphos acts upon the brain & nerve cells upon the corpuscles of the blood affecting the nutrition, causing irritation followed by inflammation & lastly moderate degree of degeneration.

CONSTITUTION

Physical Make Up—Anaemic Chlorotic & delicate persons, worn out from long suffering.

Temperament—Nervous temperament Relation with head & cold—Chilly patient

Miasm—Psora.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Conditions arising from want of nerve power, neurasthenia, mental and physical depression are wonderfully improved by this remedy.

2) It corresponds to states of adynamia and decay, gangrenous conditions.

3) Great prostration runs through the remedy,

350

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Head

Vertigo from lying, on standing up, from sitting andwhen looking upward. Causation: Headache of students and those worn out by fatigue. Location: Occipital headache. Sensation: Head feels tired & dull. Back of head sore as if hair was pulled, Modalities: Headaches are relieved by gentle motion. Concomitant: Headache with weary, empty gone feeling at stomach.

Eyes

Weakness of sight, loss of perceptive power after diphtheria, from exhaustion. Sensation of sand or Sticks in eyes. Drooping of eyelids.

Ears

Deafness from want of nervous perception with weakness and exhaustion of the nerves. Discharges of foul, offensive ichorous pus from the ears. Humming and buzzing In the ears.

Gastrointestinal symptoms

Mouth : Stomatitis, breath offensive, fetid. Gums spongy and receding. Toothache with easily bleeding gums. Tongue coated brownish, like mustard. Excessively dry in the morning. Speech slow &

inarticulate. Grinding of teeth,

INTRODUCTION: This is one of the organic tissue salts introduced by Dr. Schussler. This medicine has been proved by several authorities from time to time but proving by provers’ union of Chicago under the direction of H. C. Allen is notable one. One of the greatest nerve remedies.
CLINICAL: Anaemia, Asthma, Brainfag, Cancrum Oris, Carbuncle, Chilblains, Dysentery, Enuresis, Gangrene, Hypo-chondriasis. Hysteria, Insomnia, Melancholia, Neurasthenia, Paralysis, Puerperal mania, Whitlow.
SPHERES OF ACTION: The main action of this drug is on animal fluids & tissues, notably of the brain, nerves, muscles and blood-cells.

PATHOGENESIS

Kaliphos acts upon the brain & nerve cells upon the corpuscles of the blood affecting the nutrition, causing irritation followed by inflammation & lastly moderate degree of degeneration.

CONSTITUTION

Physical Make Up—Anaemic Chlorotic & delicate persons, worn out from long suffering.

Temperament—Nervous temperament Relation with head & cold—Chilly patient

Miasm—Psora.
GUIDING SYMPTOMS: 1) Conditions arising from want of nerve power, neurasthenia, mental and physical depression are wonderfully improved by this remedy.

2) It corresponds to states of adynamia and decay, gangrenous conditions.

3) Great prostration runs through the remedy,

PARTICULARS: Head

Vertigo from lying, on standing up, from sitting andwhen looking upward. Causation: Headache of students and those worn out by fatigue. Location: Occipital headache. Sensation: Head feels tired & dull. Back of head sore as if hair was pulled, Modalities: Headaches are relieved by gentle motion. Concomitant: Headache with weary, empty gone feeling at stomach.

Eyes

Weakness of sight, loss of perceptive power after diphtheria, from exhaustion. Sensation of sand or Sticks in eyes. Drooping of eyelids.

name: Kali Sulphuricum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: One of the twelve tissue remedies introduced by Dr. Schussler. This drug is yet to be proved homeopathically. Symptoms available are from Schussler’s work as well as clinical sources. This drug is known as “Schussler’s Pulsatilla”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma. Catarrh. Dandruff. Eczema. Epithelioma. Itch. Polypus. Psoriasis. Rheumatism, whooping cough. Ch. Eustachian Catarrh.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its chief action is on epidermis, epithelium, muscles, nerves & blood corpuscles, PATHOGENESIS

The Oxygen taken up by the iron content in the blood corpuscles is carried to every cell of the organism by Kali Sulph, so the deficiency of Kali Sulph produces vertigo, chilliness, palpitation, fear, melancholy, desquamation of epidermis & yellow mucus

discharge.

PERTICULARS

Head :

Rheumatic headache beginning in evening. Bald spots. Dandruff and scaldhead. Worse in warm room and better in cool or open air.

Ears :

Eustachian deafness. Discharge of yellow matter. Pain under the ear, sharp cutting pain, tension. Stitches and piercing below the mastoid process.

Nose:

Colds with yellow, slimy expectoration. Nose obstructed. Smell lost. Engorgement of the nasal pharyngeal mucous membrane, mouth-breathing, snoring ete. remaining after adenoids.

name: Kalmia Latifolia
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It is one of the important remedies for rheumatism and especially adapted to people of rheumatic and gouty diathesis with tendency to metastasis. Dr. Hering and his friends proved this remedy for the first time and introduced it into homoeopathic practice.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Angina Pectoris, Gout. Heart—disease of, Reratitis, Neuralgia. Rheumatism. Vertigo. SPHERES OF ACTION AND PATHOGENESIS Kalmia has prominent action on heart, blood circulation, nerves, joints and skin.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Kalmia is adapted to rheumatic and gouty complaints esp. when heat is involved as a sequel of rheumatism or gout.

2) Pain : (a) sticking, darting, pressing, shooting in a downward direction. (b) Pain attended or succeeded by numbness of affected part.

3) Heart complaints developed from or alternate with rheumatism.

4) Rhuematism : Joints hot, red, swollen and painful ; shifting pain going from one joint to another suddenly.

5) Pulse slow, scarcely perceptible (35 to 40 per minute) pale face and cold extremitis.

6) Severe stitching pain in right eye and orbit ; pain worse when turning the eyes.

7) Vertigo when stooping or looking down (Spig.)

8) Ailments from : Chill, Exposure, wind, sun.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eyes

It is particularly useful in neuralgic and rheumatic pain in the eyes and eye balls. There is stiff drawing sensation when moving the eyes. Severe stitching pain in right eye and orbit with stiffness in muscle. Rheumatic iritis, scleritis with impairment of vision.

subsections.heading: Eyes
subsections.content: It is particularly useful in neuralgic and rheumatic pain in the eyes and eye balls. There is stiff drawing sensation when moving the eyes. Severe stitching pain in right eye and orbit with stiffness in muscle. Rheumatic iritis, scleritis with impairment of vision.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Kreosotum occupies the second position the TRIO OF OFFENSIVE DRUGS—first being Mercurius and the third, Baptisia. In Kreosote the characteristic odour is PUTRID. Being a member of the tar family, ACRIDITY is the second characteristic of the drug. PUTRIDITY AND ACRIDITY run through the whole drug. Kreosote is mainly a left sided medicine.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Abdominal and stomach troubles, Cough, Cancer, Carbuncle, Consumption, Constipation, Cholera, Dentition, Diarrhoea, Enuresis,

Haemorhage, Haemorrhoids, Hysteria, Leucorrhoea, Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Pregnancy troubles, Rheumatism, Teeth Caries, Toothache, Ulcers, Urine—incontinence

of, Vomiting, Whooping Cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Kreosote acts upon the lymphatic system and especially upon the mucus membrane of digestive system, female generative organs, the skin and teeth.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces tendency to disorganisation, ulceration and destruction of the parts involved such as teeth, skin, mucus membrane of digestive system, etc. Scorbutic gum comes under the pathogenetip action of this drug.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up: Especially suited to ladies having dark complexion.

Tall, slender, ill developed, overgrown, very tall for her age (Phos.).

Children are old looking, wrinkled, scrofulous with rapid emaciation and difficult dentition,

Temperament: Irritable temperament.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora and syphilis are in the background.

Diathesis: Haemorrhagic and scorbutic diathesis.

357

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. 2.

Haemorrhagic diathesis; small wounds bleed freely.

Offensiveness, acridity and putridity of all discharges from mucous membrane are the keynote symptoms of whole remedy.

Highly chilly Patient. All the symptoms are aggravated from cold and relieved b’y warmth in general.

Pulsation is felt all over the body (Lil. tig.).

For flow of blood from uterus and vagina consequent upon lifting, over-exertion or coitus, Kreosote Is infallible.

6. Putrid and acrid leucorrhoea is a striking feature of this remedy.

Decayed teeth and gum, with foetid, corrosive discharge calls for this remedy. Tooth begins to decay as soon as it comes out.

In cholera infantum with profuse vomiting, cadaverous smelling stool, Kreosote is efficacious.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Haemorrhaaic diathesis (Crot. nor., Ipecac, Lachesis, Phosphorus, Secale cor., China). Small wounds bleed profusely. Flow is passive in epistaxis, haematemesis, haemoptysis, haematuria and from uterus. Blood oozes out for weeks together.

Character of blood: Dark and very much offensive. There is haemorrhage after extraction of teeth (Ham., Bovista).

Nose

In epistaxis, offensive smell and discharges. Blood is acrid, offensive and coming out from the nose-

Mouth

Painful dentition. Teeth begin to decay as soon as they appear. Gums are bluish red, soft, spongy. dark oozing after extraction of teeth.

Stomach

Kresote is one of the good drugs of cancer of stomach, there is burning pain in the stomach soon after eating and sense of fulness with increasing nausea ending in vomiting which is sour, acrid, undigested and offensive.

After swallowing water, bitter taste is prolonged in the mouth for a long time.

In malignant diseases of stomach, where there \s vomiting of blood, sputa is very much offensive and covered with dark blood, if Kreosote is given, it will furnish some degree of palliation even in cancerous and other incurable diseases of the stomach.

Menses

It is well indicated and suited in MENORRHAGIA OR DYSMENORRHOEA. Time: Too early.

name: Lac Caninum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Lac caninum is an animal product, used as food of early animal life and, therefore, corresponds to the, beginning of our innermost physical nature. In crude and natural state, milk is a complete food, but when it is potentised it is an infallible remedy for many diseases, if symptoms correspond. Persons who dislike milk will become sick from taking it in. potentised form. It is one of the ‘Ladies Remedies’.

Breast affection, Backache, Female sexual , Headache, Menstrual disorders, Leucorrhoea, Neuralgia, Nose and Throat ion, Rheumatism, Sciatica, Stomach affection, Uterine troubles, Vaccinosis, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Lac caninum acts especially upon the mucous membrane, female uro-genital system, uterus, cervix, throat and mind.

In the throat it produces an inflammation, particularly of the left side; of course, it extends to right side, but again settles back to the left. It inflames and congests the ovaries and uterus.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Alteration of sides is a great characteristic of this remedy e.g., in diphtheria, rheumatism, pain and even eczema.

2. Erratic disposition of symptoms such as pain constantly flying from one part to another which is yet another striking feature of Lac can.

3. Hyperaesthesia of skin and all parts is another keynote symptoms of Lac can., e.g. during,diphtheria and tonsillitis throat becomes exceedingly sensitive to touch (Lach).

4. Chronic blue condition, everything seems dark.

5. SHINING, GLAZED APPEARANCE OF THROAT during diphtheria, chancres in syphilis and ulcers having glistening look reminds of this remedy,

8. Breasts and throat get sore at menstrual period. They cannot bear jar; must hold

them firmly when stepping up or going downstaris. Eee

361

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Location: Mostly frontal headache, but it has also hot occipital headache; above the eyes, especially of the left side.

Sensation: Sensation as if the brain were alternately contracted and relaxed.

Character of pain: Shifting pain, constantly flying from one part to another; changing from side to side; every few hours or days; pain during the day, first on left side and then on other side.

* Aggravation: From turning the eyeball upwards and using the eyes for fine work, touch or noise.

* Amelioration: By going into open air.

Nose

Coryza with discharge of thick, white mucus. One nostril stuffed up and the other free and The condition alternates one after another. The character of discharge is bloody, pus like, very much acrid and causes rawness of lip and nose.

Throat

Location: In diphtheria or tonsillitis, symptoms shift from one side to the other and again go to the original side, and this condition alternates.

Sensation: Of lump in throat with constant desire to swallow.

Look of the throat: Shining, glazed appearance of the diphtheritic deposits with yellow and white patches.

Character of pain: Throat is very much sensitive to touch both internally and externally.

name: Lac Defloratum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This remedy owes its origin to Dr. Swan who in his turn got the idea of potentising skimmed milk upon reading “Donkin’s Skimmed Milk Treatment of Diab-etes and Bright’s Disease”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Constipation. Dropsy. Diabetes. Headache. Vomiting. Globus hystericus. Menses suppressed. Obesity. Lactation defective.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up—pale, sickly, anaemic look, wornout, wasted persons with sallow complexion. Relation with heat & cold: Chilly patient. The patient is chilly all the time even in warm room, near fire. Miasm : Psora and syphilis in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Great prostration is felt whether she does anything or not, great fatigue when walking.

2) It is one of the top most medicines for sick headache.

3) Constipation : Stool large, hard, painful, extorting cries.

4) Aversion to milk.

5) “Milk sickness”—It is most useful and frequently needed remedy for those who cannot take milk, who suffer from various complaints like disordered stomach, headache etc.

6) It is used in cases of defecient milk secretion in young mothers, (to dry up milk- Asaf., Lac Can.)

7) Menses : Delayed or suppressed by putting hands in cold water, drinking a glass of milk will promptly suppress flow until next period.

8) Great restlessness, extreme and protracted suffering from loss of sleep (Coc., Nit. Ac.)

9) Globus hystericus : Sensation of a large ball rising from stomach to throat, causing 8ense of suffocation (Asaf., Kal.)

i

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Milk, loss of sleep. Location : Begins in forehead extending to occiput (Bry., Nux V., Sepia, Tuber.).

Sensation : As if head would burst. There is also a sensation as if top of head was lifted off and brain was coming out.

Character of pain : The pain is most excruciating and unbearable. Intense throbbing pain in forehead.

Modalities : Aggravation—in morning on rising, noise, light, motion, during menses, conversation. periodically (every 8 days).

Amelioration : Pressure, tight bandaging, profuse urination, cold application.

Concomitant : Headache in anaemic, chilly patients who have tendency to constipation. Headache

associated with intense photophobia, great postration, nausea and vomiting and blindness. Headache alternating with tonsillitis (Clarke).

Constipation : It is needed in inveterate, intensely chronic cases where the most powerful purgative fails. It is usually associated with periodical headache and vomiting. The feaeces are dry hard ain large and they lacerate anus extorting cries with ineffectual urging. Dropsy : It has been used in dropsy from organic heart disease or weak heart, from chronic liver complaint, far advanced albuminuna also from suppressed malaria.

Relations

Compare : Nat. Mur.

6) It is used in cases of defecient milk secretion in young mothers, (to dry up milk- Asaf., Lac Can.)

7) Menses : Delayed or suppressed by putting hands in cold water, drinking a glass of milk will promptly suppress flow until next period.

8) Great restlessness, extreme and protracted suffering from loss of sleep (Coc., Nit. Ac.)

9) Globus hystericus : Sensation of a large ball rising from stomach to throat, causing 8ense of suffocation (Asaf., Kal.)

i
PARTICULARS: Headache

Causation : Milk, loss of sleep. Location : Begins in forehead extending to occiput (Bry., Nux V., Sepia, Tuber.).

Sensation : As if head would burst. There is also a sensation as if top of head was lifted off and brain was coming out.

Character of pain : The pain is most excruciating and unbearable. Intense throbbing pain in forehead.

Modalities : Aggravation—in morning on rising, noise, light, motion, during menses, conversation. periodically (every 8 days).

Amelioration : Pressure, tight bandaging, profuse urination, cold application.

Concomitant : Headache in anaemic, chilly patients who have tendency to constipation. Headache

associated with intense photophobia, great postration, nausea and vomiting and blindness. Headache alternating with tonsillitis (Clarke).

Constipation : It is needed in inveterate, intensely chronic cases where the most powerful purgative fails. It is usually associated with periodical headache and vomiting. The feaeces are dry hard ain large and they lacerate anus extorting cries with ineffectual urging. Dropsy : It has been used in dropsy from organic heart disease or weak heart, from chronic liver complaint, far advanced albuminuna also from suppressed malaria.

Relations

Compare : Nat. Mur.

name: Lachesis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Of all the remedies derived from snake poison, Lachesis predominantly leads and serves as the most, valuable one. The curative power of this virulent venom of Surukuku Snake of South America, was quite unknown untill Dr, Constantine Hering had potentised and proved it first on himself, to be of immense benefits for millions. The idea GREATER THE POISON, GREATER THE REMEDY eventually struck him, resulting in his greatest contribution to generations of patients suffering from many desperate diseases, especially at, during and after climacteric age for those who have been changed both mentally and physically and are thin and emaciated rather than

fleshy.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Alcoholism, Apoplexy, Asthma, Boils, Carbuncles, Change of life, Cough, Diphtheria, Epilepsy, Enteric fever, Flatulence, Gangrene, Haemorrhage, Haemorrhoids, Heart affection, Headache, Jaundice, Laryngitis, Liver affection, Mental disorders, Malignant pustules, Neuralgia, Pneumonia, Puerperal fever and convulsion, Purpura, Pyaemia, Quinsy, Skin affections, Throat and lung affections, Ulcers, Varicose veins, Vertigo, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Being a constitutional DEEP AND LONG ACTING POLYCHREST REMEDY, Lachesis has great affinity for almost any and every organ in the body. However, its action are more manifest on the nervous system, mind, cardio-vascular system, skin and mucous membrane, respiratory organs, heart, kidney.female genital organs, etc.

PATHOGENESIS

Like any other poison, Lachesis disorganises and decomposes the blood, making it More fluid and non-coaguable, resulting in haemorrhage, asthenic and malignant inflammation, ecchymosis, gangrene, abscess, pyaemia, general typhoid condition and jaundice. It irritates peripheral nerve, setting in hypersensitiveness. While its action on Pneumogastric nerve causes irritation of throat, larynx, bronchus and heart, it poisons the nerve centres, producing profound prostration, convulsion and unconsciousness implicating the functional integrity of brain.

367

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Lachesis is predominantly A LEFT SIDED REMEDY. All complaints commence on the left side and go to right excepting the lower limbs.

2. All symptoms are worse during and after sleep. Lachesis “sleeps into aggravation and aggravation from sleep”. Because of increased sufferings such as suffocation, pain, etc, the patient is terribly afraid to go to sleep in spite of the fact that sleep is really needed.

3. Great sensitivenesss to touch, all over, especially throat, abdomen, ete. Even cannot bear clothes to touch which cause uneasiness and produce nervousness. There is great intolerence of tight clothings. Wants everything loose (Apis).

4. Most of the complaints ARE RELIEVED BY MENSTRUAL FLOW (Zinc).

5. Climactric ailments, “Have never been well since that time” says Lachesis patient referring to menopausal period.

6. Burning all over the body: HOT FLUSHES AND HOT PERSPIRATION, hot haemorrhages; burning on vertex, ete.

7. Blueness and purple colour in every trouble amply singles out Lachcesis—blue and purple face inflamed spot is purple, skin is blue, ulcers are blue, etc.,

8. A sense of constriction and tight feeling everywhere-—heart, throat, etc. 9. Sensation of a ball in the inside or organs, especially urinary bladder.

10. Great desire for fanning, but slowly and from a distance (Med.—rapidly and from near, Carbo. veg).

11. Great physical and mental exhaustion, trembling in whole body.

12. Trembling tongue: Difficult to protrude. Trembles like that of a snake. Tongue is black.

13. Desire for wine, liquors, coffee, Aversion to food, acids and drinks.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Headache in drunkards with high bleod pressure.

Location: Left sided headache, tendency to go to right.

Sensation: As if all the blood has gone towards the head.

Character of headache: Congestive type of headache as if skull would burst.

Character of pain: There is pressing and bursting pain In temples. The head Is very much sensitive to touch.

Modalitiy: Aggravation from motion, pressure, after sleep. Amelioration by menstrual flow (Zincum

met., Allium cepa).

Throat

Lachesis is especially indicated In tonsiliitis and diphtheria.

Location: Begins on the left side and extends to the right.

name: Ledum Palustre
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Ledum is one of the frequently used medicines for injury, skin affections, rheumatic and gouty complaints. It is a remedy gifted by the vegetable kingdom; particularly so from a wild plant which normally has no utility. But Hahnemann found its usefulness in a number of ailments after potentisation.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Ascites, Asthma, Bruises, Gout, Injury, Rheumatism, Skin affection, Wounds, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its seat of action is mainly on skin, serous and mucous membranes, fibrous tissues, circulatory system and joints.

The action of Ledum on skin retards capillary circulation, especially on the external surface of the body and the extremities, resulting in coldness of the surface afed due to its affections on the fibrous tissues and joints, joints are enlatged and become the seats of nodosities and “gout-stones”.

CONSTITUTION

Since it is more or less an acute drug, consideration of constitution is not of much importance. However, Ledum patient is very chilly, with psoric and syphilitic background having rheumatic diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. There is general lack of animal heat; yet heat of bed is intolerable. The patient is unnaturally cold.

2. Complaints of people who are cold all the time; cold to touch but not cold subjectively to patient.

3. In spite of coldness of the body, the symptoms are relieved by cold application (like Secale cor., Rev. of Arsenic).

4. Relief from cold, is so prominent that sometimes the only amelioration is obtained by putting the feet into ice-cold water,

372

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eye

Haemorrhage into interior chamber of eyes after iridectomy (Amica, Ruta). Cataracts with gout.

Face

Red pimples on forehead and cheeks, stinging when touched, crusty eruption around nose and mouth.

Injury

Causation: Punctured wounds, by sharp pointed instruments, as awls, nails, rat bites, mosquito bites or blows.

Location: Punctured wounds anywhere on the body. Haemorrhage into anterior chamber of eyes after iridectomy (Amica, Ruta), Contusions of eyes and lids, especially if much extravasation of blood,

Causing ecchymosis of lids and conjunctiva. Sensation: Pain es if the whole body is bruised and beaten.

Character: Pain in ankles as if sprained or from false step. Pains are of sticking, tearing and throbbing type.

Modalities ; Aggravated by motion and at night, by warmth of bed and covering. Amelioration by applying ice-cold water,

Concomitants : Long remaining discolouration after Injury. Black and blue places become green. Emaciation of affected part (Graphites). Parts are very cold to touch but not cold subjectively to Patient.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Tiger lily is a powerful poison, therefore, a Tee a ty, good medicine, says Dr. Tyler. It is a precious * ate remedy for most distressing conditions. Well |[itw! proved and of very definite and distingusihing symptoms, yet not sufficently used and understood is Tiger lily. Unfortunately, this important female remedy is unknown to old school practitioners. It is a drug of such vehement action as to be safe and useful only in the hands of those who have leamt from Hahnemann how to prepare and prescribe such a remedy.

There are a few intellectual persons possessing poetic faculties, who can better grasp and remember things when presented in rhyme, and for them appended below is a Tiger lily rhyme;—

Tiger lily hurries about,

Feels, her insides being all dragged out, Frequent urging to micturition,

Almost approaching a Cantharis condition, Rectal distress a band,

Constricting the heart (just like Cactus grand.), Pulsatilla-like tears, her salvation’s a worry, With silver nitrate, she’s “duties” and hurry.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Angina pectoris, Constipation, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Eye affection, Heart troubles, Hysteria, Menstrual disorders, Ovarian and Uterine affections, Pruritus vulvae, Urinary troubles, Prolapse of uterus, Uterus displacement of, Sub-involution, ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Acts especially on pelvic organs; such as uterus, fallopian tubes, ovaries, brain, the vessel walls and the heart.

PATHOGENESIS

The drug can produce various types of pathological states of the pelvic organs in 8eneral and female genital organs in particular. The various clinical symptomatology are

ee

375

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
L

Affects principally left side of the body (Thuja, Lach., Lac can., Berberis vulgaris, Colocynth)

. Hot Patient: Wants cold air, open air and cool room (Puls., Sabina, Nat. mur.)., . Bearing down sensation, dragging sensation in abdomen and pelvis as if all the

organs would escape (Murex, Sepia, Bell.),

. Consolation from others aggravates the sufferings (Nat. mur., Ign., Silicea, Sepia,

Halleborus.,—Consolation relieves, Pulsatilla).

. Frequent urging to urinate. . Shifting pain; pain flying from one part to another. . Pulsation all over the body (Kreosote) and full, distended feeling as if blood would

burst through the vessels.

. Sensation as if the heart was grasped in a vise (Cactus) as if blood had all gone to

heart; feels full to bursting, inability to walk erect. Clasped and unclasped feeling in heart as if by an iron hand. Rapid heart-beat, 150 to 170 per minute.

. Mind : It produces various types of mental symptoms which are as follows: -

Weeping disposition; can hardly avoid weeping (Puls., Sepia, Med.); very much timid and fearful.

There is profound depression of spirit; patient is quite indifferent about what is being done for her.

Consolation aggravates the complaints.

Furthermore, there is great irritability of mind. She can hardly speak a decent word to anybody. She will snap even when spoken kindly to. She is so irritable that her friends cannot pacify her.

There is great fear of being alone, about her diseases as if she is incurable, fear of organic disease of heart and insanity etc.

The patient is very much hurried and worried; desires to do something in a hurried manner; there is aimless hurried motion. There is an irresistible desire to curse and swear (Anac, Lac can., Nit.ac.).

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Uterine symptoms, Prolapse :

There is weakness and atonic condition of pelvic tissues, uterus and ovaries resulting in anteversion, retroversion, subinvolution from paralytic condition. There is GREAT BEARING DOWN SENSATION, dragging sensation in abdomen and pelvis as if all the organs would escape (Lac can., Sepia, Murex, Bell.): relieved by supporting the vulva with hands,

Here it differs from SEPIA. Both have got bearing down sensation and intolerance of sympathy. Both support the vulva during prolapse, but Lilium tig. feels heat more abd Sepia feels cold more. Sepia is INDIFFERENT AND APATHETIC whereas Lilium is always hurried and worried. Tiger lily craves meat while Sepia has got aversion to meat. Sepia has no sexual desire. Tiger lily has great sexual desire. nevertheless, in order to suppress the sexual desire, she keeps herself busy.

Menses

Time: Too early. Quantity: Scanty. Character of blood: Very much dark and offensive. Character of flow: Flow only when moving about. Flow ceases when she stops walking.

Character of pain: Shifting pain in small spots that can be covered with the tip of a finger (Kali bich., Ign.).

Concomitants: Bearing down sensation, dragging sensation in abdomen and pelvis as if all the organs would escape; relieved by supporting the vulva with hands,

Constipation

Causation: Inactivity of rectum.

During stool: There is great tenesmus in rectum with MUCH URGING. Sits for a long time in the closet to pass stool. Although there is great urging and greatstraining, no stool or little stool passes out. Along with frequent urging to stool, there is sensation of a ball in the rectum. Due to retrovefsion of uterus, there is sensation as if the rectum were full of faeces, which brings on repeated urging to stool and the patient sits and only strains but no stool passes out.

With desrie for stool and bearing down sensation in abdomen, there |s great pressure in recturn.

name: Lithium Carbonicum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Dr. Constantine Hering introduced and made the first provings of Lithium Carb.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Eyes-affection of. Gastralgia. Headache. Heart-affection of. Prostatitis. Gout. Rheumatism.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Uric-acid diathesis.

2) “Soreness” is the one of the great characteristics of Lith. Carb. Like Arnica, bones, joints, muscles whole body sore as if beaten.

3) Rheumatic & Gouty symptoms: Lithium Garb, has Rheumatic and gouty diathesis. This is an invaluable; remedy in chronic rheumatism when accompained with heart or eye symptoms and recurring attacks of acute inflammation of the small joints. author: Dubey
