sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Other names for this plant are Asthma root and Indian tobacco. Taken in big quantity, it produces intense nausea, vomiting, profuse salivation and great prost-ration. These are the key notes of this drug.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Alcoholism. Asthma. Cough. Dyspepsia. Dyspnoea. Emphysema. Gastralgia. Heart com-plaints. Headache. Morning sickness.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its action is centered on pneumogastric nerve, respiratory organs, epigastrium, heart etc.

PATHOGENESIS

As it is a vasomotor stimulant it increases activities of all vegetative processes, acting on pneumogastric nerve. It produces a depressed relaxed condition with oppression of eldest and epigastrium, impeded respiration, nausea and vomiting. CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up—It is especially suited to persons of light hair, blue eyes, fair complexion and persons inclined to be freshy.

Relation with heat & cold—Chilly patient. Miasm—Psoric & Syphilitic in the back ground.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Extreme nausea, vomiting, profuse salivation, sweating and marked prostration are the indications in many com-plaints.

2) Faintness, weakness and indescribable feeling at epigas-trium.

3) Sensation of pressure or weight in chest or congestion as if blood from extremeties was filling it, relieved by rapid walking.

4) Sensation as if heart would stand still. There is deep seated pain at the base of heart.

5) Extreme sensitiveness of sacrum, patient cannot bear slightest touch even of a soft pillow.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Headache of gastric origin, from tobacco, tea, alcohol etc. We think of this medicine particularly in periodical headache that comes on in afternoon and continues till midnight. Nausea, vomiting, and great prostration, profuse salivation, sweating, faintness and weak feeling in epigastrium are the accompanying symptoms.

Modalities : Aggravation : Afternoon until midnight. Tobacco or tobacco smoke.

Gastro-intestinal tract:

Mouth: Semilateral coating of tongue is a peculiar symptom. Copious secretion of saliva, acrid, burning or mercurial taste in mouth.

Stomach : Should be thought of in all diseases which are attended with extreme nausea and vomiting with faint, weak and an indescribable feeling at epigastrium with cold sweating and marked prostration such as, gastralgia, dyspepsia, asthma, pertusis etc. There is acidity, flatulence, shortness of breath after eating. Hiccough and heart-burn with profuse flow of saliva and good appetite. Patient cannot bear smell or taste of tobacco. (Ign., Sep.) It is often indicated in vomiting and morning sickness during pregnancy. Chronic cases of vomiting with good appetite with nausea, profuse sweat and marked prostration.

Modalities - Worse tobacco, afternoon, Better towards evening, warmth.

Respiratory system

It is an excellent remedy in asthma. Dyspnoea due to constriction of middle of chest with sensation of pressure or weight in chest which is relieved by rapid walking. Patient feels as if heart would stop. Feeling of a peculiar pricking sensation all over the body precedes an attack of asthma.

Modalities : Aggravation with every labour pain, exposure to cold, slightest exertion, going up or down stairs.

Amelioration : Walking rapidly anetfrom warmth.

Relations

Compare : Ant.t., Ars., Ipec., Tab., Ver.

N.B. : For the bad effects of drunkenness In people with light hair, blue or grey eyes, florid complexion; corpulent. Lobelia bears the same relation that Nux Vomica does to persons of the opposite temperment.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
According to Darwin’s Theory of evolution, moss was the first plant in the vegetable kingdom to take shape in the world. Ordinarily, moss has got very little or no value; on the other hand, occasionally it proves to be a nuisance to farmer. The fact is that it possesses immense inherent curative power in latent and dormant state in its crude form, for, people in extremes of life, could only be found out by the deep penetrating intelligence of Hahnemann. When this power is dynamically aroused, it finds its respectable place in the hands of every Homoeopath, bringing in immense relief to thousands of suffering people.

Lycopodium is a wonderful CONSTITUTIONAL, DEEP ACTING REMEDY FOR DEEP SEATED, PROGRESSIVE CHRONIC DISEASES. It is nicknamed as “Vegetable Sulphur’.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdomen distended, Aneurysm, Asthma, Bililousness, Cancer, Constipation, Consumption, Cough, Colic, Diphtheria, Dysentery, Dyspepsia, Eczema, Flatulence, Gall- stone, Gout, Headache, Heartburn, Hernia, Hysteria, Impotency, Liver affection, Locomotor ataxy, Lung affection, Male and female pexual orgns, Menstrual disorders, Physometra, Pneumonia, Renal colic, Rheumatism, Stomach disorders, Throat affection, Typhoid fever, Urinary troubles, Whooping cough, Worms, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts powerfully upon the vegetative system specially upon the mucous membrane of respiratory tract, dfgestfae system, genito-urinary tract, kidney etc. It shows its most important: local action upon the liver and digestive tract.

_ It depresses the vegetative system causing slowly, advancing weaknes and decay of tissues, Acting upon the genito-urinary tract and kidney, it produces lithic and uric acid, diathesis. On the liver and digestive system, it disturbs the digestion and produces

constipation. The lymphatic system becomes weak and thereby their glands are swollen and indurated, especially of the neck.

—_—

. Acidity, wind and bloating of abdomen, especially the lower abdomen.

Red sand in urine. Child cries before urinating.

name: Lyssin
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Deep acting constitutional medicine. Polychrest remedy. (An analogue of many animal poisons especially Lachesis & Vipera).

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Convulsions. Diarrhoea. Dysentery. Headache. Hydrophobia. Leucorrhoea. Lysophobia. Mania. Paralysis. Prolapse Satyriasis. Throat complaints. Urinary complaints. Wounds and Ulcers.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content: It affects principally the nervous system, then oesophagus, female genitalia etc.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) The sight or sound of running water or pouring water, even thinking of it

aggravates all complaints.

2) Cannot bear heat of sun (Gels., Glon., Lach., Nat.Mur)

3) Excessive sensitiveness to external stimuli like sound, noises, air, running water,

light etc.

4) Profuse salivation—Saliva is tough, ropy, viscid, frothy with constant spitting.

5) Hypersensitiyeness to smell (esp.of tobacco) taste, touch.

6) Dysphagia, even spasm of oesophagus from swallowing liquids.

7) Craving for salt and aversion to fat food.

8) Ravenous hunger or anorexia.

9) Complete absence of thirst or great thirst for cold water but unable to drink.

10) Frequent desire to urinate on seeing running water (Cantharis. Sulphur).

11) Complaints resulting from abnormal sexual desire, (from abstinence, Conium.)

12) Long lasting prolapse of uterus, rectum or any organ.

13) Sleep—Persistent insomnia is another characteristic of Lyssin.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

It is usually needed in chronic headache from bites of dog or from mental emotion of exertion. Location : There is violent headache from temple to temple, also frontal. Sensation : Pain as if head would burst.

Character of pain : Maddening, outward pressing pain in forehead; patient presses his head against the wall, beating and throbbing pain with peculiar lightness of head.

Modalities : Aggravation on seeing water, during day, from writing. Amelioration from cold air.

Concomitant : Headache with dizziness, nausea, and backache. It may alternate with hot flushes in face.

Convulsions

From dazzling or reflected light from water or mirror (Stram.); from even thinking of fluids of any kind; from slightest touch or current of air,

Throat

Sore throat, constant desire to swallow (Lac.Can., Merc.) Difficulty in swallowing ; even spasm of

oesophagus from swallowing liquids; gagging when swallowing water. Saliva is tough, ropy, viscid, frothy in mouth and throat with constant spitting. (Hydr.)

Lascivious; priapism, with frequent emissions. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire. Atrophy of testicles. No emission during coition.

Female

Sensitivenes of vagina, rendering coition painful. Conscious of womb.

name: Magnesia Carbonica
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Magnesia carbonica was used in ancient days in the form of Gregory's Powder, other constituents being Rhubarb and Ginger. This powder was used, to sweeten the stomach; hence occupied a position of much repute in the Allopathic Nursery. The properties of Mag. carb., from the old school’s stand point are summed up as “Laxative, antacid and antilithic’. In Homoeopathy we use it with great advantage for complaints arising in people who have been taking the drug to “sweeten the stomach”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acidity, Catarrh, Constipation, Cough, Diarrhoea, Dyspepsia, Flatulence, Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Pregnancy—nausea of, Toothache, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts especially on the gastro-intestinal system, liver and also female genital organs. It also has got action over the nerve, especially the facial and dental nerves. PATHOGENESIS

It produces gastro-intestinal catarrh with marked hyper acidity and sour diarrhoea. It also causes nervous exhaustion and sleeplessness. CONSTITUTION

Physical make up: It is especially suited to women having broken down or worn-out constitution with uterine and climacteric disorders and with lax fibres and sour smell of the whole body.

Temperament: Nervous temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Very much sensitive to cold air. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Aggravation of all the symptoms, especially pains from rest and relieved by walking about.

INTRODUCTION: Magnesia carbonica was used in ancient days in the form of Gregory's Powder, other constituents being Rhubarb and Ginger. This powder was used, to sweeten the stomach; hence occupied a position of much repute in the Allopathic Nursery. The properties of Mag. carb., from the old school’s stand point are summed up as “Laxative, antacid and antilithic’. In Homoeopathy we use it with great advantage for complaints arising in people who have been taking the drug to “sweeten the stomach”.
CLINICAL: Acidity, Catarrh, Constipation, Cough, Diarrhoea, Dyspepsia, Flatulence, Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Pregnancy—nausea of, Toothache, etc.
SPHERES OF ACTION: It acts especially on the gastro-intestinal system, liver and also female genital organs. It also has got action over the nerve, especially the facial and dental nerves. PATHOGENESIS

Physical make up: It is especially suited to women having broken down or worn-out constitution with uterine and climacteric disorders and with lax fibres and sour smell of the whole body.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Magnesia Muriatica is the most neglected liver remedy in our Materia Medica. It is particularly a woman’s remedy who suffers from hysterical complaints with uterine diseases and indigestion.

Cardiailgia, Constipation, Dyspepsia. Diarrhoea, Dysmenorrhoea, Headache. Hysteria. Leucorrhoea. Liver complaints. Toothache.

SPHERE OF ACTION

Gastro intestinal tract, liver, nerves, uterus, heart, urinary bladder.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up—It is especially suited to hysterical nervous women who suffer from hepatic and uterine disorders. Puny, rachitic children during dentition, Relation

with heat & cold—chilly patient. Miasm—Psora.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Patient, though chilly, desires fresh open air which relieves.

2) Great sensitivenes to noise (Phos., Theridion., Nux Vom.)

3) Affections of the right side with liver affections.

4) Stool dry, knotty, difficult to evacuate, like sheep dung crumbling at verge of

anus (Ammon Mur., Nat.Mur.)

5) Great tendency to head-sweat. (Cale. Sil., Sani.)

6) Pressing pain in enlarged liver, pain radiates to spine. Aggravation by lying on

right side, better by hard pres-sure.

7) Profuse dark pitch like menses with cramps, backache, pain in thighs and

indigestion.

8) Leucorrhoea after every stool, two weeks after menses,

9) Craving for sugar.

10) Intolerance of milk.

11) Aggravation while sitting.

12) Palpitation relieved by motion or lying on left side.

394

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
—— : Time : Every six weeks.

Location : Forehead and around the eyes.

Sensation : As if it would burst.

Character of headache : Congestive headache at menstrual period in hysterical women. Modalities : Aggravation—from motion, in open air.

Amelioration : From lying down, strong pressure, wrapping up warmly.

Gastrointestinal Symptoms

Mouth : Blisters on lips. A coated large flabby yellow tongue. Tongue feels burnt. Swollen and easily bleeding gums. Toothache unbearable when food touches the teeth.

Stomach : Appetite poor, bad taste in mouth. Eructations like rotten eggs. Continued rising-of white froth into mouth. Cannot digest milk, it causes pain in stomach and passes undigested. Complaints aggravated from salty food & sea bathing.

Liver: Chronic liver complaints with tenderness and pressing pain extending to-spine and epigastrium. Enlarged, sore mvt with flatulence.

Aggravation : Lying on right side, after food.

Amelioration ; By hard pressure.

Constipation : It is mostly indicated in obstinate constipation and of infants during dentition. The

characteristic stool is hard, knotty, scanty, passes with difficulty with crumbling at verge of anus. After stools rectum feels sore & painful. Constipation at sea (Bry., Platina.)

Menses : The flow is black and clotted. Profuse at night, in bed causing hysterical symptoms. The Menstrual pain is generally relieved by having back pressed. There is great excitement at every period, and pains in the back while walking and in the thighs when sitting. Eruptions on face and forehead worse before menses.

Leucorrhoea : After exertion, after every stool, or following uterine spasm. It may be followed by Metrorrhagia. Leucorrhoea two weeks after menses for three or four days.

General modalities

Aggravation—Lying on right side, sea bathing, immediately after eating. Amelioration—From pressure, motion, open air (except headache).

Relations

Antidotes : Cham. Camph. Compare : Chamomilla in diseases of children.

name: Magnesium
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Phosphate of magnesium is one of the most important of the twelve tissue remedies. It is a precious gem derived from biochemical studies of Dr. Schuessler the father of Twelve Tissue Remedies. This salt is one of the important constituents of various cells in our body, especially blood corpuscles, muscles, brain, spinal marrow and various other tissues. Disturbance of its molecules results in pain, cramps and

paralysis. In Homoeopathy it was MASTER HAHNEMANN who first used it in the treatment

of dysmenorrhoea. He remarked that “Mag. phos.” is one of the greatest, if not the greatest of the remedies for dysmenorrhoea, but only one of its own kind. N.M. CHOUDHURY also says that a careful study of Mag. phos. will convince every student of Homoeopathy, the utter need of discrimination, careful cool judgment and a constant burning of incense before the Goddess of Materia Medica.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Colic, Convulsion, Cough, Dentition, Headache, Intercostal neuralgia, Locomotor ataxia, Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Toothache, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Especially it acts upon brain, nerves, muscles, intestine and uterus.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces neuralgic pain in the head, teeth, etc. which is sharp, cutting, lightning like, shooting and almost unbearable. It also produces spasmodic pain, especially in the abdomen.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up: Mag. phos. is especially adapted to the affection of thin, emaciated persons of a highly nervous organisation and of dark complexion. Jt affects, right side of the body. Hering says that it is suited to young and very strong persons and teething children.

Temperament: Nervous temperament. Relation with heat and cold; Chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It affects the right side of the body, generally head, ear, face, chest, ovary, sciatic nerve (Chel., Lyco., Ciusticum, Kali carb., Bry., Merc. sol.). 9. Great desire of cold air, of uncovering, of touching the affected part, of cold, of bathing or washing.

3. Colicky pain in abdomen forcing the patient to bend double, RELIEVED BY HEAT AND WARMTH. RUBBING AND HARD PRESSURE (colocynth).

4. It is the best medicine for all sorts of pain, especially CRAMPING. SHOOTING LIKE A LIGHTNING. Pains are sharp, cutting, stabbing, stitching, lightning like coming and going rapidly. The pain rapidly changes from place to place. It is RELIEVED BY HEAT, WARMTH AND BY PRESSURE but aggravated by COLD IN GENERAL, from motion and in open air.

During menses, pain is relieved when flow begins (Lach., Zincum met.).

_ All the symptoms are worse from 4-9 p.m. (Colocynth).

. Enuresis after catheterization.

. Ailments from : Standing in cold water or working.with cold clay; dentition, cold winds, cold water, catheterization.

name: Medorrhinum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Medorrhinum is one of the greatest constitutional remedies contributed _ by Hahnemann to Materia Medica. Although Thuja claims to be the king of anti-sycotic remedies, in actual effect, Medorrhinum ranks PARI PASSU with the “KING” and merits the consideration of having an equally wide range of action as that of Thuja. Having been derived from the Gonorrhoeal cocci, it has been found most efficacious in eradicating any and _ every complaint, by whatever name they are called, brought on and consequent upon Gonorrhoea. The dormant curative power of the same contagious principle has been utilised, through potentisation, for complete annihilation of all diseases and manifestations produced by gonococcus itself. Master Hahnemann found’ in the Gonorrhoeal cocci the immense.curative value of not only all diseases of sycotic origin, but also diseases caused by psora and syphilis. MEDORRHINUM bears the same relation to deep seated sycotic chronic affections of spinal cord and the sympathetic nervous system as PSORINUM does to deep seated chronic affections of skin and mucous membrane and SYPHILINUM to all syphilitic affections.

Abdominal disorders, Asthma, Cough, Diabetes, Epilepsy, Eye affection, Gonorrhoea suppressed, Headache, Liver affection, Mental disorders, Nocturnal enufesis, Paralysis, Rheumatism, Throat and Lung affections, Urinary troubles, Tumours, Warts, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Medorrhinum predominantly affects the nervous system, brain, spinal cord and its meninges, mind, lymphatics, skin and mucous membane, joints, cardio-vascular and respiratory system, gastro intestinal tract, female genital organs, urinary and sexual organs, all troubles which can be traced to a sycotic origin.

PATHOGENESIS Medorrhinum affects:

(a) The brain and spinal cord, producing paralysis, trembling and tidgety feeling with loss of memory.

(b) Cardio-vascular and respiratory systems resulting in dyspnoea, pain and cough.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Sensation: Head feels very heavy and is drawn backward. Sensation of tightness and constriction, extending down the spine; weight and pressure on vertex.

Character of pain: There is intense burning pain in the brain which extends down the spine. Modality: Headache aggravated from jarring of cars, exhaustion or hard work.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Melilotus was first proved by Bowen in ay Man hi fie ost

1851. A second proving was made by him |—R% Ny Ait NY bys fifteen years later. It has been re-proved by Dr. fi Slt i) 2 H.C.Allen,

In common language it is called as ‘Buck- bean’ or Bog—Bean ‘as it grows in boggy places. It is a water plant and abounds in few districts, where it is in great local repute, as a remedy for ague. It was introduced into homoeopathy by Hahnemann, who proved it on himself.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Congestion, constipation, convulsions, eclampsia, epilepsy, epistaxis, haemorrhages, headache, melancholia.

Headache. Heart pains. Intermittent fever. Gastric affections. Nerve—disorders.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Congestions, relieved by haemorrhage.

2) Headache : Violent congestive or nervous headaches. Location : Frontal Headache intense in left supra orbital region.

Sensation : Sensation of tension and wave like movement in brain with vertigo and nausea.

Character : Violent, congestive, periodical, nervous headaches, every week or every four weeks. Modality—Aggravation—By motion, by thinking. Amelioration—By lying down, by profuse urination, by epistaxis, by menstruation. Concomitant— Retching, vomiting, cold hands and feet.

3) Epistaxis preceded by intense redness, flushing of face and throbbing of carotids with general relief.

4) Very red face precedes haemorrhage from every organ.

name: Mercurius Corrosivus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Merc. cor. is a very small drug, but its action is very remarkable in a few diseases. The key- note which runs through the whole drug is GREAT TENESMUS, either in the rectum or urinary bladder, or in both.

It was proved by our Master Hahnemann with the help of physio-chemical process, by mixing one part of mercury and two parts of chlorine.

Mercurius corrosivus very much resembles Mercurius in many of its pathogenesis, but the depth of action, severity of the case, excoriation and burning, rapid spreading of ulcer and tenesmus are much more in Merc. cor.

Apthae, Bone affection, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Eczema, Gonorrhoea, Kidney affection, Labour, Mumps, Puerperal fever, Paralysis, Syphilis, Tenesumus, Throat affections, Tongue affections, Ulcerated intestine, Urinary troubles, Uvula elongated, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on mucous membrane, intestine, urinary bladder, eye, bones etc. It also has got action over the serous membranes, especially peritoneum.

It causes irritation and inflammation of both mucous and serous memmbranes producing tenesmus of rectum and bladder, suppression of urine.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Great tenesmus persists before, during and even after stool. Tenesmus not relieved by stool; stool scanty mucus mixed with stool.

2. Tenesmus of the bladder and rectum at the same time; urine passes in drops with much pain,

3. Throat intensely inflamed, swollen, burning with swollen gums, which bleed easily.

4. Ulcers are deep and spread very rapidly.

5. Desire for cayenne pepper, ice, cold water.

6. Aliments from : Syphilis, sun and summer weather.

——

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eyes

Opthalmia neonatorum. Burning, excoriating discharge from the eyes, soreness of the eyes. Eyelids swollen. Deep ulcers on the cornea.

Mouth

Teeth loose. Gums spongy and swollen. Pyorrhoea and ptyalism. Tongue swollen and inflamed, Salivation is profuse. Salty and bitter taste in mouth.

Throat

UVULA SWOLLEN; SWALLOWING IS VERY PAINFUL RAPIDLY SPREADING ULCERS, BURNING PAIN WITH GREAT SWELLING. All glands about the throat are swollen.

Modality: Worse by external pressure.

Dysentery

Merc. cor. is FAMOUS for dysentery in violent cases. Causation: Mostly during summer weather.

Stool: COPIOUS, BLEEDING, SUMY; contains streaks of mucus membrane; very offensive; frequent evacuation.

Before stool: Tenesmus, cutting colic and uriging to stool.

During stool: Tenesmus of the rectum and may be accompanied with tenesmus of bladder too.

After stool: No relief. Tenesmus persists for some time, Great burning in the rectum.

Modality: More at night and aggravated by motion.

Concomitants: Unquenchable thirst. Salivated, swollen tongue. Abdomen swollen, hard and sensitive to pressure, especially about the umbticus. Scanty urine, passes drop by drop; hot, bloody, tenesmnus in the bladder. Faintness, weakness and shuddering. Cramps in the calf muscles,

Urine

Tenesmus of bladder with intense burning in urethra. Urine is hot, burning, scanty or

suppressed. Voided drop by drop, with great pain; bloody. Intense burning in urethra. Stabbing pain extends up urethra info bladder.

Concomitants: Perspiration after urinating. Albuminuria in early preganancy (Phosphorus, later and at full term).

Gonorrhoea

In the second stage of gonorrhoea when the greenish discharge begins to flow and the burning and tenesmus continues, Merc. cor. is of great help.

Modality: Aggravation at night. Concomitants: Penis and testes are enormously swollen. Chancres assume phagadenic appearance.

General Modalities :

Aggravation; Afternoon, AT NIGHT AND DURING SUMMER. Amelioration: By rest.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Especially suited to scrofulous children who are liable to bilious attacks and whose complexions are charac-terised by a peculiar corpse like pallor:

2) Catarrhal affections of mucous membranes especially of the eyes and ears.

3) Catarrhal inflammation of middle ear, eustachion tube closed, catarrhal deafness and otorrhoea in psoric children.

4) Black tongue, sore gums, constant and putrid saliva and ulcerations in mouth are characteristics of Merce. Dulcis.

5) Acute affection of prostate after maltreated stricture.

6) Condylomatous growth around external genitals, perineum and anus of the females emitting an extremely offensive smell.

7) Diarrhoea of children, profuse grass green stool like chop-ped eggs causing soreness of anus.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Mercurius is the KING OF ANTI- SYPHILITIC remedies, prepared and proved by Hahnemann. It is prepared by precipitating Mercury from its solution in Nitric acid by means of Caustic ammonia. The Pathogenesis of Mercury is found in the provings of Merc, viv., and Merc. sol. “I'wo different preparations, but not different enough to make any distinctions in practice” remarks DR KENT. Even CLARKE supports this fact in his Dictionary by saying, “No pains have been taken to keep distinct Merc, sol and Merc, viv., and I do not find it practicable to attempt to separate them”. One more thing to clarify is that the pure element, Mercurius, manifested the same symptoms as soluble mercury—Merc. sol. Hence there is no point in separately discussing them.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Anaemia, Bone affection, Breath offensive, Bronchitis, Catarrh, Cold, Dentition, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Dyspepsia, Eye affection, Gout, Glandular swelling, Gum troubles, Heart affection, Jaundice, Leucorrhoea, Liver affection, Lung affection, Measles, Melancholia, Perspiration abnormal, Pregnancy troubles, Prostatic disorders, Rheumatism, Small-pox, Suppuration, Syphilis, Teeth affection, Throat and Lung affections, Toothache, Tremors, Ulcers, Vomiting, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Every organ and tissue of the body is more or less affected by this powerful drug— such as bones, glands, lymphatic system, internal organs, intestine, mucous membrane, etc.

PATHOGENESIS

Lesions produced by Mercury are very similar to those of syphilis. It decomposes blood, producing profound anaemia. It has great power over suppuration with sero- Sanguinous discharge, slimy in character. It also produces ulceration of mouth and throat, much salivation, with falling of hair. It causes inflammation which leads to induration and from induration to ulceration.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Bitter taste, sweetish, putrid or slimy or metallic, coppery, soapy, stringy, tenacious mucus WITH INTENSE THIRST AND FOUL BREATH; profuse offensive saliva.

Tongue : Tongue is SWOLLEN, FLABBY; TAKES IMPRINT OF TEETH. Coated brown, black or thickly coated, dirty, yellow in case of jaundice. May have painful ulcers.

Teeth : Toothache, pulsating, tearing, lacerating, shooting to the face or ears. Aggravated in damp weather of evening from warmth of bed, from extremes of both heat and cold, but relieved by rubbing the cheeks, “Teeth erown decoy - Raret 4eemy CHezeriue)

Gums : Gums are swollen, painful, sore, ulcerated, gangrenous, with bleeding on least touch.

Thirst : Although tongue is moist and salivated there is INTENSE THIRST.

Dysentery

Causation: Fright and suppressed sweat.

Character of stool: Slimy, bloody, very offensive stool excoriating the anus. MORE THE BLOOD THE BETTER IS MERC SOL., INDICATED. Cannot finish sensation; tenesmus_not relieved after stool. (Temporary relief after stool, Nux vomica). lao kal

Modality: Aggravated at NIGHT.

Concomitants; Colic and fainting with creeping chilliness and thirst. Great tenesmus during and after Colic.

(Maximum tenesmus is in Merc., cor., even for passing urine).

Nose : Nasal catarrh, with much sneezing, of fluent acrid corrosive discharge, with raw and ulcerated

nostrils. Yellow green, foetid puslike discharge. Shining bloody discharge from nostrils. Nasal bone swollen, sore and painful.

Modality: Aggravated at night and FROM DAMP WEATHER.

Throat : Best indicated in tonsillitis and quinsy, diphtheria, laryngitis or pharyngitis, when there is Constant desire to swallow. Fever with creeping chilliness, profuse offensive perspiration without any relief. All symptoms are worse at night

Pneumonia stage: Late in the hepatisation and resolution stages. Location: When the lower lobe of right lung \s affected (Bryonta, Chelidonium, Kali carb., Lyco.).

Modality: Cough AGGRAVATED AT NIGHT AND FROM WARMTH OF BED WHEN LYING ON RIGHT SIDE; in darmp wet weather. There is utter inability to lie on the right side (Bry., Natrum. mur., Phos., Sulph.).

SPHERES OF ACTION: Every organ and tissue of the body is more or less affected by this powerful drug— such as bones, glands, lymphatic system, internal organs, intestine, mucous membrane, etc.

PATHOGENESIS

Lesions produced by Mercury are very similar to those of syphilis. It decomposes blood, producing profound anaemia. It has great power over suppuration with sero- Sanguinous discharge, slimy in character. It also produces ulceration of mouth and throat, much salivation, with falling of hair. It causes inflammation which leads to induration and from induration to ulceration.

413
PARTICULARS: Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Bitter taste, sweetish, putrid or slimy or metallic, coppery, soapy, stringy, tenacious mucus WITH INTENSE THIRST AND FOUL BREATH; profuse offensive saliva.

Tongue : Tongue is SWOLLEN, FLABBY; TAKES IMPRINT OF TEETH. Coated brown, black or thickly coated, dirty, yellow in case of jaundice. May have painful ulcers.

Teeth : Toothache, pulsating, tearing, lacerating, shooting to the face or ears. Aggravated in damp weather of evening from warmth of bed, from extremes of both heat and cold, but relieved by rubbing the cheeks, “Teeth erown decoy - Raret 4eemy CHezeriue)

Gums : Gums are swollen, painful, sore, ulcerated, gangrenous, with bleeding on least touch.

Thirst : Although tongue is moist and salivated there is INTENSE THIRST.

Dysentery

Causation: Fright and suppressed sweat.

Character of stool: Slimy, bloody, very offensive stool excoriating the anus. MORE THE BLOOD THE BETTER IS MERC SOL., INDICATED. Cannot finish sensation; tenesmus_not relieved after stool. (Temporary relief after stool, Nux vomica). lao kal

Modality: Aggravated at NIGHT.

Concomitants; Colic and fainting with creeping chilliness and thirst. Great tenesmus during and after Colic.

(Maximum tenesmus is in Merc., cor., even for passing urine).

Respiratory System

Nose : Nasal catarrh, with much sneezing, of fluent acrid corrosive discharge, with raw and ulcerated

nostrils. Yellow green, foetid puslike discharge. Shining bloody discharge from nostrils. Nasal bone swollen, sore and painful.

Modality: Aggravated at night and FROM DAMP WEATHER.

Throat : Best indicated in tonsillitis and quinsy, diphtheria, laryngitis or pharyngitis, when there is Constant desire to swallow. Uvula swollen and elongated, bluish, red swelling with burning and putrid discharge with PROFUSE, OFFENSIVE SALIVA. Tongue large, flabby with imprint of teeth. Fever with creeping chilliness, profuse offensive perspiration without any relief. All symptoms are worse at night

Pneumonia stage: Late in the hepatisation and resolution stages. Location: When the lower lobe of right lung \s affected (Bryonta, Chelidonium, Kali carb., Lyco.).

Character of cough: Dry, fatiguing cough, usually coming in two paroxysms. (In 3 paroxysms— Stannum met., Cup. met.) with stitching pain which extends to the back. Cough with yellow muco- Purulent expectoration which may be mixed with blood, putrid or salty In taste; offensive breath.

Modality: Cough AGGRAVATED AT NIGHT AND FROM WARMTH OF BED WHEN LYING ON RIGHT SIDE; in darmp wet weather. There is utter inability to lie on the right side (Bry., Natrum. mur., Phos., Sulph.).

name: Mezereum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It was introduced in the Materia medica by Dr. Stapf, but extensively proved by Hahnemann. “The medicine still remains as one of Hahnemann’s precious medical legacies”, remarks Dr. Tyler in her drug picture, Hughes tells us that mezereum was one of the vegetable substances with which it was attempted to replace mercury in the tretment of syphilis, This fact has been supported by provings. Hence, the drug is also called VEGETABLE MERCURY.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Bone affection, Ear troubles, Exostosis, Enlargement of glands, Gonorrhoea, Herpes zoster, Impetigo, Irritation, Leucorrhoea, Neuralgia, Rheumatism, Syphilis, Teeth affection, Tongue affection, Skin troubles, Ulcers, Vaccination-bad effects of, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on skin, bones, teeth, nerve and mind.

PATHOGENESIS

On the skin it produces variety of destructive changes, right from a simple non- eruptive itch to malignant ulcers, lesions with or without oozing and black discharges dry up and become thick leather-like scab with a soft pus-like material intervening between it and skin surface. On bones, especially the periosteum, it causes inflammations and bone pains. Nerves, underthe action of this drug produce neuralgia predominantly about teeth and face.

CONSTITUTION Physical make-up: It is especially suited to light haired, irresolute persons.

Temperament: Phlegmatic temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm: Psora and syphilis are in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Bad effects of vaccination (Antim. tart., Silicea, Thuja, Crotalus hor.) especially skin eruptions.

417

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation. After slight vexation and anger. Location: Right sided, extending from root of the nose to the forehead. Sensation: Feel as if the head would be crushed.

Character of headache. Violent type of headache. Pains are tearing and boring. Pain in head causes faintness.

Modalities

* Aggravation: From slightest touch, motion and at night. ¢ Amelioration; \n the open air, by heat and by covering the head.

Toothache

In carious teeth, teeth decay suddenly, especially at the roots.

Character of toothache: Violent neuralgic pain; dull pain when biting on them and when touched by tongue. There is decaying about the root of the teeth. There is also scorbutic conditions of the gum which bleeds.

Modalities

¢ Aggravation: At night and from touch, * Amelioration: By keeping the mouth open and drawing the air in (rev. of Staph).

name: Millefolium
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Another name for this plant is ‘Noseb-leed’, a very appropriate term because of its great tendency to produce haemorrhage, not only from the nose, but from every orifice and of the human system. Its medicinal proper-ties were known to the ancients. It is mentioned in Homer’s [liad as being utilised by Achilles to heal the wounds of his soldiers and hence it is called Achillea millefolium.

It is potentised from the musk which is the fatty, waxy and gelatinous substance with a very strong smell and is found in a sack between the umbilicus and the pre-putial orifice of the mask deer.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Cough, Convulsions, Epilepsy, Haemorrhages,

Hysteria, Leucorrhoea, Vertigo.

1) Haemorrhages : from all the orifices of the body ; from wounds or of mechanical origin ; painless haemorrhage without fever ; blood is bright red and fluid.

2) Profusely bleeding wound especially after a fall.

3) Vertigo when moving slowly, but not when taking violent exercise.

4) Cough: Causation : Suppressed menses or haemorrhoids, after a fall from a height, after violent exertion.

Character of cough : Cough with raising of blood daily at 4 p.m. (Lyco.) Concomitant : Cough with oppression and palpitation.

5) Menses : Time : Early Quantity : Profuse 4 Duration : Protracted Character : Suppressed with colic pain in abdomen. Blood is bright red & fluid.

6) Leucorrhoea of Children from atony (Cal., Caulo.)

7) Ailments from : Falls (from height), Overexertion. Lifting. Suppressed lochia. Suppressed menses. Suppressed haemorrhoids etc.

In haemorrhage, Millefolium canbe.compared with Erige-ron, Ipceac, Nitric Acid, Phosphorus & Trillium.

420

Hysteria. Hystero-epilepsy.

CONSTITUTION

It is suited to nervous, sensitive and hysterical persons. Chilly patient; antipsoric medicine.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
It is one of the valuable hysterical remedies useful in cases of hystero-epilepsy, convulsion, globus hystericus etc. where the symptoms are—

(i) Fainting : frequent tendency to fainting from least excitement, while eating, during menses, (ii) Sensation of coldness and shivering,

(iii) Tension in muscles, in skin and mind is another keynote of Moschus. (iv) Spasm of the larynx and spasm of the chest may be present. (vy) Great flatulence, craving for beer, stimulants and aversion to food.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Mind : Uncontrollable laughter. Scolding. Sexual hypo-chondriasis. Anxiety with palpitation ; starting as if frightened.

Stomach : Spasmodic, nervous hiccough (Ign., Sulph. ac.) Anxiety in chest with gastric symptoms. Distension of abdomen. Faints when eating. Desire for black coffee, Stimulants. Aversion to food.

Sexual symptoms

Male : Sexual hypochondriasis. Violent desire ; irivolun-tory emissions. Impotence, associated with diabetes. Premature senility. Nausea and vomiting after coltion.

Female : Menses too early, too profuse with disposition to faint. Sexual desire, with intolerable titilation in parts. Drawing and pushing in the direction of the genitals ; Sensation as if menses appear,

name: Murex
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Murex purpurea is prepared from a sea snail found on the coast of mediterranean sea called the purple fish. Like Sepia, this purple fish, secretes a peculiar substance which is of a fine red hue. Just like Sapia, this remedy is particularly A WOMAN’S REMEDY. It was first proved by Petroz, unto whom we owe this remedy.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abortion, Climacteric suffering, Diabetes, Leucorrhoea, Menstrual disorders, Nymphomania, Pregnancy troubles, Prolapse of Uterus, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Murex acts especially upon the female genital organs—uterus, ovaries and other genital organs. CONSTITUTION

Physical make up: Best adapted to lively affectionate women.

Temperament: Melancholic temperament.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. This remedy is infallible for the sufferings during climacteric in women. 2. There is sore PAIN IN THE UTERUS. 3. Least Contact of parts cause violent sexual excitement.

4. Bearing down sensation, as if internal organs would be pushed out. Must sit down and cross limbs to relieve pressure.

5. Pain from right side of womb to right or left breast. 6. Leucorrhoea alternates with mental symptoms. 7. Sinking, all gone sensation in stomach.

8. Violent excitement in sexual organs and excessive desire for an embrace. 9. Great depression of spirit with sadness.

10. Ailments from : Climacteric age (Medo., Lachesis, Sepia, Calc. carb, Glonoine,

B24

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Menses

Suited in dysmenorrhoea. Time: Irregular. Quantity: Too profuse. Duration: Usually long. Character: Protracted, large clots with violent bearing down pain in abdomen. Concomitants: With extreme sensitiveness of external genital organs and violent sexual excitement.

Leucorrhoea

Serous, greenish, thick, becoming sanguinous. There is reappearance of sanguinous leucorrhoea while at stool.

Sensation: Sensation of pelvic bones getting loose.

Modality: Leucorrhoea relieves mental depression. Patient is happier when leucorrhoea is worse.

Prolapse

It is an admirable remedy for the prolapse of uterus, when the displacement is associated with SORE PAIN IN UTERUS; a distinct sensation of a womb. The pain extends upwards from the right side of uterus and after crossing the body it goes to the left mammae. There is bearing down sensation as if internal organs would be pushed-out. The patient must sit down and cross limbs to resist pressure.

In this respect, Murex is very similar to Sepia. The differentiating features consist in its profuse and excessive haemorrhage, whereas in Sepia the flow is usually scanty. Furthermore, during the period of haemorrhage, she passes large clots.

Both have got bearing down sensation as if the internal organs would be pushed out and she must sit and cross legs to resist the pressure. Along with prolapse, in Murex, there is INTENSE SEXUAL DESIRE, while in Sepia, there is COMPLETE LACK OF SEXUAL DESIRE OR RATHER aversion to it especially with prolapse. Sepia is also chilly, apathetic and indifferent.

Sexual symptoms

There is violent excitement in sexual organs. She is afflicted with almost a frantic desire for sexual gratification, having excessive desire for an embrce. There Is almost unbearable sexual desire.

Least contact of parts causes violent sexual excitement.

General Modalities : Aggravation: From least touch.

Relations

Compare: Platina, Lilium, Sepia.

name: Muriatic Acid
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It is an acid prepared by the action of concentrated Sulphuric acid on Sodium chloride. Like all acids, it produces the peculiar DEBILITY AND IRRITABILITY. It has 574 symptoms in Hahnemann’s Materia Medica Pura.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anus—prolapse of, Diphtheria, Diarrhoea, Enteric fever, Haemorrhoids, Hemiopia, Heart troubles, Mouth and Tongue affection, Typhoid, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its actions are centred on blood, gastro-intestinal tract, anus, urinary organs, mucous membrane and skin.

PATHOGENESIS

Muriatic acid irritates and corrodes the mucous membranes, leading to ulceration. It causes a low febrile condition and hence becomes useful in cases of typhoid. Like

s ve cot —T2 ——————

Hig transcHet ras

Nitric acid, Muriatic acid is a powerful antidote to Mercurius. Just like other disinfectants, it causes rapid decomposition of tissues and dynamically cures the putrid conditions met with in some severe diseases. It produces sour excretion and make them

acrid.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is adapted to person with black hair, dark eyes and dark

complexion. Temperament: Irritable and peevish temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Diseases of asthenic type with intense prostration.

2. Patients become unconscious and fretful.

3. Great debility, slides down in bed: Even the LOWER JAW HANGS DOWN. His

eyes close as soon as he sits down.

426

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Mouth

Mouth is one of the chief seats of actions of this drug. There are malignant affection of mouth. Mouth is studded with ulcers which are deep and perforating having a black or dark base. The breath is very offensive.

Tongue: It is coated at edges. It is famous as BEEFY TONGUE. Tongue is shrunken, dry, leather- like.

Diarrhoea

There is diarrhoea while urinating, with involuntary stool. Can not urinate without having the bowels move at the same time. Involuntary stool even, when passing wind (Phosphorus, Aloe).

Haemorrhoids

Anus is VERY SENSITIVE either with or without haemorrhoids. Haemorrhoids are very SENSITIVE AND PAINFUL TO TOUCH. It is swollen and blue, It may appear suddenly m children. It is too sore to bear the least touch, even the touch of the bed sheet is uncomfortable. Haemorthoids prolapse while urinating (Baryta cart).

Urine

Urine passes slowly. The bladder is weak, so he has to wait for a long time to pass urine (Natrum mur., Hepar sulph.). He has to press the aodomen so that the anus also pmtruds before urine can pass. Cannot urinate without having the bowels move at the same time. Cannot bear least touch, even of the bed sheet on genitals.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It has been used in India since ancient time in many nervous and blood diseases, Kent says, “The use of Naja has extended far beyond its provings because many Homoeopaths presume that many of the ophidian fam-ily presents symptoms in common with it”. Cobra poison is also as deadly as Lachesis and Crotalus Horridus.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Anginapectoris. Chronic hypertrophy and valuular diseases of heart, Cardiac asthma. Cholera. Dipth-eria, Endocarditis. Oesophagismus. etc.

SPHERE OF ACTION

Naja has got strong affinity for the heart. All its complaints have tendency to settle about the heart. Other than heart it also affects Nervous system, such as medulla oblongata, cerebellum, respiratory nerves, pneumogastric and glossopharyngeal nerves.

Like other ophidians it does not have action over the blood but unlike them it strongly affects nervous system and thereby produces bulbar paralysis and feeling of intoxication, followed by loss of power over the lower limbs, aphasia, loss of control over swallowing and movement of lips, loss of sense of constriction, gradual loss of respiratory power and its ultimate cessation.

Unlike other ophidians it has strong affinity for the cardiac region, by acting on the heart it produces all sorts of pathological conditions as mentioned in “Clinical”.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) All complaints have tendency to settle around the heart.

2) Left side is principally affected and the symptoms have tendency to go from left to right.

3) All the complaints aggravate after sleep. Sleep profound like a log with stertorous breathing.

4) Profound exhaustion and trembling of the muscles.

5) Constriction of throat, chest etc.

sections.content: This is one of the tissue salts introduced by Schussler. Symptomatology available are the combined feature of indications by Schussler, proving symptoms by Dr. E. A. Farrignton & by others & the clinical observations by homoeopathic stalwarts in the field.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acidity, Diabetes. Dyspepsia. Gastralgia, Leucorrhoea, Post Nasal Catarrh. Rheumatism. Worms, Sterility.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Spheres of action of this remedy is mainly found in G.I. tract & also upon the bones, gla-nds, lungs & abdominal organs.

This drug has got a special affinity for the complaints arising from excess of lactic acid in the system hence acidity is the most important characteristic of Natrum phos & is seen to taint practically every organ under this remedy.”

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Mind : Anxious and apprehensive. Fears as if something would happen. Imagines on waking at night, that pieces of furniture are persons ; that he hears footsteps in next room.

Ears : One ear red, hot, frequently itchy accompanied by gastric derangements and acidity. Roaring in ears.

Gastrointestinal symptoms

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The Sodium carbonate from which this drug is prepared was first introduced in the field of Homoeopathic therapeutics by Hahnemann. It is a typical salt of the Natrum group with great antipsoric property. In the old school, its use is confined to burns and eczema and as a douche for nasal or vaginal catarrh. It forms alkaline base of soap. When these are used in excess, it almost b the superficial layer of the epidermis and leaves the skin dry and cracked The proving of this drug shows that Natrum carb. is truely a remedy for chapped hand and face, rough dry skin, eczema.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Burns, Cough, Diarrhoea, Headache, Herpes, Rheumatism, Respiratory troubles, Sterility, Menstrual disorders, Sunstroke, Throat affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It has got very marked action over the skin and mucous membrane of the human body. It stimulates the cellular activities and increases oxidation and metabolism. PATHOGENESIS

It irritates the skin and thereby the skin of the whole body becomes dry rough and cracked with severe itching. On mucous membrane, the effects are equally marked. The whole of the alimentary canal from mouth to anus is in a state of irritation, bordering on inflammation with redness of the mucous-membrane of the mouth and faces with rawness and soreness.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Suited to persons leucophlegmatic constitution. The patient has aversion to open air dislike of exercise, either mental or physical. Imbecility, Face paleiwitn blue ring around the eyes.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient; but head is very much affected by the heat of sun.

Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache is caused by HEAT OF SUMMER, CHRONIC EFFECTS OF SUN STROKE,

renewed with return of hot weather, from mental labour.

fore

Location: Headache first felt in the occiput. Sensation: Head feels too large as if it would burst.

Character of pain: There \s tearing, shooting pain with .sensation of pressive fulness in head as if head was going; to burst. Great tension in the occiput before menses. There is inability to think or

perform any mental labour. It causes headache.

Modality: Aggravation: from slightest mental labour, from sun or working under gas light;

SUMMER HEAT, during a thunderstorm.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Natrum mur. is one of Hahnemann’s topmost constitutional deep-acting remedies which ranks in the first order for its power. It is prepared from common salt which is a very common article of diet and it had been taken for granted that it would be of no use as a medicine. But it possesses a wonderful bold on the human economy when it is served in a potentised form.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anaemia, Artophy, Catarrh, Constipation, Cough, Debility, Dyspepsia, Eye affection, Glandular affections, Headache, Heart affection, Intermittentfeyer, Leucorrhoea, Marasmus, Menstrual troubles, Respiratory troubles, Rickets, Sterility, Skin troubles, Tongue affections, Urinary affection, Vertigo, Warts, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on skin, alimentary tract, blood and lymphatic system, mind, liver, spleen, genital organs, etc. wy) way

PATHOGENESIS fer 00!

Natrum “fur. enters into every tissue of the body and stimulates them. It causes deteriorati f the blood in quantity as well as in quality, producing thereby anaemia, various ulcers and eruptions on skin, also destructive inflammation of the mucus and glandular tissues. It stimulates digestion and secretion of gastric juice and the glandular secretion as well. Its lack of assimilation causes marasmus in children. It also stimulates the sebaceous glands and as a result the skin becomes oily and greasy in appearance. While the muscular tissue is strengthened by presence of salt, it maintains the tone of nerve. It has marked action on male genital organs causing great weakness and giving rise to seminal emission during sleep.

CONSTITUTION Make-up of the body: Emaciated people having shiny, oily and waxy look of the face, as if greased. Cachectic appearance having blue ring around the eyes,

Body: Emaciation is WELL MARKED IN NECK WITH LOSING OF FLESH WHILE LIVING WELL.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Exposure to sun, eye-strain, taking too much salt and loss of vital fluid. Location: Left sided clavus. Sensation: As if a thousand little hammers are knocking on the brain.

Character of pain: Bursting type of headache, which is chronic in nature. Headache starts with blindness, zig zag vision (Gels., Kali bich.). Such type of headache is usually found in school going girls, who are emaciated, anaemic and chlorotic.

Modalities

* Aggravation from heat of sun, sunrise to sunset, especially from 10 to 11 a.m. * Amelioration: Relieved by perspiration (Psorinum, zincum) and open air.

Concomitants: Blindness before headache, patient having an anaemic and chlorotic look, mapped tongue and great craving for salt.

Respiratory Organs :

Nose, violent and fluent coryza, with breathing difficulty, stoppage of nose. Discharge is thin and watery, like the white of an egg; violent sneezing, loss of smell and taste.

Cough : Natrum mur. is especially indicated in marked coryza and cough. * Sensation: Sticking sensation in throat. * Character of sputa: Sputa is thick, whitish, watery, like the white of an egg. * Modality: Aggravation: More in the morning and on the seashore.

* Concomitants: Inability to swallow. Whenever he coughs, tears stream down the face (Euphrasia). MAPPED TONGUE with red insular patches. Loss of taste in mouth.

Heart : Fluttering sensation of the heart. Weak faint feeling. The heart's pulsation shakes the whole body.

Modalities

* Aggravation from lying down and at the seashore. * Amelioration by lying on right side (Sulph).

Urinary Symptoms :

Slow action of the bladder. Urine comes slowly, dribble out. Lack of force in the flow of urine. Involuntary urination especially when walking, coughing, laughing (Causticum, Puls, Mur. acid).

Patient cannot pass urine in presence of others (Hepar).

Has to wait for a long time before passing urine (Hepar, Staph., Mur. acid), Cutting pain in urethra after urination (Thuja, Sars.). Sensation as if more urine has remained. Frequent urging for urination; must pass urine very often.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Natrum sulphuricum—Sodium sulphate was discovered by Glauber; hence it is called Glauber’s salt, it is used by the old school as a Jaxative or purgative. But Homoeopathy has raised its status and established its great utility in various diseased conditions like pneumonia, asthma, etc. Schuessler has laboriously explained the role this salt plays in the economy of life and he included it as a member of the tissue remedies. It was studied by Grauvogl, who found in it the hydrogenoid constitutions.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Asthma, Abdominal disorders, Biliousness, Cough, Diarrhoea, Debility, Diabetes, Epilepsy, Flatulence, Gonorrhoea. Headache, Injury, Liver affection, Meningitis, Pneumonia, etc.

SPHERES OF ACTION °

It acts mainly on gastro-intestinal tract, respiratory system and skin. Meninges and. mind are also affected with equal severity. Occasionally, head, conjunctiva and genital organs are also affected.

PATHOGENESIS

On the alimentary system, it produces a state of inflammation causing jsentery and diarrhoea. Vomiting may also result occasionally. The drug has got its main seat of action on the respiratory system causing sycotic pneumonia and humid asthma. Its action is undoubtedly directed upon the blood through which it produces irritating disturbances in nearly every tissue of the body. Meningitis and brain symptoms, due to effects of long-age injury are its characteristic effects,

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: HYDROGENOID CONSTITUTION, where the complaints are due to living in damp houses, basement, cellers, etc.

Temperament: Bilious temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient. Miasm: Sycosis is in the background.

Hydrogenoid Constitution. Left sided affections especially when lower lobe of left lung is affected.

. Worse by dampness of weather, in damp house and cellers.

Discharges are thick, yellowish and greenish. Ailments from abuse of quinine, neglected cases of gonorrhoea and mental trauma.

. Dirty and greenish, gray or brown coating on the tongue. . Music makes her sad.

. Constant desire to take deep and long breath in wet weather. . Burning thirst for very cold drinks, especially in evening. . Mind : Mental traumatism, mental effects from injury to head, chronic brain effect

of blow and fall. Great anxiety with loathing of life and suicidal tendency. Patient must use all possible self control to prevent shooting herself. A woman during gestation attempts to hang herself.

There is great fear. Fear of crowd, of evil, of people. Easily frightened.

Sleep disturbed by dreams of fighting.

11. Ailments from : Fear, suppressed gonorrhoea, abuse of quinine, damp and rainy

weather.

Abdomen : Fiatulent colic: Pain and tenderness in the whole abdomen. Great flatulence in the

become yellow. Nausea with vomiting of bile.

Great flatulence in the abdomen, with colic and burning irr abdomen and anus. The character of stool is watery, yellowish and greenish.

full:
INTRODUCTION: Natrum sulphuricum—Sodium sulphate was discovered by Glauber; hence it is called Glauber’s salt, it is used by the old school as a Jaxative or purgative. But Homoeopathy has raised its status and established its great utility in various diseased conditions like pneumonia, asthma, etc. Schuessler has laboriously explained the role this salt plays in the economy of life and he included it as a member of the tissue remedies. It was studied by Grauvogl, who found in it the hydrogenoid constitutions.
CLINICAL: Asthma, Abdominal disorders, Biliousness, Cough, Diarrhoea, Debility, Diabetes, Epilepsy, Flatulence, Gonorrhoea. Headache, Injury, Liver affection, Meningitis, Pneumonia, etc.

SPHERES OF ACTION °

It acts mainly on gastro-intestinal tract, respiratory system and skin. Meninges and. mind are also affected with equal severity. Occasionally, head, conjunctiva and genital organs are also affected.

PATHOGENESIS

On the alimentary system, it produces a state of inflammation causing jsentery and diarrhoea. Vomiting may also result occasionally. The drug has got its main seat of action on the respiratory system causing sycotic pneumonia and humid asthma. Its action is undoubtedly directed upon the blood through which it produces irritating disturbances in nearly every tissue of the body. Meningitis and brain symptoms, due to effects of long-age injury are its characteristic effects,

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: HYDROGENOID CONSTITUTION, where the complaints are due to living in damp houses, basement, cellers, etc.

Temperament: Bilious temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient. Miasm: Sycosis is in the background.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Nitric acid acts on blood, skin, mucous membrane glands, bones and gastro-intestinal tract.

PATHOGENESIS

The special seat of ation of Nitric acid is at the junction of skin and mucous membranes of the body, such as mouth, eyes, nose, rectum, anus, vagina, urethra, etc. It disorganises the blood causing decomposition; it produces intense irritation, resulting in inflammation, destruction, ulceration and even gangrene of the parts. Its action on gastro-intestinal tract sets in diarrhoea, haemorrhage, etc.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: Nitric acid is especially suited to thin, weak and debilitated Persons with rigid musculature, dark complexion, black hair and eyes. Ugly looking appearance; with broken down cachectic constitution; anaemic and emaciated; old people with morning diarrhoea (Phos.).

Temperament: Nervous and irritable temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Cassation: Resulting from virulent poisoning loss of sleep, anxiety or over exertion or bereavement and from pressure of hat.

Location: Drawing, stitching and throbbing pain, in temples; siiae bone pain in left temple.

Sensation: Congestive headache as if the head was tightly bound up; with sensation of a band around the head.

Character of pain: Pain comes suddenly and goes suddenly, splinter like pricking pain congestive and throbbing.

Modality: Headache in the morning on waking, disappears on rising; better while riding in a carriage.

Concomitants: Vertigo in the morning with weakness and profuse falling of hair.

Gastro-intestinal Symptoms

Mouth Putrid breath from mouth with offensive saliva and feeding, soft and sponay gums and loose teeth. Tongue is clean and red. Ulcers on soft palate and in entire mouth with splinter-like pain; mercurial or syphilitic ulcers in mouth with typical pain

Throat : Hoarseness of voice; tonsils swollen, red and ulcerated with PRICKING SPLINTER LIKE PAIN. Diphtheritic membrane on throat, fauces, larynx pharynx; extending to nose with pricking pain: worse when swallowing; burning in throat.

Stomach : Stomach and abdomen are very tense; wants to make the clothes loose; sour or bitter taste and eructation; weak and debilitated person and whose digestion is weak. There is great appetite and thirst, but cannot digest food. Persistent nausea and vomiting of offensive, undigested food, tenacious and bloody mucus. Nausea and vomiting are relleved by riding in a carriage, STICKING, SPLONTER LIKE PRICKING PAIN IN ABDOMEN; chronic enlargement of liver and spleen with the typical pain in right hypochondrium; icterus, clay coloured stool.

* Causation: The reason for the diarrhoea fs, as usual, dependent upon some virulent poison, bad effects of loss of vital fluid, haemorrhage, broken-down cachectic constitution, etc.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Nux moschata is a very useful and effective remedy derived from the vegetable kingdom. The mother tincture is prepared from the pulverised dry kernel invested in the shell. It was introduced into Materia Medica by Helbig. The tree is a native of East and West Indies and grows well in this equatorial region. The tree branches freely and is of medium height. Although it is suitable for all kinds and classes of people, it is particularly adaptable to children, old people and women during pregnancy.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Abdominal disorders, Abortion, Apoplexy, Asthma, Cough, Debility, Deltoid rheumatism, Eructation, Flatulence, Gastralgia, Haemorrhage, Headache, Heart

troubles, Menstrual disorders, Hysteria, Rheumatism, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seats of action of this drug are mind, nervous system, skin and mucous membrane, gastro-intestinal tract, respiratory organs, respiratory tract, uterus and

ovaries.

PATHOGENESIS It acts on.

(a) Nervous system and mind producing stupor, insensibility and unconquerable

sleep; weakness of memory and changeable mood. (b) On skin and mucous membrane, causing great dryness.

(c) On gastro-intestinal tract : resulting in great distension of abdomen and

diarrhoea and other troubles,

(d) On respiratory tract, setting in cough and hoarseness. In addition to rheumatic affections, menstrual disorders, etc. are also within its domain of action.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: It is suited especially to women, and children, with dry skin who rarely perspire, weak old people who are delicate, sensitive and dyspeptic having

hydrogenoid constitution (Clarke).

10. 11.

. Drowsiness and sleepiness. The greatest characteristic of Nux moschata is drowsiness and sleepiness which accompany all ailments. Complaints cause SLEEPINESS or is accompanied by DROWSINESS. This is the red strand and KEY-NOTE of the drug.

. Chilliness is yet another important symptom. The patient is very chilly. All

complaints are aggravated by cold and damp weather and relieved by warmth.

. Dryness : This too is equally important. There is great dryness of the skin and

mucus membrane. No other remedy in Mataria Medica has got this symptom so prominently. The skin is very dry, mouth is so dry that the saliva seems like cotton and the tongue adheres to the root of the mouth. This is the great second key-note of thisdrug.

Dryness of the eyes is very well-marked. Eyes are too dry for the lids to close.

. Thirsdessness : Inspite of great dryness of the mouth and the skin, curiously

enough THERE IS NO THIRST (Puls.). This is very well-marked in Nux moschata which is yet another great key-note of the remedy.

. Oversensitiveness runs thorugh the whole remedy. Oversensitive to light, touch,

smell, noise, pain, etc. which causes vertigo, nausea, vomiting and even fainting.

. The patient is very forgetful; absence of mind and indifference. Changeable, mood,

hysterical and nervous disposition.

. There is marked tendency to faint ,and inclination to become unconscious; soporous

condition as if intoxicated.

. Flatulent distension of abdomen with consequent diarrhoea. . Leucorrhoea instead of menses (Cocculus); Physometra (Lyco., Lac can.,

Sanguinaria). Cough is loose after eating and dry after drinking.

Great soreness of all the parts upon which he lies, with tendency to bed sqre (Bapt., Pyrogen, Ruta).

Mind : The mental symptoms of Nux moschata are yery striking and characteristic and are as follows:-

The patient is very much absent-minded. She cannot think ot concentrate her mind on anything.

There is marked indifference to everything. She cannot and does not take interest in anything, whether it is her own affair, domestic, personal or otherwise. No interest for anything.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Headache is caused by overeating. Eating a little more causes headache. There is pressive headache in small spot on the left frontal eminence.

The patient is very much drowsy and sleepy with dry mouth and no thirst.

Gastrointestinal tract

Mouth : There is gret dryness of mouth, lips and throat. Tongue is so dry that it adheres to the palate. There is no saliva in the mouth to be expectorated or swallowed. Saliva seems like cotton.

Throat is also very dry and stiff; yet there rs NO THIRST. Toothache Curing pregnancy. At every menstrual period, the mouth, throat and tongue are intolerably dry; especially when sleeping.

Stomach : Abdomen is enormously distended, with rumbling in abdomen; especially after every meal. Eating a little in excess causes various troubles, such as headache, pain and distress in the stomach. There is pain in the stomach during eating or immediately after eating (Kali. bi. Bry.). Flatulent dyspepsia, especially of old people, There is great appetite, but no thirst. Pressure and pain in liver and right hypochondrium. Pain, nausea and vomiting during pregnancy.

Stool : Stool is soft and foetid, but expelled with difficulty. Rectum is inactive. Diarrhoea in summer, from cold drinks and epidemic in autumn. Stool is white. Diarrhoea from boiled milk, or during dentition; during pregnancy; with sleepinss and fainting. Diarrhoea with undigested stool or like chopped egg with loss of Appetite.

Respiratory Symptoms :

There is sudden hoarseness which is aggravated from walking against the wind (Euph., Hepar). The patient suffers from severe cough. Cough |s caused by getting warm in bed, or from being overheated, from bathing or standing in water, living in cold damp places. The peculiarity of the cough is that it is loose after eating and dry after drinking with oppression of chest.

Heart : There is violent palpitation with weak pulse. Feeling of rush of blood to heart and then to the head and from there all over the body.

Gastrointestinal tract

Mouth : There is gret dryness of mouth, lips and throat. Tongue is so dry that it adheres to the palate. There is no saliva in the mouth to be expectorated or swallowed. Saliva seems like cotton.

Throat is also very dry and stiff; yet there rs NO THIRST. Toothache Curing pregnancy. At every menstrual period, the mouth, throat and tongue are intolerably dry; especially when sleeping.

Stomach : Abdomen is enormously distended, with rumbling in abdomen; especially after every meal. Eating a little in excess causes various troubles, such as headache, pain and distress in the stomach. There is pain in the stomach during eating or immediately after eating (Kali. bi. Bry.). Flatulent dyspepsia, especially of old people, There is great appetite, but no thirst. Pressure and pain in liver and right hypochondrium. Pain, nausea and vomiting during pregnancy.

Stool : Stool is soft and foetid, but expelled with difficulty. Rectum is inactive. Diarrhoea in summer, from cold drinks and epidemic in autumn. Stool is white. Diarrhoea from boiled milk, or during dentition; during pregnancy; with sleepinss and fainting. Diarrhoea with undigested stool or like chopped egg with loss of Appetite.

Respiratory Symptoms :

There is sudden hoarseness which is aggravated from walking against the wind (Euph., Hepar). The patient suffers from severe cough. Cough |s caused by getting warm in bed, or from being overheated, from bathing or standing in water, living in cold damp places. The peculiarity of the cough is that it is loose after eating and dry after drinking with oppression of chest.

Heart : There is violent palpitation with weak pulse. Feeling of rush of blood to heart and then to the head and from there all over the body.

Hahnemann’s GREATEST POLYCHREST REMEDY.

Applicable to both acute and chronic ailments.

Pre-eminently the remedy for any of thexonditions incidental to and arising from the so called MODERN CIVILIZED LIFE.

A suitable remedy for people of every age, sex and temperament.

The remedy which is capable of working wonders for people of all walks of life from the lowest to the highest standard, in both civilised and un-civilised classes.

The remedy is a unique gift from the vegetable kingdom. The tree is grown as a wild plant found in the equatorial region. In its crude form, there may not be anything more bitter than its seed.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Although every organ is susceptible to the action of Nux vomica, it predominantly acts on spinal cord, motor and sensory centres, brain, gastro-intestinal tract, respiratory organs, cardiovascular system, genito-urinary organs.

PATHOGENESIS

By its action on the spinal cord, brain, motor and sensory nerve centres, a condition of EXCESSIVE IRRITATION AND EXCITABILITY is produced which causes muscular incoordination and paralysis. It acts on the organs and their nutrition, thereby the secretions are altered, functions are perverted and the organic; substances change. A long chain of symptoms set in presenting an accurate picture of gastric, hepatic and intestinal affections. It irritates the mucous membrane of alimentary tract, thereby producing dyspepsia like symptoms and stimulate constipation, diarrhoa, dysentery, etc. Affections of the respiratory system result in dry catarrhal condition, obstruction of nose and cough. It stimulatesthe vasomotoricentre and thus gives rise to blood pressure, heart symptoms etc.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: Nux vomica is ideally suited to thin spare subjects, with dark hair and dark complexion, who lead a sedentary life, nervous, extremely susceptible to external impressions, habituated to overstudy, debauches, zealous and hypochondriac. People of all walks of life, from the highest to the lowest standard, richest or poorest, civilised or unciuilsed.

Temperament: Bilious, sanguine, irritable and impatient temperament.

“Nux is chiefly successful with persons of an ardent character; of an irritable. impatient temperament, disposed to anger, spite or deception"—says Hahnemann.

Relation with heat and cold: Nux vom. is a very CHILLY remedy. Miasm: Definitely psora isin the background as the originator of all the troubles.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It is the LEST REMEDY TO COMMENCE TREATMENT of cases that have been unduly drugged by other schools as an antidote to the bad-effects.

2. Fof all consequences and results arising from and incidental to modem life, people of all walks of life age, sex and temperament.

3. Oversensitiveness runs through the whole remedy. He is very sensitive to external impressions such as light, noise, odour, touch, pain, cold, music, ete. Hypersensitive and over-impressionable.

4. Debauches of thin, irritable nervous disposition, liable to indigestion and hepatic

troubles. ff

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: As a result of the bad effects of the modern so called civilised high living, taking coffee, tobacco, alcohol, wine, highly spiced seasoned food, irregular diet, overheating, indulging in sexual excess, long continued mental exertion, sedentary habits, want of exercise, loss of sleep, taking aromatic medicines, pills or exposure to cold and the like, headache with typical symptoms arise in the patient calling for this great polychrest.

Sensation: Sensation as if the head would burst with congestion, heaviness and pressure.

Character of headache: Headache of gastric origin, congestive headache, with heaviness of head, especially in the morning. The patient feels as if the head would burst, heaviness and pressure in the head. Scalp is very sensitive to touch.

Modalities: Aggravation in the morning, by loss of sleep, touch and noise. Relief by vomiting. warm application, in warm room, from sitting quiet and lying down in a dark room.

Concomitants: A sense of stupefaction and confusion as if intoxicated; vertigo as if the brain were moving in a circle with a very transient loss of conciousness. Vertigo with obstruction of sight, dizziness and humming in ears; nausea and vomiting.

Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Foetid ulceration in the mouth. Gums swollen and bleeding. FOETID AND SOUR TASTE IN THE MOUTH IN MORNING. Anterior half of the tongue clean and the posterior coated white, furred, cracked on edges, sometimes the tongue is, yellow, thick and ulcerated and cracked. Toothache worse from cold and better from warmth.

Throat : Stitching pain in the throat, radiating to ears on swallowing. Ulceration extends to throat from mouth, tingling sensation in uvula.

Stomach : Stomach troubles are caused by coffee, tobacco, alcohol, highly spiced seasoned food, irregular diet, overeating, aromatic patent medicines, purgatives, etc. Sensation of weight and pain in the stomach. Flatulence and pyrosis, tightness, sour or bitter eructation, nausea and vomiting, constant nausea after eating especially in the moming. PATIENT FEELS “IF | COULD ONLY VOMIT, | WOULD BE SO MUCH BETTER”. So he induces vomiting for relief. VERY HUNGRY, yet there is aversion to food. Nux is one of the leading remedies for gastritis, gastralgia and dyspepsia. It can also be given as a routine remedy for want of appetite. Stomach region is very sensitive tip touch and pressure. There is also intolerance of tight bandage around the waist, must loosen clothes. Abdomen is bloated. Pressure an hour or two after eating as from a stone, cannot use mind for 2 or 3 hours after food, vomiting of bile, vomiting of pregnancy. Disordered stomach from overeating, taking alcohol, coffee, drugs, night watching, high living,debauchery, from sedentary habits, etc. Constrictive cramp like pain in the stomach. There may also be flatulent, distension with spasmodic colle which is aggravated by uncovering.

Enlarged liver in drunkards, stitching pain and soreness. Shortness of breath.caused by upward Pressure of gas with ineffectual urge for stool and urine. Jhrobbing pain from hepatic abscess, gall stone

with jaundice.

sections.content: Amblyopia. Breast-affection of: atrophy of; Debility. Diplopia. Eyes-affection of. Headache. Sexual, stony.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1)A remedy for migraine where the indications are : Causation : Headache from eyestrain and sexual weak-ness. Location—Occipito- frontol pain, chiefly left side. Sensation—Dull headache with sensation of heaviness and dizziness. Dull heavy pain pressing upward in occiput.

Modality : Agg. Lying down, in the dark, motion. Ame. From sleep.

2) Onosmdodium is very rich in eye symptoms. The eye symptoms may be due to hyperaemic condition of optic disc, enlargement of retinal vessels, muscular asthenopia and paretic condition of internal eye muscles. There is pain in eyeballs between orbit and ball, extending to left temple. Eyes feel strained, heavy and

dull. Vision is impaired or blurred. Modality: Aggravation—From using the eyes.

3) Sexual weakness in both sexes males and females. The sexual desire is completely destroyed. In Onosmodium impotency is of more psychical character.

4) Breast : There is aching in breast and itching of nipples. Yingling prescribed Onosmodium in a woman whose breast was only partially developed with dryness of the mouth, throat and nose and the usual size of breast was restored.

5) Male : In Onosmodium impotency is more of psychical character. There is loss of desire, deficient erections & early emissions.

6) Female;In female sexual desire is completely destroyed. With this there may be history of too early, too prolonged menses & severe bearing down pains in uterine region.

Leucorrhoea : Profuse yellow & acrid discharge.
