sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Opium is a strong poison and is obtained from the unripe capsules of the poppy plant. It contains at least twenty different alkaloids such as morphine, apo-mor-phine, codeine, narcotine etc. Hahnemann says, “Opium is almost the only medicine that in its primary action does not produce a single pain” Opium is a long acting, constitu-tional, polychrest medicine having remarkable actions in several diseases.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Apoplexy, Brain affection, Colic. Constipation. Epilepsy. Fear-effects of. Marasmus. Paralysis. Sleepiness. Sleeplessness. Sunstroke. Typhoid, Urinary complaints etc,.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It is a polychrest medicine of wide range. Its chief action is on mind, senses and nerves of the body. Also acts on skin and mucous membranes of the different tracts such as respiratory, digestive and urinary.

The symptoms produced by opium poisoning vary according to the quantity of opium taken. In mild doses it causes a sort of exhilarating effect on emotional side more than the intellectual sphere for a short duration. In increased doses it produces the symptoms which simulates an attack of apoplexy.

Opium lessens voluntary movements, contracts pupils, depresses higher intellectual powers, lessons self control and power of concentration, judgment, stimulates the imagina-tion. It checks all secretions except that of skin, which is excited.

CONSTITUTION

_ Make up of the body: It is especially adapted to diseases of first and second childhood Le. to children and old people. Persons with light hair, lax muscles, and want to bodily tritability. Children with wrinkled skin, look like a little dried up old man.

Heat cold relation : Hot patient.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Want of susceptibility to well selected remedies due to lack of vital reaction. Especially in nervous diseases (Ambra. G., Valer.)

_—

461

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastro-intestinal Tract: Mouth: Dryness of mouth, Tongue black. Paralysed. Intense thirst (unquenchable).

Stomach : All gone, sinking, hungry feeling is not relieved by eating. Patient is hungry but has no desire to eat. Nausea, retching and vomiting, with sourness of stomach. There is inactivity, sluggishness of digestive organs causing reverse peristalsis which results in faecal vomiting.

Abdomen : Abdomen is hard, bloated & tympanitic. Colic after lead poisoning or painter’s colic. Very violent, griping as if intestines are cut to pieces. Colic is accompanied with an urge for stool and there is discharge of hard faeces.

Diarrhoea : Causation—After fright, from paralysis of rectum. Involuntary stool after fright (Gels.) Stool is black, offensive & frothy, Persistent diarrhoea in those treated with large doses of the drug,

Constipation

Causation : Lead poisoning. Inaction or paretic condition of intestine. Opium is suited to almost uncomparable chronic constipation, Opium renders the instestines so sluggish that the most active purgatives lose their power. Constipation of children and of corpulent, good natured women. There is no activity, no desire to go to stool.

Character of stool : Stool hard dry round black balls (Cheli., Plumb., Thuja). Faeces protrude and recede (Sil., Thuja, Sam.)

Urine : There is involuntary urination or retention after fright. Paralysis of bladder or sphincter may be after excessive use of tobacco, in nursing children after passion of nurse or in fever or acute illness,

Child : Look—Children with light hair, lax muscles, and want of bodily irritability. In marasmus, child looks like a little dried up old man with wrinkled skin. They suffer from spasms & convulsions after sudden retrocession of acute exanthema, from nursing after fright of mother (Hyos.—after anger of mother, Cham., Nux Vom.) and from crying. During spasm eyes half open and upturned (eyes turned downward-Aethusa). Screams before and during spasms (Apis., Hell.) Convulsion in warm room. He becomes unconscious and cold as corpse after warm bath. Child usually constipated with hard, black, dry stool like sheep dung.

There is also involuntary stool after fright and involuntary urination or retention in nursing children after a fit of passion in nurse, Child is hot blooded with hot perspiration. He wants cool open air, wants to be uncovered. Opium is to be thought of for those children whose moral sense has never been developed, who lie and steal.

Stomach : All gone, sinking, hungry feeling is not relieved by eating. Patient is hungry but has no desire to eat. Nausea, retching and vomiting, with sourness of stomach. There is inactivity, sluggishness of digestive organs causing reverse peristalsis which results in faecal vomiting.

Abdomen : Abdomen is hard, bloated & tympanitic. Colic after lead poisoning or painter’s colic. Very violent, griping as if intestines are cut to pieces. Colic is accompanied with an urge for stool and there is discharge of hard faeces.

Diarrhoea : Causation—After fright, from paralysis of rectum. Involuntary stool after fright (Gels.) Stool is black, offensive & frothy, Persistent diarrhoea in those treated with large doses of the drug,

Constipation

Causation : Lead poisoning. Inaction or paretic condition of intestine. Opium is suited to almost uncomparable chronic constipation, Opium renders the instestines so sluggish that the most active purgatives lose their power. Constipation of children and of corpulent, good natured women. There is no activity, no desire to go to stool.

Character of stool : Stool hard dry round black balls (Cheli., Plumb., Thuja). Faeces protrude and recede (Sil., Thuja, Sam.)

Urine : There is involuntary urination or retention after fright. Paralysis of bladder or sphincter may be after excessive use of tobacco, in nursing children after passion of nurse or in fever or acute illness,

Child : Look—Children with light hair, lax muscles, and want of bodily irritability. In marasmus, child looks like a little dried up old man with wrinkled skin. They suffer from spasms & convulsions after sudden retrocession of acute exanthema, from nursing after fright of mother (Hyos.—after anger of mother, Cham., Nux Vom.) and from crying. During spasm eyes half open and upturned (eyes turned downward-Aethusa). Screams before and during spasms (Apis., Hell.) Convulsion in warm room. He becomes unconscious and cold as corpse after warm bath. Child usually constipated with hard, black, dry stool like sheep dung.

There is also involuntary stool after fright and involuntary urination or retention in nursing children after a fit of passion in nurse, Child is hot blooded with hot perspiration. He wants cool open air, wants to be uncovered. Opium is to be thought of for those children whose moral sense has never been developed, who lie and steal.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: If Opium is the painless remedy, Oxal ac. may be considered its antithesis : it causes pains excruciating beyond description, and it has this grand keynote distinction, that its pains are all aggravated when the patient thinks of them. And not only that, thinking of pains and conditions will bring them on when they are not actually present.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Angina pectoris. Aphonia. Backache. Gastrodynia. Headache. Lung affection. Meningitis. Myelitis. Neurasthania. Oxaluria. Paralysis. Urinary com-plaints. Vnmiting of pregnancy.

SPHERE OF ACTION It acts on digestive tract, genitourinary organs, spinal cord and nerves and left lung.

PATHOGENESIS

It is both corrosive and true poison. It causes pains excruciating beyond description, corrosion of passages, destruction of mucous membrane. It influences the spinal cord, and produces motor paralysis, coldness of surface, numbness, mottled skin, blue nails are present in all degrees of its action and are leading notes for its use. It may even cause death by exhaustion.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) All pains aggravated when thinking of them. Even must urinate and defaecate when thinking of it. (Calc. Phos., Melon, Medo. Baryta Garb. Gels.)

2) Left sided remedy having special action over lower lobe of left lung (Nat. Salph., Rumex)

3) Sharp lancinating pain through the lower lobe of left lung is the great characteristic of oxalic acid.

4) Terrible pain in lumber region over regions of both kidneys extending down thigh.

5) Pain in small spots (Ign., Kali Bi., Lil Tig.), Pain aggravates from motion and slightest touch.

6) Nervous aphonia alternates with Heart symptoms (Palpitation).

7) Ailments from : Thinking of complaints, coffee, wine, sour fruits, sugar etc.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eyes

Hyperasthesia of retina. Severe pain in eyes, feel expanded.

Headache

There is pressing pain in spots or sore, tender spots on the scalp. Band like sensation about head and sense of heat. Headache before and during stool and better after stool. Worse left side, from wine, lying after sleep, slightest touch and light while thinking about it.

G.|.tract disorder :

Causation : Eating sour fruits, apples, tomatoes, grapes, sugar and starchy food. Sensation of heat in mouth, throat and stomach ultimately turning into an intense burning pain. Great pain in umbilical region aggravates in evening & night. Stitching pains in liver relieved by deep breathing. Bitter and sour eructation, worse at night. Epigastric pain relieved by passing flatus. Burning in small spots in abdomen.

Stool: Diarrhoea from coffee with watery, bloody, mucous stool.

Urinary-symptoms : The renal region is painful and tender with soreness of whole urinary tract. When urinating there is pain in glans penis and burning in urethra. Frequent uri-natiorrwith copious urine containing oxalate of lime. All the urinary symptoms are worse when thinking about them; even he must urinate when thinking about it.

Male : Terrible neuralgic pains in spermatic cord- Testicles feel contused and heavy. Seminal Vesiculitis.

Heart: On of the greatly neglected remedies for heart com-plaints.

“Sharp lancinating pains through the lower lobe of the left lung” is very characteristic symptom in cases of Angina pectoris, also in pneumonia, pleurisy etc. There is most dif-ficult breathing

with choking feeling in larynx. Loss of voice alternates with palpitation. Stitching pain behind the sternum going to shoulders and arms, worse on left side.

Pulse irreqular, intermittent, fast.

Concomitant: Blue nails and lips, cold sweat, paralysis of lower limbs, spasmodic respiration and great weakness. Modality: Worse on slight exertion and motion and while thinking of ailments.

Extremities : There is numbness, weakness & tingling in extremities. Lower extremities blue, cold & insensible. Draw-ing & lancinating pains shooting down extremities. Pain start from spine extend through extremities. Muscular prostration, Myelitis. Multiple cerebral and posterior spinal sclerosis.

General Modalities : Aggravation ; leftside, slightest touch, light, shaving. Thinking of complaints.

Relations

Campare : Ars., Colch., Arg., Pic. acid.

name: Petroleum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This product from the interior of the earth, when, used as a remedial agent, “can help a Homoeopathic physician to fight variety of diseases”, so says the Master. This crude oil is purified with the help of sulphuric acid before it undergoes the process of potentisation. Kent says that petroleum is one of the drugs abused by his colleagues of the orthodox school of medicines and when it is used in rheumatism and bruises as an external application on the surface, this is not its homoeopathic action.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anaemia, Angina pectoris, Abdominal disorders, Constipation, Diarrhoea, Eczema, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Peptic ulcer, Psoriasis, Rheumatism, Skin affection, Vomiting, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts chiefly upon the skin and mucous membrane, especially of gastro-intestinal tract. Underwood claims that it has action on heart, meninges and cerebrum too.

The skin bears the brunt of the action of the drug. It produces a number of skin changes mainly of dry character as a result of irritation manifesting as CRACKS AND FISSURES. On brain and heart when it acts, it produces tonic and clonic convulsion with oppression, giddiness, palpitation of heart and faintness.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Adapted to persons of light hair and light skin who suffer from cutaneous eruptions and gastro-intestinal disorders.

Temperament: Irritable, quarrelsome, easily offended by trifles and vexed on every thing.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora is definitely in the background.

Diathesis: Scrofulous diathesis,

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Symptoms are WORSE IN WINTER, especially skin disease. Skin is rough, bleeds

Ailments from : Riding in a carriage, car or ship, fright, vexation and eating cabbage.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Carriage riding. Location: In occiput. Sensation: Heaviness in the head, pressing and pulsating pain in the head. Sensation as if head

is made up of wood.

Character: Scalp is sore to touch, followed by numbness, throbbing and bursting headache. Modality: Aggravation during a thunderstorm, carriage riding (Cocculus). Concomitants: With headache there is vertigo on rising, in occiput, like sea sickness.

Gastro-intestinal symptoms

Stomach : Gastralgia of pregnancy, with heartburn and sour eructation. Nausea with accumulation of water in the mouth. Character of pain; Pressing and drawing pain in stomach.

Modalities

¢ Aggravation: Whenever the stomach is empty. ° Amelioration: By constant eating (Anac., Sepia, lod., Chel.).

name: Phosphoric Acid
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Phosphoric acid is another of Hahnemann’s immortal jegacies in Materia Medica Pura. He gives direction for its preparation and for its potentization upto the trillionth fold dilution. It is an invaluable remedy well deserving the name NERVE TONIC says Dr. Hughes in his Pharmacodynamics. Like all other acids, it has marked debility and prostration.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Brain-fag, Cough, Debility, Diabetes, Diarrhoea, Enteric fever, Flatulence, Gout, Headache, Locomotor ataxia, Mental weakness, Perspiration, Disorders of pregnancy, Rheumatism, Sexual organs, Spermatorrhoea, Urinary disorders, Vertigo, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on brain, nerves, blood, kidneys, mucous membrane, sex organs and bones.

PATHOGENESIS

It produces both mental and physical debility but the mental symptoms are first to develop. The remedy runs from mental to physical, from brain to muscles (In Muriatic acid, the muscular prostration comes first and the mind seems to be clear until long after the muscles are prostrated i.e. debility runs from body to mind). It also produces haemorrhage, digestive disorders and inflammation of bones.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: It is best suited to persons of originally strong constitution, who have become debilitated BY LOSS OF VITAL FLUIDS, sexual excess, violent acute diseases, chagrin or long succession of moral emotion, grief, care or disappointed affection, Pale sickly complexion, eyes sunken and surrounded by blue margins.

Temperament: Mild disposition and yielding temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasms: Psora, syphilis, sycosis are in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Patients who were originally strong but have become debilitated due to LOSS OF VITAL FLUIDS, sexual excess, violent acute diseases, chagrin or long continued mental emotions such as grief, care and disappointed love.

name: Phosphorus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
‘Phosphorus is one of our best proved and frequently used drugs and besides this, it is a remedy of very definite characteristic symptoms. In Allen’s Encyclopaedia, it has no less than 3,920 recorded symptoms.

Hahnemann by using phosphorus in Homoeo Pharmacy has proved the fact that potentised medicines are no longer subject to chemical laws. As we all know phosphorus in pure crude form, is highly cumbustible if exposed to air, hence dangerous, but when the same is potentised, it becomes one of the leading healers.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anaemia. Asthma, Bone diseases, Brain affection, Cancer, Catarrh, Constipation, Consumption,Cough, Diarrhoea, Dropsy, Ecchymosis, Enteric fever, Epilepsy, Exostosis, Eye affection, Epistaxis, Fatty degeneration, Flatulence, Gastritis, Haemorrhage, Headache, Heart affection, Jaundice, Liver affection, Locomotor ataxia, Marasmus, Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Numbness, Paralysis, Pneumona, Pregnancy—disorders of, Rheumatism, Rickets, Throat and lung affections, Ulcers, Vomiting, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Being one of the polychrest remedies, it acts practically on any and every tissue of the body, particulaly skin and mucous membrane, bones, blood, spinal cord, nerves, heart, liver, kidney, and lungs.

It initiates inflammation and degeneration of mucous membranes irritates and inflames serous membranes, destroys spinal cord and nerves causing paralysis. It also destroys bones, especially of the lower jaw and tibia. Disorganises blood; causes fatty degeneration of heart and liver, with yellow atrophy of liver.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: Phosphorus is best suited for tall, slender persons with narrow chest, who are good and beautiful to look at having fair, thin, transparent skin, delicate eyelashes, fine blond or brownish red hair. Young people who grow too rapidly and are inclined to stoop (walk stopped—Sulphur).

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Hoarseness

Aphonia, larynx is very painful. Clergy man's sore throat; violent tickling in larynx with rawness, cannot talk on account of pain in the larynx,

In Aphonia, when Phos. (Acon., Spongia) fails Cina should be thought of. Hoarseness is worse in the evening while talking, laughing, reading, cold air, etc.

Cough

Side: Left side of the chest is usually affected.

Sensation: As if some weight is lying on the chest. Character of cough: Hard, dry, tight cough, with congestion of lung.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It is always a red-letter day when one makes friendship with a new drug. For drug friendship, one needs to recognise its character and possibilities, to be able to realise the reactions and the response it can produce on human beings. Phytolacca is one of our powerful and promptly acting remedies, says Tyler. We can get the most useful data in regard to this drug FROM HALE’S NEW REMEDIES. Like Baptisia, Gelsemium, Caulophyllum and others, Phytolacca too comes to us from America by observation of the domestic or native practices, but they have been rendered very useful as therapeutic tools in precise indication, obtained by proving on healthy human beings.

According to Kent, Phytolacca can be named as “VEGETABLE MERCURY” like Podo and Mezerium.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Angina pectoris, Boils, Bone affection, Breast affection, Cancer, Cicatrices, Constipation, Cough, Diptheria, Eye troubles, Gonorrhoea, Glandular affection, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Neuralgia, Rheumatism, Respiratory troubles, Sciatia, Syphilis, Ulcers, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Phytolacca acts chiefly upon the glandular system, particularly on the throat and mammary glands. It also affects the serous, fibrous and mucous tissues. PATHOGENESIS

It causes inflammation and irritation of the serous, fibrous, and mucus tissues, skin and periosteum. On the glandular system, it causes tendency to ulceration. CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Emaciated patient, chlorbtic with loss of fat. Face sunken, pale, hippocratic, blue rings around the eyes with yellow complexion. Great exhaustion and profound prostration.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient.

482

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Pains flying like electric shocks, rapidly shifting, shooting, lancinating, worse from motion and at night.

. Right sided affections e.g., shoulders, throat, etc. Chilly patient, worse from cold, damp, rainy weather, relieved by warm application. All the symptoms are worse at night.

There is intense backache and headache, and a sore aching, bruised feeling all over accompanied by restlessness and prostration.

Irresistible desire to bite the teeth or gums together during dentition (Podo.). Burning in throat as from coal of fire or red hot iron. Cannot drink hot liquid. . Uvula is enlarged, dropsical, oedematous, almost translucent (Kali bich., Rhus tox.).

. Breast sensitive, sore, and fissured. Pain radiates from nipple to all over the body, (Pain goes from nipple to back—Croton tig. Pain goes from nipple to uterus, Pulsatilla and Silicea).

10. Breast shows an early tendency to cake; HARD AND PAINFUL.

11. Ulcers are angry looking, red, congested, gaping ulcers with ichorous, unhealthy and foetid discharge.

12. Aggravation from hot fluid and hot application. 13. Ailments from : Abuse of mercury and sypilitic affections.

oP ©

oO AH

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Glandular symptoms

Phytolacca is pre-eminently a glandular remedy, There is glandular swelling with heat and inflammation, especially of the neck, particularly the submaxillary and parotid glands which are very much HARDENED LIKE STONE. The mammary glands are also ENLARGED WITH SORE FEELING. It has got ability fo delay the formation of malignant growth especially in the breast:

Breast

The main centre of action is mammary glands. Almost any and every excitement is concentrated on the mammary gland. NO OTHER DRUG IN OUR MATERIA MEDICA HAS SO MUCH CONCENTRATION ON MAMMARY GLAND AS PHYTOLACCA.

There is mastitis with enlaged auxiliary glands. The look of the mammae is of a purple hue. The mammae are full of HARD AND PAINFUL NODOSITIES. Cancer of breast, which shows an early tendency to cake. IT IS FULL STONY HARD AND VERY MUCH PAINFUL. Irritable breast before and during menses.

There is a tumefaction of the breast which neither heals nor suppurates.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
It exists as bright yellow glistening crystal. It has sour odour, but it has a very bitter taste. It is one of the important medicines for diseases of spinal

origin.

Platinum, the costliest and the heaviest metal in the mineral kingdom, is nick-named by some authors as the “BLACK” LETTER MEDICINE” meaning thereby that the drug has occupied its place in pur pharmacopoeia by causing (in proving) and by curing (in homoeopathic preparation) maladies especially mental or those connected with perverted mental conditions. The curious thing in Platina, is that this mental subconscious state extends outwards into the physical sphere.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Anaemia, Boils. Brainfag. Burns. Debility. Headache, Lumbago. Myelitis. Neurasthania. Paralysis. Priapism. Self-abuse. Spinal diseases. Writers’ Cramp.

SPHERE OF ACTION AND PATHOGENESIS

It causes degeneration of spinal cord with paralysis. It produces a fair picture of “Nervous frustration”. Has also action on blood, genito-urinary system and skin.

CONSTITUTION

Make up suited to dark complexioned persons with dirty appearance about knuckles; anaemic, cachetic persons, worn out persons, who are overtaxed mentally and physically.

Relation with heat & cold : The patient is better by cold air and cold water. Miasms : Psoric, Sycotic & Syphilitic.

Abdominal disorders, Constipation, Convulsion, Delusion, Genital organs, Hysteria, Headache, Labour, Melancholia, Menstrual disorders, Neuraliga, Numbness, Rheumatism, Vag-inismus, etc.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Progressive weariness from a slight feeling of fatigue on motion to complete paralysis.

2) Like all acids, profound weakness and debility run through the whole drug.

3) Burning along spine and great weakness of spine and back, softening of cord (Phos., Zinc).

4) Brain fag : Of literary or business people. Slightest excite-ment, mental exertion or over work brings on headache and causes burning along the spine (Kali Phos.)

5) Headache : Of students, teachers and overworked busi-nessmen, from grief or depressing emotions, occipito-cervical region.Might bandaging (Bell., Arg. Nit.)

6) Heaviness, numbness, formication, and weakness are the words which are the keynotes of this drug.

7) Priapism, with spinal disease there is violent & long last-ing erection. Penis is painfully distended. Great sexual desire with emissions leading to impotency.

1. Sexual organs are exceedingly sensitive, cannot even bear the cloth or napkin to touch the private parts; will go into spasm from an examination; vulva is very painfully sensitive during coitus; will faint during coitus or cannot endure it.

Extremities

Great weakness. Tired heavy feeling all over body, especially of limbs. Worse exertion. Weariness, progressing from a slight feeling of fatigue on motion to complete paralysis. Acute ascending paralysis. Burning along spine and great weakness of spine & back, softening of cord.

General Modalities Amelioration <- From cold air and cold water. Aggravation : Least mental exertion; motion; study; wet weather.

Headache

Causation: From anger, chargin, uterine diseases, fright, vexation, sexual excess, masturbation, etc. Location: Headache may be in the temple, in the top of the head or in the forehead. Sensation: Sensation of numbness in head.

Character of pain: Pain comes gradually and goes gradually (Stannum, Syphilinum), attended with numbness of parts, (Cham., Acon.). There is pressing pain in the head. Tension in the scalp. There is cramp-like constriction of the scalp. Also there is squeezing sensation in the head.

Modalities: Aggravation: in the evening, inside a room, and ameliortion from motion and in open air.

Menses

Duration: Too long lasting.

The menstrual periods sometimes return every fourteen days.

The parts are very much sensitive to touch. During laour the contractions are interrupted by

sensitiveness of vagina and the internal parts. It is impossible for the physician to make the usual

Genital symptoms

Genital organs are exceedingly sensitive. She cannot bear even the napkin to touch her Private parts. She will go into spasm from an examination. There issexual erethysm which isone of the most prominent features of the Platina lady.

There is great nymphomania, especially in a lying in woman, with excessive sexual development in virgins. There is vaginismus with spasm and constriction, although there is unusual sexual excirment and voluptuous crawling in the genitals. Such extreme sensitiveness of the sexual organs make the woman not to wear the pads during menstruation. Vulva is very much painful. It, is not due to any inflammation, but due to HYPERAESTHESIA AND SENSITIVENESS. Therefore, she cannot endure coitus, If coition is attempted; she faints during the act.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Plumbum has been proved by Hering and three other eminent doctors. The metal “LEAD” is used as one of the constituents of paints. Hence symptoms of gradual lead poisoning are commonly met with amongst the painters. Compilation of our Materia Medica is greatly helped by the careful and scientific observation of symptoms brought about by the inadvertent use of the poisonous doses, especially amongst the painters. In the old school, metallic lead was seldom used, being considered as inert, but Boehave gave it internally after reducing it to an impalpable powder for leucorrhoea, dysentery, syphilis and gout. In Homoeopathy, it is used only if the drug fulfils the law of Similia-in relation to the disease.

Physical make-up: Excessive and rapid emaciation, with extreme weakness and anaemia, The look of the face is greasy, shiny, pale yellow and hippocratic. Cheeks are sunken, expressive of great anxiety and suffering.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasm: Syphilis is in the background.

author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Podophyllum grows throughout the United States in damp, sheddy places in wood. It has leaves having 5 to 9 lobes, large white flowers with fruits like small lemon; hence the plant is sometimes called wild lemon. Indian tribes use the roots to expel worms and also drop the juice of the root into the ear to cure deafness. In Homoeopathy it has been introduced by our Master, with its reputation as the VEGETABLE MERCURY.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acidity, Anus—prolapse of, Asthma, Bilious attack, Constipation, Cholera infantum, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Dyspepsia, Female genital organs, Fever, Flatulence, Gallstone, Headache, Jaundice, Liver affection, Tenesmus, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts especially upon the liver and digestive tract, has particular affinity to the mucous membrane, more especially of the duodenum, rectum and glandular structure.

It produces irritation and excessive secretion with a characteristic jelly-like mucus from the intestine. Acting on the liver, it causes torpidity of liver jaundice, portal engorgement with tendency to haemorrhoids and fulness of the superficial veins.

CONSTITUTION Physical make-up: Adapted to persons who suffer from gastro-intestinal derangements, especially after abuse of mercury. Children who suffer from diarrhoea during the time of dentition in hot weather. Temperament: Bilious temperament. Relation with heat and cold: Affected by extremes of heat and cold. Miasm: Psora and syphilis are in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It is pre eminently a right sided remedy e.g. right throat right ovary, right hypochondriun, etc.

It is indicated in chronic sick headache. Time: Periodic headache. Sensation: As if the head would burst.

Modality: Worse in the morning and in hot weather. Concomitants: Headache alternates with diarrhoea; headache in winter and diarrhoea in summer.

Distended abdomen.

Liver region is very painful. The patient constantly rubs and shakes the region of liver with hands. Sensation of weakness and sinking in abdomen. Rumbling and shifting of flatus in abdomen with nausea and vomiting.

There is thirst for large quantity of cold water (Bry).

Constipation

Clay-coloured stool, very much dry, hard vioded with great difficulty. Constipation of bottle fed babies with dry crumbling stool (Alumina).

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Psorinum is one of the greatest anti-psoric polychrest constitutional remedies without which our Materia Medica would not have been completed. It is a nosode being prepared from a disease product i.e., Psoric viruses which, after undergoing the process of potentization, becomes much altered in its nature. The Homoeopathic preparation of it, is not “INERT” in the human economy, but, on the contrary, it is a powerful healing agent. It is a known fact that psora which is the mother of all other miasms, is the only real fundamental cause and producer of a variety of diseases which goes under the name of nervous debility, mania, hysteria and many others excepting the general chancre of syphilis and the condylomatous diseases of sycosis. That is why, great Psorinum can show its magic.

Psorinum should not be given for psora or the psoric diathesis but like every other remedy, upon a strict individualization of the totality of symptoms and then only we realize its wonderful work.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal disorders, Acne, Asthma, Cholera infantum, Cough, Constipation, Debility, Diarrhoea, Diphtheria, Dyspepsia, Ear trouble, Eczema, Enuresis, Glandular affection, Gonorrhoea, Gout, Headache, Influenza, Itching, Liver affection, Polypus, Quinsy, Skin affection, Throat and lung affection, Tonsillitis, Ulcer, ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The therapeutic field of this remedy is found in all the psoric manifestations. Its action is principally centred upon skin, subcutaneous tissues, lungs, intestine, mind and gland.

It produces OFFENSIVENESS OF ALL THE DISCHARGES, All secretions and excretions are of extremely foul, CARRION LIKE ODOUR, having very filthysmell. Acting on intestine, it produces profuse watery diarrhoea, especially in the morning. It also produces otorrhoea which is very much offensive and ichorous.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. In chronic cases when the well selected remedy fails to relieve or permanently improve and when even sulphur seems indicated but fails to act, Psorinum should be thought of.

2. Great debility : Independent of any organic disease, especially the weariness remaining after acute diseases with lack of reaction, i.e, phagocytosis defective, when well chosen remedies fail to act.

3. Extremely chilly : Wants warm clothing even in hot summer weather (Hepar sulph., silicea).

4. All secretions and excretions of the BODY ARE FOUL SMELLING HAVE CARRION LIKE ODOUR.

. Skin eruptions appear in every winter which is dry, thick and dirty looking.

. Hungry in the middle of the night. Must have something to eat.

. Profuse perspiration after acute disease with relief of all sufferings (Nat. mur.).

. There is decided amelioration of all complaints by lying down and by perspiration. . Feels unusually well day before the attack begins.

10. Mind : Very much anxious, full of fear, melancholic, very depressed with suicidal thoughts; despondent. Fears that he will die, that he will fail in business. Religious melancholy, very depressed and despair of salvation. Thinks that he has sinned away his days of grace; he sees darkness around him; feels no joy in his family; despair of recovery from his sickness. Extremely irritable and wants to be alone. Fears that he will die, that he will fail in his business; making his own life and that of those around him intolerable. Anxious, full of fear and evil forebodings (Phos).

11. Ailments from: Suppression of skin eruption, change of weather, exposure to cold, etc.

author: Dubey

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Acne, Abortion, Anaemia, Amenorrhoea, Appetite, Bladder affections, Breast affections, Bronchitis, Catarrh, Chest affections, Chillblains, Cold, Colic, Cough, Diarrhoea, Distension, Dyspepsia, Ear and Eye affection, Fever, Female gential organs, Glandular Ophthalmia, Gonorrhoea, Gout, Haemorrhoid, Headache, Heart affections, Heart bum, Labour, Lactation, Leucorrhoea, Measles, Menstrual disorder, Mumps, Neuralgia, Pregnancy—disorders of, Rheumatism, Respiratory troubles, Sleep, Toothache, Thrist, Urinary affections, Varicose veins, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content: The main seats of action of Pulsatilla are veins, mucous membrane of tongue, stomach, bowels, female genital organs such as ovary, uterus, vagina, eyes and ears.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Headache |s from overloading the stomach, fatty diet and stooping. Location: One sided headache especially in the forehead and temples. Sensation : One sided headache especially in the forehead.

Character: Bruised pain, stupefying headache. There is great heaviness on stooping. Dullness of head; headache with aching pain in the eyes. Throbbing, pressive headache, pressive and constrictive pain in temples; violent pain on one side as if a nail was driven in beating, jerking and lacerating headache.

Modalities: Aggravation by stooping, lying down or exposure to cold, Relief by sitting, in the morning and by pressure.

Concomitants: Confusion in head, vertigo as if intoxicated with nausea and inclination to vomit. Apoplexy with unconsciousness: violent beating in head, pain in the eyeballs.

Eyes

There is dryness of eyes and lids; with sensation as if darkened by mucous. Pressure as from sand in eyes. Conjunctivitis with PROFUSE, THICK, YELLOW, BLAND DISCHARGE; BURNING AND ITCHING in the eyes and inflammation of eyes, margins of eyelids with lachrymation and nightly agglutination. There may be styes, especially on upper eyelids with itching, biting and burning. Opthalmia may also be treated successfully with Pulsatilla.

Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Mouth is dry in the morning without thirst. Bad taste and smell from mouth in the morning. Accumulation of saliva in the mouth. Saliva gives sweetish taste; constant spitting of frothy cotton like mucous (Nux mos.).

Tongue : Loss of taste: nothing tastes good. In catarrh, the tongue is white or yellow and coated with tenacious mucus.

Tongue is parched dry, yet no thirst. Tongue feels too broad and too large; edge of tonque feels sore as if scalded.

Toothache worse in morning and at night and in a warm room, Pain in gums.

Stomach

* Causation: Eating rich and fatty food, fruits, ice-cream, tea, worms in case of children; weakness of stornach, indigestion and suppressed menses. The above factors may cause nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, abdominal colic and diarrhoea. * Nausea: Felt in the throat as if worms are crawling, nausea may end in vomiting. Vomiting of blood or of bilious matter. Therefore, the vomitus is green with pale face and chilliness; but not thirst.

* Epigastric pain: There is pain in the pit of stomach, The character of pain and the accompanying symptoms are just as mentioned above under item No. 4 of the guiding symptoms.

There is sensation of weight as from a stone In the stomah, about an hour after eating. Pressure in pit of stomach after meals with growing distress when stomach is empty.

SPHERES OF ACTION: The main seats of action of Pulsatilla are veins, mucous membrane of tongue, stomach, bowels, female genital organs such as ovary, uterus, vagina, eyes and ears.
PARTICULARS: Headache

Causation : Headache |s from overloading the stomach, fatty diet and stooping. Location: One sided headache especially in the forehead and temples. Sensation : One sided headache especially in the forehead.

Character: Bruised pain, stupefying headache. There is great heaviness on stooping. Dullness of head; headache with aching pain in the eyes. Throbbing, pressive headache, pressive and constrictive pain in temples; violent pain on one side as if a nail was driven in beating, jerking and lacerating headache.

Modalities: Aggravation by stooping, lying down or exposure to cold, Relief by sitting, in the morning and by pressure.

Concomitants: Confusion in head, vertigo as if intoxicated with nausea and inclination to vomit. Apoplexy with unconsciousness: violent beating in head, pain in the eyeballs.

Eyes

There is dryness of eyes and lids; with sensation as if darkened by mucous. Pressure as from sand in eyes. Conjunctivitis with PROFUSE, THICK, YELLOW, BLAND DISCHARGE; BURNING AND ITCHING in the eyes and inflammation of eyes, margins of eyelids with lachrymation and nightly agglutination. There may be styes, especially on upper eyelids with itching, biting and burning. Opthalmia may also be treated successfully with Pulsatilla.

Gastro-intestinal tract :

Mouth : Mouth is dry in the morning without thirst. Bad taste and smell from mouth in the morning. Accumulation of saliva in the mouth. Saliva gives sweetish taste; constant spitting of frothy cotton like mucous (Nux mos.).

Tongue : Loss of taste: nothing tastes good. In catarrh, the tongue is white or yellow and coated with tenacious mucus.

Tongue is parched dry, yet no thirst. Tongue feels too broad and too large; edge of tonque feels sore as if scalded.

Toothache worse in morning and at night and in a warm room, Pain in gums.

Stomach

* Causation: Eating rich and fatty food, fruits, ice-cream, tea, worms in case of children; weakness of stornach, indigestion and suppressed menses. The above factors may cause nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, abdominal colic and diarrhoea. * Nausea: Felt in the throat as if worms are crawling, nausea may end in vomiting. Vomiting of blood or of bilious matter. Therefore, the vomitus is green with pale face and chilliness; but not thirst.

* Epigastric pain: There is pain in the pit of stomach, The character of pain and the accompanying symptoms are just as mentioned above under item No. 4 of the guiding symptoms.

There is sensation of weight as from a stone In the stomah, about an hour after eating. Pressure in pit of stomach after meals with growing distress when stomach is empty.

name: A Nosode
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Pyrogen is a nosode and is prepared from the pus of septic abscess. It corresponds to streptococcus and other antifebrile yaccine. Pyrogen can very conveniently be called a “(OMOEOPATHIC DYNAMIC ANTI-SEPTIC”. The pus from the septic abscess when potentised, serves as a great anti-septic remedy. Pyrogen can be said to be the “ACONITE OF TYPHOID QUALITY OF PYREXIA’.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Bedsores, Constipation, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Eczema, Enteric fever, Heart affection, Labour, Puerperal fever, Ptomaine poisoning, Pyaemia, Sepsis, Ulcers, Vomiting, Urinary disorders, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Pyrogen predominantly acts on blood, heart, cardio-vascular system, gastro-intestinal

tract, skin, mucus membrane and uterus.

The action of Pyrogen results in a septic condition, setting in sapraemia or septicaemia, blood poisoning. It also causes septic fevers, typhoid condition, puerperal

sepsis, diphtheria and the like. “Sepsis” is the essence of the action of Pyrogen.

1. In Sapraemia or septicaemia puerperal or surgical, from ptomaine poisoning or sewer gas infection, when the best selected remedy fails to relieve or permanently

improye. Pyrogen should be thought of.

2. All discharges are horribly offensive—menstrual, lochial, diarrhoea, vomitus,

sweat, breath, etc. (Mere sol., Psor., Kreosote, Baptisia).

3. Chronic complaints that date back to a previous septic condition.

4. The bed feels too hard (Am). Parts rested upon feels sore and bruised (Bapt.) with

rapid decubitus (Carb. acid),

5. The patient is very much restless; must move constantly to relieve the soreness of

parts (Arn., Euph. Rhus., Bapt.).

6. Tongue is very CLEAN AND SMOOTH AS IF VARNISHED AND FIERY red

(Crotalus hor., Per. met. and Apis).

eee

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Septic fever

Pyrogen is a great remedy for ALL TYPES OF SEPTIC FEVER, e.g. typhoid, puerperal fever,

ptomaine poisoning or sewer gas infection, wherever the symptoms peculiar to this drug are present, which are as follows:-

Causation; It is caused by any septic condition such as septicaemia or sapraemia, puerperal or surgical, from ptomaine poisoning or sewer gas infection.

Temperature: Sudden heat with rise of temperature upto 103-106°F. Skin is very dry and burning, may be pale or cold. Heat is followed by cold and clammy sweat. The BED FEELS VERY HARD; parts

rested upon feels sore and burised; rapid decubitus. The patient is very much restless. He must move constantly to get relief from the soreness of parts.

Chill: Chill begins in the back, between the scapulae. Chill is very severe. Feels generally cold, but particularly of extremities and bones.

Sweat: Very offensive sweat; sometimes clammy.

Pulse: Pulse abnormaly rapid, 140-170 per minute, out of all proportion to temperature. Tachycardia.

Tongue: Tongue is very characteristic. Periodically the tongue is CLEAN AND SMOOTH, AS IF VARNISHED AND FIERY RED, large and flabby, dry and cracked, articulation is difficult.

Taste: There is PUS-LIKE taste in the mouth as from an abscess. Occasionally sweetish taste and terribly foetid smell from mouth may also appear.

Discharge: All the discharges are very offensive, such as diarrhoea, vomitus, breath, urine. menstrual blood or lochia.

In septic fever, especially puerperal, Pyrogen has demonstrated its worth as a great Homoeopathic dynamic antiseptic. During the course of diphtheria or typhoid when the best selected remedy fails to relieve of permanently improve.

Vomiting

Vomiting is persistent in Pyrogen. The character of vomitus Is brownish or COFFEE-GROUND and very offensive. In the case of impacted or obstructed bowels, there may be vomiting of stool, stercoracious vomiting. This sort of vomiting may accompany septic fevers,

Diarrhoea

Diarrhoea is HORRIBLY OFFENSIVE (Psor.). Stool is brown or black; painless and involuntary. Stoo! Passes unconsciously along with flatus; uncertain stool.

name: Radium Bromatum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This remedy occupies its place near X-Ray in our homoeopathic Materia Medica. It is a very deep acting, constitutional, polychrest, medicine, useful in dis-eases caused by mixed miasmatic states. Radium was first discovered in 1898 by prof. Madam Curie of Paris. It is an infallible remedy especially in skin lesions and in chronic rheumatic complaints.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Acne. Arthritis. Bony affeciions. Cancer. Caruncle of urethra. Eczema. Epithelioma. Lupus. Naevus. Pruritus vulvae. Pigmented moles. Rodent ulcers. X-Ray bad effects. .

SPHERE OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS

Acts chieflly on skin producing redness, soreness, itching and ulcerations. Also acts on connective tissues like blood, bones, fibrous tissues and mucous membranes. It increases the polymorphs.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) History of repeated exposure to X-ray either for diagnos-tic or therapeutic purpose and/or history of radium therapy—there may be or may not be such history, if symptoms agree, radium should be thought of.

2) When well indicated medicines fail to relieve or cure the mixed miasmatic conditions even after failure of nosodes like medo, syphi, etc. it should be thought of.

3) In mixed misamatic conditions produced by psora, sycosis and syphilis when well selected constitutional medicines does little good to the patient.

4) Various kinds of skin lesions, such as keloids, naevi, pigmented mole, acne rosacea, lupus ete.

5) Old, obstinate, long standing ulcers, cases of rodent ulcers, and ulcers caused by Radium burn which take a long time to heal.

6) Chronic rheumatoid arthritis, osteo arthritis, spondylosis and gout

7) Severe aching pain all over the body, especially in joints with restlessness.

512

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastrointestinal Systems

Stomach : There is warm, empty feeling in stomach better after eating. Nausea & sinking sensation at pit of stomach. Loss of appetite. Aversion to sweet, meat & ice cream.

Abdomen : The abdomen is distended with much foul flatulency. Pain over Me Burney's point and

at location of sigmoid flexure is peculiar symptom of this medicine. It has many alternating symptoms such as indigestion alternates with earache and pain in chest. Alternating constipation and diarrhoea. Yellow soft stools alternate with hard brown stools.

Urinary System : Has to waif some minutes before urine comes : dvsuria during day, urine contains brickdust sediment, albumin and granular casts. There is slight burning in urine. Nephritis with rheumatic symptoms.

Rheumatism

Causation : Bad effects of X-Ray or radium therapy. Location ; Almost all joints of the body are affected.

Sensation : Aching and tired feeling, legs, arms and neck feel hard and brittle as though they would break on moving.

Character of pair-—Severe aching pain all over the body especially in knee and ankles. Sharp electirc shock or lightning like pain in joints. There {s also aching pain and lamenes in back of neck, between shoulders and in lumbo-sacral region. Pain in cervical vertebrae worse bending head forward and better standing or sitting erect. Nephritis with rheumatism,

name: Ranunculus Bulbosus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Ranunculus bulbosus belongs to the natural order Ranunculaceae. This was proved and added to Materia Medica by Franz. The Mother tincture is prepared from the whole plant “buttercup”. The juice is highly excoriating and irritating to skin where it gives rise to many skin eruptions. Just like Rhus tox., it is poisonous and one is very often mistaken for the other. It is an excellent remedy for the bad effects of alcoholism.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Alcoholism, Brain affection, Chest pain, Corns, Delirium tremens, Diarrhoea, Eczema, Intercostal rheumatism, Jaundice, Neuralgia, Skin troubles, Throat and Lung affection, Writers’ cramp, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on mucous membrane and serous membrane, skin, spinal nerves, pleurae and lungs as well as on intercostal muscles.

PATHOGENESIS

It causes irritation and smarting pain of eyes, nose and fauces. It also produces inflammation of the serous membrane, especially pleura and peritoneum where it sets up an acute stabbing pain accompanied by effusion and pleurisy. It irritates spinal nerves and causes INTERCOSTAL RHEUMATISM: NEURALGIA AND MYALGIA OF CHEST.

CONSTITUTION

There is no particular constitution for this drug. The patient however, is very chilly, irritable and quarrelsome, having psoric and gonorrhoea! background and have the rheumatic diathesis,

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It is one of the most effective remedies for the bad effects of alcoholic beverages, spasmodic hiccough and delirium tremens.

2. Day blindness (Hemeralopia) as if there is mist before the eyes. Pressure and smarting pain in eyeballs (Hering).

515

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Throax

Chest region is the main seat of action of Ranunculus bulbosus; whether it is of inter-costal muscles in the form of rheumatism or neuralgia or myalgia or in pleura as pleurisy or in lungs as pneumonia, it matters little, Ranunculus is a great remedy. The cardinal symptoms are as follows:

Chest affections may be caused by exposure to cold when heated or vice versa and physical exertion, etc.

There is heavy, but short breathing with oppression of chest in the evening; sighing respiration.

Muscular pain about the margin of shoulder blades, especially hi woman of sedentary habits with burning, from needle work, typewriting or piano-playing.

intercostal rheumatism.

There is intolerable pain in the chest, It may be rheumatic or neuralgic or myalgic. The pain is stitching, sharp and shooting in character; coming in paroxysm and is excited or brought on by atmospheric change, or inflammation and depend upon spinal irritation.

Pleurisy or pneumonia, caused by sudden exposure to cold while overheated or vice versa may also call for this remedy.

Pain in the chest region if aggravated by touch, motion or turning of the body and in wet stormy weather.

Aggravation: During inspiration and lying on affectd side.

Skin

Ranunculus bulbosus is a good medicine for the skin affections such as HERPES ZOSTER, VESICULAR ERUPTIONS, corns, etc.

name: Raphanus
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This is one of our new remedies. The tincture is prepared from fresh root immediately before flow-ering and also from the whole plant.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Diarrhoea. Flatulence. Globus hystericus. Hysteria. Insomnia—sexual. Nymphomania. Post operative gas pains,

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Incarceration of Flatulence é Accumulation & retention of flatus, no flatus emitted upward or downward’. Abdo-men distended, tympanitic, hard & painful to pressure especially hypogasirium. Distension of abdomen, fol-lowed by griping as if stool would occur. Burning in epigastrium followed by hot eructations.

2) Diarrhoea : Stool brown, liquid, frothy, profuse & expel-led with much force. (Gambogia, croton tig.) It may be yellowish brown & extremely fluid with colic.

3) Urine: Turbid with yeast like sediment. Profuse, thick urine like milk.

4) Nymphomania causing sleeplessness with aversion to her own sex.

5) Mind : Mentally Raphanus patient is characterised by a great dislike to her own sex. There is sadness with aver-sion to children especially girls. It is a good medicine for hysteria with globus symptoms.

Abdo-men distended, tympanitic, hard & painful to pressure especially hypogasirium. Distension of abdomen, fol-lowed by griping as if stool would occur. Burning in epigastrium followed by hot eructations.

2) Diarrhoea : Stool brown, liquid, frothy, profuse & expel-led with much force. (Gambogia, croton tig.) It may be yellowish brown & extremely fluid with colic.

3) Urine: Turbid with yeast like sediment. Profuse, thick urine like milk.

4) Nymphomania causing sleeplessness with aversion to her own sex.

5) Mind : Mentally Raphanus patient is characterised by a great dislike to her own sex. There is sadness with aver-sion to children especially girls. It is a good medicine for hysteria with globus symptoms.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
The Ratanhia tincture is prepared from the roots of krameria triandra, a plant growing in dry argil-laceous and sandy soils of Peru. The colour of the tincture is blood—red. It is a great astringent and a styptic and is consequently used jn passive haemorrhages.

Rumex, the yellow dock, or curled dock, is a common British weed. This medicine was used by the Allopaths for the cure of itch, but we, Homoeopaths, use this medicine for diseases like, laryngitis, bronchitis, asthma and diarrhoea. No doubt, it is indicated in skin diseases as well when the symptoms agree. The leaves of this plant from which the drug is obtained and potentised are found to contain Bin oxalate of Potash. So, most of the symptoms manifested during proving, though partial, resemble those of potassium salts.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Fissures-anal and nipples. Haemorrhages. Haemor-rhoids. Pin worms. Toothache.

SPHERE OF ACTION

It has marked action on Gastrointestinal tract specially rectum & anus, also acts on nipple of breast & teeth.

Abdominal disorders, Aphonia, Asthma, Bronchitis, Catarrh, Cough, Coryza, Diarrhoea, Hoarseness, Phthisis, Rheumatism, Skin affection, Throat and Lung affections, Urticaria, etc.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Excruciating pains after stool ; burning after stool.

2) Fissures of anus with great sensitiveness of rectum.

3) Fissures of nipples in nursing women (Graph. Sep.)

4) Constipation : Hard stool with much straining; haemorrhoids protrude during stool & is followed by long lasting aching and burning in anus. (Sulph.) There is pain after stool as if splinters of glass were sticking in anus & rectum.

5) Burning for hours after each stool is a characteristic symptom and is only relieved by the application of hot water.

6) Terrible toothache during early months of pregnancy; aggravation by lying, compelling to rise and walk about.

7) Pin worms with itching of anus.

In Aesculus the rectum feels full of small sticks like Ratanhia but there is in Aesculus the seasation of fullness, dryness & heat in the rectum with severe dull pain in the lumbo-sacral articulation.

In Paeonia, fissures with much oozing due to ulceration of the mucous membrane of rectum and anus. The parts are usually swollen, offensive and moist all the time.

name: Sensation
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Respiratory Symptoms : Coryza : It suits to both acute and chronic catarrhal states.

Nose is obstructed; dry sensation in posterior nares. Often coryza starts with a marked dryness in the posterior nares. Violent sneezing is a frequent occurrence.

Rheum Baby

The whole body of the Rheum baby smells sour. No amount of washing or bathing can rid it. Sourness pervades the whole system & characterises all the discharges & exhalations of the body. Rheum is suited especially to baby during dentition,

524

Modalities

* Aggravation: In the evening, at night and FROM COLD AIR. ¢ Amelioration: BY WARMTH AND COVERING. Concomitants : This catarrhal state is commonly accompanied by morning diarrhoea.

Cough

Causation: EXPOSURE TO COLD AIR. Location: Lower lobe of left lung is generally affected.(Nat. sulph., Syphilinum).

Sensation: Tickling sensation in throat pit with rawness. Sensation of Jump in throat; descends on swallowing but returns immediately.

Character of cough: Dry, incessant, fatiguing cough, hoarse barking cough WITH TICKLING SENSATION.

Dry teasing cough preventing sleep. Touching the throat-pit causes dry teasing cough. Cough with pain behind the sternum.

Character of sputa: Usually there is no expectortion but sometimes, in the frist stage, there is thin, watery, frothy expectoration; later it becomes yellowish, thick, tough, and tenacious; so ropy and stringy that the patient is exhausted from his efforts to expectorate the tough sputa.

¢ Aggravation: The patient is extremely sensitive to open air. EVEN CHANGING AIR OR ROOM BRINGS ON COUGH; FROM SLIGHTEST INHALATION OF COLD AIR, IN THE EVENING, after lying

down and especially on left side. Touching or pressing the throat pit and lying on left side. Anything which increases the volume or rapidity of inspired air which brings on a paroxysm of cough.

* Amelioration : From warmth, keeping the mouth covered to exclude cold air; COVERING THE BODY WARMLY.

Concomitants; While COUGHING THERE is involuntary urination (Causticum, Arg. nit., Nat. mur.).

Hoarseness

Hoarseness with uncertain voice, with raw sensation in larynx and trachea. There is tickling sensation in throat-pit.

Toothache

Causation: In every spring and fall; SHARP EAST WIND.

Character: There is violent jerking pain involving dental nerves from temple to lower jaw and chin with swollen teeth.

¢ Aggravation : By cold and during a thunder-storm. * Amelioration: By warmth and extemal heat.

Male genital organs

Testes : Orchitis with swelling and induration of testicles. Causation: From suppressed gonorrhoea. Location: Right sided affection. Sensation: Sensation in glands as if they were being, crushed.

Character of pain: Orchitis with much swelling in rheumatic patient. Drawing, tearing pain in spermatic cord. There is swelling of testes with much pain, glands feel crushed, as if drown up.

Modalities

* Aggravation: From taking cold, from sitting on a cold stone, from suppressed gonorrhoea. before a storm especially an electric storm.

¢ Amelioration: From warmth and motion.

Rheumatism

Causation: from cold, damp and WINDY WEATHER. Location: Right side principally affected. Sensation: Sore and bruised feeling,

Character of pain: It is a very useful remedy in gouty patient, who suffer rheumatic pains.

Acute inflammatory swelling of the joints. There Is drawing, tearing pains in all the limbs. The pain sometimes WANDERS FROM ONE JOINT TO ANOTHER. There Is tearing, shooting pain, sore bruised Pain, with stiffness of joints, neck and back,

Pain in dorsal region, extending to arm, pain In bone and periosteum, pain drives him out of bed. Pain in the shoulder joint is so severe that the arm cannot be moved. The patient cannot sleep unless the legs are crossed.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Rheum is our everyday Rhubarb which grows plentifully in China. Hahnemann’s proving of Rheum has confirmed many of its traditional uses. This medicine is prepared from the powdered root.

Rhododendron is an evergreen shrub found growing largely on the mountain tops of Siberia and is locally named as snow rose. For the Homoeopathic purpose, the tincture is prepared from the dried leaves of this plant. This remedy deserves a place in our Materia Medica by reason of its extensive use in RHEUMATIC AND GOUTY COMPLAINTS. In support of the doctrine of signature, CLARKE SAYS, “Growing among the fogs and storms of the Siberian mountains, its provings show that it produces, sensitiveness to storm and weather changes, and this gives the grand key-note for it in our Materia Medica”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Colic. Dentition-difficult. Diarrhoea.

1) Suited to children especially during dentition.

2) Sour smell of the whole body ; child smells sour, even after washing or bathing (Hep. Mag C.)

3) Profuse & constant sweat on scalp ; whether asleep or awake, quiet or in motion, the hair is always wet; may or may not be sour. (Calc. Sanic.).

4) Child is restless, irritable, peevish with pale face and sour smell during difficult dentition. —

5) Desires various kinds of food, but canjjot eat them ; becomes repugnant.

6) Colic : Aggravated at once while uncovering an .arm or leg and standing ; Not better by stool. Colic with sour stool.

7) Children cry & toss about all night (Psor.)

8) Ailments from : Eating unripe fruits, Dentition.

9) Mind : Mentally he is impatient & vehement, Ugly & impossible to satisfy. He screams, kicks & makes himself decidedly unpleasant. He cries & tosses about all night. Desires various kinds of food but cannot eat them ; becomes repugnant. He desires many things and cries. He dislikes even favourite playthings.

Amenorrhoea, Bone affection, Bunions, Ciliary Neuralgia, Earache, Eye affections, Flatulence, Lumbago, Neuralgia, Orchitis, Rheumatism, Toothache, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It has a limited sphere of action on fibrous tissues particularly on big joints and the vertebral column. Serous membrane, pleura and synovial membranes also come under its action.

PATHOGENESIS

It acts as an irritant and produces excessive secretion from the synovial membranes in the joint and causing all the signs and symptoms of inflammation, Fibrous tissues get inflamed producing rheumatic and gouty changes, Pleurisy results when the pleura gets affected but usually of the wet type.

CONSTITUTION

Temperament : Nervous patients who DREAD A STORM.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient.

Miasm: Psora is in the background,

Diathesis: Rheumatic and gouty diathesis,

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content: 1. Dread of a storm is the key-note of this remedy.

name: Rhus Toxicodendron
author: Dubey

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Rhus is a native medicine of the North America and {s one of those most valuable medicines which we owe to the domestic practice of the North American Indians. Hahnemann in his Materia Medica Pura praised this medicine as a remarkable and valuable medicinal substance having a great number of characteristic peculiarities in its action. There are other members of the Rhus family which are also used in the Homoeopathic Therapeutic.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abortion, Beriberi, Cough, Chilblains, Cyanosis, Dengue fever, Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Eczema, Enteric fever, Erysipelas, Eye and Ear affection, Gout, Headache, Herpes zoster, Lumbago, Measles. Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Paralysis, Ptosis, Pyaemia, Rheumatism, Restlessness, Sciatica, Sleep, Sprain, Tongue affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Rhus tox. acts predominantly upon the organs of animal life, upon the mucous membrane, lymphatic glands, skin, muscular tissues and component parts of joints e.g. LIGAMENTS, FIBROUS TISSUES. TENDONS, etc.

By its actions, it produces a condition of primary irritation of serous membrane which may proceed to inflammation or if it stops, it produces serous discharge, effusion and oedema. On the skin it produces theumatoid inflammation, eruptions, burning and itching. The lymph glands throughout the body enlarge and inflame under the influence of Rhus tox. When circulatory system becomes the seat of its action, it causes a state of blood poisoning typhoid like symptoms and febrile disturbances. Intermittent fevers, etc. are also noticed.

CONSTITUTION

Since it is more or less an acute remedy, the physical, make-up or temperament, is not of much importance. However, the patient is very chilly, easily susceptible to cold and aggravated by cold in general.

Relation with heat and cold: Very CHILLY patient. Even open air is intolerable. Miasm: Psora is in the background of all the troubles. Diathesis: Rheumatic and gouty diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It is one of the NASH’S TRIO OF RESTLESS MEDICINES. CANNOT STAY IN ONE PLACE. MUST CHANGE POSITION FREQUENTLY TO OBTAIN RELIEF FROM PAIN (others of the trio are Aconite and Arsenic).

_—

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: FROM BEER or too much summer bathing.

Sensation: Brain feels loose when stepping or shaking the head, Sensation of swashing in brain: stupefying; brain feels as if torn.

Location: Frontal headache especially.

Modalities

* Aggravation; By sitting or lying in cold. * Amelioration; By warmth and motion. Concomitants: Vertigo when standing or walking, aggravation when lying down, stooging (Bry.), and amelioration when rising from bed.

Cough

Causation: From exposure to cold or even to open air, putting hand outside from under the bed cover brings on cough.

PARTICULARS: Headache

Causation: FROM BEER or too much summer bathing.

Sensation: Brain feels loose when stepping or shaking the head, Sensation of swashing in brain: stupefying; brain feels as if torn.

Location: Frontal headache especially.

Modalities

* Aggravation; By sitting or lying in cold. * Amelioration; By warmth and motion. Concomitants: Vertigo when standing or walking, aggravation when lying down, stooging (Bry.), and amelioration when rising from bed.

Cough

Causation: From exposure to cold or even to open air, putting hand outside from under the bed cover brings on cough.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Amongst many remedies in our Materia Medica, for injuries caused by mechanical devices and appliances, Ruta is one possessing prime importance. This is prepared from a shrub-like plant indigenous in Europe and is widely cultivated in the gardens. The juice of the plant is capable of causing irritation and inflammation of the skin when touched. The mother tincture is prepared from the fresh herb collected before blooming. The irritating and inflammatory character of the plant is transformed into an excellent therapeutic property after undergoing the process of potentization.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Amblyopia, Bone diseases, Bruises, Chest affections, Constipation, Enuresis, Eye affections, Facial paralyasis, Fracture, Haemorrhage, Injury, Prolapse of Uterus, Rheumatism, Sciatica, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on bones, periosteum, joints, eyes, urinary bladder, uterus and skin.

Its action on the bones, periosteum and joints produces symptoms of a rheumatic nature, periostitis and exostosis; in the eyes, errors of xaccommodation and vision, also causes prolapse of rectum, urinary troubles, metrorrhagia and miscarriage.

CONSTITUTION

There is no particular constitution of the patient as such. However, there are scrofulous exostosis and warts, especially on the palm of the hand.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Miasms: Psora and sycosis are in the background,

1. Sore, lame, bruised feeling over the entire body, as after a blow, fall or any sort of mechanical injury especially of bones and periosteum.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eyes

Causation: Eye troubles are caused by mechanical injuries and overstrain of ocular muscles.

Character of pain: There is severe aching in and over the eyes, with blurred vision as if they had been strained; after fine work, watch making, engraving or looking intensely. AMBLYOP1A AND ASTHENOPIA from over strain of eyes or anomalies of refraction, from overuse in bad light, fine sewing. over-reading at night in dimlight. Consequently there is misty feeling before the eyes, with dim vision. diplopia (Gels. Syphilinum), with complete obscuration of sight at a distance. Eyes burn, ache.red. feel strained and hot like fire with spasm of lower lids.

Injury

As a result of mechanical injuries, sprain, bruised injuries, fall or blow, etc. there may be SCROFULOUS EXOSTOSIS, SPRAINS, PERIOSTITIS, ERYSIPELAS, FRACTURES AND DISLOCATION. There is bruised, lame and sore feeling all over the body which is worse in the limbs and joints.

All parts of the body upon which the patient lies are painful as if bruised (Bapt., Phyto., Nux mos.. Ham.). Due to the intolerable pain, the patient is very much restless and, therefore, changes position quite frequently when lying. Lameness after sprain, especially of WRISTS AND ANKLES.

Phthisis after mechanical injuries of chest is also successfully treated by this remedy.

Quite often following mechanical injuries, constipation from inactivity or Inypaction may also be dealt With by this drug.

name: Sabadilla
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Sabadilla first appears in homoeopathic literature as one of Stapf's additions, The drug was first proved by Samuel Hahnemann. Dr. N.M. Choudhury has justified in calling this remedy as a great sneezing remedy of our Materia Medica.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Coryza. Diphtheria. Hay asthma. Headache. Influenza. Intermittents. Throat-sore, Tonsillitis, Worms.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It affects the mucous membrane of respiratory tract, lachrymal glands and nerves.

Acting on mucous membrane of the nose & the lachrymal glands, it produces coryza & symptoms like hay—fever.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up : It is suited to persons of light hair, fair complexion with a weak, relaxed muscular system.

Relation with heat & cold ; Chilly patient. Miasm : It is an anti-psoric remedy.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Sneezing in spasmodic paroxysms, followed by Lachrymation.

2) Copious watery Coryza with hot flush and red and burning eye lids.

3) Twitching, Convulsion, tremblings and catalepsy, from worms (Cina, Psor.)

4) Illusion : (i) that he is sick. (ii) that she is pregnant when only disten-ded with flatus, (iii) that parts are shrunken, (iv) that she has cancer in throat.

537 {ir

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : From too much thinking ; too close application or attention, from worms. Sensation : There is boring, burning and pressive pain in head with heaviness of head.

Concomittant: Headache with vertigo as if things were turning around him or as if all things were turning around each other. It is accompanied by blackness before eyes and sensation of fainting.

Modalities

Aggravation: In forenoon, cold, mental exertion, thinking.

Nose

Being a topmost sneezing remedy it is indicated in hay fever, influenza etc. There is spsmodic paroxysmal sneezing with copious water discharge from nose. Face is hot and eye lids red and burning with lachrymation. There may be severe pain in frontal region of head with coryza. Influenza with violent spasmodic sneezing and lachrymation on going to open air.

Throat

Sabadilla is specially indicated in tonsillitis and diphtheria. Location : Being on the left side and extended to the right side.

Sensation : Sensation of a skin hanging loosely in throat, must swallow over it. Sensation of a lump in throat with constant necessity to swallow, There is dryness of fauces andthroat, empty swallowing is most painful & patient can swallow warm food more easily. Patient imagines that she has some horrible throat disease that will be fatal.

Modalities

Aggravation : Cold air, cold food & drinks. Amelioration : Warm food and drink.

name: Sabina
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This drug was first proved by Hahnemann and is one of our important haemorrhagic medicines. Old school uses the roots of the plant to produce miscarriage. Hahnemann provedit for the prevention of abortion especially at the third month. Sabiha may be said to be predominantly female remedy.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abortion, Condylomata, Cystitis, Gonorrhoea, Gout, Leucorrhoea, Menstural disorders, Miscarriage, Rheumatism, Skin troubles. Uterine affection, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts especially upon the uterus, serous and fibrous tissues.

PATHOGENESIS

It causes widespread irritation, congestion and inflammation of uterus and serous and fibrous tissues resulting in uterine and rheumatic symptoms.

CONSTITUTION

It is especially suited to chlorotic women, having tendency to miscarriage, particularly in the third month.

Relation with heat and cold: Hot patient. Miasm: Sycosis is in the background. Diathesis: Haemorrhagic and gouty diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Music is intolerable. (Aconite, Graph., Thuja, Nat. carb., Nat. sulph.) Music produces nervousness and goes through the bone and marrow.

. There is DRAWING PAIN FROM SACRUM TO PUBES in nearly all diseases.

. Ailments after abortion or premature labour.

. Violent pulsation all over the body.

. The patient is hot, disturbed by heat, worse in a warm room, wants doors and windows open and to be ifi the open air.

aoe WC NW

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
menses : It is useful in menorrhagia, metrorrhagia or dysmenorrhoea. Quantity: Too profuse. Duration: Too long lasting.

Character of blood: Flow in paroxysms, which is too protracted. Flow is bright red, liquid and intermingled with clot i.e. partly fluid and partly clotted, especially in those ladies who have menarche very early

Character of pain: During the menses the lady suffers from bearing down, labour-like pain which is drawing in character in small ol back especially FROM SACRUM TO PUBES.

Modality: Aggravation FROM LEAST MOTION, but flow ceases when walking about (Clarke).

Concomitants: Discharges of blood between periods with sexual excitement. The lady gives the history of rheumatism especially in lower limbs. There may also be history of gonorrhoea. Such ladies have GREAT INTOLERANCE OF MUSIC.

Abortion

Sabina is especially indicated in those ladies who have menarche very early in their lives having the tendency to miscarriage, abortion, especially at third month (puls., Secale cor., Belladonna) with severe pain in the abdomen. There is shooting-pain from back to front, bearing down labour-like pain FROM SACRUM TO PUBES.

During abortion: The striking features in this drug at the time of abortion are flow of liquid, bright red, copious blood, which is intermingled with clot; in other words, the flow is partly fluid and partly clotted. This type of symptoms occur over and over again.

After abortion: There is inflammtion of ovaries and uterus after premature labour or abortion. There is violent pain through ovaries and uterus. Aching pain in the back especially in sacrum and thence to pubes as if broken, as if bones were separated (opposite to sepia, where the pain is from front to back).

There is most violent, tearing, throbbing pain with copious haemorrhage accompained by uterine colic, RETAINED PLACENTA, ATONY OF UTERUS, AND VESICULAR MOLE.

At the time of climacteric: At the time of climacteric period the patient has repeated uterine

haemorrhage of bright red blood, intermingled with clot and pain from sacrum to pubes. She becomes exhausted and anaemic.

N.B. : The shooting pain from back to front and from sacrum to pubes with hae norrhages are the striking features of corroborations In abortion and haemorrhage. In abortion, it differs from BELLADONNA which is also an important remedy for abortion especially at the third month. But Belladonna has also got the same bearing down pain with bright red blood, followed by expulsion of clot, But the Belladonna state is not like that of Sabina. In Belladonna, there are hyperaesthesia and Versensitiveness to touch, jar and motion. The patient will not allow anyone to touch even the nurse.

name: Sambucus Nigra
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Chest oppression of, Goryza, Cough, Croup, Headache, Hoarseness, Perspiration, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seat of action of Sambucus nigra is the mucous membrane of respiratory organs, nasal passage, larynx, chest and skin. PATHOGENESIS

Its action on the mucous membrane results in difficult spasm of the respiratory organs, dyspnoea, coryza and suffocative cough. It also produces profuse debilitating sweat, especially during waking hours. In addition, it causes oedematous swellingon various parts of the body particularly legs.

CONSTITUTION

Make-up of the body: It is adapted to persons who were formerly robust and fleshy, but suddenly became emaciated; and to the diseases of scrofulous children with affection of the air passage especially.

Relation with heat and cold: Very chilly patient. Miasm: Psora is in the background, Diathesis: Scrofulous diathesis.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Respiratory organs

Sambucus affects especially the mucous membrane of the respiratory organs and following are its cardinal symptoms.

The remedy is indicated in catarrhal affections of the air passages with suffocative attack.

There is DRY CORYZA. The nose is completely dry and stopped up. Breathing through the nose is most difficult, if not impossible, especially while nursing.

The suffocative attack comes particularly after mid-night and the patient is compelled to wake up suddenly and sit up in bed panting for breath; but unable to breathe; turns blue and cyanosed; face becomes livid. The attack passes off after sometime, but again returns after a short while.

The patient can INSPIRE WELL, BUT CANNOT EXPIRE, regular inhalation but sighing expiration. The patient sleeps into attack.

The attack of suffocation is in the last stage of croup. Hoarseness with much tenacious mucus in

larynx.

The couigh is very much suffocative; hollow, deep coughing, with spasm of the chest. There is much mucus in the bronchi; expectoration is very difficult.

Cough is deep and dry, precedes the fever paroxysms. There Is profuse debilitating sweat over the entire body during waking hours;; disappears as soon as the patient sleeps.

Fever

During fever, there is dry heat while the patient sleeps or on falling asleep. The patient dreads uncovering wants to cover up completely.
