The remedy is indicated in catarrhal affections of the air passages with suffocative attack.

There is DRY CORYZA. The nose is completely dry and stopped up. Breathing through the nose is most difficult, if not impossible, especially while nursing.

The suffocative attack comes particularly after mid-night and the patient is compelled to wake up suddenly and sit up in bed panting for breath; but unable to breathe; turns blue and cyanosed; face becomes livid. The attack passes off after sometime, but again returns after a short while.

The patient can INSPIRE WELL, BUT CANNOT EXPIRE, regular inhalation but sighing expiration. The patient sleeps into attack.

The attack of suffocation is in the last stage of croup. Hoarseness with much tenacious mucus in

larynx.

The couigh is very much suffocative; hollow, deep coughing, with spasm of the chest. There is much mucus in the bronchi; expectoration is very difficult.

Cough is deep and dry, precedes the fever paroxysms. There Is profuse debilitating sweat over the entire body during waking hours;; disappears as soon as the patient sleeps.

Fever

During fever, there is dry heat while the patient sleeps or on falling asleep. The patient dreads uncovering wants to cover up completely.

name: Sanguinaria Canadensis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Blood root is used to be one of the oldest domestic remedies. In winter season, farmers wives would not forget to keep always blood root in their house. In the cold winter days when the coryza comes on, with a cold in the head, chest, throat, then they get hold of the blood root and make a cup of tea with it which was a routine drug to combat all complaints from cold, Even in this crude form it is used to break up colds.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Alcholism, Asthma, Breast affection, Bronchitis, Cancer, Catarrh, Chest affection,

Cold, Dyspepsia, Headache, Influenza, Menstrual disorders, Pneumonia, Rheumatism, Vomiting, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Sanguinaria acts chiefly upon the mucous membrane, especially of the respiratory tract. It has marked vasomotor disturbances. PATHOGENESIS

It irritates the mucous membrane and produces catarrhal inflammation. It also causes derangement of liver and the digestive tract. CONSTITUTION

Since it is more or less an acute drug, no importance is attached to the constitution as such. The patient is however, CHILLY, with psora in the background, having tubercular diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Highly chilly patient; very much susceptible to cold, even gets affected by a change of weather.

2. It is a right sided remedy. Right sided affections of the whole body e.g., head, chest, lungs, arm, shoulders, ete.

3. There is CIRCUMSCRIBED REDNESS OF THE CHEEKS, especially in the afternoon and the respiratory diseases e.g., in bronchitis, pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, etc.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Location: Right sided headache. Headache begins in the occiput, spreads upwards and settles over the right eye (Sil.—Left orbit, Spig.).

Sensation : As if head would burst or as if eyes would be pressed out.

Character of headache: Periodic sick headache, returns at the climacteric, every seventh day: sun headache.

Throbbing, pulsating and congestive headache.

Modalities

* Aggravation: Begins in the morning, increases during the day, lasts until evening. ¢ Amelioration: By sleep and by perfectly lying quiet in a dark room. Concomitants: Neuralgia of face; pain extends to all directions from the upper jaw; relieved by kneeling down and pressing the head firmly against the floor.*~ Respiratory Symptoms : Nose : Catarrhal affection of the nose. Nose filled up with mucus and blocked up. From nose. there is a profuse, thick, yellowish discharge coming out. Nasal polyp (Psor., Allium cepa, Teuc. mv}

Cough

Causation: From taking cold, from draught of cold air, change of weather, after whooping cough. Location: Right side of the chest is affected most. Sensation: Burning and sorness in chest. Character of cough: Spasmodic cough with gagging and vomiting.

Cough of gastric origin; every cough ends in belching. Severe pain in the larynx and trachea When talking. Severe cough, especially at night, making the patient get up and not ceasing until he sits up in bed and passes flatus.

With cough there is thick, yellowish, offensive sputa being coughed out.

name: Sanicula
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
From water of a mineral spring of Ottawa, proved, as to its deleterious effects by Dr, J.G. Gundlach who, with his family drank it for more than a year, and who was still suffering from its effects five years later. The evaporated, triturated and potentised salt, was proved in the usual way under the auspices of the American doctor, Sherbina, Sanicula is chiefly the children’s remedy of our materia medica. It is a deep acting, constitutional polychrest remedy and should be prescribed in higher potencies.

Clinical: Car sickness. Constipation. Dandruff. Diarrhoea. Emaciation. Excoriations. Foot sweat. Indigestion. Leucorrhoea. Marasmus. Ossification too early. Prolapse of Uterus. Vomiting. Urine & Faeces-in-continence of.

SPHERE OF ACTION

It has action all over the body especially gastrointestinal tract, nervous system, female sexual organs & skin,

CONSTITUTION

Physical make up—Sanicula child looks old, dirty, greasy & brownish. Skin about neck wrinkled, hangs in folds, scaly dandruff on scalp, eyebrows and beard.

Heat cold relation—Not stamping. Temperament—Mentally head strong and obstinate. Miasm—Psoric & Sycotic miasms are in the background. Diathesis—Scrofulous, diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Dread of downward motion (Bor.)

2) Child headstrong, obstinate, cries and kicks ; does not want to be touched.

3) Head & neck sweat profusely and while sleeping wets pillow far around (Cale., Sil.)

4) Premature ossification of bones.

5) Tongue : Large, flabby, burning, must protrude it to keep it cool; ringworm on tongue (Nat. M.)

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Gastrointestinal Symptoms

Mouth : Tongue is large flabby and burning, must protrude to keep it cool. Ringworm on the tongue.

Stomach : Stomach is disordered from jarrying. Nausea & vomiting from carriage riding. Thirst for little quantity of water very often. Water is vornited as soon as it reaches the stomach. Appetite is increased, hungry before meals. He craves fat, bacon & salt.

Rectal Symptoms :

Constipation : In Sanicula there is no desire until a large accumulation ; after great straining stool partially expelled, recedes back again (Sil., Thuja.) Crumbling at verge of anus (Mag M.) ; large evacuation of small dry, gray balls, must be removed mechanically. (Sil. Calc.) stool is hard, impossible to evacuate : of grayish white balls, like burnt lime and with the odour of limburger cheese.

Diarrhoea : Changeable in character and colour. Stool Is frothy, grass green, turns green on standing. It looks like scrambled egg or scum of a frogpond. (Helb, Mag carb) After eating patient must hurry from table. The odour of stool follows despite bathing (Sulph.) No. amount of washing can make him get rid of it. Incontinence of faecs and urine. Sphincters unreliable so there is urging from flatus, patient must cross legs to prevent faeces escaping. Female genital symptoms ; It acts on female genital organs producing leucorrhoea and prolapsus uteri. Leucorrhoea with strong odour offish brine is a characteristic symptom of sanicula.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Sarsaparilla is a wonderful medicine for the |[FR4 7%

age

urinary troubles of peculiar characteristic symptoms. The mother tincture is prepared from the dried root. It is also a kind of restorative after an exhausting course of mercury. Hahnemann’s provings have amply justified the above facts.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Asthma, Bladder affection, Bone affections, Breast affections, Bright’s disease, Catarrh, Constipation, Fever, Gonorrhoea, Gout, Gravel, Headache, Herpes, Rheumatism, Skin troubles, Urinary disease, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts on urinary organs, genitals, rectum, skin, bones, and right lower part of the body. PATHOGENESIS

It acts on kidney and urinary organs producing renal colic, renal and bladder stone and consequential urinary troubles. It also acts on skin causing various kinds of eruptions, rash, cracks and fissures. Furthermore, rheumatic affections, periostea! pains, etc. are also within the range of its action.

CONSTITUTION

Look of the patient: Lean, thin and debilitated persons with dark hair and shrivelled skin which lies loose in folds. In children the face looks like that of an old man with enlarged abdomen, dry and flabby skin, with various skin eruptions and cracks and fissures, especially in hands and feet.

Relation with heat and cold: Easily affected by cold in general, Miasm: It covers all the three miasms, psora, syphilis and sycosis. Diathesis: LITHIC and scrofulous.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. It is a RIGHT SIDED REMEDY (Lyco., Caust., Sang., Bry., Kali. carb.).

2. THERE IS SEVERE, UNBEARABLE PAIN AT THE CONCLUSION OF URINATION, just as urine ceases to flow (Berb. vulgaris, Med., Thuja).

pe

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Urinary symptoms

Sarsaparilla is an excellent remedy for the urinary troubles brought on or aggravated by abuse of mercury, due to syphilis or gonorrhoea, the cardinal symptoms of which are as follow =

There is severe, almost UNBEARABLE PAIN AT THE CONCLUSION OF URINATION just as urine ceases to flow (Berb., Med., Thuja).

Quite frequently, passage of gravel or or small calculi and white sand in urine, or on diaper (brown sand, Phos., red sand, Lyco.).

Right sided renal colic: There is excruciating pain from the right kidney to downwards (Lyco.}.

Child screams and cries before and during passing urine due to pain caused by the passage of small stones (Bor., Lyco.).

Urine may be scanty or copious, bloody or bright and clear, but irritating; flaky and sandy: passes without any sensation (Caust., Arg nit.).

There is painful distention, and tenderness in the bladder. Urine dribbles while sitting, passes freely while standing. Air passes from the urethra. Modalities: Sitting and motion aggravate many symptoms. Amelioration: By standing and rest. wine is an intolerable bad smell (stench) on genital organs with bloody seminal emission and fluid ons.

Skin

Sarsaparilla is a very good remedy for the skin troubles caused by psora, mercurial, syphilitic or gonorrhoea! affections, if following symptoms are found.

Skin is loose, shrivelled or lies infolds and flabby. The skin is hard and indurated.

There are herpetic eruptions on all parts of the body; ulcers after abuse of mercury in syphilis.

From the exposure to open air there may be rash and dry itch like eruptions, which are prone to appear in spring and they are generally crusty.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This is a remedy obtained from one of the poisonous plants—Fungi—which was used in good old days as an abortificient. It is still in practice in some of the rural areas where illegal abortions are in vogue. In the Homoeopathic world, it was HALE, who introduced this poisonous fungi as a reliable therapeutic tool.

Nervous temperament.

sections.content:
Selenium, an element, was first discovered in 1818 by Berzelium. In homoeopathy it was introduced and proved by Dr. Hering. Selenium is a constant constituent of bones and teeth. It is one of the topmost remedies for sexual weakness.

WINE RELATION

Clinical: Alcoholism, Aphonia, Constipation, Debility, Hair falling out, Headache, Hoarseness, Impotency, Laryngitis, Liver-affection of, Priaprism, Pros-iatitis, Prostatorrhoea, Psoriasis. Spermatorrhoea.

Constitution & physical make-up : Adapted to light complex-ion & blondes ; there may be great emaciation of face, hands, legs and feet or single parts.

Relation with heat and cold : Hot patient. Complaints aggra-vate from hot weather but patient sensitive to draft of air also. Miasm : Syphilis : and Psora.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Great weakness, weak, easily exhausted from either men-tal or physical labour after typhoid, typhus, debauchery.

2) Irresistible desire to lie down and sleep, strength sud-denly leaves him ; especially in hot wether.

3) Very forgetful in business, but during sleep dreams of what he had forgotten.

4) Very great aversion to draft of air-either cold, damp or warm.

5) Longing for spirituous liquors, an almost irresistible, maniacal desire; hungry at night (Cina, Psor).

6) Hair falle off: on head, eyebrows, whiskers, genitals.

7) Constipation: Stool large hard, impacted, so tHat it requires mechanical aid (Aloe, Calc, Sani, Sep, Sil).

8) Urine dribbles involuntarily, while walkhig. Urine is dark, red & scanty with coarse, red, sandy sediment.

9) Impotency with lewd thoughts & desire, but physically impotent.

10) Involuntary dribbling of semen and prostatic fluid which oozes while sitting, at stool, during sleep.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation : Debauchery. Tea. Lemonade. Wine. Location : Pain over left eye.

Character of headache

There is violent attacks of lancinating pains in head above left eye with desire to lie down. Head-ache every afternoon; Headache in old drunkards.

Aggravation:Walking in the sun, strong odours, tea.

Gastrointestinal Symptoms

Throat : Selenium is a very useful remedy in hoarseness, aphonia even in incipient tubercular laryngitis. Aphonia after long use of voice. Voice is husky when beginning to sing, there is hawking & raising of transparent lumps of mucus like a starch. Patient must clear throat frequently. There may be cough in the moming with bloody expectoration.

Stomach : Causation of stomach ailments : Sugar, Salt food, tea, lemonade.

Longing for spirituous liquors—an almost maniacal desire. Sweetish taste in mouth with thick white coating of tongue in the morning. Hiccough and eructations after smoking. There is pressure in the stomach as if cramp would occur. Hunger at night.

Abdomen : Chronic liver affections with painful enlarged liver and fine rash over liver region.

Constipation ; Causation ; Constipation after serious illness especially enteric fevers. Stool is hard, large and is very much impacted. Stool has to be removed mechanically,

Male Sexual symptoms

This remedy has a very marked action on male genital system and is quiet a favourite remedy with homoeopaths for the ills and abuses of sexual system such as impotency, spermatorrhoea, prostatorrhoea, priapism etc. Debility—weakness of sexual organs is a characteristic feature. There is desire, lewd thoughts but the patient is physically impotent. It increases desire, decreases ability. Loss of sexual power with lascivious fancies. Erections slow, insufficient, too rapid emission with long continued thrill.

name: Sepia
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Popularly known as the “Washer Woman's remedy”. Sepia is one of the _ greatest contributions to Homoeopathy, by Master Hahnemann.

The crude substance for preparation of this wonderful constitutional remedy is a_ liquid contained in the ‘INK BAG’ of the Cuttle fish. This brownish black substance is ejected out by the fish from its gland to protect itself from any external aggression. A very small insignificant quantity of this ink is capable of making the whole water around the fish completely dark so that the enemy would get confused arid lose sight of the fish and thus it can ascape unhurt. The drug substance thus possesses the great potential power in its inherent, dormant and latent state which when aroused is capable of curing a variety of diseases, particularly chronic, in nature in the same way as the cuttle-fish protects itself from any

dangerous enemy.

Hahnemann got the clue to initiate proving of this remedy from a patient, who was in the regular habit of wetting his brush containing Indian Ink with his own saliva. Every time he did so, a very small portion of the ink would naturally find its way into the stomach to be absorbed by the system. By and by, he developed certain chronic ailments. Hahnemann treated him with all the then known similimums to he best of his skill and ability but without any appreciable benefit. Excepting that his habit of wetting his brush with his own saliva and consequent affection of the ink, would have been the maintaining cause, the artist was advised to discontinue with his profession. The artist obeyed him and he was completely redeemed of all his chronic ailments. This unique pleasant experience ultimately led him to prove Sepia for the benefit of generations of mankind.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdominal disorders, Amenorrhoea, Apoplexy, Asthma, Cough, Cancer, Dyspepsia. Eczema, Eye affection, Female genital organs, Gout, Gonorrhoea, Headache, Jaundice, Leucorrhoea, Liver affection, Preganancy, Psoriasis, Prolapse of uterus, Ptosis, Sciatica, Toothache, Urinary troubles, Uterus bearing down, Varicose veins, Whooping cough, ete.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content: Sepia acts of female genital organs, gastrointestinal tract, liver and portal system, skin, glands and nervous system.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Lack of vital heat, especially in chronic diseases.

2. Weakness and bearing down sensation; must sit close and cross her legs to prevent something from coming down the vagina (Murex).

3. Pains extends from other parts to the back.

4. Painful sensation of emptiness, “ALL GONE FEELING IN THE STOMACH RELIEVED BY EATING.

. Sense of fulness in the pelvic organs and pressure down into the anus. . Sensation of a ball in inner parts.

. Flushes of heat and perspiration.

. General relaxation, weak, faint, empty feeling while kneeling at church.

. Dyspnoea aggravated by sitting, after sleep in room, but relieved by dancing or walking rapidly.

10. Very sensitive to cold air “CHILLS SO EASILY”.

11, Drooping of eye-lids with catarrhal discharge (Gels., Rhus tox., Causticum, Caulophyllum).

oonna om

12. Faints easily from extremes of heat and cold,

13. Desire for acids, vinegar, pickles, sweets, to be let alone, bread, butter, soup, wine, spicy, pungent and bitter things. Aversion to smell of food, milk, tobacco and meat.

14. The sight or even the thought of food sickens; the smell of cooking food nauseates (Ars., Colchicum, Stannum met.).

15, Mind : Sepia patient manifests some peculiar and striking mental conditions which are as follows: -

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Head

There is rush of blood to head. Vertigo with sensation of something rolling around in head.

There is violent pressive headache in terrible shocks at menstrual nisus, with scanty flow: sensation as if head would burst.

Great falling of hair, after chronic headache at the climacteric period.

Headache of delicate sensitive and hysterical women. Pressing and bursting headache, aggravated by stooping, mental labour and relieved by external pressure and continued motion,

Herpes behind ears, on nape of neck, pain as if from subcutaneous ulceration, swelling, eruption on external ear.

Stomach

Feeling of emptiness, all-gone sensation In the pit of stomach, relieved by eating.

Nausea and vomiting at smell or sight and even thought of food. Nausea worse when lying on side and nausea from tobacco smoking.

Nausea in the morning before eating. There is burning in pit of stomach. Everything tastes too salty.

name: Silicea
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
SILICEA is one of the twelve wonders of the Schuessler’s Tissue Remedies. It is a great polychrest and has got powerful hold on the human economy. Silicea is a long and deep-acting constitutional remedy which was proved and incorporated in Homoeopathic Materia Medica by Hahnemanh.

It occurs in abundance in nature and is chemically “inert” in its natural state, but once it is potentised, it works like a miracle.

Silicea has been proved to be a boon to the suffering humanity and serves the purpose of “SURGEON’S KNIFE” in the hands of a Homoeopath. It is capable of reaching and curing the derangement in the most vital process of life; in the internal sphere of man, where “SURGEON’S KNIFE” can never

reach.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Abdomen distended, Abdominal disorders, Abscess, Ankles weak, Boils, Bone affection, Cancer, Carbuncle, Constipation, Cough, Debility, Dentition, Diabetes, Enuresis, Epilepsy, Fistula, Foot-sweat suppressed. Foreign body expulsion of, Glandular swelling, Headache, Hernia, Perspiration offensive, Pleurisy, Rheumatism, Rickets, Somnambulism, Skin troubles, Suppuration, Sweat, Sexual organs’ ailments, Teeth—caries of, Tenesmus, Ulcers, Urethra—stricture of, Urinary trouble, Vaccination

after effects, Vertigo, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Silicea acts on bones, cartilages, mucous membranes, skin, elastic and cellular tissues, nerves, glands, lachrymal duct, Eustachian tube, etc.

It is a pus-forming remedy, it promotes and controls suppuration and hastens formation of abscesses and boils (Merc. sol., Hepar sulph.). Hence it should not be given to the patient in whom there is a deposit of tubercular focus in the lungs even after the filling of the tubercular focus in the lungs is complete, because it has got a tendency to re-establish an inflammation and throw it out, resulting in the formation of abscess of the lungs again.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Chronic sick headache since some severe diseases of youth.

Location: Headache arises from the nape of neck ascends the vertex and finally settles over the right eye; generally right sided headache.

Sensation: Sensation of roaring or shattering in brain.

Character of headache: Pressing and bursting headache as if eyes and brain were forced out. Violent headache with confusion of mind. Violent tearing in head with pressive pain in morning. Jerking headache extending to brain. Tearing in vertex as if it would burst. Headache with bruised pain above the eyes so that the patient can scarcely open them.

Modalities

* Aggravation: By mental exertion, noise, motion, jerking, light, stooping, cold air, uncovering, draught of air.

* Amelioration: By binding the head tightly, by profuse urination and covering the head warmly.

Concomitants: There is difficulty in holding up the head. Headache causes chilliness and nausea. Scalpisvery sensitive to touch. The patient is very chilly with low vitality. He is usualty-eonstipated.

Gastro-intestinal symptoms

Stomach. There is disgust for meat and WARM FOOD. Loss of appetite or ravenous hunger with great thirst, but vomiting occurs after drinking (Arsenic, Ver.alb.).

Abdomen : There is painful cold feeling in the abdomen with much rumbling and colicky pain, better from application of external heat; obstinate constipation.

Rectum : There is sensation of weakness or paresis whichresults in obstinate constipation so much so that faeces is retained for a long time in the rectum, Stool passes out with great straining (Alumina, Nux vom., Nux mos., Nat mur., Thuja). The pecullarity of the constipation and the stool is that it is partly expelled and then recedes back again (Thuja). Consequently the stool has to be removed mechanically (Calc. carb.).

Fistula in ano alternates with chest complaints. (Berb. vul, Calc. phos).

Painful fissures and haemorrhoids which cause Irritation and spasm of the sphincter-ani muscles. Constipation always occurs before, during and after menses.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The Demerara pink root, a grass from which this drug has been prepared was used in the days of Galen and Aristotle as a worm expeller antihelminth. The leaves of this shrub was pounded together with some sweetening agent and was used in crude physiological doses to expel round worms particularly in children. Hence Master Hahnemann unto whom we owe the introduction of this medicine to the Homoeopathic system, named it Spigelia Anthelmic.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Angina pectoris, Ciliary neuralgia, Cold, Constipation Depression of spirit, Eyes— pain in, Glaucoma, Headache, Heart affections, Neuralgia, Toothache, Worms, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Spigelia acts especially upon the fibrous and muscular tissues of eyes and heart. The nerves especially the fifth Cranial nerve—Trigeminal nerve—is affected by this medicine. The head, particularly the left side is affected.

When affecting the eyes—left being more common, it produces congestion, redness and intolerable pain with dilated pupils; even the headache of left side centres on the left eye. Heart produces violent contractions resulting in roaring heart. Trigeminal neuralgia is one of the main pathogenetic effects when it affects cranial nerves. The fibrous tissues produce a state of inflammation, rheumatic, arthritis, etc.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Spigelia is especially adapted to anaemic, debilitated subjects who are brokendown, pale with light hair and yellow skin. In children who are afflicted with ascarides and luimbrici.

Temperament; Nervous temperament.

Relation with heat and cold: Chilly patient. Even open air is unbearable. Miasm: Psora is in the background. Diathesis: Rheumatic diathesis.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This remedy was introduced into our Materia Medica by Samual Hahnemann. According to Hahnemann toasted sponge was first mentioned as a specific, remedy for goitre by Arnald Von Villanova. It contains Iodine and certain other ingredients of minor importance.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Angina Pectoris. Asthma. Cough. Croup. Goitre- Exophthalmic. Heart-affections. Laryngitis. Rheumatic fever. Testicles-inflammation of. Tuberculosis. Whooping cough.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS
sections.content:
Its chief action is on the respiratory tract, larynx & trachea. It also acts on heart & glands, especially, thyroid & testes. CONSTITUTION

Physical make up : It is especially adapted to diseases of children and women & persons having light hair, lax fibre, fair complexion.

Heat & Cold relation : Chilly patient. Miasm : Psoric, Syphilitie & Sycotic. All the three miasms are in the background. Diathesis : Tubercular diathesis.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Swelling & induration of glands.

2) Awakens in a fright and feels as if suffocating; as if he had to breathe through a sponge.

3) Great dryness of mucous membranes of air passages—throat, larynx, trachea, bronchi — “dry as a horn.”

4) Goitre : Thyroid glands swollen even with chin; with suffqcative paroxysms at night.

5) Cough : Dry, barking, croupy; sibilant like a saw driven through a pine board < from sweets, cold drinks, lying with head low > from eating & drinking warm

things’.

576

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Respiratory Symptoms:

Spongia is one of the routine remedies for croupy cough in our practice. There is great dryness of mucous membranes of air passages such as throat, larynx, trachea, bronchi, etc.

Throat

There is dryness of mucous membranes of throat and stitching pain, There is also burning, stinging and tickling which causes cough. Patient clears throat constantly.

Sore throat : Aggravation after eating sweets.

Cough

Causation— Exposure : Exposure to dry cold wind, cold drinks, tobacco smoking, sweets.

Character of cough : Cough is dry, barking.gasping, ringing, wheezing, whistling. As there is great dryness of all air passages, cough is dry, sibilant like a saw driven through a pine board and usually with no mucous rales. Sometimes there may be asthmatic cough with wheezing, suffocation and profuse expectoration.

Modalities

Aggravation : Dry cold wind, cold drinks, sweets, smoking, lying with head low, mental excitement.

Amelioration ; Eating or drinking warm things

Croup

Croup is anxious, wheezing and worse during inspiration and before midnight. (Aggravation during expiration—Aeon; Agg. before morning, Hep. Sulph)

Asthma

Asthma from taking cold, after menses, in consequence of goltre with organic disease of heart. Patient cannot lie down and fears she will die of suffocation. After every slight motion looses her breath & becomes faint.

Modalities

Agg : At full moon, after sleep. Amelio :; Bending forward.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: In the good old ancient days, long before Hahnemann, the application of this nut, was in existence evidently in domestic practice for the cure of toothache. The nut was known to an agent for producing vomiting and salivation and used for the cure toothache. Teste found Staphisagria a remedy for sea-sickness. To be successful, Staphisagria must be taken at the moment when dizziness and nausea commence, before vomiting sets in and it will give instantaneous relief. It is the best remedy for removing the habit of masturbation in young subjects and also for removing abnormal appetite in adults.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Anger fits of, Backache, Cauliflower excrescences, Chalazion, Condylomata, Cough, Eczema, Eyes-tumours on Masturbation—effects of, Neuralgia, Prostate—affections of, Rheumatism, Sciatica, Sexual organs affection, Skin affection, Selfabuse, Spermatorrhoea, Styes, Teeth affection, Urinary affection, Warts etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seats of action of Staphisagria are genitourinary organs, brain, mindrgastro-intestianal tract, respiratory organs and skin. PATHOGENESIS

It causes irritation and inflammation on the genitourinary organs, especially prostatic portion of the urethra and ejaculatory and seminal ducts, producing sexual desire and excitement, leading to abuse of sex, retention of urine, etc. It also causes- various skin troubles such as styes, chalazae, eczema, warts, etc.

Mental affections are caused by onanism, sexual excess, sexual abuse, pride, envy or chagrin and anger with indignation.

The patient is very sensitive to slightest me’ntal impression and least action. Even harmless word offends (Ign.).

Great indignation about things done by others or by himself; but grieves about consequences,

The patient is very apathetic and indifferent; low-spirited and has weak memory from sexual abuse (Anac., Aur., Nat., Phos acid).

Ill humoured children cry for things which, after receiving, they petulantly push and throw away (Bry., Cham., cina., Kreosote).

The patient was insulted, but being too dignified to fight, subdued his wrath and went home sick, trembling and exhausted; very much abashed and apprehensive.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eyes

Styes and chalazae appear on upper lids or on both the eyelids; coming on one after another and when they disappear, hard nodosities are left in their place (Conium, Thuja).

Gastro-intestinal Symptoms

Toothache : There is toothache appearing during menses. Both sound and decayed toothache. But the peculiarity of the toothache is that the teeth are very painful to the touch of food and drink, but not from biting or chewing. Toothache is aggravated by drawing in cold air into the mouth and from cold drinks and after eating (rev. of mez.). The teeth turn black, show dark streaks through them; cannot keep them clean, tooth crumbles and decays at edges (Decays at root and crown intact, Thuja, Mez.— Crown decay and roots intact, Merc. sol.). Scorbutic cachexia.

Stomach : Sensation as if the stomach and abdomen feel hanging down and relaxed (Agar., Ipec.). There is extreme appetite even when the stomach is full of food (Cina, Lyco., Lac can.). Ravenous hunger for days before attack of fever. There is also colicky pain in abdomen after lithotomy or ovariotomy. Nausea, vomiting during pregnancy.

Urine symptoms : There is nervous weakness as if done up after much hard work. The patient has urgent urging to urinate; still has to sit at the urinal for hours before urine will pass. This symptom is especially noticed in newly married women after coition or after difficult labour, There is, burning in urethra when not urinating. Prolapse of urinary bladder (cystocele) is a common feature. Where there are prostatic troubles in old men even after urinating, there is urging followed by pain.

Sexual organs : Due to sexual excess or sexual abuse, the patient feels very much guilty, with sunken face and abashed look; very much weak and prostrated. Sexual organs are relaxed and atrophied, with nocturnal emission followed by weakness and prostration. Sexual organs are very painful and sensitive. Vulva is so sensitive that the patient can hardly wear a napkin (platina). There ts intolerable sexual desire and excitement and, therefore, the patient is persistently dwelling upon sexual subjects and constantly thinking of sexual pleasure.

Spermatorrhoea caused by sexual excess and/or sexual abuse Is successfully treated by this drug.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It is a little known and a rarely used remedy, put that does not render it any the less important for those cases that will call for sticta, will need sticta, none but sticta will help.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Anosmia, Atrophic Rhinitis. Catarrh. Cough. Headache. Housemaid’s Knee. Rheumatism.

SPHERES OF ACTION AND PATHOGENESIS It Chiefly acts on respiratory tract & joints; but also having action on head, gastrointestinal & genitourinary tracts. GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Respiratory Symptoms :

Nose : Feeling of fullness at the root of the nose is the charac-teristic symptom of Sticta. There is dryness of nasal mucous membrane not due to lack of secretion, but secretions dry up very rapidly leaving thick crusts behind them. The patient blows his nose, but no dishcarge comes out, There may be incessant sneezing, hay fever etc.

Cough :The Cough of Sticta is also mostly dry, but loose in the morning. It is an important drug in cases of cough left after measles. Throat is raw with posterior dropping of mucus and dry hacking cough. (Sang, Eup. Perf, Puls.)

Modalities : Aggravation—Inspiration, towards evening and when tired. Concomitant—Rheumatism precedes catarrhal symptoms

2) Headache : Sticta is suited to catarrhaj headache before discharge appears. There is dull headache with heavy pressure in forehead and root of the nose. Sensation as if scalp was too small may be there,

3) Rheumatism Causation : Fall.

Location : Specially right shoulder, Knee Joints and neck are affected. (Cheli, Mag. Garb. Sang., Strontia).

Sensation : There is drawing & shooting pains in joints, Joints are red, painful & swollen.

name: Stramonium
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Stramonium, the last of the great TRIO OF DELIRIUM, is a wonderful remedy obtained from the vegetable kingdom. Thorn apple is very poisonous, affecting primarily the brain and secondarily other organs. Hahnemann’s high intelligence penetrated into this aspect of the problem and transformed this very destructive poisonous property into a useful unique remedy applied successfully for the characteristic mental derangement. It has been found to be very useful for the human race for all time to come.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Apoplexy, Chorea, Delirium tremens, Ecstasy, Epilepsy, Eye affection, Headache, Hysteria, Mania, Meningitis, Stammering, Trismus, Vomiting, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
The main seats of action of Stramomium, are nervous system, brain, mind, skin and mucous membrane.

The action of this agent is very similar to that of Belladonna, except that the sympathetic nervous system is more affected by this drug than by Belladonna. It is a powerful narcotic and antispasmodic. The heart’s action is rendered more irregular than by Belladonna and the involuntary muscular fibres or the bronchial tubes are relaxed to a great extent. It produces suppressed secretions and excretions of mucous membrane.

CONSTITUTION

Just like Belladonna, Stramonium too is more or less a drug required mostly in acute cases and as such the consideration of constitution of the patient is of little importance. However, it is more adapted to young plethoric persons and especially children in chorea, mania and fever with delirium.

Temperament: Bilious temperament, Relations with heat and cold: Easily affected by cold in general. Miasm: Psora is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1, “Painlessness” is a very characteristic and striking feature of Stramonium. There

2.

is no pain with most of the complaints (Opium).

The patient DESIRES LIGHT AND COMPANY. Cannot bear to be alone for a moment. Always wants light, but dazzling light (e.g. light reflected from a mirror or flowing water) aggravates the troubles.

. Great LOQUACITY is yet another important guiding symptom (Lach., Podo.). The

patient is disposed to talk continuously; incessant and incoherent talking and laughing, PRAYING,, BESEECHING, ENTREATING, etc.

. The patient always feels sleepy, but cannot sleep (Bell., Cham. Op.). . During delirium and convulsion, there is twitching of single muscle or group of

muscles, especially of upper part of the body (Aconite, Agaricus, Cicuta).

. Convulsion with consciousness (Nux vom.) is very characteristic of this remedy;

renewed by sight of bright light.

. Vomiting as soon as he raises head from the pillow, or from bright light.

8. The patient feels that his head is scattered about in many pieces.

11.

. He awakes with a shrinking look as if afraid of the first object seen. 10.

Sight of water or anything gjittering or reflected light brings on spasm and convulsion. It is simply intolerable.

Mind : Stramonium, the last of the trio, is pre-eminently a high grade ‘delirium remedy. The mental symptoms very commonly found in this important remedy, which would help selection on the basis of similinum, are as follows:—

Loquacity is of the topmost degree in Stramonium. During delirium, the patient talks all the time, sings, makes verses, and raves; nonstop and incoherent talking and laughing.

In this respect it is very similar to Belladonna and Hyoscydmus, but only differing in degree. Stramonium is very furious. Mania more acute and Congestion is more than in Hyoscyamus but less than that of Belladonna. However, there is no inflammation in Stramonium, as is usually found in Belladonna.

The patient has a disposition continuously for PRAYING, BESEECHING AND ENTREATING, especially with suppression of menses in ladies.

THE PATIENT ALWAYS WANTS AND DESIRES LIGHT AND COMPANY. Yet cannot tolerate shining bright object or reflected or dazzling light such as from a mirror or flowing water. He cannot bear solitude and darkness; cannot remain in a dark room alone.

From the sleep he awakes with a shrinking look aa if he is very much afraid of the object first seen. He is too much terrified by hallucinations.

During delirium, the patient gets up and wants to escape and, therefore, he runs away, and hides himself in a corner, difficult to be located.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Headache is caused by shock, Sun's heat or fright. Location: There is intolerable pain in forehead and over the eyebrows.

Sensation: There is boring pain in forehead and tempjes. Head feels as if scattered about in many pieces.

Modalities: Aggravation: After sleep, in darkness or looking at bright object. Relieved: By warmth.

Concomitants: Preceded by obscure vision. Rush of blood to head. Raises the head frequently from the pillow. Vertigo with tendency to-fall forward and to left.

Eyes

Eyes are wide open, prominent and brilliant; pupils are widely dilated; insensible; contortion of eyes and eyelids. Pupils dilate when child is reprimanded. Loss of vision, complains that it is dark and calls for light. Small objects look large. All objects look black.

Face

Face is red and hot with cold hands and feet. There is circumscribed redness on the cheeks. (Sang.). Blood rushes to face with an expression of terror. Pale face, sometimes facial expression shows as if smiling (Risus sardonicus). Mouth is dry, with viscid saliva; yet aversion to water. Stammering tendency. The patient has to exert himself a long time before he can utter a word. Cannot swallow on account of spasm of glottis; chewing motion of the mouth,

The patient vomits persistently mucus and green bile as soon as he raises head from the pillow.

Convulsion

There is convulsion with consciousness (Nux vom.) which is very striking in this drug. Graceful thythmic motion, convulsion especially of upper extremities and upper part of the body. There is twitching and jerking of single muscle or a group of muscles (Acon., Agaricus, Cicuta, Zincummet.). Chorea with violent pain in left hip, Trembling and twitching of tendons.

The convulsive attack is aggravated by dazzling and shining lights and objects.

The patient has fear of water with excessive aversion to liquids. Spasmodic contraction of throat. Hydrophobia.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Sulphur is one ot the greatest ‘POLYCHRESTS’. IT IS THE KING OF ANTIPSORIC HAVING a wide range in Homoeopathic prescribing. Hahnemann says that Sulphur has reputation as a remedy against itch perhaps as old as medicine i.e., as early as 2000 years ago. Sulphur is a non-metallic yellow, brittle substance. It is found in plenty in Sicily and Italy. In the organic world, we meet with Sulphur everywhere. This element forms an essential component of the albuminoids, a class of compounds contained in all vegetable and animal structures. Sulphur is prepared for Homoeopathic use in two different ways, firstly the flowers of sulphur washed and cleaned, are mixed with alcohol to form the tincture; secondly by triturating flowers of sulphur with sugar of milk.

Acne, Anaemia, Asthma, Biliousness, Boils, Brain complaints, Catarrh, Cough. Diarrhoea, Dysentery, Eye affection, Eczema, Emaciation, Enuresis, Epilepsy, Eructation. Eruptions, Feet burning, Perspiring, Fever, Gout, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Liver affection, Menstrual disorders, Neuralgia, Pleurisy, Pregnancy disorders, Rheumatism. Skin affection,. Throat and Lung affection, Vertigo, Worms, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Its action is centrifugal, from within outwards. It has great affinity for the skin. No remedy has more general, positive and persistent action upon the skin than Sulphur. It acts pre eminently on the nervous system, also affecting the venous capillary system and through it affecting profoundly, the entire vegetative sphere. Mucous membranes also feel most severely the influence of Sulphur, especially of eyes, bronchi, urethra and rectum. The portal system also comes under its special influence.

PATHOGENESIS

Subjected to venous plethora. It has portal stasis manifesting as redness at the muco- cutaneous junctions e.g. nostrils, lips, anus, etc. Affecting the skin, it produces heat and burning with severe itching.

Throat and Lung affection, Vertigo, Worms, etc.
SPHERES OF ACTION: Its action is centrifugal, from within outwards. It has great affinity for the skin. No remedy has more general, positive and persistent action upon the skin than Sulphur. It acts pre eminently on the nervous system, also affecting the venous capillary system and through it affecting profoundly, the entire vegetative sphere. Mucous membranes also feel most severely the influence of Sulphur, especially of eyes, bronchi, urethra and rectum. The portal system also comes under its special influence.

PATHOGENESIS

Subjected to venous plethora. It has portal stasis manifesting as redness at the muco- cutaneous junctions e.g. nostrils, lips, anus, etc. Affecting the skin, it produces heat and burning with severe itching.
PARTICULARS: Gastro-intestinal system :

Abdomen : There is WEAK, EMPTY, ALL GONE OR FAINT FEELING IN THE ABDOMEN AT

ABOUT 11 A.M. Cannot wait for lunch. Frequent, weak, faint spells during the day with burning sensation.

There is great desire for sweets. Aggravation from milk and meat. Movement in the abdomen as of a foetus, Is felt by the patient.

Constipation

* Causation: Alcoholism and suppression of skin eruption, * Character of stool: Stoo! is very much HARD, KNOTTY, DRY AS IF BURNT, LARGE AND

PAINFUL. Difficult and painful defaecation. The patient is afrak! fo pass stool on account of pain, or pain compels the patient to give up the effort, and the discharge of faeces is painful to parts over which it passes.

¢ Constipation alternates with diarrhoea.

name: Symphytum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Symphytum is a great vulnerary remedy, same as Arnica and Ruta. It is also called ‘Camfrey’ and it belongs to the natural order of Borraginaceae. It may be con-sidered the orthopaedic specific of herbal medicine.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Backache, Bone-injuries of, fracture of, cancer of. Eyes—pains in, injuries of. Fractures,—non- union of. Sexual excess-effects of. Sprains. Stump-irritable, wounds,

1) Symphytum facilitates union of fractured bones (Gale, phos) by favouring production of callus

2) It lessens peculier pricking pain of fracture of bones.

3) For the periosteal pain after wounds have healed or irrita-bility at point of fracture.

4) Pain in eye after mechanical injuries; bruises, fall of an obtuse body, when snow strikes the eye, or when infant thrusts its fist into its mother’s eye.

5) Backache from excessive sexual indulgence with sper-matorrhoea.

6) Ailments from—Fractures. Injuries (to eye, bone; perios-teum) Falls. Blows. Sexual excesses.

Relations Follows well: After Arnica for pricking pain, and soreness of periosteum remaining

name: Syphilinum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This great nosode of historical importance, has been introduced into the Homoeopathic Materia Medica by Dr. Swan. He prepared it from the syphilitic discharges and used it in the treatment of syphilitic patients. He has., of course, done it empirically after potentising according to the Doctrine of Dynamisation. At present, it. holds the place of the “KING OF ANTI-SYPHILITICS” amongst the nosodes so far proved.

Dr. Hering remarks, “No patient having syphilitic history in the past can be declared cured until and unless this nosode is administered at least once in the course of the treatment. So much is its importance if adequately given”.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abscess, Alcoholism, Asthma, Boils, Constipation, Deltoid rheumatism, Dentitipn, Diplopig, Heart troubles, Headache, Leucorrhoea, Neuralgia, Ozoena, Ptosis, Rheumatism, Sciatica, Syphilis, Ulcers, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It acts chiefly on the brain and spinal cord. Bones, periosteum, skin and mucous membrane also come under the spheres of action of this drug.

PATHOGENESIS

Its action results in manifestation of various stages of syphilis in different organs. nervous symptoms, brain and heart.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: Many different types of eruptions; particularly copper coloured, which become blue on getting cold,

Temperament: Melancholic temperament.

Miasm: Syphilis is in the background.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content: 1. Whenever there is a history of syphilis in the patient or in the family, we should think of Syphilinum.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Eye

In ophthalmia neonatorum, chronic and recurrent phlyctenular inflammation of cornea, this remedy

is indicated as follows:

Location: Especially in the left eye. Successive crops of phlyctenule and abrasion of epithelial layer

of cornea.

Character of pain; There is intense sharp, pulsating pain with intense photophobia. Lids are

swollen and adhere during sleep. Furthermore, there is ptosis consequent upon paralyisis of superior oblique muscle of the eye. Sleepy look from drooping lids. Diplopia, one image seen below the other

Modialities

¢ Aggravation: From 2 to 5 a.m., at night. ¢ Amelioration: By cold application.

Headache

Causation: Sunstroke, excitement and syphilis. Location: Across the temple,

Sensation: As if head would be crushed, with sense of weight and bursting in the vertex. Character of pain: Neuralgic pain, intolerable pain. Violent pain In the whole head with red face,

enlarged veins of the face, restless and sleepless night. Lancinating pain in the eyes. Pain increases and decreases gradually. Pains frequently shifting place with change of position.

name: Syzygium Jambolanum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Diabetes melitus, Prickly heat. Ulcers;

It is a native of India, The tincture is prepared from pow-dered seeds. The fruit is of the size of grapes, black in colour and tastes delicious.

It is a most useful remedy in diabetes melitus as it causes a marked diminution of sugar in urine.

Great thirst, weakness, emaciation inspite of proper nutriti-ous diet, profuse urination of high specific gravity, are the characteristic indications.

Prickly heat in upper part of the body. Small red pimples with much itching. This is also one of the important symptoms which the author has verified (can be given exter-nally and internally).

It is also to be thought of in old ulcers of skin associated with diabetes melitus.

name: Tabacum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: The symptoms of the pathogenesis are composed partly of provings made by Lembke Schreter and others and partly of poisonings and overdosings.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Amaurosis, Angina Pectoris. Asthma. Backache. Cholera. Constipation. Diarrhoea. Headache. Hiccough. Pregnancy sickness. Renal colic. Sea sickness. Vertigo etc. Hypertension. Heart-dilatation of.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
It has profound, action on nerves espe-cially Vagi and Heart. It also acts on eyes, G.L. Tract, and urinary system.

It causes cerebal irritation followed by marked irritation of functions of Vagi. It produces muscular prostration, free secretions. It produces (brings forth) symptoms, which are experienced by people who had taken tobacco first time in their lives such as nausea, vomiting, salivation, giddiness even one may faint with prostation and cold

sweating.

CONSTITUTION Make-up : Patient is emaciated, pale, blue, sunken, Emaciation of cheeks and back. Sometimes deathly pallorness covered with cold sweat.

Heat cold relation : Hot patient. Miasm : All the 3 miasms are in the background but it is chiefly an antipsoric remedy. GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Deathly nausea, vomiting, and giddiness with death like pallor.

2) Vertigo on opening the eyes (on closing the eyes—Lach., Thuja., Theri.)

3) Icy coldness of surface; covered with cold sweat.

4) A weak, faint sinking feeling at pit of stomach.

5) Child wants abdomen uncovered which relieves nausea & vomiting. a ————— 603

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

It is needed in periodical sick headache which begins in the morning increases during day and last of until evening (Sang C., Spig. Nat M, Nat Carb. etc.) and lastig one or two days.

Location : Whole head especially right side.

Sensation : Pain as if struck by a hammer or club. Tight feeling as from band (Gels., Spig. etc.) Modalities : Aggravation—by noise light, motion.

Amelioration : in open fresh air.

Concomitant : Deathly nausea and vomiting. There may be vertigo on opening the eyes.

Vertigo

Vertigo on opening the eyes is a strong feature of this remedy. It increases loss of consciousness with death like pallor. Vertigo on rising or looking upward and is relieved in open fresh air and by vomiting.

Eyes

It has a good action over the eyes.

Dim sighted—Sees as through a veil.

Amaurosis—From atrophy of retina or optic nerve, Fre-quent recurrence of amblyopia. It is also to be thought of in stravismus when depending upon brain troubles.

Heart

It has been recommended in dilatation of the heart caused by a shock or violent physical exertion and in angina with high tension.

Sensation : Constriction of throat and tightness feeling across the upper part of the chest. Pain :Pain in praecordial region. Pain radiates from centre of sternum. Pulse :Feeble, imperceptible and intermittent.

Modality : Aggravation on least motion, Indoor (in warm room) relleved in open fresh cold air, uncovering.

name: Taraxacum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This remedy deserves mention by reasons of its curative value in affections of the liver, such as gallstone, bilious attacks, jaundice & typhoid fever.

IDING SYMPTOMS : .

1) Mapped tongue (Lach, Merc, Nat. M.) covered with a white film with sensation of rawness. This film comes off in patches, leaving dark red, tender, very sensitive spots.

2) Jaundice with enlargement & induration of liver.

3) Debility and profuse night sweats, esp. when convalesc-ing from bilious or typhoid fever.

4) Loss of appetite.

5) Gastric headaches with sensation of great-heat on top of head & mapped tongue. There may be jaundiced skin.

6) Limbs are very restless & painful to touch, in typhoid fever (Rhus., Zin.)

7) Fever Chilli—Chilliness after eating & aggravated by drinking.

Heat : Heat stage without thirst. Heat in face & in toes. During fever finger tips cold & bitter taste in mouth.

Sweat—Perspiration on falling asleep. General Modalities :

Aggravation ; Almost all symptoms appear when sitting ; lying down ; resting. Relations :

Compare : Bry, chel., Hydr., Nux in gastric and bilious affections.

name: Tarentula Cubensis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Though it is not a polychrest medicine as it has limited sphere of action, still it has got the power to make Surgeon’s knife useless and relieves the most serious cases of blood boils, carbuncle, felons and gangrene etc. In Allen’s Keynote Tarentula Hispania & Tarentula cubensis both are given under one heading ‘Tarantula” though they are different medicines. Tarentula cubensis is a larger spider of a dark brown colourless poisonous variety & covered with more hair than the Tarentula Hispania.

Tarentula Cubensis is prepared from the whole hairy spider. This spider is very poisonous.

Clinical Anthrax. Abscess. Carbuncle. Fever. Felon. Gangrene. Septic Fever. Ulcer ete.

Tarentula cubensis is a medicine for above mentioned dis-eases when there is severe type inflammations and septic conditions and even malignancy, if the following symptoms are present.

1) Atrocious burning pains, stinging pains, make the patient restless and compels him to walk at night. It is the remedy for pains of death.

2) Bluish, purple, discolouration of affected part with swelling.

3) Very early & persistent prostration.

4) Intermittent septic chills.

5) Hyperaesthesia relieved by constant movement & some kind of friction.

6) Modalities : Aggravation—at night, contact, touch of affected parts Amelioration—Rubbing affected parts.

Dr. Benthack says Tarentula Cubensis and Arsenicum Alb. are complementary to tach other in septic inflammatory states,

607

name: Tarentula Hispania
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Tarentula is a deep and long acting medicine. This spider is very poisonous in nature. Those who are bitten by this spider or those who imagine them-selves to have been bitten by it develop “Tarantism” which means dancing mania.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Chorea. Epilepsey. Hysteria. Paralysis agitans. Nymphomania. Multiple sclerosis. Pruritus vul-vae. Tabes dorsalis. etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content: Many symptoms of body are confined to right side. Its main action is over the nervous system espe-cially the termini of nerves, genito-urinary system.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Restlessness : Cannot keep quiet in any position, must keep in motion though walking aggravates all symptoms.

2) Constant movement of the legs, arms, trunk with inability to do anything.

3) Hyperaesthesia—Least excitement irritates followed by languid sadness, especially

of tips of finger.

4) Very sensitive to music. It relieves nearly all symptoms but sometimes it excites violently.

5) Craves raw food ; aversion to food & meat.

6) Thirst for cold water.

7) Extreme sexual desire leading to mania.

8) Annual Periodicity of symptoms is marked. (Ars, Garb. Veg, Lach, Siilph, Thuja)

9) At every menstrual period tongue, mouth & throat get intolerably dry especially while sleeping.

10) Cough only relieved from smoking.

Mind : Anxiety of mind and body. Cardiac anxiety is promi, nent, Strong aversion to striking colours such as green, red & black. Very sensitive to music. It relieves all symptoms, but sometime it excites violently. Loss of shame, lascivious, uncontrollable sexual desire.

name: Terebinthina
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
The oil of turpentine, a clear colourless liquid is obtained by the distillation of the exudation from certain varieties of the pine.

Terebinthina was introduced to homoeopathy by Hartlaub. A proving of it appeared in Hartlaub and Trinks’ Annalen. Many symptoms have been added from poisonings and over- dosings in old-school practice.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Albuminuria, Cystitis, Dropsy, Diarrhoea. Enteric fever. Haematuria Kidneys-Congestion of, neuralgia of. Purpura haemorrhagica. Scarlatina, Sciatica. Strangury. Tympanitis. Uraemia. Urine-suppression of. Worms.

Spheres of action & Pathogenesis : This remedy has a selec-tive affinity for mucous membrances of kidneys ; bladder and urethra, also respiratory and gastrointestinal tract. It also acts on heart, blood and skin. It checks haemorrhage from the bowels, kidneys, bladder, lungs, uterus and anus, spe-cially when the ejected blood shows signs of

degeneration.

GUIDING SYMPTOMS :

1) Tongue : Tongue symptoms of Terebinthina are very characteristics for the selection of a remedy than any other symptoms.

(a) Tongue smooth, glossy, red, as if deprived of pa-pillae or as if glazed. The papillae may be elevated.

(b) The coating of tongue peels off in patches leaving bright red spots, or entire coating cleans off suddenly.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Bone-affections of Caries, Cough, Eye-teeth pain in Headache. Hysteria. Nausea. Necrosis. Nose-catarrh of Phthisis Florida, Pregnancy, sickness of Rickets. Scrofulosis. Sea sickness, Spinal irritation. Toothache, Vertigo.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION & PATHOGENESIS
sections.content:
This remedy chiefly acts on nervous system, bones, head, chest and teeth. It produces hypersensitiveness of nerves & causes spinal irritation. It affects the bones causing carries & necrosis.

CONSTITUTION

In Theridion there is no worth mentioning look of the patient, however, patient is hysterical and sensative to cold. It is chiefly an anti-psoric and anti-syphilitic remedy.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Every sound seems to penetrate through the whole body, causing nausea & vertigo.

2) Vertigo on closing the eyes (Lach., Thuja) and from any, even least noise.

3) Nausea, esp. oh closing the eyes, from least motion and from fast riding in a carriage.

4) Toothache : every shrill sound penetrates the teeth.

5) For Extreme nervous sensitiveness : of puberty, during pregnancy and climacteric years.

6) Seasickness of nervous women : they close their eyes to get rid of the motion of the vessel and grow deathly sick.

7) Headache : When begining to move. Location : Forehead & temples.

name: Thlaspi Bursa Pastoris
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: It is one of the important anti haemorrhagic remedies of our Materia Medica and is frequently used by us to control uterine haemorrhage. In this respect it stands near the Sabina.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Abortion : haemorrhage after. Dysuria, Haematuria, Haemorrhages, Leucorrhoea, Metror-rhagia, Uterus-cancer of. Renal

Calculi. Fibroma.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Profuse, passive haemorrhage from every outlet of the body where the character of

blood is dark & clotted.

2) Metrorrhagia—wth violent cramps and uterine colic ; after abortion ; miscarriage or

labour, with cancer uteri.

3) Menses : Too early & too profuse. Protracted, tardy instarting; first day merely a show ; second day colic, vomiting, haemorrhage with large clots ; each alternate period more profuse. Exhausting haemorrhage from uterine inertia, scarcely

recovers from one period before another begins.

4) Haemorrhage accompanying uterine fibroid.

5) Leucorrhoea before and after menses (Graph.) ; bloody, dark offensive ; stains

difficult to Wash off.

6) Urinary symptoms: It is one of the anti Uric acid remedies and useful in renal colic, chornic cystitis, dysuria, haematuria and albuminuria during gestation, etc- There is frequent desire for urine with heavy urine containing brickdust

sediment and phosphates, RELATIONS

Compare : Sinapis, Trillium, Viburnum, Ustilago.

name: Thuja Occidentalis
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Thuja IS ONE OF HAHNEMANN’S GREATEST DISCOVERIES. Most of the medicines of his Materia Medica had been in vogue as therapeutic tools before his time. Of the therapeutic properties of Thuja, practically nothing was known until Hahnemann proved it. Subsequent observers have only confirmed the pathogenesis proved and established by Hahnemann. He specified it as “THE ONLY EFFICACIOUS REMEDY FOR FIG WARTS AND GONORRHOEA”. Hahnemann found in Thuja the antidote to the miasmatic condition which he termed. SYCOSIS, meaning thereby the constitutional } ok disease resulting from gonorrhoea and having its characteristic manifestations, viz.>

,faexcrescences in the form of warts, sometimes dry, more frequently soft and spongy, emitting a foetid fluid having a sweetish odour, bleeding readily and having a cauliflower-like from.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Abdomen distended, Abortion, Angina pectoris, Asthma, Cancer, Chorea, Condylomata, Constipation, Convulsion, Diarrhoea, Epilepsy, Eye affection, Gleet, Gonorrhoea, Haemorrhoids, Headache, Polypus, Prostatic disorders, Rheumatism, Tea— bad effects of, Teeth affection, Urinary affection, Vaccination, Warts, Whooping cough, etc.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Thuja acts on skin and genito-urinary organs. It has also got action on the nervous system, especially the brain, gastrointestinal tract, etc.

As far as the pathogenesis of the drug is concerned, HERING states that it has too many characteristic actions.

On the fluids: “Dissolution of fluids of the body, which become acrid, probably caused by Thuja which perverts lymphatic secretions; disturbs digestion and sanguinification.”

In the vegetative sphere: A surplus of life producing matter undergoes nearly unlimited proliferation in the shape of pathological vegetations, in the shape of

615

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Fig-warts, condylomata and wart-like excrescences upon the mucous membrane and cutaneous surfaces of the body.

2. Thuja bears the same relation to sycosis that Sulphur does to psora and Mercury to syphilis.

3. Thuja is a left-sided drug. Left side principally affected; left ovaryr! left testis, left side of abdomen, left kidney, etc.

4. The medicine should be thought of in bad effects of vaccination (Silicea, Antim. tart., Mezerium, Crotalus hor.).

5. Mucopurulent, copious foul smelling discharges from all the mucus membranes of the body.

6. There is SWEAT ONLY ON THE UNCOVERED PARTS OR ALL OVER, EXCEPTING THE HEAD, ESPECIALLY AT NIGHT WHEN HE SLEEPS. Sweating stops when he wakes (China, Con., Cactus—sweat only during wakingl hours, Sambucus). Perspiration on genitals smells like honey.

7. There is vertigo WHEN CLOSING THE EYES (Lachesis). 8. Teeth decay at the roots, crowns remain sound.

9. Coition prevented by extreme sensitiveness of the vagina.

name: Thyroidinum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
This remedy may be prepared either from the dried triturated thyroid gland of the sheep or calf or from extract made from it. To be able to arrive at a proper under- standing of its symptomatology one should consider the physiology of the gland. The administration of thyroid gland in large doses acclerates protein and fat metabolism and causes increased elimination of nitrogen, phosphorus, chlorine ete. Clinically polyuria, sweating, tachycardia, tre-mor, emaciation and glycosuria are observed. The removal of the thyroid gland

on the other hand leads to anaemia, oligaemia, myxoedema, cretinism and obesity.

Albuminuria, Amenorrhoea. Anaemia. Convul-sion. Cretinism. Dropsy. Eczema. Fractures. Goitre, Milk deficiency, Hysteroepilepsy. Myxaedema. Obesity. Psoriasis.

Headache. Enuresis. Rheumatic Arthritis. Undesce’nded testicle.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Thyroidinum acts upon glandular system especially thyroid gland,

genitalia, skin, nerves, blood, bones etc.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
female

1) It is suited to thin or obese persons with an irregular deposition of fat, but are

usually pale and anaemic. There may be exophthalmic look.

2) Chilly patient. There is sensation of chilliness with increased sensitivity to cold and

aggravation from cold.

3) A state of puffiness and obesity may be regarded as a keynote indication for

Thyrodinum—clarke.

4) Tachycardia.

5) Palpitation : From least exertion (Calc. Ars.)

6) Excessive sweating.

7) Craving for sweet.

Set

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Head

Persistent frontal headache. Feeling of lightness in brain. Eyeballs prominent. Fullness & heat in head with flushed face.

Eyes

Prominent Eyeballs, Progressive diminution of sight with central scotoma.

Stomach

Desire for sweets and thirst. for cold water. Nausea worse riding in car. Flatulence, much flatus in abdomen.

Respiratory symptoms Dry, painful cough with scanty, difficult expectoration and burning In pharynx. Urinary symptoms

Polyuria with increased flow, some albumen and sugar. Urine smells of violets, burning along urethra, increase of uric acid. Enuresis in weakly children who are nervous and irritable.

Heart

Weak, frequent pulse, with inability to lie down. Tachycardia. Palpitation from least exertion. Ready excitability of heart. Severe heart pain.

name: Trillium Pendulum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Another popular name for this plant is Beth—root, which sufficiently signifies its reputation as a great haemostat. Though this remedy has not been proved thoroughly, there is hardly any doubt as to its capacity to control haemorrhage, be it from nose, kidney, uterus or any other organ.

Tuberculinum is prepared from the pus of human pulmonary tubercle whereas Bacillinum is prepared from the lung tissue in which tubercular bacilli are detected microscopically. CLARKE makes no distinction between the two remedies. He says, ONE WILL ANSWER TO THE INDICATION OF THE OTHER ALLEN does not apparently recognise any difference between the two preparation in potencies.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Bladder-Catarrh of. Climaxis. Fainting with flooding. Fibroma-haemorrhages from. Haemorrhages-post-partum, anti-partum. Menorrhagia. Metror-rhagia.

Asthma, Bone caries of, Bronchitis, Boils, Catarrhal, Dentition, Diarrhoea, Erysipelas, Erythema, Headache, Heart affection, Influenza, Leucorrhoea, Meningitis, Menstrual disorders, Marasmus, Pleurisy, Meningitis tubercular, Phthisis, Pneumonia, Plica Polonica, Skin affection, Tuberculosis, etc.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) In haemorrhage from nose, lungs, kidneys, uterus or any other organ where the character of blood is usually pro-fuse, bright red and flow may be active or passive.

2) Menses : Every two weeks, lasting a week or longer and very profuse.

3) Flooding, with fainting ; faint, dim sight, palpitation, obstruction and noises in the ears.

4) Menorrhagia ; Flow profuse, gushing, bright red, at least movement (Sabina); from displaced uterus; at the climacteric; every two weeks ; dark clotted (Thlas. Ust).

5) Incipient phthisis with bloody sputa ; in advanced stages with copious, purulent expectoration and troublesome cough.

6) Sensation as if hips & small of back were falling to pieces ; as if sacro-illiac synchondroses were falling apart, wants to be bound tightly ; as if bone of pelvis

were broken vith haemorrhage.

RELATIONS : Complementary—to Cale Phos in menstrual and haemorrhagic affections.

1. Symptoms ever changing—are very striking. Symptoms change all the time affecting one organ after another, such as brain, lungs, liver, etc. (Lac can.). Symptoms begin suddenly and cease suddenly.

2. The patient takes told easily without knowing how and from where. Seems to take cold “every time he takes a breath of fresh air”.

3. This remedy can be thougt of when there is a family history of tubercular affections or when the best selected remedy fails to relieve or permanently improve, without reference to the name of the disease.

4. Emaciation rapid and pronounced. Losing flesh while living well (Abrot., Cale. Phos., Iodum, Silicea).

5. Sudden, early morning diarrhoea.

6. It is a good, remedy for bony suppurations especially in cases that have been resistant to other remedies.

7. Patient feels better in every way when in open air.

8. Chronic headache, when the best selected remedy only palliates. Also it is good for school girl’s headache even when suitable glasses fail to relieve, but the paient must have a tubercular history.

9. Crops of small boils which are intensely painful, appear successively, especially in nose, containing green foetid pus (Secale cor.).

10. Mind : The patient is very much PRECOCIOUS mentally but physically weak. He is irritable and fretful, especailly when waking up. Depressed and melancholic; despondent and morose.

The drug also has contradictory mental symptoms such as mania and melancholia, insomnia and sopor.

There is great fear of animals especially of DOGS. The patient has disposition and desire to use foul and filthy language to curse to swear.

The patient is naturally of asweet disposition, but now turned peevish, taciturn and sulky—on the boderland of insanity. Everything in the room seems to be strange as though in a strange place, despite the fact that the place and room are very familiar.

11. Ailments from tubercular heritage.

sections.title: SPHERES OF ACTION
sections.content:
Tuberculinum acts on skin, lungs, gastrointestinal tract, especially, bronchi, lungs, pleurae lymph glands, particularly those of cervical group. PATHOGENESIS

It affects the respiratory system manifesting as bronchitis, catarrhal pneumonia, tubercular pleurisy; the skin manifests itching eczema with scabies.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is especailly adapted to the light complexioned, narrow-chest subjects with blue eyes, who are tall, slim and active, but rapidly emaciate especially children. Persons who are very precocious mentally but weak physically.

Temperament: Nervous persons with the tubercular soil.

Relation with heat and cold: Highly chilly patient takes cold easily on slight exposure to cold air.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Headache

Causation: Tubercular history in family, chronic headache, when the best selected remedies only palliate.

10. Mind : The patient is very much PRECOCIOUS mentally but physically weak. He is irritable and fretful, especailly when waking up. Depressed and melancholic; despondent and morose.

The drug also has contradictory mental symptoms such as mania and melancholia, insomnia and sopor.

There is great fear of animals especially of DOGS. The patient has disposition and desire to use foul and filthy language to curse to swear.

The patient is naturally of asweet disposition, but now turned peevish, taciturn and sulky—on the boderland of insanity. Everything in the room seems to be strange as though in a strange place, despite the fact that the place and room are very familiar.

11. Ailments from tubercular heritage.
SPHERES OF ACTION: Tuberculinum acts on skin, lungs, gastrointestinal tract, especially, bronchi, lungs, pleurae lymph glands, particularly those of cervical group. PATHOGENESIS

It affects the respiratory system manifesting as bronchitis, catarrhal pneumonia, tubercular pleurisy; the skin manifests itching eczema with scabies.

CONSTITUTION

Physical make-up: It is especailly adapted to the light complexioned, narrow-chest subjects with blue eyes, who are tall, slim and active, but rapidly emaciate especially children. Persons who are very precocious mentally but weak physically.

Temperament: Nervous persons with the tubercular soil.

Relation with heat and cold: Highly chilly patient takes cold easily on slight exposure to cold air.
PARTICULARS: Headache

Causation: Tubercular history in family, chronic headache, when the best selected remedies only palliate.

name: Urtica Urens
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Urtica Urens is a remedy of a very ancient lineage. We find this remedy mentioned in the writings of Diascorides, who extolled it very highly as a great cleansing agent. In our time Dr. Burnett has taken it up and given it a very extensive proving.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content:
Agalactia. Bee-stings. Burns. Fever. Gout. Gravel. Pruritus. Rheumatism. Uraemia. Urticaria. Spleen-affections of. Menorrhagia.

SPHERE OF ACTION Skin and mucous membrane, mammae, genitourinary organs, spleen and joints.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1) Urticaria— Burning stinging and violent itching of skin, Urticaria disappears while lying down and reappears while getting up. It may come before rheumatism with fever. Burning in skin is aggravated after sleep.

2) Burns—It is used in “first degree of burns”"—locally and internally. It should be thought of even prior to Cantharis.

3) Rheumatism and Gout : Rheumatism alternates with urticaria. Uric acid diathesis.

4) Symptoms return at the same time every year

5) Dr. Burnett used Urtica urens in acute gout associated with fever.

6) Ailments from : Burns. Beestings. Flows. Suppressed milk. Suppressed nettle rash. Ill effects of shell fish and nettle rash.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Female

Uterine haemorrhage. Acrid and excoriating leucorrhoca, Pruritus vulvae, with stinging, itching and oedema.

author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: This remedy was proved by Dr. Hurt on himself and others. This is a fungus that grows on the Indian corn. The provings of this remedy brought out specific affin-ity for the generative sphere of both sexes. The next important sphere of this remedy is on the skin, hair and nails.

sections.title: PARTICULARS
sections.content:
Sexual Organs :

Male : Spermatorrhoea after onanism, emission every night, talking about women causes an emission. Seminal emission and irresistible desire to masturbation. There is constant aching distress in the testicles, more specially in the right. The pain is very severe & it shifts suddenly to the bowels, the pain is accompanied by nausea & cold sweat on the scrotum. Irritable weakness and relaxation of the male sexual organs with erotic fancies and seminal

emissions.

Female : The most valuable symptoms of this fungus are to be found in its action on the female generative organs.

Menses : Onset too easily.

Quantity : Too scanty, or too profuse.

During menses : Pains from back to loins and womb. Crampy pain, great nervous restlessness, flatulency, nausea which is relieved by eating (Bovista., Lith Garb, Anacardiur). Frequent, profuse

Modalities

Aggravation : from movement, before menses, in warm room, lying on affected side. (rev. of Puls.)

Amelioration : Lying down, in open air, (Puls.)

2) Useful in false pains preceding labour and after pains if pain is crampy and spasmodic in character.

3) Frequent and very early miscarriages causing sterility.

4) Reflex symptoms from uterine affection.

Extremities : Stiff, sore feeling In nape of neck. Feels as if back woukl break. Sacral backache. Lower extremities weak & heavy.

Leucorrhoea :Thin yellow—white colourless, except with stool, when it is thick, white, blood streaked. Excoriating.

name: Variolinum
author: Dubey
chapter: Dubey Text Book of Materia Medica

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
Variolinum is a drug belonging to the nosode family. The pus from the smallpox pustules is taken and potentised. It has only fragmentary

and partial provings and as such full therapeutic uses are not known.

sections.title: CLINICAL
sections.content: Chicken pox, Herpes Zoster, Smallpox, - prevention of.

sections.title: GUIDING SYMPTOMS
sections.content:
1. Generally Variolinum is used as a

preventive medicine for smallpox. It bears the same relation to smallpox that antitoxin does to diptheria.

2. As far as the curative value of this drug is concerned, it can be given in all cases of variola—whether single, confluent, haemorrhagic or malignant and in varioloid and vericella, if and when they appear even after vaccination is given.

3. But as a preventive against smallpox as well as a protection against it, this remedy is far superior to crude vaccination and is absolutely safe and free from any sequelae especially of septic and tubercular infection.

4. It protects from, modifies and cures smallpox.

5. It is also most efficacious, infallible and suitable in smallpox both for curative and preventive purposes in any potency—low or high.
